`android/tools/appcompat-test.ps1`:

```ps1
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Launch installed Android apps on WSA one by one and report how each one runs.

.DESCRIPTION
    For every package (all third-party packages by default, or -Packages) the script
    force-stops the app, launches it through its launcher activity, waits, and records:
      * whether the process is still alive and a Windows window for it is visible,
      * Java crashes (FATAL EXCEPTION) and native crashes (Fatal signal) during the run,
      * the app's primary ABI and how its native code runs (native x86, Google
        ndk_translation, Houdini).
    The result is printed as a Markdown table and saved next to the script's logs.
    Needs adb with root (userdebug build) to read /proc/<pid>/maps.

.EXAMPLE
    .\appcompat-test.ps1 -WaitSec 20
    .\appcompat-test.ps1 -Packages com.microsoft.emmx,com.whatsapp
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string[]] $Packages,
    [int] $WaitSec = 15,
    [string] $Serial = '127.0.0.1:58526',
    [string] $OutDir = 'C:\backup\wsa-appcompat'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Find-Adb {
    $cmd = Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    $sdk = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'
    if (Test-Path $sdk) { return $sdk }
    throw 'adb not found'
}
$adb = Find-Adb
function Invoke-Shell([string] $cmd) { (& $adb -s $Serial shell $cmd 2>$null) -join "`n" }

Add-Type -Namespace WsaNext -Name Win -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc cb, System.IntPtr l);
public delegate bool EnumWindowsProc(System.IntPtr h, System.IntPtr l);
[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int GetClassName(System.IntPtr h, System.Text.StringBuilder s, int n);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(System.IntPtr h, out uint p);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(System.IntPtr h);
'@ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

function Test-WindowsWindow([string] $package) {
    $ids = @(Get-Process WsaClient -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object Id)
    $script:found = $false
    $cb = [WsaNext.Win+EnumWindowsProc] {
        param($h, $l)
        $p = 0; [void][WsaNext.Win]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($h, [ref]$p)
        if ($ids -contains $p -and [WsaNext.Win]::IsWindowVisible($h)) {
            $cn = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder 256
            [void][WsaNext.Win]::GetClassName($h, $cn, 256)
            if ($cn.ToString() -eq $package) { $script:found = $true; return $false }
        }
        $true
    }
    [void][WsaNext.Win]::EnumWindows($cb, [IntPtr]::Zero)
    $script:found
}

& $adb connect $Serial *> $null
& $adb -s $Serial root *> $null
Start-Sleep 2
& $adb connect $Serial *> $null

if (-not $Packages) {
    $Packages = (Invoke-Shell 'pm list packages -3') -split "`n" |
        ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() -replace '^package:', '' } | Where-Object { $_ }
}
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$logDir = Join-Path $OutDir $stamp
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $logDir | Out-Null

$rows = foreach ($pkg in $Packages) {
    $abi = (Invoke-Shell "dumpsys package $pkg | grep -m1 primaryCpuAbi") -replace '.*=', ''
    $ver = (Invoke-Shell "dumpsys package $pkg | grep -m1 versionName") -replace '.*=', ''
    Invoke-Shell "am force-stop $pkg; logcat -c; logcat -b crash -c" | Out-Null
    Invoke-Shell "monkey -p $pkg -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1" | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $WaitSec
    $procPid = (Invoke-Shell "pidof $pkg").Trim()
    $maps = if ($procPid) { Invoke-Shell "cat /proc/$($procPid.Split(' ')[0])/maps" } else { '' }
    # Every app process maps the native bridge library at fork time, so the ABI decides
    # first; for ARM apps the guest linker (arm64 or Houdini's arm) shows which one runs.
    $runs = if ($abi -match 'x86') { 'native' }
            elseif ($abi -match 'null|^$') { 'Java only' }
            elseif ($maps -match '/system/bin/arm64/linker64|/system/lib64/arm64/') { 'ndk_translation' }
            elseif ($maps -match 'houdini|/arm/') { 'Houdini' }
            elseif (-not $procPid) { 'not running' } else { '?' }
    $javaCrash = (Invoke-Shell "logcat -d -b crash | grep -c 'FATAL EXCEPTION'").Trim()
    $nativeCrash = (Invoke-Shell "logcat -d | grep -c 'Fatal signal'").Trim()
    $window = Test-WindowsWindow $pkg
    Invoke-Shell 'logcat -d' | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $logDir "$pkg.log")
    $state = if ($procPid -and $window -and $javaCrash -eq '0' -and $nativeCrash -eq '0') { 'works' }
             elseif ($procPid -and $javaCrash -eq '0' -and $nativeCrash -eq '0') { 'runs, no window' }
             else { 'crashes' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Package = $pkg; Version = $ver; ABI = $abi; Runs = $runs; State = $state
                       JavaCrashes = $javaCrash; NativeCrashes = $nativeCrash }
    Invoke-Shell "am force-stop $pkg" | Out-Null
}

$md = @('| Package | Version | ABI | Native code | State |', '|---|---|---|---|---|')
$md += $rows | ForEach-Object { "| $($_.Package) | $($_.Version) | $($_.ABI) | $($_.Runs) | $($_.State) |" }
$md | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $logDir 'appcompat.md')
$rows | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 220
"Report: $(Join-Path $logDir 'appcompat.md')"

```

`android/tools/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
# Build Android system images for WSA and convert them to VHDX.
#
# Usage: build.sh <aosp_dir> [vendor_wsa_dir] [variant] [targets...]
#   aosp_dir        AOSP checkout (android-15.0.0_r36)
#   vendor_wsa_dir  optional private WSA integration layer, copied to vendor/wsa
#   variant         userdebug (default) or user
#   targets         make targets (default: systemimage systemextimage productimage)
# Environment:
#   WSA_PRODUCT     lunch product (default wsa_x86_64; wsa_x86_64_gapps needs vendor/gapps)
#   BUILD_NUMBER    build number in the fingerprint (default: the build's date and time, UTC)
set -euo pipefail

# A new fingerprint for every build. Android treats an installation over a different fingerprint
# as a system update (OTA): default permissions and roles are granted again and packages are
# scanned again. AOSP's default, "eng.<user>", is the same for every build, so an update of the
# images kept the permissions of the first installation.
export BUILD_NUMBER=${BUILD_NUMBER:-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M)}

AOSP=${1:?aosp dir}
VENDOR_WSA=${2:-}
VARIANT=${3:-userdebug}
shift $(( $# < 3 ? $# : 3 ))
TARGETS=("$@")
[[ ${#TARGETS[@]} -gt 0 ]] || TARGETS=(systemimage systemextimage productimage)

REPO=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
log() { printf '[build] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

# Device tree (public) and integration layer (private) into the AOSP tree.
mkdir -p "$AOSP/device/wsa"
rsync -a --delete "$REPO/device/wsa/" "$AOSP/device/wsa/"
if [[ -n $VENDOR_WSA ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$AOSP/vendor/wsa"
    rsync -a --delete "$VENDOR_WSA/" "$AOSP/vendor/wsa/"
    log "vendor/wsa synced from $VENDOR_WSA"
else
    rm -rf "$AOSP/vendor/wsa"
    log "no vendor/wsa: plain Android 15 build"
fi

# Source patches: patches/<aosp project path>/*.patch, applied in name order.
while IFS= read -r -d '' patch; do
    rel=${patch#"$REPO/patches/"}
    project=$(dirname "$rel")
    if git -C "$AOSP/$project" apply --reverse --check "$patch" 2>/dev/null; then
        continue  # already applied
    fi
    git -C "$AOSP/$project" apply "$patch"
    log "applied $rel"
done < <(find "$REPO/patches" -name '*.patch' -print0 2>/dev/null | sort -z)

cd "$AOSP"
set +u
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source build/envsetup.sh >/dev/null
PRODUCT=${WSA_PRODUCT:-wsa_x86_64}
if [[ $PRODUCT == *_gapps && ! -d vendor/gapps ]]; then
    log "vendor/gapps is missing (MindTheGapps, branch vic)"
    exit 1
fi
lunch "$PRODUCT-bp1a-$VARIANT"
set -u
log "build number $BUILD_NUMBER"

start=$(date +%s)
m "${TARGETS[@]}"
log "build finished in $(( ($(date +%s) - start) / 60 )) min"

OUT=$(get_build_var PRODUCT_OUT)
for img in system system_ext product; do
    [[ -f $OUT/$img.img ]] || continue
    # Dynamic VHDX: the file holds only the written blocks, so it is the size of the image.
    # qemu-img's fixed VHDX is twice that size (with block_state_zero=on every payload block
    # starts in the "zero" state and each write appends another one), and with
    # block_state_zero=off Windows refuses to attach it. Hyper-V reads both subformats alike;
    # WSA's own user data disk is dynamic too.
    qemu-img convert -f raw -O vhdx -o subformat=dynamic "$OUT/$img.img" "$OUT/$img.vhdx"
    log "$img.vhdx $(du -h --apparent-size "$OUT/$img.vhdx" | cut -f1) (from $(du -h --apparent-size "$OUT/$img.img" | cut -f1) raw)"
done

```

`android/tools/collect-play-apps.ps1`:

```ps1
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Collects the Google apps that Google Play has updated on a running WSA-Next, to integrate
    them into the next image (android/tools/integrate-play-apps.sh).

.DESCRIPTION
    Every WSA-Next installation is the same device for Google Play (x86_64 with x86, the same
    density and Android version), so the updates Play delivers to one of them are the ones every
    user would download in their first minutes. This script takes them from a reference
    installation, bit for bit, the way uupdump takes Windows from Microsoft's servers:

      1. every system app whose current code is an update in /data/app (Play services, the Play
         Store, Chrome, WebView, YouTube, ...), with all of its APKs (base and splits) and, when
         the app extracts its native libraries, the extracted lib/ folders;
      2. every newer version of a static shared library the image carries (TrichromeLibrary).

    Nothing is changed or re-signed. Android verified each update against the signature of the
    app in the image when Play installed it; play-apps.json records versions, the place in the
    image and the SHA-256 of every file, and the integration step checks them again.

    Google Play delivers an app's language splits only for the languages on the device's list,
    so the reference installation lists every language first (tools/locales/SetLocales.java,
    the first language stays the UI's); Play then adds the missing language splits to every app
    by itself. With fewer than -MinLanguages languages the script stops: the image would greet
    the users of the missing languages with Play's "switching to your language" screen.

    Needs adb (Google's Platform-Tools) and WSA's developer mode on. Run it after Google Play has
    finished "Update all" on a clean installation that is signed in.

.PARAMETER Serial
    adb address of WSA (default 127.0.0.1:58526).

.PARAMETER Out
    Output folder; a dated subfolder is created in it.

.PARAMETER DryRun
    Only list what would be collected.

.PARAMETER MinLanguages
    Fewest languages the device must list (default 70).
#>
param(
    [string]$Serial = '127.0.0.1:58526',
    [string]$Out = 'F:\WSA\android-15\inputs\play-apps',
    [switch]$DryRun,
    [int]$MinLanguages = 70
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Find-Adb {
    $onPath = Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($onPath) { return $onPath.Source }
    $sdk = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'
    if (Test-Path $sdk) { return $sdk }
    throw 'adb not found: install Google''s SDK Platform-Tools or put adb on PATH.'
}
$adb = Find-Adb

function Invoke-Adb {
    $output = & $adb -s $Serial @args 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "adb $($args -join ' '): $output" }
    return $output
}
function Invoke-Shell([string]$command) { Invoke-Adb shell $command }

& $adb connect $Serial | Out-Null
if ((Invoke-Shell 'getprop sys.boot_completed') -ne '1') { throw "Android at $Serial has not finished starting." }
Invoke-Adb root | Out-Null
Invoke-Adb wait-for-device | Out-Null
$languages = @((Invoke-Shell 'settings get system system_locales') -split ',' | Where-Object { $_ })
if ($languages.Count -lt $MinLanguages) {
    throw "The device lists $($languages.Count) languages; Google Play delivers language splits only for listed ones. List them all first (tools/locales/SetLocales.java), let Play add the splits, then collect."
}

# --- What Android knows about every package -------------------------------------------------
# "dumpsys package packages" lists the current packages, then "Hidden system packages:" - the
# image's versions of the apps that have an update.
function Read-Packages([string[]]$lines) {
    $list = @(); $current = $null
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if ($line -match '^  Package \[(.+?)\] \(') {
            if ($current) { $list += [pscustomobject]$current }
            $current = @{ Name = $Matches[1]; CodePath = ''; VersionCode = ''; VersionName = ''; Flags = '' }
        } elseif ($current) {
            if ($line -match '^    codePath=(.+)$') { $current.CodePath = $Matches[1].Trim() }
            elseif ($line -match '^    versionCode=(\d+)') { $current.VersionCode = $Matches[1] }
            elseif ($line -match '^    versionName=(.+)$') { $current.VersionName = $Matches[1].Trim() }
            elseif ($line -match '^    flags=\[(.+)\]') { $current.Flags = $Matches[1] }
        }
    }
    if ($current) { $list += [pscustomobject]$current }
    return $list
}
$dump = Invoke-Shell 'dumpsys package packages'
$split = [Array]::IndexOf($dump, ($dump | Where-Object { $_ -match '^Hidden system packages:' } | Select-Object -First 1))
$currentLines = if ($split -ge 0) { $dump[0..($split - 1)] } else { $dump }
$hiddenLines = if ($split -ge 0) { $dump[$split..($dump.Count - 1)] } else { @() }
$packages = Read-Packages $currentLines
$hidden = @{}
foreach ($p in (Read-Packages $hiddenLines)) { $hidden[$p.Name] = $p }

$partitions = '^/(system|system_ext|product|vendor)/(app|priv-app)/[^/]+$'
$targets = @()
foreach ($p in $packages) {
    if (-not $p.CodePath.StartsWith('/data/app/')) { continue }
    if ($p.Flags -match '\bUPDATED_SYSTEM_APP\b' -and $hidden.ContainsKey($p.Name)) {
        $targets += [pscustomobject]@{ Package = $p.Name; Current = $p; ImageDir = $hidden[$p.Name].CodePath; ImageVersion = $hidden[$p.Name].VersionCode }
        continue
    }
    # A static shared library is a package per version ("<name>_<version>"): a newer one from Play
    # replaces the one in the image.
    if ($p.Name -match '^(.+)_(\d+)$') {
        $base = $Matches[1]
        $inImage = $packages | Where-Object { $_.Name -match ('^' + [regex]::Escape($base) + '_\d+$') -and $_.CodePath -match $partitions } | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($inImage -and [int64]$p.VersionCode -gt [int64]$inImage.VersionCode) {
            $targets += [pscustomobject]@{ Package = $base; Current = $p; ImageDir = $inImage.CodePath; ImageVersion = $inImage.VersionCode }
        }
    }
}
if (-not $targets) { throw 'No updated system apps: let Google Play finish "Update all" first.' }
foreach ($t in $targets) {
    if ($t.ImageDir -notmatch $partitions) { throw "$($t.Package): unexpected place in the image: $($t.ImageDir)" }
}

# --- Privileged permissions -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Android 15 stops the system server at boot when a privileged app in the image requests a
# privileged permission of the platform ("android") that the allowlist of its partition does not
# name. Updated apps are exempt, so a newer version may hold permissions the image's allowlist
# lacks. They are found here, on the device that granted them: requested by the update,
# privileged, defined by "android", and neither allowed nor denied in <partition>/etc/permissions.
$privileged = @{}
$name = $null; $owner = $null
foreach ($line in (Invoke-Shell 'pm list permissions -f')) {
    if ($line -match '^\+ permission:(.+)$') { $name = $Matches[1].Trim(); $owner = $null }
    elseif ($line -match '^\s+package:(.+)$') { $owner = $Matches[1].Trim() }
    elseif ($line -match '^\s+protectionLevel:(.+)$' -and $owner -eq 'android' -and $Matches[1] -match '\bprivileged\b') { $privileged[$name] = $true }
}
function Get-Allowlisted([string]$partition, [string]$package) {
    $listed = @{}
    $files = Invoke-Shell "ls /$partition/etc/permissions/*.xml 2>/dev/null"
    foreach ($file in $files) {
        if (-not $file) { continue }
        $xml = [xml]((Invoke-Shell "cat '$file'") -join "`n")
        foreach ($block in $xml.SelectNodes("//privapp-permissions[@package='$package']")) {
            foreach ($child in $block.ChildNodes) { if ($child.name) { $listed[$child.name] = $child.LocalName } }
        }
    }
    return $listed
}
function Get-Requested([string]$package) {
    $requested = @(); $inside = $false
    foreach ($line in (Invoke-Shell "dumpsys package $package")) {
        if ($line -match '^Hidden system packages:') { break }  # only the current version
        if ($line -match '^    requested permissions:') { $inside = $true; continue }
        if ($inside) {
            if ($line -match '^      ([\w.]+)') { $requested += $Matches[1] } else { break }
        }
    }
    return $requested
}
foreach ($t in $targets) {
    $t | Add-Member privappMissing @()
    if ($t.ImageDir -notmatch '^/([^/]+)/priv-app/') { continue }
    $listed = Get-Allowlisted $Matches[1] $t.Package
    $t.privappMissing = @(Get-Requested $t.Package | Where-Object { $privileged[$_] -and -not $listed.ContainsKey($_) } | Sort-Object -Unique)
}

# --- Pull -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($DryRun) {
    foreach ($t in $targets | Sort-Object Package) {
        Write-Host ("{0,-45} {1} -> {2} (image {3})" -f $t.Package, $t.Current.VersionName, $t.ImageDir, $t.ImageVersion)
        if ($t.privappMissing) { Write-Host ("    not in the allowlist: " + ($t.privappMissing -join ', ')) }
    }
    return
}
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmm'
$folder = Join-Path $Out $stamp
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $folder | Out-Null
$report = @()
foreach ($t in $targets | Sort-Object Package) {
    $dir = $t.Current.CodePath
    $target = Join-Path $folder $t.Package
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $target | Out-Null
    $files = @()
    $apks = Invoke-Shell "cd '$dir' && ls -1 *.apk"
    $libs = Invoke-Shell "cd '$dir' && if [ -d lib ]; then find lib -type f -name '*.so'; fi"
    foreach ($relative in @($apks) + @($libs)) {
        if (-not $relative) { continue }
        $local = Join-Path $target ($relative -replace '/', '\')
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $local) | Out-Null
        Invoke-Adb pull "$dir/$relative" $local | Out-Null
        $files += [ordered]@{ name = $relative; size = (Get-Item $local).Length; sha256 = (Get-FileHash $local -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() }
    }
    $entry = [ordered]@{
        package      = $t.Package
        versionCode  = [int64]$t.Current.VersionCode
        versionName  = $t.Current.VersionName
        imageDir     = $t.ImageDir
        imageVersion = [int64]$t.ImageVersion
        privappMissing = $t.privappMissing
        files        = $files
    }
    $report += $entry
    Write-Host ("{0,-45} {1,-28} {2,3} files  -> {3}{4}" -f $t.Package, $t.Current.VersionName, $files.Count, $t.ImageDir,
        $(if ($t.privappMissing) { "  (+$($t.privappMissing.Count) privileged permissions)" }))
}

$device = [ordered]@{
    fingerprint = (Invoke-Shell 'getprop ro.build.fingerprint')
    abis        = (Invoke-Shell 'getprop ro.product.cpu.abilist')
    density     = (Invoke-Shell 'getprop ro.sf.lcd_density')
    languages   = $languages
}
[ordered]@{ collected = (Get-Date).ToString('o'); device = $device; apps = $report } |
    ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $folder 'play-apps.json')
Write-Host "Collected $($report.Count) apps in $folder"

```

`android/tools/deploy-test.ps1`:

```ps1
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Deploy freshly built system images into an installed (registered) WSA 2407 package
    for a test boot, keeping every replaced file.

.DESCRIPTION
    1. Stops WSA.
    2. Moves the current system/system_ext/product/vendor disks, kernel and initrd of the
       package into a time-stamped backup folder (nothing is deleted).
    3. Copies the new images (and optionally a vendor disk, kernel and initrd) in.
    4. With -FreshData, renames the per-user data disks in LocalCache so Android starts
       with empty userdata (the renamed files stay next to the originals).
    5. Starts WSA through the wsa:// protocol and waits for adb to report boot completed.

.EXAMPLE
    .\deploy-test.ps1 -ImagesDir \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu-26.04\home\me\aosp15\out\target\product\wsa_x86_64 `
        -VendorVhdx C:\Projekty\WSA-Next-inputs\wsa-2407-a13-pkg\vendor.vhdx -FreshData
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $ImagesDir,
    [string] $WsaDir = 'C:\wsa',
    [string] $BackupRoot = 'C:\backup\wsa-deploy',
    [string] $VendorVhdx,
    [string] $Kernel,
    [string] $Initrd,
    [switch] $FreshData,
    [int] $BootTimeoutSec = 180
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$pkgFamily = 'MicrosoftCorporationII.WindowsSubsystemForAndroid_8wekyb3d8bbwe'
$localCache = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Packages\$pkgFamily\LocalCache"

function Stop-Wsa {
    Get-Process WsaClient -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
    Stop-Service WsaService -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    # The VM can outlive the service briefly; wait until its worker process is gone.

function Find-Adb {
    $cmd = Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    $sdk = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'
    if (Test-Path $sdk) { return $sdk }

    $log = Get-Content (Join-Path $logDir 'logcat.txt') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

        'Notification redirection ready'  = 'WsaSystemUIInitializer.*Initialize complete'

        Write-Host ("  [{0}] {1}" -f ($(if ($hit -contains $true) { 'ok' } else { '--' })), $name)
```

`android/tools/dexcompat.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
"""Static API compatibility scan: Microsoft WSA code (built for Android 13) vs a newer Android.

For every target APK/JAR it reports what resolved against the Android 13 platform but no
longer resolves against Android 14:
  missing-class     referenced class is gone
  missing-method    referenced method (name + exact signature) is gone
  missing-field     referenced field (name + type) is gone
  became-private    member still exists but is now private (IllegalAccessError)
  unimplemented     concrete class lacks a new abstract method (AbstractMethodError)
  orphan-override   method overrode a platform method in 13, overrides nothing in 14
                    (callback silently never called); A14 same-name candidates are listed
  res-moved         inlined framework resource id (const 0x01xxxxxx) now names another resource
  res-missing       inlined framework resource no longer exists
It also lists "hooks": places inside the Android 13 framework that call into Microsoft code.
Those hooks are absent from a stock AOSP 14 framework.

Usage: dexcompat.py <tree_root> <out_dir> [new_version, default a14]
  <tree_root>/{a13,aNN}/{system,system_ext,product}/...  and  <tree_root>/{a13,aNN}/apex/<name>/
  Set AAPT2=/path/to/aapt2[.exe] to let the script dump framework-res resource tables itself.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from dexmodel import (ACC_ABSTRACT, ACC_CONSTRUCTOR, ACC_PRIVATE, ACC_STATIC,  # noqa: E402
                      ClassDef, Dex, dex_blobs, load_classes)

# enum Classpath from packages/modules/SdkExtensions/proto/classpaths.proto
# (0 = UNKNOWN; values verified against WSA's systemserverclasspath.pb: services.jar -> 2)
BOOT, SYSTEMSERVER, DEX2OAT_BOOT, STANDALONE_SS = 1, 2, 3, 4
MS_PREFIXES = ('Lcom/microsoft/',)
POLYMORPHIC = {'Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodHandle;', 'Ljava/lang/invoke/VarHandle;'}

# Microsoft code shipped with WSA 2407 (relative to the A13 tree).
TARGETS = {
    'Settings': ('app', 'system_ext/priv-app/Settings/Settings.apk'),
    'SystemApp': ('app', 'system_ext/priv-app/SystemApp/SystemApp.apk'),
    'SystemUIApp': ('app', 'system_ext/priv-app/SystemUIApp/SystemUIApp.apk'),
    'UserApp': ('app', 'system_ext/priv-app/UserApp/UserApp.apk'),
    'HomeApp': ('app', 'product/app/HomeApp/HomeApp.apk'),
    'pdk.notifications': ('app', 'system_ext/framework/com.microsoft.windows.pdk.notifications.jar'),
    'windows-system_server': ('server', 'system/system/framework/windows-system_server.jar'),
}
TARGET_LIBS = ['system_ext/framework/com.microsoft.windows.pdk.notifications.jar']


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- classpath discovery

def _uleb(b: bytes, i: int):
    r = s = 0
    while True:
        x = b[i]; i += 1
        r |= (x & 0x7F) << s; s += 7
        if x < 0x80:
            return r, i


def parse_classpaths_pb(data: bytes) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """ExportedClasspathsJars { repeated Jar jars = 1; } Jar { string path = 1; int classpath = 2; }"""
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(data):
        key, i = _uleb(data, i)
        if key >> 3 == 1 and key & 7 == 2:
            ln, i = _uleb(data, i)
            jar, i = data[i:i + ln], i + ln
            path, cp, j = '', 0, 0
            while j < len(jar):
                k, j = _uleb(jar, j)
                if k & 7 == 2:
                    l2, j = _uleb(jar, j)
                    if k >> 3 == 1:
                        path = jar[j:j + l2].decode()
                    j += l2
                elif k & 7 == 0:
                    v, j = _uleb(jar, j)
                    if k >> 3 == 2:
                        cp = v
                else:
                    break
            out.append((path, cp))
        else:
            break
    return out


class Tree:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, ver: str):
        self.root = root / ver
        self.ver = ver
        sysroot = self.root / 'system'
        self.sysroot = sysroot / 'system' if (sysroot / 'system').is_dir() else sysroot

    def device_to_host(self, dev: str) -> Path | None:
        if dev.startswith('/apex/'):
            name, _, rest = dev[6:].partition('/')
            base = self.root / 'apex'
            cand = base / name
            if not cand.is_dir():
                hits = [d for d in base.iterdir() if d.name.startswith(name)]
                if not hits:
                    return None
                cand = hits[0]
            return cand / rest
        if dev.startswith('/system/'):
            return self.sysroot / dev[8:]
        if dev.startswith('/system_ext/'):
            # Android 14 build keeps WSA's system_ext partition
            return self.root.parent / 'a13' / 'system_ext' / dev[12:]
        return None

    def classpaths(self) -> dict[int, list[Path]]:
        pbs = sorted((self.sysroot / 'etc' / 'classpaths').glob('*.pb'))
        pbs += sorted((self.root / 'apex').glob('*/etc/classpaths/*.pb'))
        cps: dict[int, list[Path]] = defaultdict(list)
        for pb in pbs:
            for dev, cp in parse_classpaths_pb(pb.read_bytes()):
                host = self.device_to_host(dev)
                if host and host.is_file() and host not in cps[cp]:
                    cps[cp].append(host)
        return cps

    def optional_libs(self, cps) -> list[Path]:
        used = {p for v in cps.values() for p in v}
        return [p for p in sorted((self.sysroot / 'framework').glob('*.jar')) if p not in used]


class Platform:
    def __init__(self, tree: Tree):
        cps = tree.classpaths()
        target_names = {Path(rel).name for _, rel in TARGETS.values()}
        keep = lambda jars: [j for j in jars if j.name not in target_names]  # noqa: E731
        self.boot_jars = keep(cps[BOOT])
        self.server_jars = keep(cps[SYSTEMSERVER] + cps[STANDALONE_SS])
        self.lib_jars = keep(tree.optional_libs(cps))
        boot = load_classes(self.boot_jars, with_code=False)
        libs = load_classes(self.lib_jars, with_code=False)
        server = load_classes(self.server_jars, with_code=False)
        self.app_view = {**libs, **boot}
        self.server_view = {**server, **boot}
        print(f'[{tree.ver}] boot={len(self.boot_jars)} jars/{len(boot)} classes, '
              f'server={len(self.server_jars)}/{len(server)}, libs={len(self.lib_jars)}/{len(libs)}',
              file=sys.stderr)

    def view(self, kind: str) -> dict[str, ClassDef]:
        return self.app_view if kind == 'app' else self.server_view


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- resolution

class Resolver:
    def __init__(self, own: dict[str, ClassDef], platform: dict[str, ClassDef]):
        self.own = own
        self.platform = platform

    def get(self, name: str) -> ClassDef | None:
        return self.own.get(name) or self.platform.get(name)

    def is_platform(self, cd: ClassDef) -> bool:
        return cd.name not in self.own

    def ancestry(self, name: str):
        """Yield (ClassDef|None, name) for superclass chain then all superinterfaces (BFS)."""
        chain, ifaces, seen = [], [], set()
        cur = name
        while cur and cur not in seen:
            seen.add(cur)
            cd = self.get(cur)
            chain.append((cd, cur))
            if cd is None:
                break
            ifaces.extend(cd.interfaces)
            cur = cd.superclass
        yield from chain
        queue = list(ifaces)
        while queue:
            cur = queue.pop(0)
            if cur in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(cur)
            cd = self.get(cur)
            yield cd, cur
            if cd:
                queue.extend(cd.interfaces)
        if 'Ljava/lang/Object;' not in seen:
            yield self.get('Ljava/lang/Object;'), 'Ljava/lang/Object;'

    def resolve_method(self, cls: str, sig: str):
        if cls.startswith('['):
            return 'ok', None
        start = self.get(cls)
        if start is None:
            return 'missing-class', cls
        name = sig.split('(', 1)[0]
        for cd, cname in self.ancestry(cls):
            if cd is None:
                return 'unresolvable', cname
            m = cd.methods.get(sig)
            if m is not None:
                return ('became-private' if m.access & ACC_PRIVATE else 'ok'), cd
            if cname in POLYMORPHIC and any(s.startswith(name + '(') for s in cd.methods):
                return 'ok', cd
        return 'missing-method', None

    def resolve_field(self, cls: str, fsig: str):
        start = self.get(cls)
        if start is None:
            return 'missing-class', cls
        for cd, cname in self.ancestry(cls):
            if cd is None:
                return 'unresolvable', cname
            acc = cd.fields.get(fsig)
            if acc is not None:
                return ('became-private' if acc & ACC_PRIVATE else 'ok'), cd
        return 'missing-field', None

    def resolve_type(self, desc: str):
        base = desc.lstrip('[')
        if not base.startswith('L'):
            return 'ok', None
        return ('ok', None) if self.get(base) else ('missing-class', base)

    def unimplemented(self, cd: ClassDef) -> set[str]:
        """Abstract instance methods the concrete class `cd` inherits without an implementation."""
        if cd.is_abstract:
            return set()
        concrete, abstract = set(), set()
        for anc, _ in self.ancestry(cd.name):
            if anc is None:
                return set()   # incomplete hierarchy, cannot judge
            for sig, m in anc.methods.items():
                if m.access & ACC_STATIC or sig.startswith('<'):
                    continue
                (abstract if m.access & ACC_ABSTRACT else concrete).add(sig)
        return abstract - concrete

    def platform_overridden(self, cd: ClassDef, sig: str) -> bool:
        first = True
        for anc, _ in self.ancestry(cd.name):
            if first:
                first = False
                continue
            if anc is not None and self.is_platform(anc) and sig in anc.methods:
                m = anc.methods[sig]
                if not m.access & (ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC):
                    return True
        return False

    def same_name_candidates(self, cd: ClassDef, name: str) -> list[str]:
        out = []
        first = True
        for anc, cname in self.ancestry(cd.name):
            if first:
                first = False
                continue
            if anc is not None and self.is_platform(anc):
                out += [f'{cname}->{s}' for s in anc.methods if s.split('(', 1)[0] == name]
        return sorted(set(out))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scan

def short(cls: str) -> str:
    return cls[1:-1].replace('/', '.') if cls.startswith('L') and cls.endswith(';') else cls


def scan_target(label: str, kind: str, path: Path, p13: Platform, pnew: Platform, lib_classes,
                res13: dict[int, str], resnew: dict[str, int]):
    own = load_classes([path], with_code=True)
    if kind == 'server':
        # copies of platform classes inside the jar are shadowed by the platform at runtime
        shadow = p13.view('server')
        own = {k: v for k, v in own.items() if k not in shadow}
    own_all = {**lib_classes, **own} if label != 'pdk.notifications' else own
    r13 = Resolver(own_all, p13.view(kind))
    rnew = Resolver(own_all, pnew.view(kind))
    issues: dict[tuple, dict] = {}

    def add(kind_, key, where, extra=None):
        it = issues.setdefault((kind_,) + key, {'kind': kind_, 'ref': key, 'sites': set(), 'extra': extra})
        it['sites'].add(where)

    for cd in own.values():
        for m in cd.methods.values():
            where = f'{short(cd.name)}.{m.name}'
            for rkind, ref in m.refs:
                if rkind == 'method':
                    if ref[0] in own_all:   # declared by own class: still may inherit from platform
                        owner = own_all[ref[0]]
                        if ref[1] in owner.methods:
                            continue
                    s13, _ = r13.resolve_method(*ref)
                    if s13 != 'ok':
                        continue
                    s14, x = rnew.resolve_method(*ref)
                    if s14 != 'ok':
                        add(s14 if s14 != 'missing-class' else 'missing-class',
                            (short(x),) if s14 == 'missing-class' else (short(ref[0]), ref[1]), where)
                elif rkind == 'field':
                    if ref[0] in own_all and ref[1] in own_all[ref[0]].fields:
                        continue
                    s13, _ = r13.resolve_field(*ref)
                    if s13 != 'ok':
                        continue
                    s14, x = rnew.resolve_field(*ref)
                    if s14 != 'ok':
                        add(s14, (short(x),) if s14 == 'missing-class' else (short(ref[0]), ref[1]), where)
                elif rkind == 'type':
                    if r13.resolve_type(ref[0])[0] == 'ok' and rnew.resolve_type(ref[0])[0] != 'ok':
                        add('missing-class', (short(ref[0].lstrip('[')),), where)
                elif rkind == 'const' and res13:
                    name = res13.get(ref[0])
                    if name is None:
                        continue            # not a framework resource id
                    new = resnew.get(name)
                    if new is None:
                        add('res-missing', (f'0x{ref[0]:08x}', name), where)
                    elif new != ref[0]:
                        add('res-moved', (f'0x{ref[0]:08x}', name, f'0x{new:08x}'), where)

        # inheritance checks
        if not cd.is_abstract:
            for sig in sorted(rnew.unimplemented(cd) - r13.unimplemented(cd)):
                add('unimplemented', (short(cd.name), sig), short(cd.name))
        for sig, m in cd.methods.items():
            if m.access & (ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC | ACC_CONSTRUCTOR) or sig.startswith('<'):
                continue
            if r13.platform_overridden(cd, sig) and not rnew.platform_overridden(cd, sig):
                cands = rnew.same_name_candidates(cd, m.name)
                add('orphan-override', (short(cd.name), sig), short(cd.name), cands)

    # superclasses/interfaces that disappeared
    for cd in own.values():
        for sup in ([cd.superclass] if cd.superclass else []) + cd.interfaces:
            if r13.get(sup) and not rnew.get(sup):
                add('missing-class', (short(sup),), f'{short(cd.name)} (extends/implements)')
    return own, issues


def scan_hooks(p13_tree: Tree, p13: Platform):
    """Calls from Android 13 framework code into com.microsoft.* (Microsoft's framework patches)."""
    hooks = defaultdict(set)
    for jar in p13.boot_jars + p13.server_jars:
        if jar.name == 'windows-system_server.jar':
            continue
        for origin, blob in dex_blobs(jar):
            for cd in Dex(blob, origin, with_code=True).classes():
                if cd.name.startswith(MS_PREFIXES):
                    hooks[f'{jar.name}: Microsoft class embedded in framework'].add(short(cd.name))
                    continue
                for m in cd.methods.values():
                    for rkind, ref in m.refs:
                        if rkind != 'const' and ref[0].lstrip('[').startswith(MS_PREFIXES):
                            callee = short(ref[0].lstrip('[')) + (('.' + ref[1]) if len(ref) > 1 else '')
                            hooks[f'{jar.name}: {short(cd.name)}.{m.name}'].add(callee)
    return hooks


def ensure_res_dump(tree: Tree, out: Path) -> Path:
    """Create fw_res_<ver>.txt with `aapt2 dump resources` when AAPT2 is set and the dump is missing."""
    dump = out / f'fw_res_{tree.ver}.txt'
    aapt2 = os.environ.get('AAPT2')
    apk = tree.sysroot / 'framework' / 'framework-res.apk'
    if dump.is_file() or not aapt2 or not apk.is_file():
        return dump
    arg = str(apk)
    if aapt2.lower().endswith('.exe'):           # Windows aapt2 called from WSL
        arg = subprocess.check_output(['wslpath', '-w', arg], text=True).strip()
    res = subprocess.run([aapt2, 'dump', 'resources', arg], capture_output=True,
                         text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    dump.write_text(res.stdout, encoding='utf-8')
    return dump


def load_res_dump(path: Path) -> dict[int, str]:
    """Parse `aapt2 dump resources` output: '    resource 0x01040000 string/foo [PUBLIC]'."""
    if not path.is_file():
        return {}
    rx = re.compile(r'^\s+resource (0x[0-9a-f]{8}) (\S+)')
    out = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig', errors='replace').splitlines():
        m = rx.match(line)
        if m:
            out[int(m.group(1), 16)] = m.group(2)
    return out


def main():
    root, out = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
    new = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 'a14'
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    t13, tnew = Tree(root, 'a13'), Tree(root, new)
    p13, pnew = Platform(t13), Platform(tnew)
    lib_classes = load_classes([t13.root / p for p in TARGET_LIBS], with_code=False)
    res13 = load_res_dump(ensure_res_dump(t13, out))
    resnew = load_res_dump(ensure_res_dump(tnew, out))
    resnew = {name: rid for rid, name in resnew.items()}
    if not res13:
        print('resource dumps missing: run `aapt2 dump resources framework-res.apk` into '
              f'{out}/fw_res_a13.txt and fw_res_{new}.txt (or set AAPT2) to enable the res-* checks',
              file=sys.stderr)

    report, summary, js = [], [], {}
    for label, (kind, rel) in TARGETS.items():
        path = (t13.root / rel)
        if not path.is_file():
            summary.append(f'{label:24} NOT FOUND ({rel})')
            continue
        own, issues = scan_target(label, kind, path, p13, pnew, lib_classes, res13, resnew)
        by_kind = defaultdict(list)
        for it in issues.values():
            by_kind[it['kind']].append(it)
        summary.append(f'{label:24} classes={len(own):6}  ' +
                       '  '.join(f'{k}={len(v)}' for k, v in sorted(by_kind.items())))
        report.append(f'\n{"=" * 100}\n{label}  ({rel}, {kind})\n{"=" * 100}')
        js[label] = []
        for k in ('unimplemented', 'missing-class', 'missing-method', 'missing-field',
                  'became-private', 'orphan-override', 'res-missing', 'res-moved'):
            items = sorted(by_kind.get(k, []), key=lambda i: i['ref'])
            if not items:
                continue
            report.append(f'\n--- {k} ({len(items)})')
            for it in items:
                report.append('  ' + ' -> '.join(it['ref']))
                sites = sorted(it['sites'])
                report.append('      used in: ' + ', '.join(sites[:6]) + (f' (+{len(sites) - 6})' if len(sites) > 6 else ''))
                if it['extra']:
                    report.append('      A14 has: ' + '; '.join(it['extra'][:4]))
                js[label].append({'kind': k, 'ref': list(it['ref']), 'sites': sites, 'a14_candidates': it['extra']})

    hooks = scan_hooks(t13, p13)
    hook_lines = [f'{k}\n    -> ' + '\n    -> '.join(sorted(v)) for k, v in sorted(hooks.items())]

    (out / f'compat_report_{new}.txt').write_text('\n'.join(['SUMMARY', *summary, *report]) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    (out / f'compat_report_{new}.json').write_text(json.dumps(js, indent=1), encoding='utf-8')
    (out / 'framework_hooks_a13.txt').write_text('\n'.join(hook_lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('\n'.join(summary))
    print(f'framework hooks into com.microsoft.*: {len(hooks)} sites')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`android/tools/dexmodel.py`:

```py
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
"""Minimal DEX reader: class model + per-method code references.

No third-party dependencies. Parses just enough of the DEX format to:
  * list classes with superclass, interfaces, access flags, fields and methods
  * walk each method's bytecode and collect the type/field/method references it uses
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

NO_INDEX = 0xFFFFFFFF

ACC_PUBLIC = 0x1
ACC_PRIVATE = 0x2
ACC_STATIC = 0x8
ACC_FINAL = 0x10
ACC_INTERFACE = 0x200
ACC_ABSTRACT = 0x400
ACC_CONSTRUCTOR = 0x10000

# Resource package ids whose inlined constants are recorded as ('const', (id,)) refs.
RES_PACKAGES = {0x01}


def _uleb(buf: bytes, off: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    result = shift = 0
    while True:
        b = buf[off]
        off += 1
        result |= (b & 0x7F) << shift
        if b < 0x80:
            return result, off
        shift += 7


# Width in 16-bit code units and reference kind for every opcode.
# kind: None, 'type', 'field', 'method', 'string', 'callsite', 'mhandle', 'proto'
_OPS: list[tuple[int, str | None]] = [(1, None)] * 256


def _set(lo: int, hi: int, width: int, kind: str | None = None) -> None:
    for op in range(lo, hi + 1):
        _OPS[op] = (width, kind)


_set(0x00, 0x01, 1); _set(0x02, 0x02, 2); _set(0x03, 0x03, 3)
_set(0x04, 0x04, 1); _set(0x05, 0x05, 2); _set(0x06, 0x06, 3)
_set(0x07, 0x07, 1); _set(0x08, 0x08, 2); _set(0x09, 0x09, 3)
_set(0x0A, 0x12, 1)
_set(0x13, 0x13, 2); _set(0x14, 0x14, 3); _set(0x15, 0x16, 2); _set(0x17, 0x17, 3)
_set(0x18, 0x18, 5); _set(0x19, 0x19, 2)
_set(0x1A, 0x1A, 2, 'string'); _set(0x1B, 0x1B, 3, 'string')
_set(0x1C, 0x1C, 2, 'type'); _set(0x1D, 0x1E, 1); _set(0x1F, 0x1F, 2, 'type')
_set(0x20, 0x20, 2, 'type'); _set(0x21, 0x21, 1); _set(0x22, 0x23, 2, 'type')
_set(0x24, 0x25, 3, 'type'); _set(0x26, 0x26, 3); _set(0x27, 0x28, 1)
_set(0x29, 0x29, 2); _set(0x2A, 0x2C, 3)
_set(0x2D, 0x3D, 2); _set(0x3E, 0x43, 1)
_set(0x44, 0x51, 2)
_set(0x52, 0x6D, 2, 'field')
_set(0x6E, 0x72, 3, 'method'); _set(0x73, 0x73, 1); _set(0x74, 0x78, 3, 'method')
_set(0x79, 0x7A, 1)
_set(0x7B, 0x8F, 1); _set(0x90, 0xAF, 2); _set(0xB0, 0xCF, 1); _set(0xD0, 0xE2, 2)
_set(0xE3, 0xF9, 1)
_set(0xFA, 0xFB, 4, 'method'); _set(0xFC, 0xFD, 3, 'callsite')
_set(0xFE, 0xFE, 2, 'mhandle'); _set(0xFF, 0xFF, 2, 'proto')


@dataclass
class MethodDef:
    name: str
    proto: str          # "(Ljava/lang/String;I)V"
    access: int
    refs: list[tuple[str, tuple]] = field(default_factory=list)  # (kind, ref)

    @property
    def sig(self) -> str:
        return self.name + self.proto


@dataclass
class ClassDef:
    name: str           # "Landroid/app/Activity;"
    access: int
    superclass: str | None
    interfaces: list[str]
    fields: dict[str, int]      # "name:type" -> access
    methods: dict[str, MethodDef]  # sig -> MethodDef
    origin: str

    @property
    def is_interface(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.access & ACC_INTERFACE)

    @property
    def is_abstract(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.access & (ACC_ABSTRACT | ACC_INTERFACE))


class Dex:
    def __init__(self, data: bytes, origin: str, with_code: bool):
        self.d = data
        self.origin = origin
        if data[:3] != b'dex':
            raise ValueError(f'{origin}: not a dex file')
        (self.string_ids_size, self.string_ids_off, self.type_ids_size, self.type_ids_off,
         self.proto_ids_size, self.proto_ids_off, self.field_ids_size, self.field_ids_off,
         self.method_ids_size, self.method_ids_off, self.class_defs_size,
         self.class_defs_off) = struct.unpack_from('<12I', data, 56)
        self._strings: dict[int, str] = {}
        self._protos: dict[int, str] = {}
        self.with_code = with_code

    def string(self, idx: int) -> str:
        s = self._strings.get(idx)
        if s is None:
            off = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.d, self.string_ids_off + idx * 4)[0]
            _, off = _uleb(self.d, off)
            end = self.d.index(b'\0', off)
            s = self.d[off:end].decode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')
            self._strings[idx] = s
        return s

    def type(self, idx: int) -> str:
        return self.string(struct.unpack_from('<I', self.d, self.type_ids_off + idx * 4)[0])

    def type_list(self, off: int) -> list[str]:
        if off == 0:
            return []
        n = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.d, off)[0]
        return [self.type(struct.unpack_from('<H', self.d, off + 4 + i * 2)[0]) for i in range(n)]

    def proto(self, idx: int) -> str:
        p = self._protos.get(idx)
        if p is None:
            _, ret, params_off = struct.unpack_from('<3I', self.d, self.proto_ids_off + idx * 12)
            p = '(' + ''.join(self.type_list(params_off)) + ')' + self.type(ret)
            self._protos[idx] = p
        return p

    def field_ref(self, idx: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
        cls, typ, name = struct.unpack_from('<HHI', self.d, self.field_ids_off + idx * 8)
        return self.type(cls), self.string(name) + ':' + self.type(typ)

    def method_ref(self, idx: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
        cls, proto, name = struct.unpack_from('<HHI', self.d, self.method_ids_off + idx * 8)
        return self.type(cls), self.string(name) + self.proto(proto)

    def _code_refs(self, code_off: int) -> list[tuple[str, tuple]]:
        d = self.d
        insns_size = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, code_off + 12)[0]
        pos = code_off + 16
        end = pos + insns_size * 2
        refs: list[tuple[str, tuple]] = []
        while pos < end:
            unit = d[pos] | (d[pos + 1] << 8)
            op = unit & 0xFF
            if op == 0x00 and unit != 0:            # payload pseudo-instructions
                if unit == 0x0100:
                    size = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, pos + 2)[0]
                    pos += (4 + size * 2) * 2
                elif unit == 0x0200:
                    size = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, pos + 2)[0]
                    pos += (2 + size * 4) * 2
                elif unit == 0x0300:
                    width = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, pos + 2)[0]
                    size = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, pos + 4)[0]
                    if width == 4:      # int arrays: styleable attr id tables
                        for v in struct.unpack_from(f'<{size}I', d, pos + 8):
                            if v >> 24 in RES_PACKAGES:
                                refs.append(('const', (v,)))
                    pos += (4 + (size * width + 1) // 2) * 2
                else:
                    pos += 2
                continue
            width, kind = _OPS[op]
            if kind == 'method':
                refs.append(('method', self.method_ref(struct.unpack_from('<H', d, pos + 2)[0])))
            elif kind == 'field':
                refs.append(('field', self.field_ref(struct.unpack_from('<H', d, pos + 2)[0])))
            elif kind == 'type':
                refs.append(('type', (self.type(struct.unpack_from('<H', d, pos + 2)[0]),)))
            elif op == 0x14:                        # const vAA, #+BBBBBBBB
                v = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, pos + 2)[0]
                if v >> 24 in RES_PACKAGES:                 # framework package (android:) resource id
                    refs.append(('const', (v,)))
            elif op == 0x15:                        # const/high16 vAA, #+BBBB0000
                v = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, pos + 2)[0] << 16
                if v >> 24 in RES_PACKAGES:
                    refs.append(('const', (v,)))
            pos += width * 2
        return refs

    def classes(self):
        d = self.d
        for i in range(self.class_defs_size):
            (cls_idx, access, super_idx, ifaces_off, _src, _ann, data_off,
             _sv) = struct.unpack_from('<8I', d, self.class_defs_off + i * 32)
            cd = ClassDef(
                name=self.type(cls_idx), access=access,
                superclass=None if super_idx == NO_INDEX else self.type(super_idx),
                interfaces=self.type_list(ifaces_off), fields={}, methods={},
                origin=self.origin)
            if data_off:
                off = data_off
                sf, off = _uleb(d, off)
                inf, off = _uleb(d, off)
                dm, off = _uleb(d, off)
                vm, off = _uleb(d, off)
                for count in (sf, inf):
                    idx = 0
                    for _ in range(count):
                        diff, off = _uleb(d, off)
                        acc, off = _uleb(d, off)
                        idx += diff
                        cd.fields[self.field_ref(idx)[1]] = acc
                for count in (dm, vm):
                    idx = 0
                    for _ in range(count):
                        diff, off = _uleb(d, off)
                        acc, off = _uleb(d, off)
                        code_off, off = _uleb(d, off)
                        idx += diff
                        _, sig = self.method_ref(idx)
                        name, _, rest = sig.partition('(')
                        m = MethodDef(name=name, proto='(' + rest, access=acc)
                        if self.with_code and code_off:
                            m.refs = self._code_refs(code_off)
                        cd.methods[m.sig] = m
            yield cd


def dex_blobs(path: Path):
    """Yield (origin, bytes) for every classes*.dex inside a jar/apk, or a bare .dex."""
    if path.suffix == '.dex':
        yield str(path), path.read_bytes()
        return
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
            names = sorted((n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('classes') and n.endswith('.dex')),
                           key=lambda n: (len(n), n))
            for n in names:
                yield f'{path.name}!{n}', z.read(n)
    except zipfile.BadZipFile:
        return


def load_classes(paths, with_code: bool) -> dict[str, ClassDef]:
    """Load classes from several containers. First definition wins (classpath order)."""
    out: dict[str, ClassDef] = {}
    for p in paths:
        for origin, blob in dex_blobs(Path(p)):
            for cd in Dex(blob, origin, with_code).classes():
                out.setdefault(cd.name, cd)
    return out
```

`android/tools/extract_images.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
# Extract WSA (Android 13) and AOSP GSI (Android 14) partition images into plain
# directory trees, then unpack every APEX payload, so the DEX tools can work on files.
#
# Usage: extract_images.sh <inputs_dir> <work_dir>
#   <inputs_dir>/wsa-2407-a13-pkg/{system,system_ext,product,vendor}.vhdx
#   <inputs_dir>/aosp<N>-gsi/*.zip         AOSP GSI zips (aosp14-gsi, aosp15-gsi, ...)
# Output:
#   <work_dir>/img/a<N>/*.img            raw ext4 images
#   <work_dir>/tree/a<N>/<part>/         extracted file trees
#   <work_dir>/tree/a<N>/apex/<name>/    extracted APEX payloads
set -euo pipefail

IN=${1:?inputs dir}
WORK=${2:?work dir}
mkdir -p "$WORK"/img/a13 "$WORK"/tree/a13

log() { printf '[extract] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

vhdx_to_raw() {  # <src.vhdx> <dst.img>
    [[ -s $2 ]] && return 0
    log "convert $(basename "$1") -> $2"
    qemu-img convert -f vhdx -O raw "$1" "$2.tmp" && mv "$2.tmp" "$2"
}

rdump_tree() {  # <img> <dest_dir>
    [[ -d $2 ]] && return 0
    log "rdump $(basename "$1") -> $2"
    mkdir -p "$2.tmp"
    debugfs -R "rdump / $2.tmp" "$1" 2>/dev/null
    mv "$2.tmp" "$2"
}

# Android 13 (WSA 2407.40000.4.0)
for p in system system_ext product vendor; do
    vhdx_to_raw "$IN/wsa-2407-a13-pkg/$p.vhdx" "$WORK/img/a13/$p.img"
    rdump_tree "$WORK/img/a13/$p.img" "$WORK/tree/a13/$p"
done

# Newer Android versions (AOSP GSI, system only): one aosp<N>-gsi/ directory per version
GSI_VERS=()
for d in "$IN"/aosp*-gsi; do
    zip=$(ls "$d"/*.zip 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
    [[ -n $zip ]] || continue
    ver=$(basename "$d"); ver=${ver#aosp}; ver=a${ver%-gsi}
    GSI_VERS+=("$ver")
    mkdir -p "$WORK/img/$ver" "$WORK/tree/$ver"
    if [[ ! -s $WORK/img/$ver/system.img ]]; then
        log "unzip $(basename "$zip") system.img -> $ver"
        unzip -o -q "$zip" system.img -d "$WORK/img/$ver"
    fi
    rdump_tree "$WORK/img/$ver/system.img" "$WORK/tree/$ver/system"
done

# APEX payloads: <tree>/system/system/apex/*.apex|*.capex (system-as-root layout)
unpack_apexes() {  # <ver>
    local ver=$1 sysroot apexdir out f name tmp
    sysroot="$WORK/tree/$ver/system"
    [[ -d $sysroot/system ]] && sysroot="$sysroot/system"
    apexdir="$sysroot/apex"
    out="$WORK/tree/$ver/apex"
    mkdir -p "$out"
    for f in "$apexdir"/*.apex "$apexdir"/*.capex; do
        [[ -e $f ]] || continue
        name=$(basename "$f"); name=${name%.apex}; name=${name%.capex}
        [[ -d $out/$name ]] && continue
        tmp=$(mktemp -d)
        if [[ $f == *.capex ]]; then
            unzip -q -o "$f" original_apex -d "$tmp"
            unzip -q -o "$tmp/original_apex" apex_payload.img -d "$tmp"
        else
            unzip -q -o "$f" apex_payload.img -d "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -rf "$tmp"; continue; }
        fi
        if file "$tmp/apex_payload.img" | grep -q ext[234]; then
            mkdir -p "$out/$name"
            debugfs -R "rdump / $out/$name" "$tmp/apex_payload.img" 2>/dev/null
        else
            log "WARN $name: payload is not ext4 ($(file -b "$tmp/apex_payload.img" | cut -c1-40))"
        fi
        rm -rf "$tmp"
    done
    log "$ver: $(ls "$out" | wc -l) APEX payloads unpacked"
}
unpack_apexes a13
for v in "${GSI_VERS[@]}"; do unpack_apexes "$v"; done
log done
```

`android/tools/fetch_gms.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
# Prepare vendor/gapps for the wsa_x86_64_gapps product.
#
# MindTheGapps (branch "vic", Android 15) provides the makefiles and the common GMS
# packages, but its x86_64 Play services (22.21) predate Android 15: Android 15's
# Google Services Framework expects Play services to own the gservices provider, so the
# old GmsCore crash-loops. This script replaces Play services, the Play Store and the
# Google Services Framework with the matching x86_64 builds from Google's official
# Android 15 emulator image (google_apis_playstore), together with their privileged
# permission allowlists. It also prepares vendor/ndk_translation, Google's ARM64
# translator, from the Android 16 emulator image (see step 4), and vendor/google_apps,
# the Google apps preinstalled on a stock phone (see step 5). Nothing downloaded here is
# redistributed by this repository.
#
# Usage: fetch_gms.sh <aosp_dir> [work_dir]
set -euo pipefail

AOSP=${1:?aosp dir}
WORK=${2:-$HOME/gapps}
MTG_URL=https://gitlab.com/MindTheGapps/vendor_gapps.git
EMU_ZIP=x86_64-35-ext15_r01.zip
NDK_ZIP=x86_64-36_r07.zip
APPS_ZIP=x86_64-37.0_r08.zip
# The browser set (Chrome, its Trichrome library and WebView, one version) comes from the newest
# image whose WebView still carries 32-bit x86 libraries next to x86_64 (see step 5).
BROWSER_ZIP=x86_64-36.1_r04.zip
APPS_SET=4  # bump when step 5 changes, so it runs again
IMG_URL=https://dl.google.com/android/repository/sys-img/google_apis_playstore
HOST=$AOSP/out/host/linux-x86/bin
log() { printf '[gms] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

# extract_image <zip> <dir> <partition>...: download an emulator image and unpack the
# given partitions of its super partition to <dir>/x/<partition>; only the extracted
# trees are kept.
extract_image() {
    local zip=$1 dir=$2 start end p tool
    shift 2
    for tool in lpunpack fsck.erofs; do
        [[ -x $HOST/$tool ]] || { log "build $tool first: m lpunpack fsck.erofs"; exit 1; }
    done
    mkdir -p "$dir" && cd "$dir"
    [[ -f $zip || -f x86_64/system.img ]] || { log "downloading $zip"; curl -f -o "$zip" "$IMG_URL/$zip"; }
    [[ -f x86_64/system.img ]] || unzip -o -q "$zip" x86_64/system.img
    # The disk holds vbmeta and super partitions; take super by its GPT entry.
    read -r start end < <(sgdisk -i 2 x86_64/system.img |
        awk '/First sector/ {s=$3} /Last sector/ {e=$3} END {print s, e}')
    dd if=x86_64/system.img of=super.img bs=512 skip="$start" count=$((end - start + 1)) status=none
    rm -rf parts && mkdir parts
    "$HOST/lpunpack" $(printf -- '-p %s ' "$@") super.img parts/ >/dev/null
    for p in "$@"; do
        rm -rf "x/$p" && mkdir -p "x/$p"
        "$HOST/fsck.erofs" --extract="x/$p" "parts/$p.img" >/dev/null
    done
    rm -rf super.img parts x86_64 "$zip"
}

mkdir -p "$WORK"
G=$AOSP/vendor/gapps

# 1. MindTheGapps without the arm/arm64 trees.
if [[ ! -f $G/x86_64/x86_64-vendor.mk ]]; then
    log "cloning MindTheGapps (vic, x86_64 and common only)"
    rm -rf "$WORK/vendor_gapps"
    git clone -q --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --no-checkout -b vic "$MTG_URL" "$WORK/vendor_gapps"
    git -C "$WORK/vendor_gapps" sparse-checkout init --no-cone
    printf '/*\n!/arm/\n!/arm64/\n' > "$WORK/vendor_gapps/.git/info/sparse-checkout"
    git -C "$WORK/vendor_gapps" checkout -q vic
    rm -rf "$G"
    mv "$WORK/vendor_gapps" "$G"
fi

# 2. Official Android 15 emulator image: product and system_ext.
E=$WORK/emu/x
[[ -f $E/product/priv-app/PrebuiltGmsCore/PrebuiltGmsCore.apk ]] ||
    extract_image "$EMU_ZIP" "$WORK/emu" product system_ext

# 3. Matching Play services / Play Store / GSF and their allowlists.
cp "$E/product/priv-app/PrebuiltGmsCore/PrebuiltGmsCore.apk" \
   "$G/x86_64/proprietary/product/priv-app/GmsCore/GmsCore.apk"
cp "$E/product/priv-app/Phonesky/Phonesky.apk" \
   "$G/x86_64/proprietary/product/priv-app/Phonesky/Phonesky.apk"
cp "$E/system_ext/priv-app/GoogleServicesFramework/GoogleServicesFramework.apk" \
   "$G/common/proprietary/system_ext/priv-app/GoogleServicesFramework/GoogleServicesFramework.apk"
cp "$E/product/etc/permissions/privapp-permissions-google-p.xml" \
   "$G/common/proprietary/product/etc/permissions/privapp-permissions-google-product.xml"
cp "$E/system_ext/etc/permissions/privapp-permissions-google-se.xml" \
   "$G/common/proprietary/system_ext/etc/permissions/privapp-permissions-google-system-ext.xml"
cp "$E/product/etc/sysconfig/google-hiddenapi-package-whitelist.xml" \
   "$G/common/proprietary/product/etc/sysconfig/google-hiddenapi-package-allowlist.xml"
cp "$E/product/etc/sysconfig/google.xml" "$G/common/proprietary/product/etc/sysconfig/google.xml"
cp "$E/product/etc/sysconfig/google_build.xml" "$G/common/proprietary/product/etc/sysconfig/google_build.xml"
log "vendor/gapps ready (Play services, Play Store and GSF from the Android 15 emulator image)"

# 4. Google's ARM64 translator (ndk_translation), for vendor/ndk_translation.
#    WSA's Houdini (2023) cannot load many current ARM64 apps (BTI/PAC code, 16 KB pages,
#    packed libraries). The translator comes from the Android 16 image: the Android 15
#    images carry ndk_translation 0.2.3, which hands translated code the host JNIEnv, so
#    apps that replace JNI functions in it (Microsoft Edge replaces FindClass) crash the
#    runtime; the Android 16 build gives translated code its own JNIEnv. Its host-side
#    dependencies are all present in Android 15. The images carry only the 64-bit
#    translator, so 32-bit ARM apps keep using Houdini.
N=$AOSP/vendor/ndk_translation
if [[ $(cat "$N/source.txt" 2>/dev/null) != "$NDK_ZIP" ]]; then
    S=$WORK/ndk/x/system/system
    [[ -f $S/lib64/libndk_translation.so ]] || extract_image "$NDK_ZIP" "$WORK/ndk" system
    rm -rf "$N" && mkdir -p "$N/system/lib64" "$N/system/bin" "$N/system/etc/binfmt_misc"
    cp -a "$S"/lib64/libndk_translation*.so "$S/lib64/libberberis_exec_region.so" "$N/system/lib64/"
    cp -a "$S/lib64/arm64" "$N/system/lib64/"
    cp -a "$S/etc/cpuinfo.arm64.txt" "$S/etc/ld.config.arm64.txt" "$N/system/etc/"
    cp -a "$S/bin/arm64" "$S/bin/ndk_translation_program_runner_binfmt_misc_arm64" "$N/system/bin/"
    cp -a "$S/etc/binfmt_misc/arm64_exe" "$S/etc/binfmt_misc/arm64_dyn" "$N/system/etc/binfmt_misc/"
    grep -h '^ro.ndk_translation.version=' "$S/build.prop" > "$N/version.prop" || true
    # The image files carry 2009 timestamps; give them the current time so make sees a
    # translator change as newer than the files already installed in out/.
    find "$N" -exec touch -h {} +
    echo "$NDK_ZIP" > "$N/source.txt"
    rm -rf "$WORK/ndk"
fi
log "vendor/ndk_translation ready (from $NDK_ZIP, $(find "$N/system" -type f | wc -l) files)"

# 5. Google apps of a stock Android 15 phone that make sense on a PC, for vendor/google_apps.
#    Google ships them compressed behind stub APKs, which the package manager unpacks to /data
#    on first boot; on a PC disk the plain APK is smaller in total, so they are unpacked here.
#    Google Play updates them all.
#
#    Gmail, YouTube and the Google app come from the newest Google Play emulator image whose
#    build still runs on Android 15 (minSdkVersion <= 35), otherwise from the Android 15 image.
#
#    The browser set - Chrome, Google WebView and the Trichrome library both are built on - is
#    one version from one image (BROWSER_ZIP): WebView and Chrome load the Trichrome library of
#    exactly their own version. WSA runs 32-bit apps too (x86, and 32-bit ARM through Houdini),
#    which load WebView in their own process, so WebView needs x86 next to x86_64 libraries; from
#    API 37 on, the images carry a stand-alone 64-bit-only WebView. Google WebView replaces AOSP's
#    (overrides): AOSP's is never updated, Google's is kept current by Google Play.
A=$AOSP/vendor/google_apps
APPS="app/PrebuiltGmail app/YouTube priv-app/Velvet"
BROWSER="app/Chrome app/TrichromeLibrary app/WebViewGoogle"
min_sdk() {
    "$HOST/aapt2" dump badging "$1" 2>/dev/null | sed -nE "s/^(min)?[sS]dkVersion:'([0-9]+)'.*/\2/p" | head -1
}
badging() { "$HOST/aapt2" dump badging "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
if [[ $(cat "$A/source.txt" 2>/dev/null) != "$APPS_ZIP $BROWSER_ZIP $APPS_SET" ]]; then
    P=$WORK/apps/x/product
    [[ -d $P/app ]] || extract_image "$APPS_ZIP" "$WORK/apps" product
    B=$WORK/browser/x/product
    [[ -d $B/app ]] || extract_image "$BROWSER_ZIP" "$WORK/browser" product
    rm -rf "$A" && mkdir -p "$A"
    # The browser set: from its image only, checked before anything else is taken.
    for entry in $BROWSER; do
        name=${entry#*/} dst=$A/$entry/${entry#*/}.apk src=$B/$entry/${entry#*/}.apk
        mkdir -p "$A/$entry"
        if [[ -f $src.gz ]]; then gunzip -c "$src.gz" > "$dst"
        elif [[ -f $src ]]; then cp "$src" "$dst"
        else log "$name is not in $BROWSER_ZIP"; exit 1
        fi
        sdk=$(min_sdk "$dst")
        [[ -n $sdk && $sdk -le 35 ]] || { log "$name from $BROWSER_ZIP needs API ${sdk:-?}"; exit 1; }
        badging "$dst" | grep -q "alt-native-code: 'x86'" || [[ $name == Chrome ]] ||
            { log "$name from $BROWSER_ZIP has no 32-bit x86 libraries"; exit 1; }
        log "$name $(badging "$dst" | sed -nE "s/.*versionName='([^']*)'.*/\1/p" | head -1)"
    done
    trichrome=$(badging "$A/app/TrichromeLibrary/TrichromeLibrary.apk" | sed -nE "s/^static-library: .* version='([0-9]+)'.*/\1/p")
    for user in Chrome WebViewGoogle; do
        wants=$(badging "$A/app/$user/$user.apk" | sed -nE "s/^uses-static-library: name='com.google.android.trichromelibrary' version='([0-9]+)'.*/\1/p")
        [[ $wants == "$trichrome" ]] || { log "$user wants Trichrome $wants, the set has $trichrome"; exit 1; }
    done
    PRIV=()  # "package|image root" of the privileged apps
    for entry in $APPS; do
        name=${entry#*/} dst=$A/$entry/${entry#*/}.apk
        mkdir -p "$A/$entry"
        for root in "$P" "$E/product"; do
            src=$root/$entry/$name.apk
            if [[ -f $src.gz ]]; then gunzip -c "$src.gz" > "$dst"
            elif [[ -f $src ]]; then cp "$src" "$dst"
            else continue
            fi
            sdk=$(min_sdk "$dst")
            [[ -n $sdk && $sdk -le 35 ]] && break
            log "$name from $root needs API ${sdk:-?}, trying the next image"
            rm -f "$dst"
        done
        [[ -f $dst ]] || { log "no Android 15 build of $name found"; exit 1; }
        log "$name $("$HOST/aapt2" dump badging "$dst" | sed -nE "s/.*versionName='([^']*)'.*/\1/p" | head -1)"
        [[ $entry == priv-app/* ]] &&
            PRIV+=("$("$HOST/aapt2" dump badging "$dst" | sed -nE "s/^package: name='([^']*)'.*/\1/p")|$root")
    done
    # A privileged app from a newer image may hold privileged permissions that the Android 15
    # allowlist (privapp-permissions-google-p.xml) does not name, and Android 15 stops the
    # system server at boot for that. Its allowlist entries come from the image the app came from.
    mkdir -p "$A/etc/permissions"
    python3 - "$A/etc/permissions/privapp-permissions-google-apps.xml" "${PRIV[@]}" <<'PY'
import glob, os, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
out, pairs = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
root = ET.Element("permissions")
for pair in pairs:
    package, image = pair.split("|", 1)
    merged = ET.SubElement(root, "privapp-permissions", package=package)
    seen = set()
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(image, "etc", "permissions", "*.xml"))):
        for block in ET.parse(path).getroot().iter("privapp-permissions"):
            if block.get("package") != package:
                continue
            for child in block:
                key = (child.tag, child.get("name"))
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    ET.SubElement(merged, child.tag, name=child.get("name"))
    print("[gms] %s: %d allowlist entries" % (package, len(seen)), file=sys.stderr)
ET.indent(root)
comment = "<!-- Generated by tools/fetch_gms.sh from the images the privileged Google apps come from. -->"
with open(out, "w") as f:
    f.write('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>' + chr(10) + comment + chr(10))
    f.write(ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode") + chr(10))
PY
    find "$A" -exec touch -h {} +
    {
        echo "// Generated by tools/fetch_gms.sh. Do not edit."
        echo
        echo "soong_namespace {}"
        for entry in $BROWSER $APPS; do
            # The Google app is a module of vendor/gapps; only its APK is replaced below.
            [[ $entry == priv-app/Velvet ]] && continue
            name=${entry#*/}
            echo
            echo "android_app_import {"
            echo "    name: \"$name\","
            echo "    apk: \"$entry/$name.apk\","
            echo "    presigned: true,"
            echo "    preprocessed: true,"
            echo "    dex_preopt: {"
            echo "        enabled: false,"
            echo "    },"
            # Google's WebView instead of AOSP's, which Google Play cannot update.
            [[ $name == WebViewGoogle ]] && echo "    overrides: [\"webview\"],"
            echo "    product_specific: true,"
            echo "}"
        done
    } > "$A/Android.bp"
    echo "$APPS_ZIP $BROWSER_ZIP $APPS_SET" > "$A/source.txt"
    rm -rf "$WORK/apps" "$WORK/browser"
```
