`android/tools/integrate-play-apps.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
# Integrate the Google apps collected from Google Play (tools/collect-play-apps.ps1) into the
# Google Play variant's images, so a new installation starts with this month's versions instead
# of downloading them in its first minutes.
#
# Usage: integrate-play-apps.sh <aosp_dir> <collected_dir>
#
# <collected_dir> holds play-apps.json and one folder per app with its APKs (base and splits)
# and extracted native libraries, exactly as Android installed them from Google Play. They are
# installed unchanged (prebuilt_root: copied, never re-signed or re-aligned) to the folder the
# image's version used (e.g. /product/priv-app/GmsCore), and the image's version is left out
# (overrides). Google Play keeps updating them, since the signature is Google's own.
#
# Checked here: the size and SHA-256 of every file, the signing certificate (the same as the
# image's version), exactly one base APK per app, and that Chrome and WebView load the Trichrome
# library the image carries. Privileged permissions the new versions hold and the image's
# allowlist does not name (found on the device by collect-play-apps.ps1) are allowlisted, since
# Android 15 stops the system server at boot for any that are missing.
#
# Output: vendor/google_apps/play (Android.bp, play.mk, the files), included by
# wsa_x86_64_gapps.mk when present. An unchanged input leaves it untouched.
set -euo pipefail
AOSP=$(readlink -f "$1")
SRC=$(readlink -f "$2")
D=$AOSP/vendor/google_apps/play
HOST=$AOSP/out/host/linux-x86/bin
log() { echo "[play] $*" >&2; }

# The build's staging folders (out/target/product/<device>/<partition>) keep the files of every
# module ever installed: Make does not remove what an overridden module installed in an earlier
# build. Left there, the image's old APK sits next to the new base.apk - two base APKs in one
# folder, which the package manager rejects, so the app would be missing. Every folder an
# integrated app owns is therefore reduced to exactly its files, and the folder of a module left
# out (dropped.txt) is removed, on every run.
clean_staging() {
    local out folder file
    [[ -f $D/expected.txt ]] || return 0
    for out in "$AOSP"/out/target/product/*/; do
        while read -r folder; do
            [[ -n $folder && -d $out$folder ]] && { rm -rf "${out:?}$folder"; log "removed $folder (left out)"; }
        done < "$D/dropped.txt"
        while read -r folder; do
            [[ -d $out$folder ]] || continue
            while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
                grep -qxF "${file#"$out"}" "$D/expected.txt" && continue
                rm -f "$file"
                log "removed ${file#"$out"} (not part of the integrated app)"
            done < <(find "$out$folder" -type f -print0)
        done < "$D/folders.txt"
    done
}

[[ -f $SRC/play-apps.json ]] || { log "no play-apps.json in $SRC"; exit 1; }
[[ -x $HOST/aapt2 && -x $HOST/zipalign ]] || { log "build the host tools first: m aapt2 zipalign"; exit 1; }
stamp=$(sha256sum "$SRC/play-apps.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [[ $(cat "$D/source.txt" 2>/dev/null) == "$stamp" && -f $D/expected.txt ]]; then
    log "unchanged ($(basename "$SRC"))"
    clean_staging
    exit 0
fi
# Generated next to the output and synchronised by content: files that come out the same keep
# their time, so an unchanged Android.bp does not make Soong regenerate (about 20 minutes).
NEW=$D.new
rm -rf "$NEW"
mkdir -p "$NEW"

# apksigner: the AOSP host build's, or the SDK's jar with AOSP's JDK.
APKSIGNER=()
if [[ -x $HOST/apksigner ]]; then
    APKSIGNER=("$HOST/apksigner")
else
    jar=$(ls -1 "$AOSP"/prebuilts/sdk/tools/lib/apksigner.jar /mnt/c/Users/*/AppData/Local/Android/Sdk/build-tools/*/lib/apksigner.jar 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1 || true)
    java=$(ls -1 "$AOSP"/prebuilts/jdk/jdk*/linux-x86/bin/java 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1 || true)
    [[ -n $jar && -n $java ]] && APKSIGNER=("$java" -jar "$jar")
fi
[[ ${#APKSIGNER[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { log "no apksigner (m apksigner, or Google's SDK build-tools)"; exit 1; }

python3 - "$SRC" "$NEW" "$AOSP" "$HOST/aapt2" "$HOST/zipalign" "${APKSIGNER[@]}" <<'PY'
import functools, glob, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

src, out, aosp, aapt2, zipalign = sys.argv[1:6]
apksigner = sys.argv[6:]

def fail(message):
    print("[play] " + message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def badging(apk):
    return subprocess.run([aapt2, "dump", "badging", apk], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

ANDROID_SDK = 35  # Android 15

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)  # one apksigner run (a JVM) per APK
def signer(apk):
    """The signing certificate (SHA-256) Android 15 uses for the app, after checking the APK.

    apksigner names a signer "Signer #1" (v1/v2/v3), or "Signer (minSdkVersion=a,
    maxSdkVersion=b)" when the signers differ by platform version (v3.1 key rotation, apps
    signed with v3 only); then the one whose range holds Android 15 counts."""
    text = subprocess.run(apksigner + ["verify", "--print-certs", apk], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if text.returncode != 0:
        fail("%s: signature does not verify: %s" % (apk, (text.stderr or text.stdout).strip()))
    ranged = re.findall(r"^Signer \(minSdkVersion=(\d+), maxSdkVersion=(\d+)\) certificate SHA-256 digest: ([0-9a-f]{64})",
                        text.stdout, re.M)
    for low, high, digest in ranged:
        if int(low) <= ANDROID_SDK <= int(high):
            return digest
    numbered = re.findall(r"^Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: ([0-9a-f]{64})", text.stdout, re.M)
    if numbered:
        return numbered[0]
    fail("%s: no signer certificate for Android %d" % (apk, ANDROID_SDK))

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def lineage(apk):
    """Every certificate the app was ever signed with (APK Signature Scheme v3 key rotation)."""
    certs = {signer(apk)}
    text = subprocess.run(apksigner + ["lineage", "--in", apk, "--print-certs"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if text.returncode == 0:
        certs.update(re.findall(r"certificate SHA-256 digest: ([0-9a-f]{64})", text.stdout))
    return certs

def same_app_signer(old, new):
    # Android accepts an update signed by the same key or by a successor in its lineage.
    return signer(old) in lineage(new)

def preprocessed_issues(apk, privileged):
    """What Soong's check_prebuilt_presigned_apk.py finds in an unchanged ("preprocessed") APK:
    zip alignment, compressed JNI libraries, compressed dex in a privileged app (Android
    uncompresses privileged apps' dex). Soong refuses skip_preprocessed_apk_checks on an APK
    without issues, so the property is set exactly when there are some."""
    import zipfile
    if subprocess.run([zipalign, "-c", "-p", "4", apk], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode != 0:
        return True
    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as z:
        for info in z.infolist():
            stored = info.compress_type == zipfile.ZIP_STORED
            if info.filename.startswith("lib/") and info.filename.endswith(".so") and not stored:
                return True
            if privileged and info.filename.endswith(".dex") and not stored:
                return True
    return False

def image_apk(kind, module):
    # The image's version of the app: our vendor/google_apps or MindTheGapps' vendor/gapps.
    for pattern in ("vendor/google_apps/%s/%s/%s.apk", "vendor/gapps/**/%s/%s/%s.apk"):
        found = glob.glob(os.path.join(aosp, pattern % (kind, module, module)), recursive=True)
        if found:
            return found[0]
    return None

with open(os.path.join(src, "play-apps.json"), encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    collected = json.load(f)

modules, privapp, versions, uses = [], {}, {}, {}
for app in collected["apps"]:
    package, image_dir = app["package"], app["imageDir"]
    m = re.fullmatch(r"/(system|system_ext|product|vendor)/(app|priv-app)/([^/]+)", image_dir)
    if not m:
        fail("%s: unexpected place in the image: %s" % (package, image_dir))
    partition, kind, folder = m.groups()
    # The base APK goes through android_app_import: Make honours "overrides" only for app
    # modules (PACKAGES.<name>.OVERRIDES), and an overridden module installed anyway would put
    # its own base APK next to this one. It installs <kind>/<name>/<name>.apk; the splits and
    # libraries go to the same folder through prebuilt_root.
    name = folder + "Play"
    copy_dir = os.path.join(out, folder)
    os.makedirs(copy_dir)
    srcs, dsts, bases = [], [], []
    for entry in app["files"]:
        rel = entry["name"]
        path = os.path.join(src, package, *rel.split("/"))
        if not os.path.isfile(path) or os.path.getsize(path) != entry["size"] or sha256(path) != entry["sha256"]:
            fail("%s: %s differs from play-apps.json" % (package, rel))
        is_base = rel.endswith(".apk") and "/" not in rel and not rel.startswith("split_")
        if is_base:
            bases.append(rel)
        installed = "base.apk" if is_base else rel
        target = os.path.join(copy_dir, *installed.split("/"))
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target), exist_ok=True)
        try:
            os.link(path, target)  # same disk: no second copy of the APKs
        except OSError:
            shutil.copy2(path, target)
        if not is_base:
            srcs.append("%s/%s" % (folder, installed))
            dsts.append("%s/%s/%s" % (kind, name, installed))
    if len(bases) != 1:
        fail("%s: expected one base APK, found %s" % (package, bases or "none"))
    base = os.path.join(copy_dir, "base.apk")
    for rel in [r for r in os.listdir(copy_dir) if r.endswith(".apk")]:
        if signer(os.path.join(copy_dir, rel)) != signer(base):
            fail("%s: %s is signed by another certificate than its base APK" % (package, rel))
    old = image_apk(kind, folder)
    if old is None:
        fail("%s: the image's version (%s) was not found under vendor/" % (package, image_dir))
    if not same_app_signer(old, base):
        fail("%s: not signed by the image's version's key or a successor of it" % package)
    info = badging(base)
    versions[package] = re.search(r"versionCode='(\d+)'", info).group(1)
    lib = re.search(r"^static-library: name='([^']+)' version='(\d+)'", info, re.M)
    if lib:
        versions[lib.group(1)] = lib.group(2)
    uses[package] = re.findall(r"^uses-static-library: name='([^']+)' version='(\d+)'", info, re.M)
    overrides = [folder] + (["webview"] if package == "com.google.android.webview" else [])
    privileged = kind == "priv-app"
    modules.append({"name": name, "partition": partition, "kind": kind, "folder": folder,
                    "srcs": srcs, "dsts": dsts, "overrides": overrides, "privileged": privileged,
                    "skip_checks": preprocessed_issues(base, privileged)})
    if app.get("privappMissing"):
        privapp.setdefault(partition, {})[package] = app["privappMissing"]
    print("[play] %-40s %-28s %3d files -> /%s/%s/%s" % (package, app["versionName"], len(srcs) + 1, partition, kind, name),
          file=sys.stderr)

# Chrome and WebView load the Trichrome library of exactly their own version: either the one
# integrated here or the image's. The image's apps that stay (not collected) count as well.
for kind, module, package in (("app", "Chrome", "com.android.chrome"), ("app", "WebViewGoogle", "com.google.android.webview")):
    if package not in uses:
        old = image_apk(kind, module)
        if old:
            uses[package] = re.findall(r"^uses-static-library: name='([^']+)' version='(\d+)'", badging(old), re.M)
# A library no app loads any more (Chrome and WebView from Google Play stand alone) leaves the
# image instead of staying there unused.
needed = {library for needs in uses.values() for library, _ in needs}
if "com.google.android.trichromelibrary" not in needed and "com.google.android.trichromelibrary" not in versions:
    host = next((m for m in modules if m["name"] in ("ChromePlay", "WebViewGooglePlay")), None)
    if host:
        host["overrides"].append("TrichromeLibrary")
        print("[play] TrichromeLibrary: no app uses it any more, left out", file=sys.stderr)
for package, needs in uses.items():
    for library, version in needs:
        have = versions.get(library)
        if have is None:
            image = glob.glob(os.path.join(aosp, "vendor/google_apps/app/TrichromeLibrary/TrichromeLibrary.apk"))
            if image:
                found = re.search(r"^static-library: name='[^']+' version='(\d+)'", badging(image[0]), re.M)
                have = found.group(1) if found else None
        if have != version:
            fail("%s needs %s %s, the image would carry %s" % (package, library, version, have))

def partition_flag(partition):
    return {"system": None, "system_ext": "system_ext_specific", "product": "product_specific",
            "vendor": "vendor"}[partition]

def quoted(items):
    return "[" + ", ".join('"%s"' % i for i in items) + "]"

bp = ["// Generated by tools/integrate-play-apps.sh from %s. Do not edit." % os.path.basename(src)]
names = []
for m in modules:
    flag = partition_flag(m["partition"])
    names.append(m["name"])
    bp += ["", "android_app_import {", '    name: "%s",' % m["name"],
           '    apk: "%s/base.apk",' % m["folder"],
           "    presigned: true,", "    preprocessed: true,"]
    if m["skip_checks"]:
        bp.append("    skip_preprocessed_apk_checks: true,")
    bp += ["    dex_preopt: {", "        enabled: false,", "    },"]
    if m["privileged"]:
        bp.append("    privileged: true,")
    bp.append("    overrides: %s," % quoted(m["overrides"]))
    if flag:
        bp.append("    %s: true," % flag)
    bp.append("}")
    if m["srcs"]:
        names.append(m["name"] + "Splits")
        bp += ["", "prebuilt_root {", '    name: "%sSplits",' % m["name"],
               "    srcs: %s," % quoted(m["srcs"]), "    dsts: %s," % quoted(m["dsts"])]
        if flag:
            bp.append("    %s: true," % flag)
        bp.append("}")
for partition, packages in sorted(privapp.items()):
    name = "privapp-permissions-wsa-next-play-%s" % partition.replace("_", "-")
    root = ET.Element("permissions")
    for package, permissions in sorted(packages.items()):
        block = ET.SubElement(root, "privapp-permissions", package=package)
        for permission in permissions:
            ET.SubElement(block, "permission", name=permission)
    ET.indent(root)
    with open(os.path.join(out, name + ".xml"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n')
        f.write("<!-- Generated by tools/integrate-play-apps.sh: privileged permissions the Google Play\n"
                "     versions hold that the image's allowlist does not name. -->\n")
        f.write(ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode") + "\n")
    names.append(name)
    flag = partition_flag(partition)
    bp += ["", "prebuilt_etc {", '    name: "%s",' % name, '    src: "%s.xml",' % name,
           "    filename_from_src: true,", '    sub_dir: "permissions",']
    if flag:
        bp.append("    %s: true," % flag)
    bp.append("}")
with open(os.path.join(out, "Android.bp"), "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(bp) + "\n")
with open(os.path.join(out, "play.mk"), "w") as f:
    f.write("# Generated by tools/integrate-play-apps.sh. Do not edit.\n")
    f.write("PRODUCT_PACKAGES += \\\n" + " \\\n".join("    " + n for n in names) + "\n")
# What the staging folders may hold (see clean_staging): every installed file of the
# integrated apps, their folders, and the folders of modules left out.
with open(os.path.join(out, "expected.txt"), "w") as f:
    for m in modules:
        f.write("%s/%s/%s/%s.apk\n" % (m["partition"], m["kind"], m["name"], m["name"]))
        f.writelines("%s/%s\n" % (m["partition"], d) for d in m["dsts"])
with open(os.path.join(out, "folders.txt"), "w") as f:
    f.writelines("%s/%s/%s\n" % (m["partition"], m["kind"], m["name"]) for m in modules)
with open(os.path.join(out, "dropped.txt"), "w") as f:
    f.writelines("%s/%s/%s\n" % (m["partition"], m["kind"], m["folder"]) for m in modules)
    if any("TrichromeLibrary" in m["overrides"] for m in modules):
        f.write("product/app/TrichromeLibrary\n")
print("[play] %d apps integrated" % len(modules), file=sys.stderr)
PY
echo "$stamp" > "$NEW/source.txt"

# No -t: a file with the same content keeps its time (rsync -a would set it again).

clean_staging
```

`android/tools/locales/SetLocales.java`:

```java
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
//
// Sets Android's system language list the way Settings > System > Languages does
// (LocalePicker.updateLocales), for collect-play-apps.ps1: Google Play delivers an app's
// language splits for every language on the device's list, so a reference installation that
// lists them all collects the apps with every language. The first language stays the UI's.
//
// Reflection only, so it builds without android.jar:
//   javac --release 8 -d classes SetLocales.java
//   d8 --min-api 30 --output . classes/SetLocales.class          (d8: Google's SDK build-tools)
//   adb push classes.dex /data/local/tmp/locales.dex
//   adb shell CLASSPATH=/data/local/tmp/locales.dex app_process /system/bin SetLocales "pl-PL,en-US,de,..."
// It needs root (adb root) and prints the list Android now uses.
public class SetLocales {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        if (args.length != 1) {
            System.err.println("usage: SetLocales <comma-separated BCP 47 language tags>");
            System.exit(2);
        }
        Class<?> configurationClass = Class.forName("android.content.res.Configuration");
        Class<?> localeListClass = Class.forName("android.os.LocaleList");
        Object service = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityManager").getMethod("getService").invoke(null);
        Object config = service.getClass().getMethod("getConfiguration").invoke(service);
        Object list = localeListClass.getMethod("forLanguageTags", String.class).invoke(null, args[0]);
        configurationClass.getMethod("setLocales", localeListClass).invoke(config, list);
        configurationClass.getField("userSetLocale").setBoolean(config, true);
        service.getClass().getMethod("updatePersistentConfigurationWithAttribution",
                configurationClass, String.class, String.class).invoke(service, config, "com.android.shell", null);
        Object now = service.getClass().getMethod("getConfiguration").invoke(service);
        System.out.println(configurationClass.getMethod("getLocales").invoke(now));
    }
}
```

`android/tools/make_stock_initrd.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
# Rebuild Microsoft's original WSA initrd (a single /init) from a WSABuilds/MagiskOnWSA
# initrd, where the original init is kept as /wsainit next to Magisk's loaders.
# Usage: make_stock_initrd.sh <initrd.img in> <initrd.img out>
set -euo pipefail
IN=${1:?input initrd}; OUT=${2:?output initrd}
TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir "$TMP/x" "$TMP/root"
(cd "$TMP/x" && cpio -idm --quiet < "$(realpath "$IN")")
if [[ -f $TMP/x/wsainit ]]; then
    cp "$TMP/x/wsainit" "$TMP/root/init"      # patched initrd: original init was renamed
else
    cp "$TMP/x/init" "$TMP/root/init"         # already a stock initrd
fi
chmod 0750 "$TMP/root/init"
(cd "$TMP/root" && find . | LC_ALL=C sort | cpio -o -H newc --quiet --owner=0:0) > "$OUT"
sha256sum "$TMP/root/init" "$OUT"
```

`android/tools/package-release.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
# Package a WSA-Next release: every component as one zstd stream plus manifest.json, the file the
# installer (WSA-Next.exe) reads. See src/core/Manifest.h for the format.
#
# Usage: package-release.sh --images <dir> --wsa <dir> --initrd <file> --out <dir> --version <v>
#                           [--android <text>] [--variant <text>] [--base-url <url>] [--wsapatch <file>]
#   --images    folder with system.vhdx, system_ext.vhdx and product.vhdx (tools/build.sh output)
#   --wsa       unpacked WSA 2407 package (AppxManifest.xml, WsaClient\, vendor.vhdx, Tools\kernel ...)
#   --initrd    the initrd to boot with (tools/make_stock_initrd.sh)
#   --out       output folder (manifest.json and the .zst files)
#   --base-url  prefix for the component URLs in the manifest (default: relative to the manifest)
#
# Unchanged components keep their file: a .zst whose source has not changed since the last run
# (same size and SHA-256 recorded in <out>/.sources) is not compressed again.
set -euo pipefail

IMAGES= WSA= INITRD= OUT= VERSION= ANDROID="Android 15" VARIANT="Google Play" BASE_URL= WSAPATCH=
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --images) IMAGES=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --wsa) WSA=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --initrd) INITRD=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --out) OUT=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --version) VERSION=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --android) ANDROID=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --variant) VARIANT=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --base-url) BASE_URL=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --wsapatch) WSAPATCH=$2; shift 2 ;;
        *) echo "unknown argument $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done
for v in IMAGES WSA INITRD OUT VERSION; do
    [[ -n ${!v} ]] || { echo "--${v,,} is required" >&2; exit 2; }
done
for tool in zstd tar sha256sum; do
    command -v $tool >/dev/null || { echo "$tool is required" >&2; exit 1; }
done
log() { printf '[package] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

mkdir -p "$OUT"
SOURCES=$OUT/.sources
touch "$SOURCES"
WORK=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
COMPONENTS=()

# component <id> <kind> <target> <source file> [optional]
component() {
    local id=$1 kind=$2 target=$3 src=$4 optional=${5:-false}
    local zst="${target##*/}.zst"  # system.vhdx.zst, kernel.zst, initrd.img.zst
    [[ $kind == archive ]] && zst="$id.tar.zst"
    local size sum stamp
    size=$(stat -c %s "$src")
    sum=$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    stamp="$id $size $sum"
    if grep -qxF "$stamp" "$SOURCES" && [[ -f $OUT/$zst ]]; then
        log "$id: unchanged"
    else
        log "$id: compressing $(numfmt --to=iec "$size")"
        # A 2 GB window (--long=31, which the installer's decoder allows) for the best ratio.
        # Every worker holds its own job buffers, so four workers keep the memory of a
        # multi-gigabyte image well inside a 16 GB WSL; the ratio hardly depends on their number.
        zstd -q -19 --long=31 -T4 -f "$src" -o "$OUT/$zst.new"
        mv -f "$OUT/$zst.new" "$OUT/$zst"
        grep -v "^$id " "$SOURCES" > "$SOURCES.new" || true
        echo "$stamp" >> "$SOURCES.new"
        mv -f "$SOURCES.new" "$SOURCES"
    fi
    local packed packedSum
    packed=$(stat -c %s "$OUT/$zst")
    packedSum=$(sha256sum "$OUT/$zst" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    log "$id: $(numfmt --to=iec "$size") -> $(numfmt --to=iec "$packed")"
    # "sha256": the unpacked file as installed (disks and files). The manifest is signed, so the
    # installed Android images can be checked against the official release.
    COMPONENTS+=("$(printf '    {\n      "id": "%s",\n      "kind": "%s",\n      "target": "%s",\n      "url": "%s",\n      "packedSize": %s,\n      "packedSha256": "%s",\n      "size": %s,%s\n      "version": "%s"%s\n    }' \
        "$id" "$kind" "$target" "$BASE_URL$zst" "$packed" "$packedSum" "$size" \
        "$([[ $kind != archive ]] && printf '\n      "sha256": "%s",' "$sum")" "$VERSION" \
        "$([[ $optional == true ]] && printf ',\n      "optional": true')")")
}

# The Windows part: the package without the Android disks, the boot files (own components) and
# the scripts of the tools it was unpacked with. The tar is reproducible (sorted, fixed owner).
STAGE=$WORK/windows
mkdir -p "$STAGE"
(cd "$WSA" && find . -type f \
    ! -name '*.vhdx' ! -path './Tools/*' ! -name 'Install.ps1' ! -name 'Run.bat' ! -name 'MakePri.ps1' \
    ! -name 'makepri.exe' ! -name 'filelist.txt' ! -name 'upgrade-magisk.md' ! -name 'WSAPatch.exe' \
    ! -path './pri/*' ! -path './xml/*' -print0) |
    (cd "$WSA" && xargs -0 cp --parents -t "$STAGE")
[[ -f $STAGE/AppxManifest.xml ]] || { echo "no AppxManifest.xml in $WSA" >&2; exit 1; }
tar --format=pax --sort=name --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mtime='2024-07-01 00:00Z' \
    --pax-option=exthdr.name=%d/PaxHeaders/%f,delete=atime,delete=ctime -C "$STAGE" -cf "$WORK/windows.tar" .
# Metadata and the empty user data disk are part of Microsoft's package.
for disk in metadata userdata; do
    [[ -f $WSA/$disk.vhdx ]] && cp "$WSA/$disk.vhdx" "$WORK/$disk.vhdx"
done

component system disk system.vhdx "$IMAGES/system.vhdx"
component system_ext disk system_ext.vhdx "$IMAGES/system_ext.vhdx"
component product disk product.vhdx "$IMAGES/product.vhdx"
component vendor disk vendor.vhdx "$WSA/vendor.vhdx"
component kernel file Tools/kernel "$WSA/Tools/kernel"
component initrd file Tools/initrd.img "$INITRD"
component windows archive . "$WORK/windows.tar"
[[ -f $WORK/metadata.vhdx ]] && component metadata disk metadata.vhdx "$WORK/metadata.vhdx"
[[ -f $WORK/userdata.vhdx ]] && component userdata disk userdata.vhdx "$WORK/userdata.vhdx"
[[ -n $WSAPATCH ]] && component wsapatch file WSAPatch.exe "$WSAPATCH" true

{
    printf '{\n  "format": 1,\n  "name": "WSA-Next",\n  "version": "%s",\n  "android": "%s",\n  "variant": "%s",\n  "minWindowsBuild": 22000,\n  "components": [\n' \
        "$VERSION" "$ANDROID" "$VARIANT"
    for i in "${!COMPONENTS[@]}"; do
        printf '%s' "${COMPONENTS[$i]}"
        [[ $i -lt $((${#COMPONENTS[@]} - 1)) ]] && printf ','
        printf '\n'
    done
    printf '  ]\n}\n'
} > "$OUT/manifest.json.new"
mv -f "$OUT/manifest.json.new" "$OUT/manifest.json"
log "manifest.json: release $VERSION, ${#COMPONENTS[@]} components, $(du -ch "$OUT"/*.zst | tail -1 | cut -f1) to download"

```

`android/tools/split_ms_classes.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
"""Split Microsoft classes of a WSA app into "binary" and "port" sets.

binary  com.microsoft.* (and WSA glue) classes that only use the public/hidden framework.
        They keep working on a newer Android as compiled bytecode and are copied into
        <out>-binary.jar (taken from a dex2jar conversion of the same APK).
port    classes that extend or call SystemUI / WM Shell / Dagger internals. These must be
        recompiled from source against the new SystemUI-core; they are only listed.

Usage: split_ms_classes.py <app.apk> <app-dex2jar.jar> <out_prefix> [support_prefix ...]
  support_prefix  extra class-name prefixes copied as-is into the binary jar, for runtime
                  libraries the Microsoft classes need and the target app does not provide
                  (e.g. com/google/protobuf/ for protobuf-lite, windows/ for AIDL stubs).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from dexmodel import load_classes  # noqa: E402

MS = ('Lcom/microsoft/', 'Lcom/android/systemui/wsa/', 'Lcom/android/wm/shell/dagger/Wsa')
INTERNAL = ('Lcom/android/systemui/', 'Lcom/android/wm/shell/', 'Lcom/android/keyguard/',
            'Lcom/android/settingslib/', 'Lcom/android/launcher3/', 'Ldagger/', 'Ljavax/inject/')


def main():
    apk, d2j_jar, prefix = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
    support = tuple(sys.argv[4:])
    classes = load_classes([apk], with_code=True)
    ms = {k: v for k, v in classes.items() if k.startswith(MS)}

    def coupled(cd) -> bool:
        types = {cd.superclass, *cd.interfaces} - {None}
        for m in cd.methods.values():
            types.update(ref[0].lstrip('[') for kind, ref in m.refs if kind != 'const')
        return any(t.startswith(INTERNAL) and not t.startswith(MS) for t in types)

    port = {k for k, cd in ms.items() if coupled(cd)}
    # Inner/synthetic classes follow their outer class
    outer = lambda n: n.split('$', 1)[0].rstrip(';') + ';'  # noqa: E731
    port_outer = {outer(n) for n in port}
    port |= {k for k in ms if outer(k) in port_outer}
    binary = set(ms) - port

    # dex2jar renames D8 synthetic classes "Foo-IA" to "Foo_IA" (and all references to them)
    wanted = {n[1:-1].replace('-', '_') + '.class' for n in binary}
    written = supported = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(d2j_jar) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(f'{prefix}-binary.jar', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for info in zin.infolist():
            if info.filename in wanted:
                zout.writestr(info.filename, zin.read(info.filename))
                written += 1
            elif support and info.filename.endswith('.class') and info.filename.startswith(support):
                zout.writestr(info.filename, zin.read(info.filename))
                supported += 1
    Path(f'{prefix}-port.txt').write_text(
        '\n'.join(sorted(n[1:-1].replace('/', '.') for n in port)) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    missing = len(wanted) - written
    print(f'{apk.name}: microsoft={len(ms)} binary={len(binary)} (jar entries {written}, missing {missing}) '
          f'support={supported} port={len(port)} -> {prefix}-binary.jar, {prefix}-port.txt')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`build.ps1`:

```ps1
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#Requires -Version 7.0
# Builds WSA-Next.vcxproj (x64) - GUI and command line in one executable, C++23.
#
# Nothing is hard-coded: the toolchain is chosen by evidence on this machine.
#   * Visual Studio: every instance vswhere reports (-all -products *: SQL Server Management Studio is
#     listed too, so products without the C++ tools are skipped) plus a scan of "Microsoft Visual Studio";
#     usable = MSBuild.exe + the platform toolset named in the project + an MSVC with bin\Host<arch>\x64\cl.exe.
#   * MSVC and Windows SDK: the newest version (sorted as [version]) whose files are really there -
#     cl.exe, and for the SDK <arch>\rc.exe, um\Windows.h and um\x64\kernel32.lib.
#   * Host: the output is x64 either way. On ARM64 Windows the ARM64-hosted tools (MSBuild\Current\Bin\arm64,
#     bin\Hostarm64\x64, SDK bin\<version>\arm64) come first, the x64-hosted ones under emulation second.
# Afterwards bin\build-receipt.json records toolchain, input hashes and output hashes.
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Release', 'Debug')][string]$Configuration = 'Release',
    [switch]$Rebuild,
    [switch]$Clean
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$project = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'WSA-Next.vcxproj'
$bin = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin'
$obj = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'obj'

if ($Clean) {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $obj -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $bin 'WSA-Next*'), (Join-Path $bin 'build-receipt.json') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bin 'language') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host 'Cleaned obj\ and the build output in bin\.' -ForegroundColor Green
    return
}

function Get-Inputs {
    $paths = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'src'), (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'third_party') -Recurse -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName)
    $paths += $project, "$project.filters", $PSCommandPath
    @($paths | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object {
        [pscustomobject]@{ path = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($PSScriptRoot, $_); sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_).Hash }
    })
}

# --- Toolchain --------------------------------------------------------------------
$toolset = ([xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $project)).Project.PropertyGroup.PlatformToolset | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
$programFilesX86 = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ProgramFiles(x86)')
$candidates = @()
$vswhere = Join-Path $programFilesX86 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere) {
    $candidates += & $vswhere -all -products '*' -prerelease -format value -property installationPath
}
foreach ($base in $env:ProgramFiles, $programFilesX86) {
    $vsBase = Join-Path $base 'Microsoft Visual Studio'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vsBase) {
        $candidates += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $vsBase -Directory |
            ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Directory } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
    }
}
# The machine's architecture comes from the registry: a process under x64 emulation sees AMD64.
$hostArm64 = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment').PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64'
$hosts = @(if ($hostArm64) { 'arm64', 'x64' } else { 'x64' })
$found = foreach ($vs in ($candidates | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -Unique)) {
    $hasToolset = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $vs 'MSBuild\Microsoft\VC') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName "Platforms\x64\PlatformToolsets\$toolset") }
    if (-not $hasToolset) { continue }
    for ($rank = 0; $rank -lt $hosts.Count; $rank++) {
        $arch = $hosts[$rank]
        $msbuild = Join-Path $vs "MSBuild\Current\Bin\$(if ($arch -eq 'x64') { 'amd64' } else { $arch })\MSBuild.exe"
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $msbuild)) { continue }
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $vs 'VC\Tools\MSVC') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -as [version] -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName "bin\Host$arch\x64\cl.exe")) } |
            ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ msbuild = $msbuild; msvc = $_.Name; vs = $vs; host = $arch; rank = $rank } }
    }
}
# The newest MSVC; of one version, the tools native to this machine.
$toolchain = $found | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { [version]$_.msvc }; Descending = $true }, @{ Expression = 'rank'; Ascending = $true } |
    Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $toolchain) { throw "No Visual Studio with MSBuild, the $toolset toolset and a C++ compiler for x64 ($($hosts -join ' or ') host) was found." }

$kits = Join-Path $programFilesX86 'Windows Kits\10'
$sdk = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kits 'bin') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.Name -as [version] -and
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName "$($toolchain.host)\rc.exe")) -and
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kits "Include\$($_.Name)\um\Windows.h")) -and
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kits "Lib\$($_.Name)\um\x64\kernel32.lib")) } |
    Sort-Object { [version]$_.Name } -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $sdk) { throw "No complete Windows SDK ($($toolchain.host) rc.exe, headers and x64 libraries) was found." }
Write-Host "MSVC $($toolchain.msvc)  |  Windows SDK $($sdk.Name)  |  toolset $toolset  |  $Configuration x64  |  $($toolchain.host) tools" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# --- Build ------------------------------------------------------------------------
$inputs = Get-Inputs
$arguments = @(
    $project, "/p:Configuration=$Configuration", '/p:Platform=x64', "/p:PlatformToolset=$toolset",
    "/p:VCToolsVersion=$($toolchain.msvc)", "/p:WindowsTargetPlatformVersion=$($sdk.Name)",
    "/p:PreferredToolArchitecture=$($toolchain.host)",
    "/t:$(if ($Rebuild) { 'Rebuild' } else { 'Build' })", '/m', '/nologo', '/v:minimal', '/clp:Summary'
)
& $toolchain.msbuild @arguments
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "Build failed ($LASTEXITCODE)." }
if ((ConvertTo-Json $inputs -Compress) -ne (ConvertTo-Json (Get-Inputs) -Compress)) {
    throw 'Sources changed while compiling - build again.'
}

# --- Result -----------------------------------------------------------------------
$name = if ($Configuration -eq 'Debug') { 'WSA-Next_debug.exe' } else { 'WSA-Next.exe' }
$outputs = @(Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bin $name)) + @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bin 'language') -Filter *.lng -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
$outputs = @($outputs | ForEach-Object {
    [pscustomobject]@{ path = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($bin, $_.FullName); length = $_.Length; sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash }
})
[pscustomobject]@{
    configuration = $Configuration; msvc = $toolchain.msvc; sdk = $sdk.Name; toolset = $toolset; toolHost = $toolchain.host
    visualStudio = $toolchain.vs; inputs = $inputs; outputs = $outputs
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bin 'build-receipt.json') -Encoding utf8
$outputs | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Host "Build succeeded (/W4 /WX /sdl /guard:cf, CET, /Brepro). Receipt: bin\build-receipt.json" -ForegroundColor Green

```

`build_msi.ps1`:

```ps1
# WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#Requires -Version 7.0
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Builds WSA-Next Setup: bin\WSA-Next.msi, and bin\WSA-Next.zip with the same files for those who
    prefer no installer.

.DESCRIPTION
    Windows' own tools only - makecab.exe and the Windows Installer COM API - so that anyone with
    Windows can rebuild the package from these sources and compare it with a release.

    WSA-Next.msi:
      * per machine, x64, in %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next. The folder is fixed: the background host
        starts at logon with the highest rights and must run from a folder only administrators
        can change, and WSA-Next looks for itself there;
      * a setup wizard: welcome, the MIT License, ready (with a desktop shortcut), progress, finish
        (start WSA-Next). Run again: repair, or remove - optionally with the Android apps and their
        data;
      * in every language WSA-Next speaks: one transform per language embedded in the package
        (installer\msi-strings.json), which Windows applies by the user's language. Windows
        Installer keeps text in an ANSI code page; Hindi has none and stays English;
      * WSA-Next's own work around it: its background host is stopped before files change and
        started again after an update, and removing WSA-Next runs "WSA-Next.exe uninstall" first,
        so the Windows Subsystem for Android, its disks, its registration and the host's logon
        task go too (WSA-Next.exe elevates itself for that when needed);
      * major upgrades (one UpgradeCode, component IDs derived from the file names), no downgrade,
        an Apps & Features entry with the icon and the project's links.

.PARAMETER SignScript
    Signs WSA-Next.msi with the publisher's certificate (a private script, not in this repository).

.PARAMETER AllowUnsigned
    Test builds: accept an unsigned bin\WSA-Next.exe. Official packages carry a signed executable.

.EXAMPLE
    .\build.ps1; <sign bin\WSA-Next.exe>; .\build_msi.ps1 -SignScript C:\path\to\sign.ps1
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$SignScript,
    [switch]$AllowUnsigned
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$root = $PSScriptRoot
$bin = Join-Path $root 'bin'
$exePath = Join-Path $bin 'WSA-Next.exe'
$langDir = Join-Path $bin 'language'
$iconPath = Join-Path $root 'src\resources\icon.ico'
$licensePath = Join-Path $root 'LICENSE.md'
$stringsPath = Join-Path $root 'installer\msi-strings.json'
$msiPath = Join-Path $bin 'WSA-Next.msi'
$zipPath = Join-Path $bin 'WSA-Next.zip'

# The identity of the product across all its versions. Never change it: Windows finds earlier
# versions by it and replaces them.
$upgradeCode = '{8F4A9E21-6C3D-4B7A-9E12-5D8A1C3F4E90}'

# --- Inputs -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
foreach ($p in $exePath, $iconPath, $licensePath, $stringsPath) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { throw "Missing: $p (run .\build.ps1 first for bin\)." }
}
$bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($exePath)
$pe = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, 0x3C)
if ([BitConverter]::ToUInt16($bytes, $pe + 4) -ne 0x8664) { throw 'bin\WSA-Next.exe is not an x64 executable.' }
$exeSignature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $exePath
if ($exeSignature.Status -ne 'Valid' -and -not $AllowUnsigned) {
    throw "bin\WSA-Next.exe is not signed ($($exeSignature.Status)). Sign it first, or pass -AllowUnsigned for a test build."
}
$fileVersion = [version](Get-Item -LiteralPath $exePath).VersionInfo.FileVersion
$productVersion = '{0}.{1}.{2}' -f $fileVersion.Major, $fileVersion.Minor, $fileVersion.Build  # MSI compares three fields
$lngFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $langDir -Filter '*.lng' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name)
$text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $stringsPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
$en = $text.strings.en
[Text.Encoding]::RegisterProvider([Text.CodePagesEncodingProvider]::Instance)

Write-Host "WSA-Next Setup  |  v$productVersion  |  WSA-Next.exe $fileVersion ($($exeSignature.Status))  |  $($lngFiles.Count) language files  |  $($text.languages.Count + 1) setup languages" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# --- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A stable GUID from a name (SHA-1, version 5 layout): the same file keeps the same component ID
# in every version, as Windows Installer's component rules want.
function NameGuid([string]$name) {
    $hash = [Security.Cryptography.SHA1]::HashData([byte[]]([guid]$upgradeCode).ToByteArray() + [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($name))
    $hash[6] = ($hash[6] -band 0x0F) -bor 0x50
    $hash[8] = ($hash[8] -band 0x3F) -bor 0x80
    '{' + ([guid]::new([byte[]]$hash[0..15])).ToString().ToUpperInvariant() + '}'
}
function NewGuid { '{' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString().ToUpperInvariant() + '}' }

$installer = New-Object -ComObject WindowsInstaller.Installer
$Method = [Reflection.BindingFlags]::InvokeMethod
$Get = [Reflection.BindingFlags]::GetProperty
$Set = [Reflection.BindingFlags]::SetProperty
function Inv($obj, [string]$name, [Reflection.BindingFlags]$kind, [object[]]$params) {
    # IDispatch takes plain values: PowerShell's wrappers (PSObject) are taken off.
    if ($null -ne $params) { $params = [object[]]@(foreach ($p in $params) { if ($p -is [psobject]) { $p.psobject.BaseObject } else { $p } }) }
    $obj.GetType().InvokeMember($name, $kind, $null, $obj, $params)
}
function Free($obj) { if ($obj) { [void][Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::FinalReleaseComObject($obj) } }

# Runs a query with ? parameters: integers as integers, FileInfo as a stream, the rest as text,
# $null as a null field.
function Sql($db, [string]$query, [object[]]$values) {
    $view = Inv $db 'OpenView' $Method @($query)
    $record = $null
    try {
        if ($values) {
            $record = Inv $installer 'CreateRecord' $Method @([int]$values.Count)
            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $values.Count; $i++) {
                $v = $values[$i]
                if ($null -eq $v) { continue }
                if ($v -is [int] -or $v -is [long]) { [void](Inv $record 'IntegerData' $Set @([int]($i + 1), [int]$v)) }
                elseif ($v -is [IO.FileInfo]) { [void](Inv $record 'SetStream' $Method @([int]($i + 1), $v.FullName)) }
                else { [void](Inv $record 'StringData' $Set @([int]($i + 1), [string]$v)) }
            }
            [void](Inv $view 'Execute' $Method @($record))
        } else {
            [void](Inv $view 'Execute' $Method $null)
        }
    } finally {
        [void](Inv $view 'Close' $Method $null)
        Free $record
        Free $view
    }
}
function Insert($db, [string]$table, [string[]]$columns, [object[]]$values) {
    if ($values.Count -ne $columns.Count) { throw "$table`: $($columns.Count) columns, $($values.Count) values ($($values -join ' | '))." }
    $names = ($columns | ForEach-Object { "``$_``" }) -join ','
    $marks = (1..$columns.Count | ForEach-Object { '?' }) -join ','
    Sql $db "INSERT INTO ``$table`` ($names) VALUES ($marks)" $values
}

# Text as the language's ANSI code page can hold it: precomposed letters it lacks are written as
# a base letter and combining marks (Vietnamese), and the language's own replacements apply
# (Persian yeh -> Arabic yeh, which cp1256 has). Anything else is an error, never a silent "?".
function ForCodePage([string]$value, [int]$codePage, $replace, [string]$what) {
    if ($replace) { foreach ($k in $replace.Keys) { $value = $value.Replace($k, $replace[$k]) } }
    $encoding = [Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding($codePage, [Text.EncoderFallback]::ExceptionFallback, [Text.DecoderFallback]::ExceptionFallback)
    $fits = { param($s) try { [void]$encoding.GetBytes([string]$s); $true } catch { $false } }
    $out = [Text.StringBuilder]::new()
    $elements = [Globalization.StringInfo]::GetTextElementEnumerator($value.Normalize([Text.NormalizationForm]::FormC))
    while ($elements.MoveNext()) {
        $element = [string]$elements.Current
        if (& $fits $element) { [void]$out.Append($element); continue }
        # A base letter with some of its marks composed (the code page's own letters, such as
        # Vietnamese "ă"), the other marks after it as combining characters ("ặ" = "ă" + dot below).
        $parts = $element.Normalize([Text.NormalizationForm]::FormD)
        $base = $parts.Substring(0, 1)
        $marks = $parts.Substring(1).ToCharArray()
        $written = $false
        for ($mask = (1 -shl $marks.Count) - 1; $mask -ge 0 -and -not $written; $mask--) {
            $composed = $base; $rest = ''
            for ($m = 0; $m -lt $marks.Count; $m++) { if ($mask -band (1 -shl $m)) { $composed += $marks[$m] } else { $rest += $marks[$m] } }
            $head = $composed.Normalize([Text.NormalizationForm]::FormC)
            if ($head.Length -eq 1 -and (& $fits $head) -and ($rest -eq '' -or (& $fits $rest))) { [void]$out.Append($head + $rest); $written = $true }
        }
        if (-not $written) { throw "$what`: '$element' does not exist in code page $codePage." }
    }
    $out.ToString()
}

# --- Staging: cabinet, bitmaps, license ----------------------------------------------------------
$stage = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "wsa-next-msi-$PID"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stage -Force | Out-Null
try {
    # Files: WSA-Next.exe and every language file, one component each (its key path).
    $files = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
    $files.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Key = 'WsaNextExe'; Component = 'CompExe'; Directory = 'INSTALLDIR'; Name = 'WSA-Next.exe'; Source = $exePath; Version = $fileVersion.ToString() })
    foreach ($lng in $lngFiles) {
        $id = ($lng.BaseName -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '_')
        $files.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Key = "Lng_$id"; Component = "CompLng_$id"; Directory = 'LANGDIR'; Name = $lng.Name; Source = $lng.FullName; Version = $null })
    }
    $cabFiles = Join-Path $stage 'cab'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $cabFiles -Force | Out-Null
    $ddf = [Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    foreach ($line in '.OPTION EXPLICIT', '.Set CabinetNameTemplate=data.cab', ".Set DiskDirectoryTemplate=$stage", '.Set Cabinet=on', '.Set Compress=on',
                      '.Set CompressionType=LZX', '.Set CompressionMemory=21', '.Set MaxDiskSize=0', '.Set InfFileName=NUL', '.Set RptFileName=NUL') { $ddf.Add($line) }
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $staged = Join-Path $cabFiles $f.Key
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.Source -Destination $staged -Force
        $ddf.Add("`"$staged`" $($f.Key)")
    }
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $stage 'data.ddf') -Value $ddf -Encoding ASCII
    Push-Location $stage
    try {
        & makecab.exe /F (Join-Path $stage 'data.ddf') | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "makecab.exe failed ($LASTEXITCODE)." }
    } finally { Pop-Location }
    $cabPath = Join-Path $stage 'data.cab'

    # Bitmaps at Windows Installer's own scale (370 x 234 units = 493 x 312 pixels at 96 DPI), so
    # the 48-pixel icon is drawn 1:1: the welcome / finish picture (a dark panel with the icon on
    # the left, white behind the text) and the banner of the other pages.
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
    $logo = [Drawing.Icon]::new($iconPath, 48, 48).ToBitmap()
    $dialogBmp = Join-Path $stage 'dialog.bmp'
    $bannerBmp = Join-Path $stage 'banner.bmp'
    $bmp = [Drawing.Bitmap]::new(493, 312, [Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format24bppRgb)
    $g = [Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
    $g.Clear([Drawing.Color]::White)
    $panel = [Drawing.Rectangle]::new(0, 0, 164, 312)
    $gradient = [Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush]::new($panel, [Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(0x0B, 0x12, 0x20), [Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(0x0E, 0x3B, 0x2A), 90.0)
    $g.FillRectangle($gradient, $panel)
    $g.FillRectangle([Drawing.SolidBrush]::new([Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(0x3D, 0xDC, 0x84)), 164, 0, 2, 312)
    $g.DrawImage($logo, 58, 96, 48, 48)
    $g.Dispose(); $gradient.Dispose()
    $bmp.Save($dialogBmp, [Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Bmp); $bmp.Dispose()
    $bmp = [Drawing.Bitmap]::new(493, 58, [Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format24bppRgb)
    $g = [Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
    $g.Clear([Drawing.Color]::White)
    $g.DrawImage($logo, 493 - 48 - 12, 5, 48, 48)
    $g.Dispose()
    $bmp.Save($bannerBmp, [Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Bmp); $bmp.Dispose(); $logo.Dispose()

    # The license page shows LICENSE.md as RTF (paragraphs; non-ASCII as \uN escapes).
    $paragraphs = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $licensePath -Raw -Encoding UTF8) -split '(\r?\n){2,}' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '\r?\n', ' ').Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ }
    $escape = {
        param([string]$s)
        $sb = [Text.StringBuilder]::new()
        foreach ($ch in $s.ToCharArray()) {
            if ('\{}'.Contains($ch)) { [void]$sb.Append('\').Append($ch) }
            elseif ([int]$ch -gt 127) { [void]$sb.Append("\u$([int]$ch)?") }
            else { [void]$sb.Append($ch) }
        }
        $sb.ToString()
    }
    $rtf = '{\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg1252\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0\fswiss\fcharset0 Segoe UI;}}\viewkind4\uc1\pard\sa120\f0\fs18 '
    $rtf += '\b ' + (& $escape $paragraphs[0]) + '\b0\par '
    $rtf += (($paragraphs | Select-Object -Skip 1 | ForEach-Object { & $escape $_ }) -join '\par ') + '\par}'

    # --- The database ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $msiPath) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $msiPath -Force }
    $db = Inv $installer 'OpenDatabase' $Method @($msiPath, [int]3)  # msiOpenDatabaseModeCreate
    $schema = @(
        'CREATE TABLE `Property` (`Property` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Value` LONGCHAR NOT NULL LOCALIZABLE PRIMARY KEY `Property`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Directory` (`Directory` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Directory_Parent` CHAR(72), `DefaultDir` CHAR(255) NOT NULL LOCALIZABLE PRIMARY KEY `Directory`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Component` (`Component` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `ComponentId` CHAR(38), `Directory_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Attributes` SHORT NOT NULL, `Condition` CHAR(255), `KeyPath` CHAR(72) PRIMARY KEY `Component`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Feature` (`Feature` CHAR(38) NOT NULL, `Feature_Parent` CHAR(38), `Title` CHAR(64) LOCALIZABLE, `Description` CHAR(255) LOCALIZABLE, `Display` SHORT, `Level` SHORT NOT NULL, `Directory_` CHAR(72), `Attributes` SHORT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Feature`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `FeatureComponents` (`Feature_` CHAR(38) NOT NULL, `Component_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Feature_`, `Component_`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `File` (`File` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Component_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `FileName` CHAR(255) NOT NULL LOCALIZABLE, `FileSize` LONG NOT NULL, `Version` CHAR(72), `Language` CHAR(20), `Attributes` SHORT, `Sequence` SHORT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `File`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Media` (`DiskId` SHORT NOT NULL, `LastSequence` SHORT NOT NULL, `DiskPrompt` CHAR(64) LOCALIZABLE, `Cabinet` CHAR(255), `VolumeLabel` CHAR(32), `Source` CHAR(72) PRIMARY KEY `DiskId`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Icon` (`Name` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Data` OBJECT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Name`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Binary` (`Name` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Data` OBJECT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Name`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Shortcut` (`Shortcut` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Directory_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Name` CHAR(128) NOT NULL LOCALIZABLE, `Component_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Target` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Arguments` CHAR(255), `Description` CHAR(255) LOCALIZABLE, `Hotkey` SHORT, `Icon_` CHAR(72), `IconIndex` SHORT, `ShowCmd` SHORT, `WkDir` CHAR(72) PRIMARY KEY `Shortcut`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Registry` (`Registry` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Root` SHORT NOT NULL, `Key` CHAR(255) NOT NULL LOCALIZABLE, `Name` CHAR(255) LOCALIZABLE, `Value` LONGCHAR LOCALIZABLE, `Component_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Registry`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Upgrade` (`UpgradeCode` CHAR(38) NOT NULL, `VersionMin` CHAR(20), `VersionMax` CHAR(20), `Language` CHAR(255), `Attributes` LONG NOT NULL, `Remove` CHAR(255), `ActionProperty` CHAR(72) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `UpgradeCode`, `VersionMin`, `VersionMax`, `Language`, `Attributes`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `LaunchCondition` (`Condition` CHAR(255) NOT NULL, `Description` CHAR(255) NOT NULL LOCALIZABLE PRIMARY KEY `Condition`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `AppSearch` (`Property` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Signature_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Property`, `Signature_`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Signature` (`Signature` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `FileName` CHAR(255) NOT NULL, `MinVersion` CHAR(20), `MaxVersion` CHAR(20), `MinSize` LONG, `MaxSize` LONG, `MinDate` LONG, `MaxDate` LONG, `Languages` CHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY `Signature`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `DrLocator` (`Signature_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Parent` CHAR(72), `Path` CHAR(255), `Depth` SHORT PRIMARY KEY `Signature_`, `Parent`, `Path`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `CustomAction` (`Action` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Type` SHORT NOT NULL, `Source` CHAR(72), `Target` CHAR(255), `ExtendedType` LONG PRIMARY KEY `Action`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `ActionText` (`Action` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Description` CHAR(64) LOCALIZABLE, `Template` CHAR(128) LOCALIZABLE PRIMARY KEY `Action`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `InstallExecuteSequence` (`Action` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Condition` CHAR(255), `Sequence` SHORT PRIMARY KEY `Action`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `InstallUISequence` (`Action` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Condition` CHAR(255), `Sequence` SHORT PRIMARY KEY `Action`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `CheckBox` (`Property` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Value` CHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY `Property`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `TextStyle` (`TextStyle` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `FaceName` CHAR(32) NOT NULL, `Size` SHORT NOT NULL, `Color` LONG, `StyleBits` SHORT PRIMARY KEY `TextStyle`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Dialog` (`Dialog` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `HCentering` SHORT NOT NULL, `VCentering` SHORT NOT NULL, `Width` SHORT NOT NULL, `Height` SHORT NOT NULL, `Attributes` LONG, `Title` CHAR(128) LOCALIZABLE, `Control_First` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Control_Default` CHAR(50), `Control_Cancel` CHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY `Dialog`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `Control` (`Dialog_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Control` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Type` CHAR(20) NOT NULL, `X` SHORT NOT NULL, `Y` SHORT NOT NULL, `Width` SHORT NOT NULL, `Height` SHORT NOT NULL, `Attributes` LONG, `Property` CHAR(50), `Text` LONGCHAR LOCALIZABLE, `Control_Next` CHAR(50), `Help` CHAR(50) LOCALIZABLE PRIMARY KEY `Dialog_`, `Control`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `ControlEvent` (`Dialog_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Control_` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Event` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Argument` CHAR(255) NOT NULL, `Condition` CHAR(255), `Ordering` SHORT PRIMARY KEY `Dialog_`, `Control_`, `Event`, `Argument`, `Condition`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `ControlCondition` (`Dialog_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Control_` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Action` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Condition` CHAR(255) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Dialog_`, `Control_`, `Action`, `Condition`)'
        'CREATE TABLE `EventMapping` (`Dialog_` CHAR(72) NOT NULL, `Control_` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Event` CHAR(50) NOT NULL, `Attribute` CHAR(50) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Dialog_`, `Control_`, `Event`)'
    )
    foreach ($q in $schema) { Sql $db $q $null }

    # Properties. Manufacturer in ASCII here: the English database uses code page 1252, which has no
    # "ł"; the Polish and Czech transforms carry the full name.
    $manufacturerAscii = 'Marek Wesolowski - wesmar'
    $manufacturer = 'Marek Wesołowski - wesmar'
    $properties = [ordered]@{
        ProductCode            = NewGuid
        ProductName            = 'WSA-Next'
        ProductVersion         = $productVersion
        Manufacturer           = $manufacturerAscii
        ProductLanguage        = '1033'
        UpgradeCode            = $upgradeCode
        ALLUSERS               = '1'
        ARPPRODUCTICON         = 'WsaNextIcon.ico'
        ARPURLINFOABOUT        = 'https://kvc.pl/wsa-next'
        ARPHELPLINK            = 'https://github.com/wesmar/wsa-next/issues'
        ARPURLUPDATEINFO       = 'https://github.com/wesmar/wsa-next/releases'
        ARPCOMMENTS            = $en.ShortcutDesc
        ARPNOMODIFY            = '1'
        REINSTALLMODE          = 'amus'
        DESKTOPSHORTCUT        = '1'
        LAUNCHAPP              = '1'
        DefaultUIFont          = 'FontNormal'
        ErrorDialog            = 'ErrorDlg'
        SecureCustomProperties = 'OLDERVERSIONBEINGUPGRADED;NEWERVERSIONDETECTED;DESKTOPSHORTCUT;REMOVEDATA;EXISTINGEXE'
        # The host is stopped by its own event (StopHosts); no Restart Manager dialogs.
        MSIRESTARTMANAGERCONTROL = 'Disable'
    }
    foreach ($kv in $properties.GetEnumerator()) { Insert $db 'Property' @('Property', 'Value') @($kv.Key, $kv.Value) }

    # Same or older versions are replaced (512: VersionMax inclusive); a newer one stops setup.
    $upgradeColumns = @('UpgradeCode', 'VersionMin', 'VersionMax', 'Language', 'Attributes', 'Remove', 'ActionProperty')
    Insert $db 'Upgrade' $upgradeColumns @($upgradeCode, $null, $productVersion, $null, 512, $null, 'OLDERVERSIONBEINGUPGRADED')
    Insert $db 'Upgrade' $upgradeColumns @($upgradeCode, $productVersion, $null, $null, 2, $null, 'NEWERVERSIONDETECTED')  # 2: detect only
    Insert $db 'LaunchCondition' @('Condition', 'Description') @('VersionNT64', $en.Need64)
    Insert $db 'LaunchCondition' @('Condition', 'Description') @('NOT NEWERVERSIONDETECTED OR Installed', $en.NewerInstalled)

    # Folders: %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next\language, the Start menu, the desktop.
    $dirColumns = @('Directory', 'Directory_Parent', 'DefaultDir')
    Insert $db 'Directory' $dirColumns @('TARGETDIR', $null, 'SourceDir')
    Insert $db 'Directory' $dirColumns @('ProgramFiles64Folder', 'TARGETDIR', '.')
    Insert $db 'Directory' $dirColumns @('INSTALLDIR', 'ProgramFiles64Folder', 'WSA-Next')
    Insert $db 'Directory' $dirColumns @('LANGDIR', 'INSTALLDIR', 'language')
    Insert $db 'Directory' $dirColumns @('ProgramMenuFolder', 'TARGETDIR', '.')
    Insert $db 'Directory' $dirColumns @('DesktopFolder', 'TARGETDIR', '.')

    Insert $db 'Feature' @('Feature', 'Feature_Parent', 'Title', 'Description', 'Display', 'Level', 'Directory_', 'Attributes') @('MainFeature', $null, 'WSA-Next', $en.ShortcutDesc, 0, 1, 'INSTALLDIR', 0)

    $componentColumns = @('Component', 'ComponentId', 'Directory_', 'Attributes', 'Condition', 'KeyPath')
    $fileColumns = @('File', 'Component_', 'FileName', 'FileSize', 'Version', 'Language', 'Attributes', 'Sequence')
    $sequence = 0
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $sequence++
        Insert $db 'Component' $componentColumns @($f.Component, (NameGuid "file:$($f.Name)"), $f.Directory, 256, $null, $f.Key)  # 256: 64-bit
        Insert $db 'FeatureComponents' @('Feature_', 'Component_') @('MainFeature', $f.Component)
        Insert $db 'File' $fileColumns @($f.Key, $f.Component, $f.Name, [int](Get-Item -LiteralPath $f.Source).Length, $f.Version, $null, 512, $sequence)  # 512: vital
    }
    Insert $db 'Media' @('DiskId', 'LastSequence', 'DiskPrompt', 'Cabinet', 'VolumeLabel', 'Source') @(1, $sequence, $null, '#data.cab', $null, $null)

    # Shortcuts, each in a component of its own with a registry value as key path (per machine).
    # The desktop one only when chosen on the "Ready" page.
    $registryKey = 'Software\KVC\WSA-Next Setup'
    Insert $db 'Component' $componentColumns @('CompStartMenu', (NameGuid 'shortcut:startmenu'), 'ProgramMenuFolder', 260, $null, 'RegStartMenu')  # 4: registry key path
    Insert $db 'Component' $componentColumns @('CompDesktop', (NameGuid 'shortcut:desktop'), 'DesktopFolder', 260, 'DESKTOPSHORTCUT = "1"', 'RegDesktop')
    foreach ($c in 'CompStartMenu', 'CompDesktop') { Insert $db 'FeatureComponents' @('Feature_', 'Component_') @('MainFeature', $c) }
    Insert $db 'Registry' @('Registry', 'Root', 'Key', 'Name', 'Value', 'Component_') @('RegStartMenu', -1, $registryKey, 'StartMenuShortcut', '1', 'CompStartMenu')
    Insert $db 'Registry' @('Registry', 'Root', 'Key', 'Name', 'Value', 'Component_') @('RegDesktop', -1, $registryKey, 'DesktopShortcut', '1', 'CompDesktop')
    $shortcutColumns = @('Shortcut', 'Directory_', 'Name', 'Component_', 'Target', 'Arguments', 'Description', 'Hotkey', 'Icon_', 'IconIndex', 'ShowCmd', 'WkDir')
    Insert $db 'Shortcut' $shortcutColumns @('StartMenuShortcut', 'ProgramMenuFolder', 'WSA-Next', 'CompStartMenu', '[#WsaNextExe]', $null, $en.ShortcutDesc, $null, 'WsaNextIcon.ico', 0, 1, 'INSTALLDIR')
    Insert $db 'Shortcut' $shortcutColumns @('DesktopShortcut', 'DesktopFolder', 'WSA-Next', 'CompDesktop', '[#WsaNextExe]', $null, $en.ShortcutDesc, $null, 'WsaNextIcon.ico', 0, 1, 'INSTALLDIR')

    Insert $db 'Icon' @('Name', 'Data') @('WsaNextIcon.ico', [IO.FileInfo]$iconPath)
    Insert $db 'Binary' @('Name', 'Data') @('DialogBmp', [IO.FileInfo]$dialogBmp)
    Insert $db 'Binary' @('Name', 'Data') @('BannerBmp', [IO.FileInfo]$bannerBmp)

    # The WSA-Next.exe already installed, if any (earlier version or a copy written by WSA-Next itself).
    Insert $db 'AppSearch' @('Property', 'Signature_') @('EXISTINGEXE', 'ExistingExe')
    Insert $db 'Signature' @('Signature', 'FileName', 'MinVersion', 'MaxVersion', 'MinSize', 'MaxSize', 'MinDate', 'MaxDate', 'Languages') @('ExistingExe', 'WSA-Next.exe', $null, $null, $null, $null, $null, $null, $null)
    Insert $db 'DrLocator' @('Signature_', 'Parent', 'Path', 'Depth') @('ExistingExe', $null, '[ProgramFiles64Folder]WSA-Next', 0)

    # Custom actions. Type bits: 34 an exe with a working folder, 51 set a property; +64 ignore the
    # exit code, +192 do not wait, +1024 deferred (in the script), +512 commit (after success),
    # +2048 as LocalSystem. Impersonated actions get the user's limited token when Setup was started
    # without elevation, so WSA-Next's own work runs as LocalSystem (app/SetupActions.h).
    $caColumns = @('Action', 'Type', 'Source', 'Target', 'ExtendedType')
    Insert $db 'CustomAction' $caColumns @('SetArpInstallLocation', 51, 'ARPINSTALLLOCATION', '[INSTALLDIR]', $null)
    # The background host of every signed-in user holds WSA-Next.exe open: it stops first.
    Insert $db 'CustomAction' $caColumns @('StopHosts', (34 + 64 + 1024 + 2048), 'INSTALLDIR', '"[EXISTINGEXE]" msi stop-hosts', $null)
    # Removing Setup removes WSA-Next: the WSA package, its disks and the host's logon task go, as
    # the user who removes Setup (that user's full token, no second UAC prompt). WSA-Next.exe and its
    # language files stay for Windows Installer to remove.
    Insert $db 'CustomAction' $caColumns @('RemoveWsaNext', (34 + 64 + 1024 + 2048), 'INSTALLDIR', '"[EXISTINGEXE]" msi uninstall [UserSID]', $null)
    Insert $db 'CustomAction' $caColumns @('RemoveWsaNextAll', (34 + 64 + 1024 + 2048), 'INSTALLDIR', '"[EXISTINGEXE]" msi uninstall [UserSID] --all', $null)
    # After an install, repair or update: the host's logon task (made by WSA-Next) starts it again.
    Insert $db 'CustomAction' $caColumns @('StartHost', (34 + 64 + 512 + 1024 + 2048), 'INSTALLDIR', '"[System64Folder]schtasks.exe" /Run /TN "WSA-Next"', $null)
    Insert $db 'CustomAction' $caColumns @('LaunchApp', (34 + 192), 'INSTALLDIR', '"[INSTALLDIR]WSA-Next.exe"', $null)
    # What the progress page says while they run.
    $actionTexts = [ordered]@{ StopHosts = 'ActionStopHosts'; RemoveWsaNext = 'ActionRemoveWsa'; RemoveWsaNextAll = 'ActionRemoveWsa' }
    foreach ($kv in $actionTexts.GetEnumerator()) { Insert $db 'ActionText' @('Action', 'Description', 'Template') @($kv.Key, $en[$kv.Value], $null) }

    $removing = 'REMOVE~="ALL" AND NOT UPGRADINGPRODUCTCODE AND EXISTINGEXE'
    $execute = @(
        @('LaunchConditions', $null, 100), @('FindRelatedProducts', $null, 200), @('AppSearch', $null, 400),
        @('CostInitialize', $null, 800), @('FileCost', $null, 900), @('CostFinalize', $null, 1000),
        @('SetArpInstallLocation', $null, 1010),
        @('InstallValidate', $null, 1400), @('InstallInitialize', $null, 1500),
        @('StopHosts', 'EXISTINGEXE', 1510),
        @('RemoveWsaNext', "$removing AND NOT REMOVEDATA", 1520),
        @('RemoveWsaNextAll', "$removing AND REMOVEDATA", 1521),
        @('RemoveExistingProducts', $null, 1525),
        @('ProcessComponents', $null, 1600), @('UnpublishFeatures', $null, 1800), @('RemoveRegistryValues', $null, 2600),
        @('RemoveShortcuts', $null, 3200), @('RemoveFiles', $null, 3500), @('RemoveFolders', $null, 3600), @('CreateFolders', $null, 3700),
        @('InstallFiles', $null, 4000), @('CreateShortcuts', $null, 4500), @('WriteRegistryValues', $null, 5000),

    Ctl 'ProgressDlg' 'TitleRemove' 'Text' 15 8 290 15 $hiddenLabel $null 'ProgressRemove' '{\FontTitle}' $null $null

    Evt 'ProgressDlg' 'Cancel' 'SpawnDialog' 'CancelDlg' '1' 1

    # Finish, interrupted, failed: the full picture; "start WSA-Next" sits next to the buttons
    foreach ($d in 'ExitDlg', 'UserExitDlg', 'FatalErrorDlg') {

        Bottom $d

        Ctl $d 'Cancel' 'PushButton' 304 243 56 17 $V $null 'Cancel' $null $null $null
    }
    Ctl 'ExitDlg' 'TitleInstall' 'Text' 135 20 220 40 $hiddenLabel $null 'ExitInstall' '{\FontHero}' $null $null
    Ctl 'ExitDlg' 'TitleRepair' 'Text' 135 20 220 40 $hiddenLabel $null 'ExitRepair' '{\FontHero}' $null $null
    Ctl 'ExitDlg' 'TitleRemove' 'Text' 135 20 220 40 $hiddenLabel $null 'ExitRemove' '{\FontHero}' $null $null
    Ctl 'ExitDlg' 'Description' 'Text' 135 70 220 100 $hiddenLabel $null 'ExitText' $null $null $null
    Ctl 'ExitDlg' 'Launch' 'CheckBox' 12 244 160 15 $E 'LAUNCHAPP' 'LaunchApp' $null $null 'Finish'
    Ctl 'ExitDlg' 'Finish' 'PushButton' 236 243 56 17 ($V + $E) $null 'Finish' $null $null 'Launch'
    Cnd 'ExitDlg' 'TitleInstall' 'Show' 'NOT Installed'
    Cnd 'ExitDlg' 'TitleRepair' 'Show' 'Installed AND NOT REMOVE~="ALL"'
    Cnd 'ExitDlg' 'TitleRemove' 'Show' 'REMOVE~="ALL"'
    Cnd 'ExitDlg' 'Description' 'Show' 'NOT Installed'
    Cnd 'ExitDlg' 'Launch' 'Show' 'NOT Installed'
    Evt 'ExitDlg' 'Finish' 'DoAction' 'LaunchApp' 'LAUNCHAPP = "1" AND NOT Installed' 1
    Evt 'ExitDlg' 'Finish' 'EndDialog' 'Return' '1' 2
    Ctl 'UserExitDlg' 'Title' 'Text' 135 20 220 40 $label $null 'UserExitTitle' '{\FontHero}' $null $null
    Ctl 'UserExitDlg' 'Description' 'Text' 135 70 220 100 $label $null 'UserExitText' $null $null $null
    Ctl 'UserExitDlg' 'Finish' 'PushButton' 236 243 56 17 ($V + $E) $null 'Finish' $null $null $null

    Ctl 'FatalErrorDlg' 'Finish' 'PushButton' 236 243 56 17 ($V + $E) $null 'Finish' $null $null $null
    Evt 'FatalErrorDlg' 'Finish' 'EndDialog' 'Exit' '1' 1

    # Maintenance: repair, or remove (optionally with the Android apps and their data)
    Banner 'MaintenanceDlg' 'MaintTitle' 'MaintDesc'
    Ctl 'MaintenanceDlg' 'Repair' 'PushButton' 25 62 80 17 ($V + $E + $Shield) $null 'Repair' $null $null 'Remove'
    Ctl 'MaintenanceDlg' 'RepairText' 'Text' 115 62 235 30 ($V + $E + $NoPrefix) $null 'RepairText' $null $null $null
    Ctl 'MaintenanceDlg' 'Remove' 'PushButton' 25 108 80 17 ($V + $E + $Shield) $null 'Remove' $null $null 'RemoveData'
    Ctl 'MaintenanceDlg' 'RemoveText' 'Text' 115 108 235 40 ($V + $E + $NoPrefix) $null 'RemoveText' $null $null $null
    Ctl 'MaintenanceDlg' 'RemoveData' 'CheckBox' 115 152 235 15 ($V + $E) 'REMOVEDATA' 'RemoveData' $null $null 'Cancel'
    Bottom 'MaintenanceDlg'
    Ctl 'MaintenanceDlg' 'Back' 'PushButton' 180 243 56 17 $V $null 'Back' $null $null $null
    Ctl 'MaintenanceDlg' 'Cancel' 'PushButton' 304 243 56 17 ($V + $E) $null 'Cancel' $null $null 'Repair'
    Evt 'MaintenanceDlg' 'Repair' 'ReinstallMode' 'ecmus' '1' 1

    Evt 'MaintenanceDlg' 'Cancel' 'SpawnDialog' 'CancelDlg' '1' 1

    Ctl 'CancelDlg' 'Text' 'Text' 20 15 220 30 ($V + $E + $NoPrefix) $null 'CancelText' $null $null $null

    Evt 'CancelDlg' 'Yes' 'EndDialog' 'Exit' '1' 1
    Evt 'CancelDlg' 'No' 'EndDialog' 'Return' '1' 1

    # Windows Installer's error messages (ErrorDialog): the text and the buttons it asks for
    Ctl 'ErrorDlg' 'ErrorText' 'Text' 20 10 230 60 ($V + $E + $NoPrefix) $null $null $null $null $null
    $errorButtons = @(@('A', 'Abort', 'ErrorAbort'), @('C', 'Cancel', 'ErrorCancel'), @('I', 'Ignore', 'ErrorIgnore'), @('N', 'No', 'ErrorNo'),
                      @('O', 'OK', 'ErrorOk'), @('R', 'Retry', 'ErrorRetry'), @('Y', 'Yes', 'ErrorYes'))
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $errorButtons.Count; $i++) {
        $b = $errorButtons[$i]
        Ctl 'ErrorDlg' $b[0] 'PushButton' 100 80 56 17 ($V + $E) $null $b[1] $null $null $errorButtons[($i + 1) % $errorButtons.Count][0]
        Evt 'ErrorDlg' $b[0] 'EndDialog' $b[2] '1' 1
    }

    $dialogs = @(
        @('WelcomeDlg', 370, 270, 3, 'Next', 'Next', 'Cancel'),
        @('LicenseDlg', 370, 270, 3, 'LicenseText', 'Next', 'Cancel'),
        @('ReadyDlg', 370, 270, 3, 'Install', 'Install', 'Cancel'),
        @('ProgressDlg', 370, 270, 1, 'Cancel', 'Cancel', 'Cancel'),
        @('ExitDlg', 370, 270, 3, 'Finish', 'Finish', 'Finish'),
        @('UserExitDlg', 370, 270, 3, 'Finish', 'Finish', 'Finish'),
        @('FatalErrorDlg', 370, 270, 3, 'Finish', 'Finish', 'Finish'),
        @('MaintenanceDlg', 370, 270, 3, 'Repair', 'Repair', 'Cancel'),
        @('CancelDlg', 260, 85, 3, 'No', 'No', 'No'),
        @('ErrorDlg', 270, 105, 65539, 'O', $null, $null)  # 65536: the error dialog
    )

    Insert $db 'TextStyle' @('TextStyle', 'FaceName', 'Size', 'Color', 'StyleBits') @('FontHero', 'Segoe UI', 13, $null, 1)

    $summary = Inv $db 'SummaryInformation' $Get @([int]20)

        1 = [int]1252; 2 = 'Installation Database'; 3 = 'WSA-Next'; 4 = $manufacturerAscii; 5 = 'Installer, WSA-Next, Windows Subsystem for Android, Android 15'

    [void](Inv $summary 'Persist' $Method $null)
    Free $summary
    [void](Inv $db 'Commit' $Method $null)
    Free $db; $db = $null

    # --- One transform per language, embedded --------------------------------------------------
    $templateLanguages = [Collections.Generic.List[int]]::new()
    $templateLanguages.Add(1033)
    $localizedControls = $controls | Where-Object { $_.Key }
    foreach ($lang in ($text.languages.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
        $info = $text.languages[$lang]
        $strings = $text.strings[$lang]
        if (-not $strings) { throw "No strings for $lang in msi-strings.json." }
        $codePage = [int]$info.codepage
        $s = { param([string]$key) ForCodePage $strings[$key] $codePage $info.replace "$lang/$key" }
        $copy = Join-Path $stage "$lang.msi"
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $msiPath -Destination $copy -Force
        $ldb = Inv $installer 'OpenDatabase' $Method @($copy, [int]1)  # transacted

        $lcid = [int]$info.lcids[0]
        $localManufacturer = try { ForCodePage $manufacturer $codePage $null 'Manufacturer' } catch { $manufacturerAscii }
        Sql $ldb 'UPDATE `Property` SET `Value` = ? WHERE `Property` = ?' @("$lcid", 'ProductLanguage')
        Sql $ldb 'UPDATE `Property` SET `Value` = ? WHERE `Property` = ?' @($localManufacturer, 'Manufacturer')
        Sql $ldb 'UPDATE `Property` SET `Value` = ? WHERE `Property` = ?' @((& $s 'ShortcutDesc'), 'ARPCOMMENTS')

        foreach ($sc in 'StartMenuShortcut', 'DesktopShortcut') { Sql $ldb 'UPDATE `Shortcut` SET `Description` = ? WHERE `Shortcut` = ?' @((& $s 'ShortcutDesc'), $sc) }
        foreach ($kv in $actionTexts.GetEnumerator()) { Sql $ldb 'UPDATE `ActionText` SET `Description` = ? WHERE `Action` = ?' @((& $s $kv.Value), $kv.Key) }
        if ($info.rtl) {
            # Right to left: text, check boxes and the dialogs themselves (32 + 64 + 128 per control,
            # 128 + 256 + 512 per dialog). The license stays English, left to right.
            foreach ($c in ($controls | Where-Object { $_.Type -in 'Text', 'CheckBox' })) {
                Sql $ldb 'UPDATE `Control` SET `Attributes` = ? WHERE `Dialog_` = ? AND `Control` = ?' @([int]($c.A -bor 0xE0), $c.Dialog, $c.Name)
            }
            foreach ($d in $dialogs) { Sql $ldb 'UPDATE `Dialog` SET `Attributes` = ? WHERE `Dialog` = ?' @([int]($d[3] -bor 0x380), $d[0]) }
        }
        [void](Inv $ldb 'Commit' $Method $null)
        $reference = Inv $installer 'OpenDatabase' $Method @($msiPath, [int]0)
        $mst = Join-Path $stage "$lang.mst"
        [void](Inv $ldb 'GenerateTransform' $Method @($reference, $mst))
        [void](Inv $ldb 'CreateTransformSummaryInfo' $Method @($reference, $mst, [int]0, [int]0))
        Free $reference; Free $ldb
        $base = Inv $installer 'OpenDatabase' $Method @($msiPath, [int]1)
        foreach ($id in $info.lcids) {
            Sql $base 'INSERT INTO `_Storages` (`Name`, `Data`) VALUES (?, ?)' @("$id", [IO.FileInfo]$mst)
            $templateLanguages.Add([int]$id)
        }
        [void](Inv $base 'Commit' $Method $null)
        Free $base
        Write-Host ("  {0,-6} code page {1,-4} -> {2}" -f $lang, $codePage, (($info.lcids | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ', '))
    }
    $base = Inv $installer 'OpenDatabase' $Method @($msiPath, [int]1)
    $summary = Inv $base 'SummaryInformation' $Get @([int]1)
    [void](Inv $summary 'Property' $Set @([int]7, ('x64;' + ($templateLanguages -join ','))))
    [void](Inv $summary 'Persist' $Method $null)
    Free $summary
    [void](Inv $base 'Commit' $Method $null)
    Free $base
    [GC]::Collect(); [GC]::WaitForPendingFinalizers()

    # --- Signature, the zip, the result ---------------------------------------------------------
    if ($SignScript) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SignScript)) { throw "SignScript not found: $SignScript" }
        & $SignScript -File $msiPath | Out-Host
    }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $zipPath) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $zipPath -Force }
    $zipStage = Join-Path $stage 'zip'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $zipStage 'language') -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $exePath, $licensePath -Destination $zipStage
    foreach ($lng in $lngFiles) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $lng.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $zipStage 'language') }
    Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $zipStage '*') -DestinationPath $zipPath -CompressionLevel Optimal

    foreach ($out in $msiPath, $zipPath) {
        $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $out
        $signature = if ($out -eq $msiPath) { (Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $out).Status } else { '-' }
        Write-Host ('{0,-14} {1,8:N2} MB  SHA-256 {2}  signature {3}' -f $item.Name, ($item.Length / 1MB), (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $out).Hash, $signature) -ForegroundColor Green
    }
}
finally {
    if ($db) { Free $db }
    Free $installer
    [GC]::Collect(); [GC]::WaitForPendingFinalizers()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stage) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "app/Cli.h"
```
