```cpp
namespace {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

std::wstring Lower(std::wstring_view s) {
    std::wstring out(s);
    for (auto& c : out) c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(c));
    return out;
}

bool IsHelp(std::wstring_view arg) {
    static constexpr std::wstring_view kHelp[] = {L"help", L"--help", L"-help", L"-h", L"-?", L"/?", L"/h", L"/help"};
    return std::ranges::contains(kHelp, Lower(arg));
}

struct Args {
    std::wstring command;
    std::vector<std::wstring> positional;
    std::wstring source, dir;
    bool yes = false, filesOnly = false, keepDownloads = false, noProgress = false, all = false, listVms = false,
         helloCheck = false, helloTest = false, fromSetup = false;
};

std::optional<std::wstring> Parse(std::span<wchar_t*> argv, Args& args) {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < argv.size(); ++i) {
        const std::wstring word(argv[i]);
        const std::wstring name = Lower(word);
        auto value = [&](std::wstring& out) -> std::optional<std::wstring> {
            if (i + 1 >= argv.size()) return std::format(L"{} needs a value", word);
            out = argv[++i];
            return std::nullopt;
        };
        if (name == L"--source") { if (auto e = value(args.source)) return e; continue; }
        if (name == L"--dir") { if (auto e = value(args.dir)) return e; continue; }
        if (name == L"--yes" || name == L"-y") { args.yes = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--files-only") { args.filesOnly = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--keep-downloads") { args.keepDownloads = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--no-progress") { args.noProgress = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--all") { args.all = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--from-setup") { args.fromSetup = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--list-vms") { args.listVms = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--check") { args.helloCheck = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--test") { args.helloTest = true; continue; }
        if (name == L"--version") { args.command = L"version"; continue; }
        if (name.starts_with(L"-")) return std::format(L"unknown option {}", word);
        if (args.command.empty()) args.command = name;
        else args.positional.push_back(word);
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::wstring YesNo(std::optional<bool> v) { return !v ? L"unknown" : *v ? L"yes" : L"no"; }

fs::path FolderOf(const Args& args) {
    if (!args.dir.empty()) return fs::absolute(args.dir);
    const std::wstring saved = Settings::Read(L"InstallFolder");
    return saved.empty() ? Core::DefaultFolder() : fs::path(saved);
}

std::wstring SourceOf(const Args& args) {
    if (!args.source.empty()) return SourceUrl(args.source);
    const std::wstring saved = Settings::Read(L"Source", L"github");  // the GUI's choice
    return saved == L"custom" ? Settings::Read(L"CustomManifest") : SourceUrl(saved);
}

std::wstring HelloRememberText(std::uint32_t minutes) {
    if (minutes == 0) return L"off (Windows Hello asks every time)";
    if (minutes == Host::kHelloUntilLocked) return L"until Windows is locked";
    return std::format(L"for {} minutes", minutes);
}

int Status(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    const Core::SystemInfo s = Core::Inspect();
    const Signature::Origin origin = Signature::Check();
    con.Line(std::format(L"WSA-Next build            {}", origin == Signature::Origin::Official      ? L"official (publisher signature)"
                                                          : origin == Signature::Origin::Unsigned    ? L"unofficial (not signed)"
                                                          : origin == Signature::Origin::OtherSigner ? L"unofficial (signed by someone else)"
                                                                                                     : L"modified after signing"));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Windows                   {}", s.Version()));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Supported                 {}", s.Supported() ? L"yes" : L"no (Windows 11 required)"));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Virtual Machine Platform  {}", YesNo(s.virtualMachinePlatform)));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Developer mode            {}", s.developerMode ? L"on" : L"off"));
    if (s.NeedsPatch()) con.Line(L"WSAPatch                  needed on this build");
    if (s.package)
        con.Line(std::format(L"WSA package               {} ({}{})", s.package->version, s.package->location.wstring(),
                             s.package->developmentMode ? L"" : L", Microsoft Store"));
    else
        con.Line(L"WSA package               not registered");
    const fs::path folder = FolderOf(args);
    const Core::InstalledState state = Core::ReadState(folder);
    con.Line(std::format(L"Install folder            {}", folder.wstring()));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Installed release         {}", state.version.empty() ? std::wstring(L"none") : state.version));
    using Core::Release::State;
    const State verdict = Core::Release::HostVerdict();
    con.Line(std::format(L"Release check (host)      {}", verdict == State::Official   ? L"official release, unchanged"
                                                          : verdict == State::Checking ? L"checking the Android disks"
                                                          : verdict == State::Unsigned ? L"not an official release"
                                                          : verdict == State::Modified ? L"official release changed after installing"
                                                          : verdict == State::Missing  ? L"WSA not installed"
                                                                                       : L"not checked yet"));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Windows Hello             {}", Bio::StatusText(Bio::CheckAvailability())));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Remember Windows Hello    {}", HelloRememberText(Host::HelloRememberMinutes())));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Root for Android apps     {}", Host::ElevationEnabled() ? L"on (confirmed with Windows Hello)" : L"off"));
    return kOk;
}

int Check(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    const std::wstring url = SourceOf(args);
    auto manifest = Core::LoadManifest(url, {});
    if (!manifest) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, manifest.error());
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    const fs::path folder = FolderOf(args);
    const Core::Plan plan = Core::MakePlan(*manifest, Core::ReadState(folder), Core::Inspect(), folder);
    con.Line(std::format(L"{} {}  {}  {}", manifest->name, manifest->version, manifest->android, manifest->variant));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Source  {}", url));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Folder  {}", folder.wstring()));
    con.Line(std::format(L"Release {}", manifest->official      ? L"official (publisher signature)"
                                        : manifest->catalog.empty() ? L"unofficial (not signed)"
                                                                    : L"unofficial (signature not valid for this manifest)"));
    con.Line();
    for (const Core::PlanItem& item : plan.items) {
        const Core::Component& c = *item.component;
        con.Line(std::format(L"  {:<11} {:<22} {:>10} -> {:>10}  {}", c.id, c.target, FormatBytes(c.packedSize), FormatBytes(c.size),
                             item.needed ? L"download" : L"installed"));
    }
    con.Line();
    if (plan.UpToDate()) con.Status(Level::Success, L"up to date");
    else con.Line(std::format(L"To download: {}, unpacked: {}", FormatBytes(plan.downloadBytes), FormatBytes(plan.diskBytes)));
    return kOk;
}

int Install(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    if (!IsElevated()) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, L"run this from an elevated (administrator) prompt");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    const std::wstring url = SourceOf(args);
    con.Status(Level::Info, std::format(L"manifest {}", url));
    auto manifest = Core::LoadManifest(url, {});
    if (!manifest) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, manifest.error());
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    con.set_progress_enabled(!args.noProgress);
    Core::Options options;
    options.folder = FolderOf(args);
    options.registerPackage = !args.filesOnly;
    options.keepDownloads = args.keepDownloads;

    Core::Callbacks cb;
    cb.progress = [&](const Core::Progress& p) {
        if (p.permille < 0 || !p.total) return;
        std::wstring detail = std::format(L"{} / {}", FormatBytes(p.done), FormatBytes(p.total));
        if (p.speed) detail += std::format(L"  {}/s", FormatBytes(p.speed));
        con.Progress(p.phase, static_cast<double>(p.done) / static_cast<double>(p.total), detail);
    };
    cb.log = [&](Level level, std::wstring text) { con.Status(level, text); };
    cb.confirm = [&](const std::wstring& question) {
        con.Line(question);
        if (args.yes) {
            con.Line(L"  --yes: accepted");
            return true;
        }
        con.Line(L"  not accepted (add --yes to accept)");
        return false;
    };
    auto outcome = Core::Run(*manifest, options, cb, {});
    con.EndProgress();
    if (!outcome) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, outcome.error());
        return outcome.error() == Text::English(IDS_CANCELED) ? kCanceled : kFailed;
    }
    con.Status(Level::Success, std::format(L"{} {} installed in {}", manifest->name, manifest->version, options.folder.wstring()));
    if (outcome->restartNeeded) {
        con.Status(Level::Warning, L"restart Windows to finish enabling Virtual Machine Platform");
        return kRestart;
    }
    return kOk;
}

int Uninstall(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    if (!IsElevated()) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, L"run this from an elevated (administrator) prompt");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    const fs::path folder = FolderOf(args);
    const fs::path data = Install::PackageDataFolder();
    if (!args.yes) {
        if (args.all)
            con.Line(std::format(L"uninstall --all removes WSA-Next ({}) and everything WSA left in Windows, including the Android apps, "
                                 L"their data and the Google account sign-in ({} in {}).",
                                 folder.wstring(), FormatBytes(Install::FolderSize(data)), data.wstring()));
        else
            con.Line(std::format(L"uninstall removes WSA-Next ({}); the Android apps and their data stay in {} for the next installation.",
                                 folder.wstring(), data.wstring()));
        con.Line(L"  not done (add --yes to confirm)");
        return kCanceled;
    }
    // Installed with WSA-Next Setup: Windows Installer removes WSA-Next, and calls back here
    // (--from-setup) before it removes its own files.
    if (!args.fromSetup) {
        if (const auto product = Install::SetupProduct()) {
            if (auto r = Install::RemoveThroughSetup(*product, args.all); !r) {
                con.Status(Level::Error, r.error());
                return kFailed;
            }
            con.Status(Level::Info, std::format(L"WSA-Next Setup ({}) removes WSA-Next now", *product));
            return kOk;
        }
    }
    Core::Callbacks cb;
    cb.progress = [](const Core::Progress&) {};
    cb.log = [&](Level level, std::wstring text) { con.Status(level, text); };
    cb.confirm = [](const std::wstring&) { return true; };
    auto outcome = Core::Uninstall(folder, args.all ? Core::Removal::Everything : Core::Removal::KeepData, cb);
    if (!outcome) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, outcome.error());
        return kFailed;
    }
    if (!outcome->leftovers.empty()) {
        con.Status(Level::Warning, std::format(L"{} item(s) could not be removed (see above)", outcome->leftovers.size()));
        return kFailed;
    }
    con.Status(Level::Success, Text::Get(args.all ? IDS_STATUS_REMOVED_ALL : IDS_STATUS_REMOVED));
    if (outcome->restartNeeded) {
        con.Status(Level::Warning, L"restart Windows to finish disabling Virtual Machine Platform");
        return kRestart;
    }
    return kOk;
}

std::stop_source g_bluetoothStop;

BOOL WINAPI StopBluetooth(DWORD) {
    g_bluetoothStop.request_stop();
    return TRUE;
}

// The Bluetooth bridge in the foreground: the PC's adapter for Android until Ctrl+C.
int Bluetooth(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    if (!IsElevated()) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, L"run this from an elevated (administrator) prompt");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    if (args.listVms) {
        con.Line(Guest::ComputeSystemsJson());
        return kOk;
    }
    if (!Signature::OfficialFeatures()) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, L"Bluetooth for Android is only in the official (signed) WSA-Next");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    if (Host::Running() && Host::BluetoothEnabled()) {
        con.Status(Level::Warning, L"the WSA-Next background host already serves Bluetooth (turn it off in the window's Bluetooth menu first)");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    Bt::SetLogSink([&con](std::string_view line) { con.Line(FromUtf8(line)); });
    SetConsoleCtrlHandler(StopBluetooth, TRUE);
    const Bt::BridgeResult result = Bt::RunBridge(g_bluetoothStop.get_token());
    SetConsoleCtrlHandler(StopBluetooth, FALSE);
    Bt::SetLogSink(nullptr);
    return result == Bt::BridgeResult::Stopped ? kOk : kUnavailable;
}

std::stop_source g_helloStop;

BOOL WINAPI StopHello(DWORD) {
    g_helloStop.request_stop();
    return TRUE;
}

// hello remember [off|5|30|lock]: how long a Windows Hello verification lets Android apps in.
int HelloRemember(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    if (args.positional.empty()) {
        con.Line(std::format(L"Remember Windows Hello  {}", HelloRememberText(Host::HelloRememberMinutes())));
        return kOk;
    }
    const std::wstring value = Lower(args.positional[0]);
    const std::uint32_t minutes = value == L"off" ? 0u : value == L"5" ? 5u : value == L"30" ? 30u : value == L"lock" ? Host::kHelloUntilLocked : 1u;
    if (minutes == 1u) {
        con.Err(L"hello remember: off, 5, 30 or lock\n");
        return kUsage;
    }
    if (minutes != 0 && !args.yes) {
        con.Line(L"After one Windows Hello confirmation, Android apps that ask for a fingerprint (a bank or a broker,\n"
                 L"for example) get in without asking again; so does anyone using this PC meanwhile. Locking Windows,\n"
                 L"sleep with a sign-in and signing out end it; root for Android apps still asks every time.");
        con.Status(Level::Warning, L"add --yes to accept this at your own responsibility");
        return kCanceled;
    }
    Host::SetHelloRememberMinutes(minutes);
    con.Status(Level::Success, std::format(L"Remember Windows Hello: {}", HelloRememberText(minutes)));
    return kOk;
}

// Windows Hello bridge (or availability/prompt self-test) for Android biometrics.
int Hello(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    if (!args.positional.empty() && Lower(args.positional[0]) == L"remember") {
        Args rest = args;
        rest.positional.erase(rest.positional.begin());
        return HelloRemember(con, rest);
    }
    if (args.helloCheck) {
        const Bio::HelloStatus status = Bio::CheckAvailability();
        con.Line(std::format(L"Windows Hello  {}", Bio::StatusText(status)));
        return status == Bio::HelloStatus::Available ? kOk : kUnavailable;
    }
    if (args.helloTest) {
        const Bio::HelloStatus status = Bio::CheckAvailability();
        con.Line(std::format(L"Windows Hello  {}", Bio::StatusText(status)));
        if (status != Bio::HelloStatus::Available) return kUnavailable;
        const Bio::VerifyResult r = Bio::RequestVerification(L"WSA-Next Windows Hello test");
        const wchar_t* text = r == Bio::VerifyResult::Verified ? L"verified"
                              : r == Bio::VerifyResult::Canceled ? L"canceled"
                              : r == Bio::VerifyResult::Busy ? L"busy"
                              : r == Bio::VerifyResult::NotAvailable ? L"not available"
                                                                     : L"failed";
        con.Status(r == Bio::VerifyResult::Verified ? Level::Success : Level::Warning, std::format(L"Result: {}", text));
        return r == Bio::VerifyResult::Verified ? kOk : r == Bio::VerifyResult::Canceled ? kCanceled : kFailed;
    }
    if (!IsElevated()) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, L"run this from an elevated (administrator) prompt");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    if (!Signature::OfficialFeatures()) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, L"Windows Hello for Android is only in the official (signed) WSA-Next");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    if (Host::Running()) {
        con.Status(Level::Warning, L"the WSA-Next background host already serves Windows Hello (see the log in %LOCALAPPDATA%\\WSA-Next)");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    Bt::SetLogSink([&con](std::string_view line) { con.Line(FromUtf8(line)); });
    SetConsoleCtrlHandler(StopHello, TRUE);
    const Bio::BridgeResult result = Bio::RunBridge(g_helloStop.get_token());
    SetConsoleCtrlHandler(StopHello, FALSE);
    Bt::SetLogSink(nullptr);
    return result == Bio::BridgeResult::Stopped ? kOk : kUnavailable;
}

// The PC's modem as Android's RIL sees it: the answers to its first questions (diagnostics; the
// card's and the device's numbers are not shown).
// What the store's SMS-DELIVER PDU (hex, with the service centre part) is: the service centre's
// time stamp ("YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss") and its kind from the user data header - "text", "MMS
// notice" (WAP push to port 2948), "port N", with "part i/n" for a piece of a longer one. Empty
// for other PDUs. Neither the sender nor the text is read.
struct DeliverInfo {
    std::wstring time, kind;
};

DeliverInfo Describe(const std::string& hex) {
    std::vector<unsigned> octets;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < hex.size(); i += 2) {
        unsigned value = 0;
        std::from_chars(hex.data() + i, hex.data() + i + 2, value, 16);
        octets.push_back(value);
    }
    auto at = [&](std::size_t i) { return i < octets.size() ? octets[i] : 0u; };
    std::size_t pos = 1 + at(0);  // past the service centre
    const unsigned first = at(pos);
    if ((first & 0x03) != 0) return {};  // not an SMS-DELIVER
    pos += 1;
    pos += 2 + (at(pos) + 1) / 2;  // the sender: its length in digits, its type, its digits
    pos += 2;                      // protocol identifier, data coding
    if (pos + 8 > octets.size()) return {};
    auto field = [&](std::size_t i) { const unsigned o = at(pos + i); return (o & 0x0F) * 10 + (o >> 4); };  // swapped semi-octets
    DeliverInfo info;
    info.time = std::format(L"20{:02}-{:02}-{:02} {:02}:{:02}:{:02}", field(0), field(1), field(2), field(3), field(4), field(5));
    pos += 7 + 1;  // the time stamp, the user data length
    info.kind = L"text";
    if (first & 0x40) {  // a user data header: information elements (23.040 9.2.3.24)
        const std::size_t end = pos + 1 + at(pos);
        std::wstring part;
        for (std::size_t ie = pos + 1; ie + 1 < end && ie + 1 < octets.size(); ie += 2 + at(ie + 1)) {
            const unsigned id = at(ie);
            if (id == 0x00) part = std::format(L" part {}/{}", at(ie + 4), at(ie + 3));       // 8-bit reference
            else if (id == 0x08) part = std::format(L" part {}/{}", at(ie + 5), at(ie + 4));  // 16-bit reference
            else if (id == 0x05) {
                const unsigned port = at(ie + 2) << 8 | at(ie + 3);
                info.kind = port == 2948 ? L"MMS notice" : std::format(L"port {}", port);
            } else if (id == 0x04) {
                info.kind = std::format(L"port {}", at(ie + 2));
            }
        }
        info.kind += part;
    }
    return info;
}

int ModemCheck(Console& con) {
    const auto modem = Tel::Modem::Open();
    if (!modem) {
        con.Line(L"Modem  none (no mobile broadband modem on this PC): Android shows no SIM");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    // The message store, as the bridge sees it when Android connects (no sender, no text).
    modem->Start({});
    if (const auto stored = modem->ReadStore(false, 15'000)) {
        con.Line(std::format(L"Messages in the modem  {}", stored->size()));
        for (const Tel::StoredMessage& message : *stored) {
            static constexpr const wchar_t* kStatus[] = {L"unread", L"read", L"draft", L"sent"};
            const DeliverInfo info = Describe(message.pdu);
            con.Line(std::format(L"  #{:<3} {:<7} {:<19}  {:>3} octets  {}", message.index, kStatus[static_cast<int>(message.status)],
                                 info.time.empty() ? std::wstring(L"-") : info.time, message.pdu.size() / 2, info.kind));
        }
    } else {
        con.Line(L"Messages in the modem  no answer from the message store");
    }
    modem->Stop();
    Tel::AtModem at(*modem);
    for (const char* command : {"AT+CPIN?", "AT+COPS=3,0;+COPS?;+COPS=3,2;+COPS?", "AT+CREG=2", "AT+CREG?", "AT+CSQ", "AT+CSCA?",
                                "AT+CRSM=192,28589,0,0,15", "AT+CRSM=176,28589,0,0,4", "ATD123;"}) {
        const Tel::AtModem::Reply reply = at.Command(command);
        std::wstring answer;
        for (const std::string& line : reply.lines) answer += (answer.empty() ? L"" : L" | ") + FromUtf8(line);
        con.Line(std::format(L"{:<40} {}", FromUtf8(command), answer));
    }
    return kOk;
}

// Root for Android apps (every request confirmed with Windows Hello): show or switch the setting.
int Elevation(Console& con, const Args& args) {
    if (args.positional.empty()) {
        con.Line(std::format(L"Root for Android apps  {}", Host::ElevationEnabled() ? L"on (every request is confirmed with Windows Hello)" : L"off"));
        con.Line(std::format(L"su for root apps       {}", Host::ElevationSuEnabled() ? L"on (apps see su, a link to 0)" : L"off"));
        return kOk;
    }
    if (Lower(args.positional[0]) == L"su") {
        const std::wstring value = args.positional.size() > 1 ? Lower(args.positional[1]) : std::wstring();
        if (value != L"on" && value != L"off") {
            con.Err(L"elevation su: on or off\n");
            return kUsage;
        }
        if (auto r = Host::SetElevationSuEnabled(value == L"on"); !r) {
            con.Status(Level::Error, r.error());
            return kFailed;
        }
        con.Status(Level::Success, value == L"on" ? L"su for root apps is on (while root for Android apps is on)" : L"su for root apps is off");
        return kOk;
    }
    const std::wstring value = Lower(args.positional[0]);
    if (value != L"on" && value != L"off") {
        con.Err(L"elevation: on or off\n");
        return kUsage;
    }
    const bool enable = value == L"on";
    if (enable && !Signature::OfficialFeatures()) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, L"root for Android apps is only in the official (signed) WSA-Next");
        return kUnavailable;
    }
    if (enable && Bio::CheckAvailability() != Bio::HelloStatus::Available)
        con.Status(Level::Warning, L"Windows Hello is not set up for this account: requests will be refused until it is");
    if (auto r = Host::SetElevationEnabled(enable); !r) {
        con.Status(Level::Error, r.error());
        return kFailed;
    }
    con.Status(Level::Success, enable ? L"root for Android apps is on: apps ask with the command 0, Windows Hello decides"
                                      : L"root for Android apps is off");
    return kOk;
}

}  // namespace

std::wstring SourceUrl(const std::wstring& source) {
    const std::wstring s = Lower(source);
    if (s == L"github") return std::format(L"https://github.com/{}/releases/download/components/{}", Config::kGitHubRepo, Config::kManifestAsset);
    if (s == L"mirror") return Config::kMirrorManifest;
    if (s == L"local" || s.empty()) return Config::kLocalManifest;
    return source;
}

std::wstring HelpText() {
    return std::format(
        L"{0} {1} - Windows Subsystem for Android with Android 15\n"
        L"\n"
        L"Usage: {2} <command> [options]   (no command: graphical interface)\n"
        L"\n"
        L"Commands:\n"
        L"  status               Windows, Virtual Machine Platform, developer mode, installed WSA\n"
        L"  check                read the release manifest and show what would be downloaded\n"
        L"  install              download, verify, unpack and register WSA-Next (administrator)\n"
        L"  uninstall            remove WSA-Next; Android apps and data stay for the next installation\n"
        L"  uninstall --all      remove everything: also Android apps and data, their Start menu entries\n"
        L"                       and associations, WSA-Next's settings; developer mode and Virtual Machine\n"
        L"                       Platform are turned off again if WSA-Next turned them on (administrator)\n"
        L"                       Installed with WSA-Next Setup (WSA-Next.msi): Windows Installer removes it\n"
        L"  bluetooth            give Android the PC's Bluetooth adapter until Ctrl+C (administrator)\n"
        L"  bluetooth --list-vms what the Host Compute Service reports (diagnostics)\n"
        L"  hello                bridge Windows Hello (fingerprint/PIN) to Android until Ctrl+C (administrator)\n"
        L"  hello --check        check whether Windows Hello is configured for this Windows account\n"
        L"  hello --test         prompt Windows Hello right now to verify the reader/PIN\n"
        L"  hello remember [off|5|30|lock] [--yes]\n"
        L"                       let Android apps that ask for a fingerprint in without asking again for 5 or\n"
        L"                       30 minutes, or until Windows is locked, after one Windows Hello confirmation\n"
        L"                       (off by default; locking Windows always ends it; root still asks every time)\n"
        L"  modem                the PC's modem as Android sees it: SIM, network, signal, SMS centre (diagnostics)\n"
        L"  elevation [on|off]   root for Android apps: an app runs \"0 [command]\" (root is uid 0) and Windows\n"
        L"                       Hello confirms every request on this PC (off by default)\n"
        L"  elevation su on|off  also offer root apps the name they look for, su (a link to 0)\n"
        L"  launch               start Android (the Play Store, or Android's Settings)\n"
        L"  stop                 stop WSA and free its memory, nothing is removed; it starts again\n"
        L"                       with the next Android app (administrator)\n"
        L"  verify [folder]      check that the installed Android is an official release, unchanged\n"
        L"  version              print the version\n"
        L"  lng-export <file>    write the English strings (start of a translation)\n"
        L"  lng-check [file]     coverage and placeholder check of language files\n"
        L"  msi stop-hosts | msi uninstall <SID> [--all]\n"
        L"                       used by WSA-Next Setup (LocalSystem): stop the background host in every\n"
        L"                       session; remove WSA-Next as the user who removes Setup, without a second\n"
        L"                       UAC prompt\n"
        L"\n"
        L"Options:\n"
        L"  --source <s>         local (http://localhost/wsa-next), mirror (kvc.pl), github,\n"
        L"                       or the URL of a manifest.json\n"
        L"  --dir <folder>       install folder (default {3})\n"
        L"  --files-only         install: files only, do not touch the Windows registration\n"
        L"  --keep-downloads     install: keep the compressed downloads\n"
        L"  --yes                install: accept the questions (developer mode, Virtual Machine Platform,\n"
        L"                       replacing WSA from the Microsoft Store); uninstall: confirm\n"
        L"  --no-progress        no progress bar\n"
        L"\n"
        L"Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage, 3 unavailable, 4 canceled, 5 restart Windows to finish\n",
        Config::kAppTitle, Config::kAppVersion, Config::kExeName, Core::DefaultFolder().wstring());
}

int Run(int argc, wchar_t** argv) {
    Console con;
    Text::Use(L"en");
    Args args;
    if (argc > 1 && IsHelp(argv[1])) {
        con.Out(HelpText());
        return kOk;
    }
    if (auto error = Parse(std::span<wchar_t*>(argv + 1, static_cast<std::size_t>(argc - 1)), args)) {
        con.Err(*error + L"\n\n");
        con.Out(HelpText());
        return kUsage;
    }
    // Package manager and WMI calls need COM (multithreaded: their async operations block).
    const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    struct ComExit {
        HRESULT hr;
        ~ComExit() { if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) CoUninitialize(); }
    } comExit{com};

    if (args.command == L"version") {
        con.Line(std::format(L"{} {}", Config::kAppTitle, Config::kAppVersion));
        return kOk;
    }
    if (args.command == L"status") return Status(con, args);
    if (args.command == L"check") return Check(con, args);
    if (args.command == L"install") return Install(con, args);
    if (args.command == L"uninstall") return Uninstall(con, args);
    if (args.command == L"bluetooth") return Bluetooth(con, args);
    if (args.command == L"hello") return Hello(con, args);
    if (args.command == L"elevation") return Elevation(con, args);
    if (args.command == L"modem") return ModemCheck(con);
    if (args.command == L"verify") {
        // The background host's check, run here: the WSA package folder (or the given one).
        fs::path folder;
        if (!args.positional.empty()) folder = args.positional[0];
        else if (const auto package = Install::FindWsa()) folder = package->location;
        using Core::Release::State;
        const State state = Core::Release::VerifyInstalled(folder, {});
        con.Line(std::format(L"Folder  {}", folder.empty() ? std::wstring(L"(WSA not installed)") : folder.wstring()));
        switch (state) {
        case State::Official: con.Status(Level::Success, L"official WSA-Next release, unchanged"); return kOk;
        case State::Modified: con.Status(Level::Error, L"official release, but its Android files were changed after installing"); return kFailed;
        case State::Missing: con.Status(Level::Error, L"WSA is not installed"); return kUnavailable;
        default: con.Status(Level::Error, L"not an official WSA-Next release (no valid publisher signature)"); return kFailed;
        }
    }
    if (args.command == L"stop") {
        if (!IsElevated()) {
            con.Status(Level::Error, L"run this from an elevated (administrator) prompt");
            return kUnavailable;
        }
        switch (Install::Stop()) {
        case Guest::VmStop::ShutDown: con.Status(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_WSA_STOPPED)); return kOk;
        case Guest::VmStop::Terminated: con.Status(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_WSA_TERMINATED)); return kOk;
        case Guest::VmStop::NotRunning: con.Status(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_WSA_NOT_RUNNING)); return kOk;
        case Guest::VmStop::Failed: break;
        }
        con.Status(Level::Error, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_WSA_STOP_FAILED));
        return kFailed;
    }
    if (args.command == L"launch") {
        if (auto r = Install::LaunchAndroid(); !r) {
            con.Status(Level::Error, r.error());
            return kFailed;
        }
        return kOk;
    }
    if (args.command == L"lng-export") {
        if (args.positional.size() != 1) {
            con.Err(L"lng-export needs a file name\n");
            return kUsage;
        }
        return Text::ExportTemplate(args.positional[0]) ? kOk : kFailed;
    }
    if (args.command == L"lng-check") {
        const auto reports = Text::Check(args.positional.empty() ? std::wstring() : args.positional[0]);
        int worst = kOk;
        for (const auto& r : reports) {
            con.Line(std::format(L"{} ({}): {}% translated, {} missing, {} unknown, {} broken placeholders", r.file, r.language.name,
                                 r.language.Coverage(), r.missing.size(), r.unknown.size(), r.placeholders.size()));
            if (!r.placeholders.empty() || !r.unknown.empty()) worst = kFailed;
        }
        return worst;
    }
    con.Err(std::format(L"unknown command {}\n\n", args.command));
    con.Out(HelpText());
    return kUsage;
}

}  // namespace WN::Cli
```

`src/app/Console.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "app/Console.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WN::Cli {
namespace {

enum class Kind { None, Console, Redirected };

Kind KindOf(HANDLE h) {
    if (!h || h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return Kind::None;
    switch (GetFileType(h)) {
    case FILE_TYPE_DISK:
    case FILE_TYPE_PIPE: return Kind::Redirected;
    case FILE_TYPE_CHAR: {
        DWORD mode = 0;
        // Real consoles answer GetConsoleMode; NUL (e.g. from SetupActions or > NUL) is a redirected char handle.
        return GetConsoleMode(h, &mode) ? Kind::Console : Kind::Redirected;
    }
    default: return Kind::None;
    }
}

FileHandle OpenConsole(const wchar_t* name) {
    return FileHandle(CreateFileW(name, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr,
                                  OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
}

void QueueEnter() {
    // CONIN$ of the attached console (works for conhost, Windows Terminal and ssh's ConPTY).
    const FileHandle in = OpenConsole(L"CONIN$");
    if (!in) return;
    INPUT_RECORD keys[2]{};
    keys[0].EventType = KEY_EVENT;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.bKeyDown = TRUE;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.wRepeatCount = 1;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.wVirtualKeyCode = VK_RETURN;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.wVirtualScanCode = static_cast<WORD>(MapVirtualKeyW(VK_RETURN, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC));
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.uChar.UnicodeChar = L'\r';
    keys[1] = keys[0];
    keys[1].Event.KeyEvent.bKeyDown = FALSE;
    DWORD written = 0;
    WriteConsoleInputW(in.get(), keys, 2, &written);
}

void WaitForKey() {
    const FileHandle in = OpenConsole(L"CONIN$");
    if (!in) return;
    FlushConsoleInputBuffer(in.get());
    for (;;) {
        INPUT_RECORD record{};
        DWORD read = 0;
        if (!ReadConsoleInputW(in.get(), &record, 1, &read) || !read) break;
        if (record.EventType == KEY_EVENT && record.Event.KeyEvent.bKeyDown) break;
    }
}

}  // namespace

Console::Console() {
    HANDLE out = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE), err = GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE);
    const Kind outKind = KindOf(out), errKind = KindOf(err);
    if (outKind == Kind::Redirected) m_out.handle = out;
    if (errKind == Kind::Redirected) m_err.handle = err;

    if (!m_out.handle || !m_err.handle) {
        if (AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS)) m_attached = true;
        else if (!m_out.handle && !m_err.handle && AllocConsole()) m_allocated = true;
        if (m_attached || m_allocated) {
            m_conout = OpenConsole(L"CONOUT$");
        }
        if (m_conout) {
            if (!m_out.handle) m_out = {m_conout.get(), true};
            if (!m_err.handle) m_err = {m_conout.get(), true};
            DWORD mode = 0;
            if (GetConsoleMode(m_conout.get(), &mode))
                m_vt = SetConsoleMode(m_conout.get(), mode | ENABLE_PROCESSED_OUTPUT | ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_PROCESSING) != 0;
        }
    }
    if (!m_out.handle) m_out = m_err;
    if (!m_err.handle) m_err = m_out;
    // Progress belongs on a terminal. Without one it goes to stdout with the status lines, so the
    // two cannot be reordered (ssh without a terminal carries stdout and stderr separately).
    m_bar = m_err.console ? m_err : m_out;
    // Colour only when stdout itself is the console: never escape codes in a file or a pipe.
    m_vt = m_vt && m_out.console;
    if (m_allocated) SetConsoleTitleW(Config::kAppTitle);
}

Console::~Console() {
    EndProgress();
    if (m_allocated) {
        Out(L"\nPress any key to close this window.");
        WaitForKey();
    } else if (m_attached) {
        QueueEnter();
    }
    m_conout.reset();
    if (m_attached || m_allocated) FreeConsole();
}

void Console::Write(Stream& s, std::wstring_view text) {
    if (!s.handle || text.empty()) return;
    DWORD written = 0;
    if (s.console) {
        WriteConsoleW(s.handle, text.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(text.size()), &written, nullptr);
        return;
    }
    // Files and pipes get UTF-8 with CRLF line ends (cmd, findstr and Notepad all expect them).
    std::wstring crlf;
    crlf.reserve(text.size() + 8);
    for (wchar_t c : text) {
        if (c == L'\n' && (crlf.empty() || crlf.back() != L'\r')) crlf.push_back(L'\r');
        crlf.push_back(c);
    }
    const std::string utf8 = ToUtf8(crlf);
    WriteFile(s.handle, utf8.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(utf8.size()), &written, nullptr);
}

void Console::Out(std::wstring_view text) {
    ClearProgressLine();
    Write(m_out, text);
}

void Console::Err(std::wstring_view text) {
    ClearProgressLine();
    Write(m_err, text);
}

void Console::Status(Level level, std::wstring_view text) {
    static constexpr struct { const wchar_t* tag; const wchar_t* color; } kTags[] = {
        {L"[INFO]", L"\x1b[90m"}, {L"[ OK ]", L"\x1b[32m"}, {L"[WARN]", L"\x1b[33m"}, {L"[FAIL]", L"\x1b[91m"}};
    const auto& t = kTags[static_cast<int>(level)];
    std::wstring line = m_vt ? std::format(L"{}{}\x1b[0m {}\n", t.color, t.tag, text) : std::format(L"{} {}\n", t.tag, text);
    if (level == Level::Error) Err(line);
    else Out(line);
}

int Console::Width() const {
    CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO info{};
    if (m_bar.console && GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo(m_bar.handle, &info))
        return std::clamp<int>(info.srWindow.Right - info.srWindow.Left + 1, 40, 200);
    return 80;
}

void Console::ClearProgressLine() {
    if (!m_progressShown) return;
    m_progressShown = false;
    if (m_bar.console) Write(m_bar, std::wstring(L"\r") + std::wstring(static_cast<std::size_t>(Width() - 1), L' ') + L"\r");
    else Write(m_bar, L"\n");
}

void Console::Progress(std::wstring_view label, double fraction, std::wstring_view detail) {
    if (!m_progressEnabled) return;
    if (m_lastLabel != label) {
        EndProgress();
        m_lastLabel = label;
        m_progressComplete = false;
    }
    // A terminal gets ~10 redraws per second, a pipe or file one line per second at most.
    const std::uint64_t now = GetTickCount64();
    const bool complete = fraction >= 1.0;
    if (complete && m_progressComplete) return;
    if (!complete && now - m_lastDraw < (m_bar.console ? 100u : 1000u)) return;
    m_lastDraw = now;
    m_progressComplete = complete;

    // Fixed columns, so consecutive lines (a pipe keeps them all) line up:
    //   "  [2/3] Downloading image           ██████░░░░  42%  480.2 MB / 1.07 GB  54.9 MB/s  ETA 0:12"
    fraction = std::clamp(fraction, 0.0, 1.0);
    const int width = m_bar.console ? Width() : 120;
    constexpr std::size_t kLabel = 30;
    constexpr int kTail = 48;  // room reserved for " 100%  1.07 GB / 1.07 GB  54.9 MB/s  ETA 1:02:03"
    const std::wstring fitted = label.size() > kLabel ? std::wstring(label.substr(0, kLabel - 1)) + L"\x2026" : std::wstring(label);
    const std::wstring head = std::format(L"  {:<{}} ", fitted, kLabel);
    const std::wstring tail = std::format(L" {:>3}%  {}", static_cast<int>(std::floor(fraction * 100.0)), detail);
    const int barWidth = std::clamp(width - static_cast<int>(head.size()) - kTail, 10, 40);
    const int filled = static_cast<int>(std::round(fraction * barWidth));
    std::wstring bar;
    bar.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(barWidth));
    for (int i = 0; i < barWidth; ++i) bar.push_back(i < filled ? L'\x2588' : L'\x2591');  // █ ░
    // A narrow console shortens the visible text - tail first, then the bar - before the colour
    // codes go around the bar, so the closing reset is never cut off.
    std::wstring shownHead = head, shownTail = tail;
    std::size_t over = head.size() + bar.size() + tail.size() + 1;
    over = over > static_cast<std::size_t>(width) ? over - static_cast<std::size_t>(width) : 0;
    for (std::wstring* part : {&shownTail, &bar, &shownHead}) {
        const std::size_t cut = std::min(over, part->size());
        part->resize(part->size() - cut);
        over -= cut;
    }
    const std::wstring line = shownHead + (m_vt && !bar.empty() ? L"\x1b[38;2;215;10;83m" + bar + L"\x1b[0m" : bar) + shownTail;

    DWORD written = 0;
    const std::wstring text = (m_bar.console ? L"\r" : L"") + line + (m_bar.console ? L"" : L"\n");
    if (m_bar.console) {
        WriteConsoleW(m_bar.handle, text.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(text.size()), &written, nullptr);
        m_progressShown = true;
    } else {
        Write(m_bar, text);
    }
}

void Console::EndProgress() {
    if (m_progressShown && m_bar.console) {
        Write(m_bar, L"\n");
        m_progressShown = false;
    }
    m_lastLabel.clear();
    m_lastDraw = 0;
}

}  // namespace WN::Cli
```

`src/app/Console.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Console output for the command-line mode of a GUI-subsystem executable.
//
//  * stdout / stderr redirected to a file or a pipe (`> log.txt`, `| findstr`, ssh without a
//    terminal): written there as UTF-8, nothing is attached;
//  * otherwise the console of the parent process is attached (cmd, PowerShell, Windows Terminal,
//    an ssh session with a terminal) and written with WriteConsoleW;
//  * started without any console (shortcut with arguments): a console is allocated and kept
//    open until a key is pressed.
//
// The shell does not wait for a GUI-subsystem program, so when the parent console was attached a
// synthetic Enter is queued at the end: the prompt is redrawn below the output.
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace WN::Cli {

class Console {
public:
    Console();
    ~Console();
    Console(const Console&) = delete;
    Console& operator=(const Console&) = delete;

    void Out(std::wstring_view text);  // stdout
    void Err(std::wstring_view text);  // stderr
    void Line(std::wstring_view text = {}) { Out(text); Out(L"\n"); }

    // "[ OK ] text" style status lines on stdout (coloured on a VT console).
    void Status(Level level, std::wstring_view text);

    // Single-line progress bar on stderr, redrawn in place; Status() keeps it below new lines.
    void Progress(std::wstring_view label, double fraction, std::wstring_view detail);
    void EndProgress();  // keeps the last bar, moves to a new line
    void set_progress_enabled(bool enabled) { m_progressEnabled = enabled; }

    [[nodiscard]] bool color() const noexcept { return m_vt; }

private:
    struct Stream {
        HANDLE handle = nullptr;  // not owned (std handle or m_conout)
        bool console = false;
    };
    void Write(Stream& s, std::wstring_view text);
    void ClearProgressLine();
    int Width() const;

    Stream m_out, m_err, m_bar;  // m_bar: where progress bars go
    FileHandle m_conout;       // CONOUT$ when a console is attached / allocated
    bool m_attached = false;   // parent console -> synthetic Enter at exit
    bool m_allocated = false;  // own console -> wait for a key at exit
    bool m_vt = false;
    bool m_progressEnabled = true;
    bool m_progressShown = false;
    bool m_progressComplete = false;  // the 100 % line of a step is drawn once
    std::uint64_t m_lastDraw = 0;
    std::wstring m_lastLabel;
};

}  // namespace WN::Cli
```

`src/app/SetupActions.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "app/SetupActions.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <WtsApi32.h>
#include <sddl.h>
#include <UserEnv.h>
#include <format>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "wtsapi32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "userenv.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "advapi32.lib")

namespace WN::SetupActions {
namespace {

constexpr int kOk = 0, kFailed = 1, kUsage = 2, kUnavailable = 3;  // as the command line's

// The sessions Windows has now (WTSEnumerateSessions), as ids.
std::vector<DWORD> Sessions() {
    std::vector<DWORD> ids;
    PWTS_SESSION_INFOW list = nullptr;
    DWORD count = 0;
    if (!WTSEnumerateSessionsW(WTS_CURRENT_SERVER_HANDLE, 0, 1, &list, &count)) return ids;
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < count; ++i) ids.push_back(list[i].SessionId);
    WTSFreeMemory(list);
    return ids;
}

// The host keeps "Local\WSA-Next.Host" (a mutex it owns while it runs) and "Local\WSA-Next.Host.Stop"
// in its session; from session 0 they are "Global\Session\<id>\...". Each host is told to stop, then
// waited for: its mutex is abandoned when it has ended. The hosts stop together, 10 s at most.
int StopHosts() {
    struct Running {
        DWORD session;
        KernelHandle mutex;
    };
    std::vector<Running> hosts;
    for (const DWORD id : Sessions()) {
        const std::wstring prefix = std::format(L"Global\\Session\\{}\\WSA-Next.Host", id);
        KernelHandle mutex(OpenMutexW(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, prefix.c_str()));
        if (!mutex) continue;
        const KernelHandle stop(OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE, FALSE, (prefix + L".Stop").c_str()));
        if (!stop || !SetEvent(stop.get())) continue;
        hosts.push_back({id, std::move(mutex)});
    }
    const ULONGLONG deadline = GetTickCount64() + 10000;
    int result = kOk;
    for (Running& host : hosts) {
        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
        const DWORD wait = WaitForSingleObject(host.mutex.get(), now < deadline ? static_cast<DWORD>(deadline - now) : 0);
        if (wait == WAIT_OBJECT_0 || wait == WAIT_ABANDONED) ReleaseMutex(host.mutex.get());
        else result = kFailed;  // still running: Windows Installer replaces the file at the next restart
    }
    return result;
}

bool EnablePrivilege(const wchar_t* name) {
    KernelHandle token;
    if (!OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_ADJUST_PRIVILEGES | TOKEN_QUERY, token.put())) return false;
    TOKEN_PRIVILEGES privileges{1, {{{}, SE_PRIVILEGE_ENABLED}}};
    if (!LookupPrivilegeValueW(nullptr, name, &privileges.Privileges[0].Luid)) return false;
    return AdjustTokenPrivileges(token.get(), FALSE, &privileges, 0, nullptr, nullptr) && GetLastError() == ERROR_SUCCESS;
}

bool TokenIsUser(HANDLE token, PSID user) {
    alignas(TOKEN_USER) unsigned char buffer[sizeof(TOKEN_USER) + SECURITY_MAX_SID_SIZE];
    DWORD size = 0;
    return GetTokenInformation(token, TokenUser, buffer, sizeof buffer, &size) &&
           EqualSid(reinterpret_cast<TOKEN_USER*>(buffer)->User.Sid, user);
}

// The token of the user with `sid` in one of the user's sessions (an active one first), the full
// one when UAC filtered it: the removal changes %ProgramFiles%, HKLM and Windows features.
KernelHandle UserToken(PSID sid, DWORD& session) {
    KernelHandle found;
    for (const bool activeOnly : {true, false}) {
        for (const DWORD id : Sessions()) {
            if (activeOnly) {
                WTS_CONNECTSTATE_CLASS* state = nullptr;
                DWORD bytes = 0;
                if (!WTSQuerySessionInformationW(WTS_CURRENT_SERVER_HANDLE, id, WTSConnectState, reinterpret_cast<LPWSTR*>(&state), &bytes))
                    continue;
                const bool active = *state == WTSActive;
                WTSFreeMemory(state);
                if (!active) continue;
            }
            KernelHandle token;
            if (!WTSQueryUserToken(id, token.put()) || !TokenIsUser(token.get(), sid)) continue;
            session = id;
            found = std::move(token);
            break;
        }
        if (found) break;
    }
    if (!found) return found;
    TOKEN_ELEVATION_TYPE type{};
    DWORD size = 0;
    if (GetTokenInformation(found.get(), TokenElevationType, &type, sizeof type, &size) && type == TokenElevationTypeLimited) {
        TOKEN_LINKED_TOKEN linked{};
        if (GetTokenInformation(found.get(), TokenLinkedToken, &linked, sizeof linked, &size)) return KernelHandle(linked.LinkedToken);
    }
    return found;
}

int UninstallAsUser(const wchar_t* sidText, bool everything) {
    PSID sid = nullptr;
    if (!ConvertStringSidToSidW(sidText, &sid)) return kUsage;
    EnablePrivilege(SE_TCB_NAME);  // WTSQueryUserToken
    EnablePrivilege(SE_ASSIGNPRIMARYTOKEN_NAME);
    EnablePrivilege(SE_INCREASE_QUOTA_NAME);
    // Failures here exit with a Win32 error code, so that Setup's log tells them from the exit codes
    // (0-5) of the removal itself.
    DWORD session = 0;
    const KernelHandle token = UserToken(sid, session);
    LocalFree(sid);
    if (!token) return ERROR_NO_TOKEN;  // not signed in (or not running as LocalSystem)

    void* environment = nullptr;
    if (!CreateEnvironmentBlock(&environment, token.get(), FALSE)) environment = nullptr;
    // Output nowhere: no console window appears in the user's session.
    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES inherit{sizeof inherit, nullptr, TRUE};
    const KernelHandle nul(CreateFileW(L"NUL", GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, &inherit, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
    STARTUPINFOW si{sizeof si};
    si.lpDesktop = const_cast<wchar_t*>(L"winsta0\\default");
    si.dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES;
    si.hStdInput = si.hStdOutput = si.hStdError = nul.get();
    const std::wstring exe = ModulePath();
    std::wstring command = std::format(L"\"{}\" uninstall --yes --from-setup{}", exe, everything ? L" --all" : L"");
    wchar_t system[MAX_PATH]{};
    GetSystemDirectoryW(system, MAX_PATH);
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
    const BOOL started = CreateProcessAsUserW(token.get(), exe.c_str(), command.data(), nullptr, nullptr, TRUE,
                                              CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT | CREATE_NO_WINDOW, environment, system, &si, &pi);
    const DWORD error = GetLastError();
    if (environment) DestroyEnvironmentBlock(environment);
    if (!started) return static_cast<int>(error);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    const KernelHandle process(pi.hProcess);
    WaitForSingleObject(process.get(), INFINITE);
    DWORD code = kFailed;
    GetExitCodeProcess(process.get(), &code);
    return static_cast<int>(code);
}

}  // namespace

int Run(int argc, wchar_t** argv) {
    if (!IsElevated()) return kUnavailable;
    if (argc == 3 && _wcsicmp(argv[2], L"stop-hosts") == 0) return StopHosts();
    if (argc >= 4 && argc <= 5 && _wcsicmp(argv[2], L"uninstall") == 0) {
        const bool everything = argc == 5 && _wcsicmp(argv[4], L"--all") == 0;
        if (argc == 5 && !everything) return kUsage;
        return UninstallAsUser(argv[3], everything);
    }
    return kUsage;
}

}  // namespace WN::SetupActions
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// WSA-Next - entry point. No arguments: graphical interface. Any argument: command line.
#include "app/Cli.h"
#include "app/SetupActions.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"

namespace {

struct ArgvDeleter {
    void operator()(wchar_t** argv) const noexcept { LocalFree(argv); }
};

class ComApartment {
public:
    ComApartment() noexcept : m_hr(CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED | COINIT_DISABLE_OLE1DDE)) {}
    ComApartment(const ComApartment&) = delete;
    ComApartment& operator=(const ComApartment&) = delete;
    ~ComApartment() { if (SUCCEEDED(m_hr)) CoUninitialize(); }

private:
    HRESULT m_hr;
};

// The GUI needs administrator rights (Program Files, developer mode, Windows features); the manifest
// stays asInvoker so the command line can report a missing elevation instead of a UAC prompt in a script.
int RelaunchElevated() {
    const std::wstring self = WN::ModulePath();
    SHELLEXECUTEINFOW info{sizeof info};
    info.fMask = SEE_MASK_NOASYNC;
    info.lpVerb = L"runas";
    info.lpFile = self.c_str();
    info.nShow = SW_SHOWNORMAL;
    if (ShellExecuteExW(&info)) return 0;
    if (GetLastError() != ERROR_CANCELLED)
        MessageBoxW(nullptr, WN::ErrorText(WN::Text::Get(IDS_ERR_ELEVATE), GetLastError()).c_str(), WN::Config::kAppTitle,
                    MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    return 1;
}

}  // namespace

int WINAPI wWinMain(_In_ HINSTANCE instance, _In_opt_ HINSTANCE, _In_ LPWSTR, _In_ int showCommand) {
    // Hardening: DLLs only from System32 (no planting next to the executable or in the working directory).
    SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
    HeapSetInformation(nullptr, HeapEnableTerminationOnCorruption, nullptr, 0);
    // No loader message boxes, here or in the processes started from here (inherited): a failure is
    // reported through the exit code and the log.
    SetErrorMode(SetErrorMode(0) | SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS | SEM_NOOPENFILEERRORBOX);

    int argc = 0;
    const std::unique_ptr<wchar_t*, ArgvDeleter> argv(CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc));
    // The background host (Windows Hello and Bluetooth for Android; started by the window or at
    // logon): no console, no window. "bluetooth --background" is its name of the first test builds.
    if (argv && argc == 3 && _wcsicmp(argv.get()[2], L"--background") == 0 &&
        (_wcsicmp(argv.get()[1], L"host") == 0 || _wcsicmp(argv.get()[1], L"bluetooth") == 0)) {
        WN::Text::UseSaved();  // its icon and the Windows Hello dialogs speak the user's language
        return WN::Host::RunBackground();
    }
    // WSA-Next Setup's custom actions (LocalSystem, session 0): no console either.
    if (argv && argc > 2 && _wcsicmp(argv.get()[1], L"msi") == 0) return WN::SetupActions::Run(argc, argv.get());
    if (argv && argc > 1) return WN::Cli::Run(argc, argv.get());

    WN::Text::UseSaved();  // Windows language unless the user picked one
    if (!WN::IsElevated()) return RelaunchElevated();

    const ComApartment com;  // file dialogs, taskbar progress
    const INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX controls{sizeof controls, ICC_STANDARD_CLASSES};
    InitCommonControlsEx(&controls);

    WN::Ui::MainWindow window(instance);
    if (!window.Create(showCommand)) {
        MessageBoxW(nullptr, WN::Text::Get(IDS_ERR_WINDOW).c_str(), WN::Config::kAppTitle, MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return 1;
    }
    return window.Run();
}
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Elevation bridge: Android's elevation daemon in WSA <-> Hyper-V socket ("WSEV") <-> Windows Hello.
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include <objbase.h>
#include "biometrics/ElevationBridge.h"
#include "biometrics/ElevationProtocol.h"
#include "biometrics/WindowsHello.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/HostEvents.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Bio::Elevation {
namespace {

constexpr std::size_t kShownPackage = 200, kShownCommand = 300;

bool RecvExact(SOCKET s, void* dst, std::size_t size) {
    auto* out = static_cast<char*>(dst);
    std::size_t done = 0;
    while (done < size) {
        const int n = recv(s, out + done, static_cast<int>(size - done), 0);
        if (n <= 0) return false;
        done += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

bool SendAll(SOCKET s, const void* src, std::size_t size) {
    const auto* in = static_cast<const char*>(src);
    std::size_t done = 0;
    while (done < size) {
        const int n = ::send(s, in + done, static_cast<int>(size - done), 0);
        if (n <= 0) return false;
        done += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

struct Request {
    std::uint32_t id = 0, uid = 0;
    std::string package, command;
};

std::optional<Request> ParseRequest(std::span<const std::uint8_t> p) {
    std::size_t at = 0;
    auto u32 = [&](std::uint32_t& v) {
        if (p.size() - at < 4) return false;
        v = p[at] | (p[at + 1] << 8) | (p[at + 2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[at + 3]) << 24);
        at += 4;
        return true;
    };
    auto text = [&](std::string& v) {
        if (p.size() - at < 2) return false;
        const std::size_t n = p[at] | (p[at + 1] << 8);
        at += 2;
        if (p.size() - at < n) return false;
        v.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(p.data() + at), n);
        at += n;
        return true;
    };
    Request r;
    if (!u32(r.id) || !u32(r.uid) || !text(r.package) || !text(r.command)) return std::nullopt;
    return r;
}

// What the guest says is shown, but tamed: package names keep their own alphabet, a command loses
// control and direction-changing characters (which could make it read as something else).
std::wstring ShownPackage(const std::string& package) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (const char c : package.substr(0, kShownPackage)) {
        const bool plain = (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '.' || c == '_' || c == ',' || c == ':' || c == '-';
        out += plain ? static_cast<wchar_t>(c) : L'?';
    }
    return out;
}

std::wstring ShownCommand(const std::string& command) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (const wchar_t c : FromUtf8(command)) {
        // C0/C1 controls, zero-width and direction marks, line/paragraph separators, BOM.
        const bool hidden = c < 0x20 || (c >= 0x7F && c <= 0x9F) || c == 0x061C || (c >= 0x200B && c <= 0x200F) || c == 0x2028 ||
                            c == 0x2029 || (c >= 0x202A && c <= 0x202E) || (c >= 0x2066 && c <= 0x2069) || c == 0xFEFF;
        out += hidden ? L'?' : c;
        if (out.size() >= kShownCommand) {
            out += L"…";
            break;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

// For the log: one line per entry, whatever the guest sent.
std::string OneLine(std::string text) {
    for (char& c : text)
        if (static_cast<unsigned char>(c) < 0x20 || c == 0x7F) c = '?';
    return text;
}

// Who asks and for what, as the dialog and the notification name them.
std::wstring ShownApp(const Request& r) {
    if (r.uid == 0) return L"root";
    if (r.uid == 2000) return L"adb shell";
    if (!r.package.empty()) return ShownPackage(r.package);
    return Text::Get(IDS_ELEVATE_APP_UID);
}

std::wstring ShownWhat(const Request& r) {
    return r.command.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_ELEVATE_SHELL) : L"“" + ShownCommand(r.command) + L"”";
}

Status MapVerify(VerifyResult result) {
    switch (result) {
    case VerifyResult::Verified: return Status::Granted;
    case VerifyResult::NotAvailable: return Status::NotAvailable;
    case VerifyResult::Busy: return Status::Busy;
    default: return Status::Denied;
    }
}

const char* StatusName(Status s) {
    switch (s) {
    case Status::Granted: return "granted";
    case Status::NotAvailable: return "refused (Windows Hello is not set up)";
    case Status::Busy: return "refused (busy)";
    default: return "denied";
    }
}

void RunSession(std::uintptr_t handle, bool suForApps) {
    const auto socket = static_cast<SOCKET>(handle);
    std::mutex sendLock;
    {
        const FrameHeader config{kMagic, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Op::Config), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(suForApps ? 1 : 0), 0};
        SendAll(socket, &config, sizeof config);
    }
    auto answer = [&](Status status, std::uint32_t id) {
        // One message, one buffer: header and the request id.
        std::uint8_t message[sizeof(FrameHeader) + 4];
        const FrameHeader frame{kMagic, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Op::Answer), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(status), 4};
        std::memcpy(message, &frame, sizeof frame);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) message[sizeof frame + i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(id >> (8 * i));
        std::lock_guard guard(sendLock);
        SendAll(socket, message, sizeof message);
    };

    std::atomic<bool> deciding{false};
    std::atomic<std::uint32_t> current{0};
    std::stop_source cancel;
    std::jthread decider;
    for (;;) {
        FrameHeader frame{};
        if (!RecvExact(socket, &frame, sizeof frame)) break;
        if (frame.magic != kMagic || frame.payloadLen > kMaxPayload) {
            Bt::Log("elevate: invalid frame (magic=0x{:08X}, len={}), dropping the connection", frame.magic, frame.payloadLen);
            break;
        }
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> payload(frame.payloadLen);
        if (!payload.empty() && !RecvExact(socket, payload.data(), payload.size())) break;

        if (static_cast<Op>(frame.op) == Op::Request) {
            const auto request = ParseRequest(payload);
            if (!request) {
                Bt::Log("elevate: malformed request, dropping the connection");
                break;
            }
            if (deciding.exchange(true)) {
                answer(Status::Busy, request->id);
                continue;
            }
            if (decider.joinable()) decider.join();  // the previous request has been answered
            cancel = std::stop_source();
            current = request->id;
            decider = std::jthread([&, r = *request, token = cancel.get_token()](std::stop_token) {
                const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
                const std::wstring app = ShownApp(r), what = ShownWhat(r);
                const std::wstring prompt = Text::Format(IDS_ELEVATE_PROMPT, app, r.uid, what);
                Bt::Log("elevate: {} (uid {}) asks for root: {}", OneLine(r.package.empty() ? "?" : r.package), r.uid,
                        r.command.empty() ? std::string("<interactive shell>") : OneLine(r.command));
                const Status status = MapVerify(RequestVerification(prompt, token));
                Bt::Log("elevate: request {} {}", r.id, StatusName(status));
                answer(status, r.id);
                // Every grant shows on Windows afterwards too (the host's icon), not only in the log.
                if (status == Status::Granted) HostNotice(Text::Get(IDS_TRAY_ROOT_GRANTED), Text::Format(IDS_TRAY_ROOT_GRANTED_TEXT, app, r.uid, what));
                deciding = false;
                if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
            });
        } else if (static_cast<Op>(frame.op) == Op::Cancel && payload.size() >= 4) {
            const std::uint32_t id = payload[0] | (payload[1] << 8) | (payload[2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(payload[3]) << 24);
            if (deciding && id == current) cancel.request_stop();
        }
    }
    cancel.request_stop();  // the daemon is gone: close a dialog that is still open
}

}  // namespace

void RunBridge(std::stop_token stop, bool suForApps) {
    if (!IsElevated()) {
        Bt::Log("elevate: administrator rights are required (Host Compute Service)");
        return;
    }
    Bt::Log("elevation bridge ready (vsock port 0x{:08X}, su for root apps {})", kBridgePort, suForApps ? "on" : "off");
    Guest::Serve(kBridgePort, "Android elevation daemon", [suForApps](std::uintptr_t socket, std::stop_token) { RunSession(socket, suForApps); }, stop);
    Bt::Log("elevation bridge stopped");
}

}  // namespace WN::Bio::Elevation
```

`src/biometrics/ElevationProtocol.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Wire protocol between the elevation bridge (host) and Android's elevation daemon
// (wsa-elevated, guest) over a Hyper-V socket: the daemon listens on vsock port "WSEV", the bridge
// connects while WSA runs and root for Android apps is turned on in WSA-Next.
//
// An app asks for root with /system_ext/bin/0 (root is uid 0); the daemon learns who asks from the
// kernel (the socket's peer credentials), never from the app, and asks the bridge. The bridge
// shows Windows Hello with its own text naming the app and the command; only a verified answer
// lets the daemon start the process as root.
//
// Every message is an 8-byte header followed by a payload of at most kMaxPayload bytes.
// Must match android/device/wsa/wsa_x86_64/elevate/elevated.cpp.
//   daemon -> bridge  Request   u32 id, u32 uid, u16 length + package(s) (UTF-8), u16 length +
//                               command (UTF-8; empty: an interactive shell)
//   bridge -> daemon  Answer    status, u32 id
//   daemon -> bridge  Cancel    u32 id: the app gave up waiting; the dialog closes
//   bridge -> daemon  Config    status 1: "su for root apps" (the daemon links /dev/wsa/bin/su -> 0
//                               while the bridge stays connected), 0: no su
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace WN::Bio::Elevation {

inline constexpr std::uint32_t kBridgePort = 0x57534556;  // "WSEV"
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kMagic = 0x56455357;       // 'W','S','E','V' in little-endian
inline constexpr std::uint16_t kMaxPayload = 2048;

enum class Op : std::uint8_t {
    Request = 1,
    Answer = 2,
    Cancel = 3,
    Config = 4,
};

enum class Status : std::uint8_t {
    Granted = 1,       // Windows Hello verified the user
    Denied = 2,        // the user canceled, or verification failed
    NotAvailable = 3,  // Windows Hello is not set up
    Busy = 4,          // another request is being decided
};

struct FrameHeader {
    std::uint32_t magic = kMagic;
    std::uint8_t op = 0;
    std::uint8_t status = 0;
    std::uint16_t payloadLen = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(FrameHeader) == 8);

}  // namespace WN::Bio::Elevation

```

`src/biometrics/HelloBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Windows Hello bridge: Android's fingerprint HAL in WSA <-> Hyper-V socket ("WSFP") <-> Windows Hello.
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cfgmgr32.h>
#include <objbase.h>
#include "biometrics/HelloBridge.h"
#include "biometrics/Protocol.h"
#include "biometrics/WindowsHello.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <wtsapi32.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

#pragma comment(lib, "cfgmgr32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "advapi32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "wtsapi32.lib")

namespace WN::Bio {
namespace {

// GUID_DEVINTERFACE_BIOMETRIC_READER (winbio_ioctl.h).
constexpr GUID kBiometricReader{0xe2b5183a, 0x99ea, 0x4cc3, {0xad, 0x6b, 0x80, 0xca, 0x8d, 0x71, 0x5b, 0x80}};

// Blocking: a stop request shuts the socket down (Guest::Serve), which ends the read.
bool RecvExact(SOCKET s, void* dst, std::size_t size) {
    auto* out = static_cast<char*>(dst);
    std::size_t done = 0;
    while (done < size) {
        const int n = recv(s, out + done, static_cast<int>(size - done), 0);
        if (n <= 0) return false;
        done += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

Status MapVerify(VerifyResult r) {
    switch (r) {
    case VerifyResult::Verified: return Status::Verified;
    case VerifyResult::Canceled: return Status::Canceled;
    case VerifyResult::NotAvailable: return Status::NotAvailable;
    case VerifyResult::Busy: return Status::Busy;
    default: return Status::Failed;
    }
}

// Signals `changed` whenever Windows Hello may have become available or unavailable: the
// Windows Biometric Service starting or stopping (service notification) and a biometric reader
// arriving or leaving (device interface notification). Nothing is polled.
class HelloChangeWatch {
public:
    explicit HelloChangeWatch(HANDLE changed) : m_changed(changed) {
        CM_NOTIFY_FILTER filter{};
        filter.cbSize = sizeof filter;
        filter.FilterType = CM_NOTIFY_FILTER_TYPE_DEVICEINTERFACE;
        filter.u.DeviceInterface.ClassGuid = kBiometricReader;
        if (CM_Register_Notification(&filter, changed, &HelloChangeWatch::OnDevice, &m_device) != CR_SUCCESS) m_device = nullptr;
        m_service = std::jthread([this](std::stop_token stop) { WatchService(stop); });
    }
    ~HelloChangeWatch() {
        if (m_device) CM_Unregister_Notification(m_device);
        m_service.request_stop();
        QueueUserAPC([](ULONG_PTR) {}, m_service.native_handle(), 0);  // ends the alertable wait
    }
    HelloChangeWatch(const HelloChangeWatch&) = delete;
    HelloChangeWatch& operator=(const HelloChangeWatch&) = delete;

private:
    static DWORD CALLBACK OnDevice(HCMNOTIFICATION, PVOID context, CM_NOTIFY_ACTION, PCM_NOTIFY_EVENT_DATA, DWORD) {
        SetEvent(static_cast<HANDLE>(context));
        return ERROR_SUCCESS;
    }
    static void CALLBACK OnService(PVOID parameter) { SetEvent(static_cast<SERVICE_NOTIFYW*>(parameter)->pContext); }

    void WatchService(std::stop_token stop) {
        const SC_HANDLE manager = OpenSCManagerW(nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_CONNECT);
        const SC_HANDLE service = manager ? OpenServiceW(manager, L"WbioSrvc", SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS) : nullptr;
        while (service && !stop.stop_requested()) {
            SERVICE_NOTIFYW notify{};
            notify.dwVersion = SERVICE_NOTIFY_STATUS_CHANGE;
            notify.pfnNotifyCallback = &HelloChangeWatch::OnService;
            notify.pContext = m_changed;
            if (NotifyServiceStatusChangeW(service, SERVICE_NOTIFY_RUNNING | SERVICE_NOTIFY_STOPPED, &notify) != ERROR_SUCCESS) break;
            SleepEx(INFINITE, TRUE);  // until the notification (or the destructor's) APC runs
        }
        if (service) CloseServiceHandle(service);  // also cancels a pending notification
        if (manager) CloseServiceHandle(manager);
    }

    HANDLE m_changed;
    HCMNOTIFICATION m_device = nullptr;
    std::jthread m_service;
};

// A remembered verification (setting "HelloRemember", Host::HelloRememberMinutes): when the last
// Windows Hello verification for Android apps succeeded, and in which locking period of this
// Windows session. Only this bridge uses it - root for Android apps always asks.
std::mutex g_rememberLock;
bool g_remembered = false;
ULONGLONG g_verifiedAt = 0;          // GetTickCount64: the time in sleep counts too
std::uint64_t g_verifiedEpoch = 0;
std::atomic<std::uint64_t> g_lockEpoch{0};  // advanced when Windows locks, signs out or disconnects
std::atomic<bool> g_lockWatched{false};     // without the lock watch nothing is remembered

// True when the setting lets a verification of this unlocked period stand for a new request.
bool Remembered() {
    const std::uint32_t minutes = Host::HelloRememberMinutes();
    std::lock_guard guard(g_rememberLock);
    if (minutes == 0 || !g_lockWatched || !g_remembered || g_verifiedEpoch != g_lockEpoch.load()) {
        g_remembered = false;
        return false;
    }
    return minutes == Host::kHelloUntilLocked || GetTickCount64() - g_verifiedAt < static_cast<ULONGLONG>(minutes) * 60'000;
}

void Remember(VerifyResult result) {
    std::lock_guard guard(g_rememberLock);
    if (result == VerifyResult::Verified) {
        g_remembered = true;
        g_verifiedAt = GetTickCount64();
        g_verifiedEpoch = g_lockEpoch.load();
    } else if (result == VerifyResult::Failed) {
        g_remembered = false;  // a wrong finger or PIN: ask again next time
    }
}

// Session notifications (WTSRegisterSessionNotification) on a message-only window: locking Windows
// (Win+L, the lock after sleep), signing out and disconnecting end the remembered verification.
class SessionLockWatch {
public:
    SessionLockWatch() {
        m_thread = std::jthread([this] { Run(); });
    }
    // Either this sees the window, or the thread sees the flag right after creating it.
    ~SessionLockWatch() {
        m_stop = true;
        if (const HWND hwnd = m_hwnd.load()) PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
    }
    SessionLockWatch(const SessionLockWatch&) = delete;
    SessionLockWatch& operator=(const SessionLockWatch&) = delete;

private:
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
        switch (message) {
        case WM_WTSSESSION_CHANGE:
            if (wParam == WTS_SESSION_LOCK || wParam == WTS_SESSION_LOGOFF || wParam == WTS_CONSOLE_DISCONNECT ||
                wParam == WTS_REMOTE_DISCONNECT) {
                ++g_lockEpoch;
                Bt::Log("hello: Windows locked or left, a remembered verification is forgotten");
            }
            return 0;
        case WM_CLOSE:
            DestroyWindow(hwnd);
            return 0;
        case WM_DESTROY:
            WTSUnRegisterSessionNotification(hwnd);
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            return 0;
        default: return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
        }
    }

    void Run() {
        WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
        wc.lpfnWndProc = &SessionLockWatch::Proc;
        wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
        wc.lpszClassName = L"WSA-Next.HelloLockWatch";
        RegisterClassExW(&wc);  // registered already when the bridge runs again
        const HWND hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, wc.lpszClassName, L"", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, HWND_MESSAGE, nullptr, wc.hInstance, nullptr);
        if (!hwnd) return;
        if (!WTSRegisterSessionNotification(hwnd, NOTIFY_FOR_THIS_SESSION)) {
            Bt::Log("hello: no session notifications (error {}), Windows Hello is never remembered", GetLastError());
            DestroyWindow(hwnd);
            return;
        }
        m_hwnd = hwnd;
        if (m_stop) DestroyWindow(hwnd);  // the bridge stopped meanwhile: the loop ends at once
        else g_lockWatched = true;
        MSG msg;
        while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        g_lockWatched = false;
        ++g_lockEpoch;  // the bridge stops: nothing carries over to the next one
        m_hwnd = nullptr;
    }

    std::atomic<HWND> m_hwnd{nullptr};
    std::atomic<bool> m_stop{false};
    std::jthread m_thread;  // last: joined first, while the members above still exist
};

// A worker thread in the multithreaded apartment that WinRT needs.
template <class Work>
std::jthread StartMta(Work work) {
    return std::jthread([work](std::stop_token stop) {
        const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        work(stop);
        if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
    });
}

// One connection to the HAL: availability pushed on connecting and on every change, verification
// requests answered (one at a time, cancelable).
void RunSession(std::uintptr_t handle, std::stop_token) {
    const auto socket = static_cast<SOCKET>(handle);
    std::mutex sendLock;
    auto send = [&](Op op, Status status) {
        const FrameHeader frame{kMagic, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(op), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(status), 0};
        const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&frame);
        std::lock_guard guard(sendLock);
        for (std::size_t done = 0; done < sizeof frame;) {  // a stream may take fewer bytes per call
            const int n = ::send(socket, bytes + done, static_cast<int>(sizeof frame - done), 0);
            if (n <= 0) return;
            done += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
        }
    };

    const KernelHandle changed(CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, TRUE, nullptr));  // signaled: push the state at once
    const HelloChangeWatch watch(changed.get());
    std::jthread pusher = StartMta([&](std::stop_token stop) {
        const KernelHandle stopEvent(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr));
        const std::stop_callback onStop(stop, [event = stopEvent.get()] { SetEvent(event); });
        int last = -1;
        for (;;) {
            const HANDLE events[] = {stopEvent.get(), changed.get()};
            if (WaitForMultipleObjects(2, events, FALSE, INFINITE) == WAIT_OBJECT_0) return;
            const int now = CheckAvailability() == HelloStatus::Available ? 1 : 0;
            if (now == last) continue;
            last = now;
            Bt::Log("hello: Windows Hello {}", now ? "available" : "not available");
            send(Op::Availability, now ? Status::Ok : Status::NotAvailable);
        }
    });

    std::atomic<bool> verifying{false};
    std::stop_source cancel;
    std::jthread verifier;
    for (;;) {
        FrameHeader request{};
        if (!RecvExact(socket, &request, sizeof request)) break;
        if (request.magic != kMagic || request.payloadLen > kMaxPayload) {
            Bt::Log("hello: invalid frame (magic=0x{:08X}, len={}), dropping the connection", request.magic, request.payloadLen);
            break;
        }
        std::string payload(request.payloadLen, '\0');
        if (request.payloadLen > 0 && !RecvExact(socket, payload.data(), request.payloadLen)) break;

        switch (static_cast<Op>(request.op)) {
        case Op::Authenticate: {
            if (verifying.exchange(true)) {
                send(Op::Authenticate, Status::Busy);
                break;
            }
            if (verifier.joinable()) verifier.join();  // the previous verification has answered
            if (Remembered()) {
                Bt::Log("hello: verification requested, remembered (setting HelloRemember)");
                send(Op::Authenticate, Status::Verified);
                verifying = false;
                break;
            }
            cancel = std::stop_source();
            // The host's own text: what the guest sends is not shown in a trusted Windows dialog.
            const std::wstring prompt = Text::Get(IDS_HELLO_PROMPT);
            Bt::Log("hello: verification requested");
            verifier = StartMta([&, prompt, token = cancel.get_token()](std::stop_token) {
                const VerifyResult result = RequestVerification(prompt, token);
                Bt::Log("hello: verification -> {}", static_cast<int>(result));
                Remember(result);
                send(Op::Authenticate, MapVerify(result));
                verifying = false;
                SetEvent(changed.get());  // the dialog may have shown that Windows Hello is gone
            });
            break;
        }
        case Op::Cancel:
            cancel.request_stop();
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }
    }
    cancel.request_stop();  // the HAL is gone: close a dialog that is still open
}

}  // namespace

BridgeResult RunBridge(std::stop_token stop) {
    if (!IsElevated()) {
        Bt::Log("hello: administrator rights are required (Host Compute Service)");
        return BridgeResult::NotElevated;
    }
    const KernelHandle guard(CreateMutexW(nullptr, FALSE, L"Local\\WSA-Next.HelloBridge"));
    const DWORD error = GetLastError();
    if (!guard) {
        Bt::Log("hello: cannot create the instance mutex (error {})", error);
        return BridgeResult::Stopped;
    }
    if (error == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) return BridgeResult::Stopped;  // another instance serves Windows Hello
    Bt::Log("Windows Hello bridge ready (vsock port 0x{:08X})", kBridgePort);
    const SessionLockWatch lockWatch;
    Guest::Serve(kBridgePort, "Android fingerprint HAL", RunSession, stop);
    Bt::Log("Windows Hello bridge stopped");
    return BridgeResult::Stopped;
}

}  // namespace WN::Bio
```
