`src/biometrics/Protocol.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Wire protocol between the Windows Hello bridge (host) and Android's fingerprint HAL (guest)
// over a Hyper-V socket: the HAL listens on vsock port "WSFP", the bridge connects whenever WSA
// runs and keeps the connection.
//
// Every message is an 8-byte header followed by an optional UTF-8 payload (the prompt of a
// request). Must match android/device/wsa/wsa_x86_64/fingerprint/WsaFingerprint.cpp.
//   bridge -> HAL  Availability   on connecting and whenever Windows Hello becomes (un)available
//   HAL -> bridge  Authenticate   with the prompt; answered by an Authenticate message
//   HAL -> bridge  Cancel         closes the Windows Hello dialog; the answer is "Canceled"
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace WN::Bio {

inline constexpr std::uint32_t kBridgePort = 0x57534650;  // "WSFP"
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kMagic = 0x50465357;       // 'W','S','F','P' in little-endian
inline constexpr std::uint16_t kMaxPayload = 512;

enum class Op : std::uint8_t {
    // 1 and 2 (ping, enroll) belonged to the first, polling version.
    Authenticate = 3,
    Availability = 4,
    Cancel = 5,
};

enum class Status : std::uint8_t {
    Ok = 0,            // Availability: Windows Hello is ready
    Verified = 1,      // Authenticate: user verified by Windows Hello
    Canceled = 2,      // the dialog was dismissed or canceled
    NotAvailable = 3,  // Windows Hello not configured or no biometric/PIN device present
    Busy = 4,          // another verification is in progress
    Failed = 5,        // verification failed or protocol error
};

struct FrameHeader {
    std::uint32_t magic = kMagic;
    std::uint8_t op = 0;
    std::uint8_t status = 0;
    std::uint16_t payloadLen = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(FrameHeader) == 8);

}  // namespace WN::Bio

```

`src/biometrics/WindowsHello.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Windows Hello user verification through WinRT UserConsentVerifier.
#include "biometrics/WindowsHello.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <UserConsentVerifierInterop.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Foundation.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Security.Credentials.UI.h>
#include <memory>

#pragma comment(lib, "windowsapp.lib")

namespace WN::Bio {
using namespace winrt::Windows::Security::Credentials::UI;

HelloStatus CheckAvailability() {
    try {
        switch (UserConsentVerifier::CheckAvailabilityAsync().get()) {
        case UserConsentVerifierAvailability::Available: return HelloStatus::Available;
        case UserConsentVerifierAvailability::DeviceNotPresent: return HelloStatus::DeviceNotPresent;
        case UserConsentVerifierAvailability::NotConfiguredForUser: return HelloStatus::NotConfigured;
        case UserConsentVerifierAvailability::DisabledByPolicy: return HelloStatus::DisabledByPolicy;
        case UserConsentVerifierAvailability::DeviceBusy: return HelloStatus::DeviceBusy;
        default: return HelloStatus::Error;
        }
    } catch (...) {
        return HelloStatus::Error;
    }
}

std::wstring StatusText(HelloStatus status) {
    switch (status) {
    case HelloStatus::Available: return L"available (fingerprint / Windows Hello ready)";
    case HelloStatus::DeviceNotPresent: return L"no biometric / Windows Hello device present";
    case HelloStatus::NotConfigured: return L"not configured for this Windows user (set up Windows Hello PIN/fingerprint in Settings)";
    case HelloStatus::DisabledByPolicy: return L"disabled by Windows policy";
    case HelloStatus::DeviceBusy: return L"biometric device is busy";
    default: return L"unavailable (WinRT check failed)";
    }
}

namespace {

// A desktop process has no CoreWindow: Windows Hello wants a window to own its dialog
// (IUserConsentVerifierInterop). The background host has none either, so a small invisible
// top-level window serves as the owner, centred on the primary monitor.
class OwnerWindow {
public:
    OwnerWindow() {
        const int x = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) / 2, y = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN) / 2;
        m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_LAYERED, L"STATIC", L"WSA-Next", WS_POPUP, x, y, 1, 1,
                                 nullptr, nullptr, GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), nullptr);
        if (m_hwnd) {
            SetLayeredWindowAttributes(m_hwnd, 0, 0, LWA_ALPHA);  // fully transparent
            ShowWindow(m_hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
            SetForegroundWindow(m_hwnd);
        }
    }
    ~OwnerWindow() {
        if (m_hwnd) DestroyWindow(m_hwnd);
    }
    OwnerWindow(const OwnerWindow&) = delete;
    OwnerWindow& operator=(const OwnerWindow&) = delete;
    [[nodiscard]] HWND get() const { return m_hwnd; }

private:
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
};

// Waits for the dialog's answer; `cancel` closes the dialog (the answer is then "canceled").
UserConsentVerificationResult Verify(const winrt::hstring& prompt, std::stop_token cancel) {
    const OwnerWindow owner;
    winrt::Windows::Foundation::IAsyncOperation<UserConsentVerificationResult> operation;
    if (owner.get()) {
        const auto interop = winrt::get_activation_factory<UserConsentVerifier, IUserConsentVerifierInterop>();
        winrt::check_hresult(interop->RequestVerificationForWindowAsync(owner.get(), static_cast<HSTRING>(winrt::get_abi(prompt)),
                                                                         winrt::guid_of<decltype(operation)>(), winrt::put_abi(operation)));
    } else {
        operation = UserConsentVerifier::RequestVerificationAsync(prompt);
    }
    const std::stop_callback onCancel(cancel, [operation] { operation.Cancel(); });
    // The owner window lives on this thread: keep its messages flowing until Windows Hello answers.
    // The completion handler owns the event too, so it never signals a closed (or reused) handle.
    const auto done = std::make_shared<winrt::handle>(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr));
    if (!*done) winrt::throw_last_error();
    operation.Completed([done](auto&&, auto&&) { SetEvent(done->get()); });
    for (;;) {
        const HANDLE events[] = {done->get()};
        const DWORD wait = MsgWaitForMultipleObjects(1, events, FALSE, INFINITE, QS_ALLINPUT);
        if (wait == WAIT_OBJECT_0) break;
        if (wait == WAIT_FAILED) winrt::throw_last_error();
        MSG msg;
        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        }
    }
    if (operation.Status() == winrt::Windows::Foundation::AsyncStatus::Canceled) return UserConsentVerificationResult::Canceled;
    return operation.GetResults();
}

}  // namespace

VerifyResult RequestVerification(std::wstring_view message, std::stop_token cancel) {
    try {
        const winrt::hstring prompt = message.empty() ? winrt::hstring(L"Android (WSA-Next) requests Windows Hello verification")
                                                      : winrt::hstring(message);
        switch (Verify(prompt, cancel)) {
        case UserConsentVerificationResult::Verified: return VerifyResult::Verified;
        case UserConsentVerificationResult::Canceled: return VerifyResult::Canceled;
        case UserConsentVerificationResult::DeviceNotPresent:
        case UserConsentVerificationResult::NotConfiguredForUser:
        case UserConsentVerificationResult::DisabledByPolicy: return VerifyResult::NotAvailable;
        case UserConsentVerificationResult::DeviceBusy: return VerifyResult::Busy;
        default: return VerifyResult::Failed;
        }
    } catch (...) {
        return VerifyResult::Failed;
    }
}

}  // namespace WN::Bio
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Bluetooth bridge: Android's HCI HAL in WSA <-> Hyper-V socket <-> emulated controller <-> WinRT.
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include "bluetooth/Bridge.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "bluetooth/Controller.h"
#include "bluetooth/H4.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "bluetooth/Scanner.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/HostEvents.h"
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Bt {
namespace {

// Signaled while Android's HAL is connected (shown by the window, which hears of the change).
class ConnectedSignal {
public:
    ConnectedSignal() : m_event(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, kConnectedEvent)) {
        if (m_event) SetEvent(m_event);
        NotifyHostChanged();
    }
    ~ConnectedSignal() {
        if (m_event) {
            ResetEvent(m_event);
            CloseHandle(m_event);
        }
        NotifyHostChanged();
    }
    ConnectedSignal(const ConnectedSignal&) = delete;
    ConnectedSignal& operator=(const ConnectedSignal&) = delete;

private:
    HANDLE m_event;
};

// One connection of the Android HAL: H4 in, H4 out, until either side closes. Blocking reads;
// a stop request shuts the socket down (Guest::Serve), which ends them.
void RunSession(std::uintptr_t handle, std::uint64_t address, std::stop_token) {
    const ConnectedSignal connected;
    const auto socket = static_cast<SOCKET>(handle);
    std::mutex sendLock;
    auto send = [&](Hci::PacketType type, std::vector<std::uint8_t> packet) {
        const std::vector<std::uint8_t> frame = H4Frame(type, packet);
        std::lock_guard guard(sendLock);
        std::size_t done = 0;
        while (done < frame.size()) {
            const int n = ::send(socket, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(frame.data() + done), static_cast<int>(frame.size() - done), 0);
            if (n <= 0) return;
            done += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
        }
    };
    Controller controller(send, address);
    H4Reader reader([&](Hci::PacketType type, std::span<const std::uint8_t> packet) {
        switch (type) {
        case Hci::PacketType::Command: controller.OnCommand(packet); break;
        case Hci::PacketType::Acl: controller.OnAcl(packet); break;
        default: Log("hci: packet type {} ignored ({} bytes)", static_cast<int>(type), packet.size()); break;
        }
    });
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buffer(64 * 1024);
    for (;;) {
        const int n = recv(socket, reinterpret_cast<char*>(buffer.data()), static_cast<int>(buffer.size()), 0);
        if (n <= 0) break;
        if (!reader.Feed(std::span<const std::uint8_t>(buffer.data(), static_cast<std::size_t>(n)))) {
            Log("hci: broken H4 framing, dropping the connection");
            break;
        }
    }
}

}  // namespace

bool AndroidConnected() {
    const HANDLE event = OpenEventW(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, kConnectedEvent);
    if (!event) return false;
    const bool connected = WaitForSingleObject(event, 0) == WAIT_OBJECT_0;
    CloseHandle(event);
    return connected;
}

BridgeResult RunBridge(std::stop_token stop) {
    Log("Bluetooth bridge {}", kBridgeVersion);
    if (!IsElevated()) {
        Log("administrator rights are required (Host Compute Service, Hyper-V socket registration)");
        return BridgeResult::NotElevated;
    }
    const std::uint64_t address = Scanner::AdapterAddress();
    if (!address) {
        Log("no Bluetooth adapter is available in Windows");
        return BridgeResult::NoAdapter;
    }
    Log("adapter {:012X}", address);
    Guest::Serve(kBridgePort, "Android Bluetooth stack", [address](std::uintptr_t socket, std::stop_token s) { RunSession(socket, address, s); },
                 stop);
    Log("bridge stopped");
    return BridgeResult::Stopped;
}

}  // namespace WN::Bt
```

`src/bluetooth/Bytes.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Little-endian byte building and reading for HCI packets.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Bt {

class Bytes {
public:
    Bytes& u8(std::uint8_t v) { m_data.push_back(v); return *this; }
    Bytes& u16(std::uint16_t v) { return u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v)).u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 8)); }
    // The low `count` bytes of v (addresses are 6 bytes, feature masks 8).
    Bytes& le(std::uint64_t v, int count) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> (8 * i)));
        return *this;
    }
    Bytes& raw(std::span<const std::uint8_t> data) { m_data.insert(m_data.end(), data.begin(), data.end()); return *this; }
    Bytes& zeros(std::size_t count) { m_data.insert(m_data.end(), count, 0); return *this; }

    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data() const { return m_data; }
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::uint8_t> take() { return std::move(m_data); }
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t size() const { return m_data.size(); }

private:
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_data;
};

// Bounds-checked reader over a received packet's parameters.
class Reader {
public:
    explicit Reader(std::span<const std::uint8_t> data) : m_data(data) {}
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint8_t u8() { Need(1); return m_data[m_pos++]; }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint16_t u16() { Need(2); const auto v = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_data[m_pos] | (m_data[m_pos + 1] << 8)); m_pos += 2; return v; }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t le(int count) {
        Need(static_cast<std::size_t>(count));
        std::uint64_t v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) v |= static_cast<std::uint64_t>(m_data[m_pos + i]) << (8 * i);
        m_pos += static_cast<std::size_t>(count);
        return v;
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes(std::size_t count) { Need(count); auto s = m_data.subspan(m_pos, count); m_pos += count; return s; }
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t left() const { return m_data.size() - m_pos; }

private:
    void Need(std::size_t count) const {
        if (m_data.size() - m_pos < count) throw std::out_of_range("HCI packet too short");
    }
    std::span<const std::uint8_t> m_data;
    std::size_t m_pos = 0;
};

}  // namespace WN::Bt

```

`src/bluetooth/Controller.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "bluetooth/Controller.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "bluetooth/Bytes.h"
#include "bluetooth/Crypto.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <thread>


namespace WN::Bt {
namespace {

// Identity: a dual-mode Bluetooth 4.2 controller. LMP feature page 0 is the one of a real 4.2
// dual-mode controller as recorded in RootCanal's CSR_RCK_PTS_DONGLE preset (Apache 2.0); LE
// features: encryption, connection parameters request, extended reject, peripheral-initiated
// feature exchange, LE ping (no extended advertising: legacy scanning and reports).
constexpr std::uint8_t kHciVersion = 0x08;  // 4.2
constexpr std::uint16_t kHciRevision = 0x0001;
constexpr std::uint8_t kLmpVersion = 0x08;
constexpr std::uint16_t kCompany = 0xFFFF;  // "for internal use": not a real chip vendor
constexpr std::uint16_t kLmpSubversion = 0x0001;
constexpr std::uint64_t kLmpFeaturesPage0 = 0x875b1fd87e8fffffULL;
constexpr std::uint64_t kLmpFeaturesPage2 = 0x0300;  // secure connections (controller), ping
constexpr std::uint64_t kLeFeatures = 0x1F;
constexpr std::uint64_t kLeSupportedStates = 0x3ffffffffffULL;
constexpr std::uint16_t kAclLength = 1021, kAclCount = 8;
constexpr std::uint8_t kScoLength = 64;
constexpr std::uint16_t kScoCount = 8;
constexpr std::uint16_t kLeAclLength = 251;
constexpr std::uint8_t kLeAclCount = 8;
constexpr std::uint8_t kAcceptListSize = 16;

constexpr std::uint16_t kInquiry = 0x0401, kInquiryCancel = 0x0402;
constexpr std::uint16_t kLeCreateConnection = 0x200D, kDisconnect = 0x0406, kLeReadRemoteFeatures = 0x2016, kReadRemoteVersion = 0x041D,
                        kLeConnectionUpdate = 0x2013, kLeStartEncryption = 0x2019;
constexpr std::uint8_t kEvtEncryptionChange = 0x08;
constexpr std::uint16_t kRemoteNameRequest = 0x0419, kRemoteNameRequestCancel = 0x041A;
constexpr std::uint8_t kEvtRemoteNameRequestComplete = 0x07, kPageTimeout = 0x04;

// The device name in advertising data (Complete or Shortened Local Name), empty when absent.
std::string AdvertisedName(std::span<const std::uint8_t> data) {
    std::string shortened;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < data.size();) {
        const std::size_t length = data[i];
        if (length == 0 || i + 1 + length > data.size()) break;
        const std::uint8_t type = data[i + 1];
        const auto value = data.subspan(i + 2, length - 1);
        if (type == 0x09) return {value.begin(), value.end()};
        if (type == 0x08) shortened.assign(value.begin(), value.end());
        i += 1 + length;
    }
    return shortened;
}

// Events and status codes of connections.
constexpr std::uint8_t kEvtDisconnectionComplete = 0x05, kEvtReadRemoteVersionComplete = 0x0C, kEvtNumberOfCompletedPackets = 0x13;
constexpr std::uint8_t kLeConnectionComplete = 0x01, kLeConnectionUpdateComplete = 0x03, kLeReadRemoteFeaturesComplete = 0x04;
constexpr std::uint8_t kUnknownConnection = 0x02, kHardwareFailure = 0x03, kLocalHostTerminated = 0x16, kConnectionTimeout = 0x08;

// Commands answered with Command Status (the result follows as its own event).
bool ExpectsStatus(std::uint16_t opcode) {
    const std::uint16_t ogf = opcode >> 10;
    if (ogf == 0x01) {  // link control: all but the "cancel" and "reply" commands
        static constexpr std::uint16_t kComplete[] = {0x0402, 0x0404, 0x0408, 0x040B, 0x040C, 0x040D, 0x040E, 0x0412,
                                                      0x041A, 0x041B, 0x042B, 0x042C, 0x042D, 0x042E, 0x0434, 0x0443};
        return std::ranges::find(kComplete, opcode) == std::end(kComplete);
    }
    static constexpr std::uint16_t kLeStatus[] = {0x200D, 0x2013, 0x2016, 0x2019, 0x2025, 0x2026, 0x2032, 0x2043, 0x2044};
    return std::ranges::find(kLeStatus, opcode) != std::end(kLeStatus);
}


// A command handler's way to fail with a specific HCI status.
struct HciStatus {
    std::uint8_t code;
};

}  // namespace

Controller::Controller(SendFn send, std::uint64_t address)
    : m_send(std::move(send)), m_address(address), m_scanner([this](const Advertisement& a) { OnAdvertisement(a); }) {
    BuildCommandTable();
}

Controller::~Controller() {
    m_scanner.Stop();
    m_inquiry.request_stop();
    CancelConnect();
    if (m_connector.joinable()) m_connector.join();
    std::map<std::uint16_t, Link> links;
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
        links.swap(m_links);
    }
    for (auto& [handle, link] : links) link.link->Close();  // the host is gone: release the devices
    // Links closing on their own threads may still call back: wait until they are closed.
    std::unique_lock guard(m_retiringLock);
    m_retired.wait(guard, [this] { return m_retiring == 0; });
}

void Controller::CancelConnect() {
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_connectLock);
        m_connectCancel = true;
    }
    m_connectChanged.notify_all();
}

void Controller::BuildCommandTable() {
    const Handler ok = &Controller::Ok;
    struct Row {
        std::uint16_t opcode;
        Handler handler;
    };
    const Row rows[] = {
        // Link policy
        {0x080E, &Controller::ReadDefaultLinkPolicy},
        {0x080F, ok},  // write default link policy settings
        // Controller and baseband
        {0x0C01, ok},  // set event mask
        {0x0C03, &Controller::Reset},
        {0x0C05, ok},  // set event filter
        {0x0C13, &Controller::WriteLocalName},
        {0x0C14, &Controller::ReadLocalName},
        {0x0C16, ok},  // write connection accept timeout
        {0x0C18, ok},  // write page timeout
        {0x0C19, &Controller::ReadScanEnable},
        {0x0C1A, ok},  // write scan enable
        {0x0C1C, ok},  // write page scan activity
        {0x0C1E, ok},  // write inquiry scan activity
        {0x0C23, &Controller::ReadClassOfDevice},
        {0x0C24, ok},  // write class of device
        {0x0C25, &Controller::ReadVoiceSetting},
        {0x0C26, ok},  // write voice setting
        {0x0C33, ok},  // host buffer size
        {0x0C38, &Controller::ReadNumberOfSupportedIac},
        {0x0C39, &Controller::ReadCurrentIacLap},
        {0x0C3A, ok},  // write current IAC LAP
        {0x0C43, ok},  // write inquiry scan type
        {0x0C45, ok},  // write inquiry mode
        {0x0C47, ok},  // write page scan type
        {0x0C52, ok},  // write extended inquiry response
        {0x0C56, ok},  // write simple pairing mode
        {0x0C58, &Controller::ReadInquiryResponseTxPower},
        {0x0C63, ok},  // set event mask page 2
        {0x0C6C, &Controller::ReadLeHostSupport},
        {0x0C6D, ok},  // write LE host support
        {0x0C7A, ok},  // write secure connections host support
        // Informational
        {0x1001, &Controller::ReadLocalVersion},
        {0x1002, &Controller::ReadLocalCommands},
        {0x1003, &Controller::ReadLocalFeatures},
        {0x1004, &Controller::ReadLocalExtendedFeatures},
        {0x1005, &Controller::ReadBufferSize},
        {0x1009, &Controller::ReadBdAddr},
        // LE
        {0x2001, ok},  // LE set event mask
        {0x2002, &Controller::LeReadBufferSize},
        {0x2003, &Controller::LeReadLocalFeatures},
        {0x2005, &Controller::LeSetRandomAddress},
        {0x2006, ok},  // LE set advertising parameters
        {0x2007, &Controller::LeReadAdvertisingTxPower},
        {0x2008, ok},  // LE set advertising data
        {0x2009, ok},  // LE set scan response data
        {0x200A, ok},  // LE set advertising enable
        {0x200B, &Controller::LeSetScanParameters},
        {0x200C, &Controller::LeSetScanEnable},
        {0x200F, &Controller::LeReadAcceptListSize},
        {0x2010, ok},  // LE clear filter accept list
        {0x2011, ok},  // LE add device to filter accept list
        {0x2012, ok},  // LE remove device from filter accept list
        {0x2017, &Controller::LeEncrypt},
        {0x2018, &Controller::LeRand},
        {0x201C, &Controller::LeReadSupportedStates},
        {0x200E, &Controller::LeCreateConnectionCancel},
        {0x1405, &Controller::ReadRssi},
    };
    auto mark = [this](std::uint16_t opcode) {
        if (const Hci::OpcodeInfo* info = Hci::FindOpcode(opcode)) m_supportedCommands[info->octet] |= static_cast<std::uint8_t>(1u << info->bit);
    };
    for (const Row& row : rows) {
        m_commands.emplace(row.opcode, Entry{row.handler});
        mark(row.opcode);
    }
    mark(kInquiry);
    mark(kInquiryCancel);
    for (std::uint16_t opcode : {kLeCreateConnection, kDisconnect, kLeReadRemoteFeatures, kReadRemoteVersion, kLeConnectionUpdate, kLeStartEncryption,
                                 kRemoteNameRequest, kRemoteNameRequestCancel})
        mark(opcode);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Packets from the host
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

void Controller::OnCommand(std::span<const std::uint8_t> packet) {
    if (packet.size() < 3) return;
    const auto opcode = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(packet[0] | (packet[1] << 8));
    const auto params = packet.subspan(3, std::min<std::size_t>(packet[2], packet.size() - 3));

    if (opcode == kInquiry) {  // classic discovery: nothing to find yet, end it after its length
        const std::uint8_t length = params.size() >= 4 ? params[3] : 1;
        Bytes status;
        status.u8(Hci::kEvtCommandStatus).u8(4).u8(Hci::kSuccess).u8(1).u16(opcode);
        m_send(Hci::PacketType::Event, status.take());
        const auto duration = std::chrono::milliseconds(std::min<int>(length * 1280, 10240));
        if (m_inquiry.joinable()) {  // a new inquiry replaces one still running
            m_inquiry.request_stop();
            m_inquiry.join();
        }
        m_inquiry = std::jthread([this, duration](std::stop_token stop) {
            // The inquiry length is the protocol's own timeout; a cancellation ends the wait at once.
            std::mutex lock;
            std::condition_variable_any nothing;
            std::unique_lock guard(lock);
            (void)nothing.wait_for(guard, stop, duration, [] { return false; });
            if (stop.stop_requested()) return;
            Bytes complete;
            complete.u8(Hci::kEvtInquiryComplete).u8(1).u8(Hci::kSuccess);
            m_send(Hci::PacketType::Event, complete.take());
        });
        return;
    }
    if (opcode == kInquiryCancel) {
        m_inquiry.request_stop();
        if (m_inquiry.joinable()) m_inquiry.join();
        CommandComplete(opcode, Hci::kSuccess, {});
        return;
    }

    try {
        if (OnConnectionCommand(opcode, params)) return;
    } catch (const std::out_of_range&) {
        CommandStatus(opcode, Hci::kInvalidParameters);
        return;
    }

    const auto it = m_commands.find(opcode);
    if (it == m_commands.end()) {
        Log("hci: unsupported command 0x{:04X} {} params {}", opcode, Hci::OpcodeName(opcode), Hex(params.data(), params.size()));
        if (ExpectsStatus(opcode)) {
            Bytes status;
            status.u8(Hci::kEvtCommandStatus).u8(4).u8(Hci::kUnknownCommand).u8(1).u16(opcode);
            m_send(Hci::PacketType::Event, status.take());
        } else {
            CommandComplete(opcode, Hci::kUnknownCommand, {});
        }
        return;
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> result;
    std::uint8_t status = Hci::kSuccess;
    try {
        result = (this->*(it->second.handler))(params);
    } catch (const std::out_of_range&) {
        status = Hci::kInvalidParameters;
        result.clear();
    } catch (const HciStatus& error) {
        status = error.code;
        result.clear();
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        Log("hci: command 0x{:04X} failed: {}", opcode, e.what());
        status = kHardwareFailure;
        result.clear();
    }
    CommandComplete(opcode, status, result);
}

void Controller::OnAcl(std::span<const std::uint8_t> packet) {
    const std::uint16_t handle = AclHandle(packet);
    if (handle == 0xFFFF) return;
    // The packet is "transmitted" at once: give the host its buffer credit back.
    Event(kEvtNumberOfCompletedPackets, Bytes().u8(1).u16(handle).u16(1).data());
    std::optional<L2capFrame> frame;
    LeLink* link = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
        const auto it = m_links.find(handle);
        if (it == m_links.end()) return;
        frame = it->second.reassembler.Feed(packet);
        link = it->second.link.get();
        if (frame) link->OnFrame(frame->cid, std::move(frame->payload));
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Connections
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool Controller::OnConnectionCommand(std::uint16_t opcode, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    switch (opcode) {
    case kLeCreateConnection: LeCreateConnection(params); return true;
    case kDisconnect: Disconnect(params); return true;
    case kLeReadRemoteFeatures: {
        Reader r(params);
        const std::uint16_t handle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(r.u16() & 0x0FFF);  // 12-bit connection handle
        if (!HasLink(handle)) {
            CommandStatus(opcode, kUnknownConnection);
            return true;
        }
        CommandStatus(opcode, Hci::kSuccess);
        LeMeta(kLeReadRemoteFeaturesComplete, Bytes().u8(Hci::kSuccess).u16(handle).le(kLeFeatures, 8).data());
        return true;
    }
    case kReadRemoteVersion: {
        Reader r(params);
        const std::uint16_t handle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(r.u16() & 0x0FFF);  // 12-bit connection handle
        if (!HasLink(handle)) {
            CommandStatus(opcode, kUnknownConnection);
            return true;
        }
        CommandStatus(opcode, Hci::kSuccess);
        Event(kEvtReadRemoteVersionComplete, Bytes().u8(Hci::kSuccess).u16(handle).u8(kLmpVersion).u16(kCompany).u16(0).data());
        return true;
    }
    case kRemoteNameRequest: {
        // Answered from what the devices advertise (no classic paging through Windows).
        Reader r(params);
        const std::uint64_t peer = r.le(6);
        std::string name;
        {
            std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
            if (const auto it = m_names.find(peer); it != m_names.end()) name = it->second;
        }
        CommandStatus(opcode, Hci::kSuccess);
        Bytes complete;
        complete.u8(name.empty() ? kPageTimeout : Hci::kSuccess).le(peer, 6);
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> field(248, 0);
        std::copy_n(name.begin(), std::min<std::size_t>(name.size(), 247), field.begin());
        complete.raw(field);
        Event(kEvtRemoteNameRequestComplete, complete.data());
        return true;
    }
    case kRemoteNameRequestCancel: {
        Reader r(params);
        const std::uint64_t peer = r.le(6);
        CommandComplete(opcode, Hci::kSuccess, Bytes().le(peer, 6).data());
        return true;
    }
    case kLeStartEncryption: {
        // Android encrypts with the key of its bond (or the pairing's STK). The radio link is
        // Windows' and is encrypted by Windows when the device needs it: report success.
        Reader r(params);
        const std::uint16_t handle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(r.u16() & 0x0FFF);  // 12-bit connection handle
        LeLink* link = nullptr;
        {
            std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
            if (const auto it = m_links.find(handle); it != m_links.end()) link = it->second.link.get();
            if (!link) {
                CommandStatus(opcode, kUnknownConnection);
                return true;
            }
            CommandStatus(opcode, Hci::kSuccess);
            Event(kEvtEncryptionChange, Bytes().u8(Hci::kSuccess).u16(handle).u8(0x01).data());
            link->OnEncrypted();
        }
        return true;
    }
    case kLeConnectionUpdate: {
        // Windows chooses the connection parameters with the device; report the request as done.
        Reader r(params);
        const std::uint16_t handle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(r.u16() & 0x0FFF), minInterval = r.u16(), maxInterval = r.u16(), latency = r.u16(), timeout = r.u16();
        (void)minInterval;
        if (!HasLink(handle)) {
            CommandStatus(opcode, kUnknownConnection);
            return true;
        }
        CommandStatus(opcode, Hci::kSuccess);
        LeMeta(kLeConnectionUpdateComplete, Bytes().u8(Hci::kSuccess).u16(handle).u16(maxInterval).u16(latency).u16(timeout).data());
        return true;
    }
    default: return false;
    }
}

void Controller::LeCreateConnection(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    (void)r.u16();  // scan interval
    (void)r.u16();  // scan window
    const std::uint8_t filterPolicy = r.u8();
    const std::uint8_t peerType = r.u8();
    const std::uint64_t peer = r.le(6);
    const std::uint8_t ownType = r.u8();  // 0 public, 1 random (2/3: controller-generated RPAs, not offered)
    const std::uint16_t interval = r.u16();
    (void)r.u16();  // maximum interval
    const std::uint16_t latency = r.u16(), timeout = r.u16();

    if (m_connecting.exchange(true)) {
        CommandStatus(kLeCreateConnection, Hci::kCommandDisallowed);
        return;
    }
    m_connectCancel = false;
    CommandStatus(kLeCreateConnection, Hci::kSuccess);
    const bool acceptList = filterPolicy != 0;
    if (m_connector.joinable()) m_connector.join();  // the previous attempt has reported already
    const unsigned generation = m_generation;
    m_connector = std::jthread([this, generation, acceptList, ownType, peerType, peer, interval, latency, timeout](std::stop_token) {
        std::uint8_t status = kUnknownConnection;
        std::unique_ptr<LeLink> link;
        std::uint16_t handle = 0;
        if (acceptList) {
            // Background connections to bonded devices come with pairing; until then the request
            // waits for its cancellation.
            std::unique_lock guard(m_connectLock);
            m_connectChanged.wait(guard, [this] { return m_connectCancel.load(); });
        } else {
            {
                std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
                handle = m_nextHandle;
                m_nextHandle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_nextHandle >= 0x0EFF ? 0x0040 : m_nextHandle + 1);
            }
            Log("le: connecting to {:012X}", peer);
            auto send = [this, handle](std::uint16_t cid, std::vector<std::uint8_t> payload) {
                for (auto& packet : AclPackets(handle, cid, payload, kLeAclLength)) m_send(Hci::PacketType::Acl, std::move(packet));
            };
            const LinkAddresses addresses{.own = (ownType & 0x01) ? m_randomAddress.load() : m_address,
                                          .ownRandom = (ownType & 0x01) != 0,
                                          .peer = peer,
                                          .peerRandom = (peerType & 0x01) != 0};
            link = LeLink::Connect(addresses, send, [this, handle](std::uint8_t reason) { OnLinkClosed(handle, reason); }, status);
            if (link && m_connectCancel) {
                DestroyLater(std::move(link));
                status = kUnknownConnection;
            }
        }
        if (generation != m_generation) {  // a reset came in between: nobody waits for this
            if (link) DestroyLater(std::move(link));
            m_connecting = false;
            return;
        }
        Bytes complete;
        complete.u8(status).u16(link ? handle : 0).u8(0x00 /* central */).u8(peerType & 0x01).le(peer, 6);
        complete.u16(link ? interval : 0).u16(link ? latency : 0).u16(link ? timeout : 0).u8(0x00);
        std::unique_ptr<LeLink> lost;  // the device left before the link was listed
        if (link) {
            std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
            if (link->Closed()) {
                // Its OnLinkClosed found no handle; under the lock a later one finds it listed.
                lost = std::move(link);
            } else {
                m_links[handle] = Link{std::move(link), {}, peer};
            }
            Log("le: connected to {:012X} as handle 0x{:04X}", peer, handle);
        } else {
            Log("le: connection to {:012X} not established (status 0x{:02X})", peer, status);
        }
        LeMeta(kLeConnectionComplete, complete.data());
        if (lost) {
            DestroyLater(std::move(lost));
            Event(kEvtDisconnectionComplete, Bytes().u8(Hci::kSuccess).u16(handle).u8(kConnectionTimeout).data());
        }
        m_connecting = false;
    });
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeCreateConnectionCancel(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    if (!m_connecting) throw HciStatus{Hci::kCommandDisallowed};
    CancelConnect();
    return {};
}

void Controller::Disconnect(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    const std::uint16_t handle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(r.u16() & 0x0FFF);
    std::unique_ptr<LeLink> link;
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
        if (const auto it = m_links.find(handle); it != m_links.end()) {
            link = std::move(it->second.link);
            m_links.erase(it);
        }
    }
    if (!link) {
        CommandStatus(kDisconnect, kUnknownConnection);
        return;
    }
    CommandStatus(kDisconnect, Hci::kSuccess);
    Log("le: disconnecting handle 0x{:04X}", handle);
    DestroyLater(std::move(link));
    Event(kEvtDisconnectionComplete, Bytes().u8(Hci::kSuccess).u16(handle).u8(kLocalHostTerminated).data());
}

void Controller::OnLinkClosed(std::uint16_t handle, std::uint8_t reason) {
    std::unique_ptr<LeLink> link;
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
        if (const auto it = m_links.find(handle); it != m_links.end()) {
            link = std::move(it->second.link);
            m_links.erase(it);
        }
    }
    if (!link) return;  // the host disconnected first
    DestroyLater(std::move(link));
    Event(kEvtDisconnectionComplete, Bytes().u8(Hci::kSuccess).u16(handle).u8(reason).data());
}

// Closing a link waits for its thread and WinRT; never do that on the HCI or a WinRT thread.
void Controller::DestroyLater(std::unique_ptr<LeLink> link) {
    if (!link) return;
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_retiringLock);
        ++m_retiring;
    }
    std::thread([this, link = std::move(link)]() mutable {
        link.reset();  // after this the link never calls back
        // Notified under the lock: the destructor cannot return (and free the lock) before.
        std::lock_guard guard(m_retiringLock);
        if (--m_retiring == 0) m_retired.notify_all();
    }).detach();
}

bool Controller::HasLink(std::uint16_t handle) {
    std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
    return m_links.contains(handle & 0x0FFF);
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadRssi(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    const std::uint16_t handle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(r.u16() & 0x0FFF);  // 12-bit connection handle
    std::uint64_t address = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
        const auto it = m_links.find(handle);
        if (it == m_links.end()) throw HciStatus{kUnknownConnection};
        address = it->second.address;
    }
    std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
    const auto rssi = m_lastRssi.find(address);
    return Bytes().u16(handle).u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(rssi != m_lastRssi.end() ? rssi->second : -60)).take();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Events to the host
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

void Controller::CommandComplete(std::uint16_t opcode, std::uint8_t status, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    // Unsuccessful commands return only the status; "unknown command" has nothing else to say.
    const bool withParams = status == Hci::kSuccess;
    Bytes event;
    event.u8(Hci::kEvtCommandComplete).u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(4 + (withParams ? params.size() : 0)));
    event.u8(1).u16(opcode).u8(status);
    if (withParams) event.raw(params);
    m_send(Hci::PacketType::Event, event.take());
}

void Controller::CommandStatus(std::uint16_t opcode, std::uint8_t status) {
    Bytes event;
    event.u8(Hci::kEvtCommandStatus).u8(4).u8(status).u8(1).u16(opcode);
    m_send(Hci::PacketType::Event, event.take());
}

void Controller::Event(std::uint8_t code, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Bytes event;
    event.u8(code).u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(params.size())).raw(params);
    m_send(Hci::PacketType::Event, event.take());
}

void Controller::LeMeta(std::uint8_t subevent, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Bytes event;
    event.u8(Hci::kEvtLeMeta).u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(1 + params.size())).u8(subevent).raw(params);
    m_send(Hci::PacketType::Event, event.take());
}

void Controller::OnAdvertisement(const Advertisement& report) {
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
        m_lastRssi[report.address] = report.rssi;
        if (std::string name = AdvertisedName(report.data); !name.empty()) m_names[report.address] = std::move(name);
        if (!m_scanning) return;
        if (!m_activeScan && report.eventType == Hci::kScanRsp) return;
        if (m_filterDuplicates) {
            auto& last = m_reported[{report.address, report.eventType}];
            if (last == report.data && !last.empty()) return;
            last = report.data;
        }
    }
    Bytes params;
    params.u8(1)  // one report
        .u8(report.eventType)
        .u8(report.randomAddress ? 0x01 : 0x00)
        .le(report.address, 6)
        .u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(report.data.size()))
        .raw(report.data)
        .u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(report.rssi));
    LeMeta(Hci::kLeAdvertisingReport, params.data());
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Command handlers: the Command Complete parameters after the status
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::Ok(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return {}; }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::Reset(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    m_scanner.Stop();
    m_inquiry.request_stop();
    // Connections end with a reset (the HAL sends one when Bluetooth is turned off); a connection
    // attempt in progress is dropped without an event (its generation is gone).
    ++m_generation;
    CancelConnect();
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_linksLock);
        for (auto& entry : m_links) DestroyLater(std::move(entry.second.link));
        m_links.clear();
    }
    std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
    m_scanning = false;
    m_filterDuplicates = false;
    m_activeScan = true;
    m_reported.clear();
    Log("hci: reset");
    return {};
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadLocalName(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> name(248, 0);
    std::copy_n(m_localName.begin(), std::min<std::size_t>(m_localName.size(), 247), name.begin());
    return name;
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::WriteLocalName(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    const auto bytes = r.bytes(std::min<std::size_t>(248, params.size()));
    std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
    m_localName.assign(bytes.begin(), std::ranges::find(bytes, std::uint8_t{0}));
    Log("hci: local name \"{}\"", m_localName);
    return {};
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadScanEnable(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return {0x00}; }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadClassOfDevice(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    return Bytes().le(0x0C010C, 3).take();  // computer, laptop
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadVoiceSetting(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return Bytes().u16(0x0060).take(); }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadNumberOfSupportedIac(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return {0x01}; }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadCurrentIacLap(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    return Bytes().u8(1).le(0x9E8B33, 3).take();  // general inquiry access code
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadInquiryResponseTxPower(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return {0x00}; }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadLeHostSupport(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return {0x01, 0x00}; }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadDefaultLinkPolicy(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return Bytes().u16(0x0005).take(); }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadLocalVersion(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    return Bytes().u8(kHciVersion).u16(kHciRevision).u8(kLmpVersion).u16(kCompany).u16(kLmpSubversion).take();
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadLocalCommands(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    return {m_supportedCommands.begin(), m_supportedCommands.end()};
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadLocalFeatures(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return Bytes().le(kLmpFeaturesPage0, 8).take(); }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadLocalExtendedFeatures(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    const std::uint8_t page = r.u8();
    // Page 1 holds the host's features (the host sets them through its own commands).
    const std::uint64_t features = page == 0 ? kLmpFeaturesPage0 : page == 1 ? 0x0F : page == 2 ? kLmpFeaturesPage2 : 0;
    return Bytes().u8(page).u8(2).le(features, 8).take();
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadBufferSize(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    return Bytes().u16(kAclLength).u8(kScoLength).u16(kAclCount).u16(kScoCount).take();
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::ReadBdAddr(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return Bytes().le(m_address, 6).take(); }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeReadBufferSize(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    return Bytes().u16(kLeAclLength).u8(kLeAclCount).take();
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeReadLocalFeatures(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return Bytes().le(kLeFeatures, 8).take(); }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeReadAdvertisingTxPower(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return {0x00}; }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeSetScanParameters(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    const std::uint8_t type = r.u8();
    std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
    m_activeScan = type == 0x01;
    return {};
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeSetScanEnable(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    const bool enable = r.u8() != 0;
    const bool filter = r.u8() != 0;
    bool active = true;
    {
        std::lock_guard guard(m_lock);
        m_scanning = enable;
        m_filterDuplicates = filter;
        m_reported.clear();
        active = m_activeScan;
    }
    if (enable) m_scanner.Start(active);
    else m_scanner.Stop();
    return {};
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeReadAcceptListSize(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) { return {kAcceptListSize}; }

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeEncrypt(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    Block key, plaintext;
    std::ranges::copy(r.bytes(16), key.begin());
    std::ranges::copy(r.bytes(16), plaintext.begin());
    const Block result = SecurityE(key, plaintext);
    return {result.begin(), result.end()};
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeRand(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> random(8);
    RandomBytes(random);
    return random;
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeSetRandomAddress(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params) {
    Reader r(params);
    m_randomAddress = r.le(6);
    return {};
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Controller::LeReadSupportedStates(std::span<const std::uint8_t>) {
    return Bytes().le(kLeSupportedStates, 8).take();
}
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// A Bluetooth controller as Android's stack sees it, backed by Windows.
//
// It answers HCI commands the way a dual-mode Bluetooth 4.2 controller does (identity: the PC's
// adapter address) and turns WinRT results into HCI events: LE scanning becomes LE Advertising
// Reports; LE Create Connection opens a WinRT connection (LeLink) whose L2CAP traffic - ATT for
// GATT - travels as ACL data. Commands it does not implement are not in its Read Local Supported
// Commands mask and are answered with "Unknown HCI Command".
//
// Thread safety: OnCommand runs on the connection thread, OnAdvertisement on WinRT threads; the
// state is guarded by one mutex and every packet to the host goes through the send function.
#pragma once
#include "bluetooth/Hci.h"
#include "bluetooth/L2cap.h"
#include "bluetooth/LeLink.h"
#include "bluetooth/Scanner.h"
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <memory>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Bt {

class Controller {
public:
    using SendFn = std::function<void(Hci::PacketType, std::vector<std::uint8_t>)>;
    Controller(SendFn send, std::uint64_t address);
    ~Controller();
    Controller(const Controller&) = delete;
    Controller& operator=(const Controller&) = delete;

    void OnCommand(std::span<const std::uint8_t> packet);
    void OnAcl(std::span<const std::uint8_t> packet);

private:
    using Handler = std::vector<std::uint8_t> (Controller::*)(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params);
    struct Entry {
        Handler handler;  // returns the Command Complete parameters after the status byte
    };

    void BuildCommandTable();
    void CommandComplete(std::uint16_t opcode, std::uint8_t status, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params);
    void CommandStatus(std::uint16_t opcode, std::uint8_t status);
    void Event(std::uint8_t code, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params);
    void LeMeta(std::uint8_t subevent, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params);
    void OnAdvertisement(const Advertisement& report);

    // Connections (commands answered with Command Status, results as their own events).
    bool OnConnectionCommand(std::uint16_t opcode, std::span<const std::uint8_t> params);
    void LeCreateConnection(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params);
    void Disconnect(std::span<const std::uint8_t> params);
    void OnLinkClosed(std::uint16_t handle, std::uint8_t reason);
    void DestroyLater(std::unique_ptr<LeLink> link);
    void CancelConnect();
    [[nodiscard]] bool HasLink(std::uint16_t handle);

    // Command handlers (std::nullopt-free: an empty vector means "status only").
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> Ok(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> Reset(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadLocalName(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> WriteLocalName(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadScanEnable(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadClassOfDevice(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadVoiceSetting(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadNumberOfSupportedIac(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadCurrentIacLap(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadInquiryResponseTxPower(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadLeHostSupport(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadDefaultLinkPolicy(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadLocalVersion(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadLocalCommands(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadLocalFeatures(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadLocalExtendedFeatures(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadBufferSize(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadBdAddr(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeReadBufferSize(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeReadLocalFeatures(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeReadAdvertisingTxPower(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeSetScanParameters(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeSetScanEnable(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeReadAcceptListSize(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeEncrypt(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeRand(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeReadSupportedStates(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeCreateConnectionCancel(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadRssi(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> LeSetRandomAddress(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);

    SendFn m_send;
    std::uint64_t m_address;
    std::map<std::uint16_t, Entry> m_commands;
    std::array<std::uint8_t, 64> m_supportedCommands{};

    std::mutex m_lock;
    std::string m_localName = "Android";
    bool m_activeScan = true;
    bool m_scanning = false;
    bool m_filterDuplicates = false;
    std::map<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::uint8_t>, std::vector<std::uint8_t>> m_reported;  // duplicate filter
    std::map<std::uint64_t, std::int8_t> m_lastRssi;  // advertising RSSI per address (Read RSSI of a link)
    std::map<std::uint64_t, std::string> m_names;     // advertised names (Remote Name Request)
    Scanner m_scanner;

    // LE links: handle -> WinRT connection, its ACL reassembly and peer address.
    struct Link {
        std::unique_ptr<LeLink> link;
        AclReassembler reassembler;
        std::uint64_t address = 0;
    };
    std::mutex m_linksLock;
    std::map<std::uint16_t, Link> m_links;
    std::uint16_t m_nextHandle = 0x0040;
    std::atomic<bool> m_connecting{false}, m_connectCancel{false};
    std::mutex m_connectLock;                 // with m_connectChanged: m_connectCancel was set
    std::condition_variable m_connectChanged;
    std::atomic<unsigned> m_generation{0};  // advanced by HCI Reset
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> m_randomAddress{0};  // LE Set Random Address (own address type 1)

    // Links being closed on their own threads (DestroyLater). They call back into the controller
    // until closed, so the destructor waits for them.
    std::mutex m_retiringLock;
    std::condition_variable m_retired;
    unsigned m_retiring = 0;

    // Threads last: joined before the members they use go away.
    std::jthread m_connector;  // LE Create Connection in progress
    std::jthread m_inquiry;    // ends a classic inquiry after its length
};

}  // namespace WN::Bt
```

`src/bluetooth/Crypto.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "bluetooth/Crypto.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

#pragma comment(lib, "bcrypt.lib")

namespace WN::Bt {

Block SecurityE(const Block& key, const Block& plaintext) {
    // AES works on the most significant octet first; Bluetooth sends the least significant first.
    Block k, data, out{};
    std::reverse_copy(key.begin(), key.end(), k.begin());
    std::reverse_copy(plaintext.begin(), plaintext.end(), data.begin());
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE algorithm = nullptr;
    BCRYPT_KEY_HANDLE handle = nullptr;
    ULONG written = 0;
    const bool ok =
        BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&algorithm, BCRYPT_AES_ALGORITHM, nullptr, 0)) &&
        BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptSetProperty(algorithm, BCRYPT_CHAINING_MODE, reinterpret_cast<PUCHAR>(const_cast<wchar_t*>(BCRYPT_CHAIN_MODE_ECB)),
                                         sizeof(BCRYPT_CHAIN_MODE_ECB), 0)) &&
        BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptGenerateSymmetricKey(algorithm, &handle, nullptr, 0, k.data(), 16, 0)) &&
        BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptEncrypt(handle, data.data(), 16, nullptr, nullptr, 0, out.data(), 16, &written, 0));
    if (handle) BCryptDestroyKey(handle);
    if (algorithm) BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(algorithm, 0);
    if (!ok) throw std::runtime_error("AES-128 unavailable");
    Block result;
    std::reverse_copy(out.begin(), out.end(), result.begin());
    return result;
}

Block C1(const Block& k, const Block& r, std::span<const std::uint8_t, 7> preq, std::span<const std::uint8_t, 7> pres, std::uint8_t iat,
         std::uint64_t ia, std::uint8_t rat, std::uint64_t ra) {
    // p1 = pres || preq || rat' || iat' and p2 = padding || ia || ra, least significant octet first.
    Block p1{}, p2{};
    p1[0] = iat;
    p1[1] = rat;
    std::copy(preq.begin(), preq.end(), p1.begin() + 2);
    std::copy(pres.begin(), pres.end(), p1.begin() + 9);
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        p2[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(ra >> (8 * i));
        p2[static_cast<std::size_t>(6 + i)] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(ia >> (8 * i));
    }
    Block x;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) x[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(r[i] ^ p1[i]);
    x = SecurityE(k, x);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) x[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(x[i] ^ p2[i]);
    return SecurityE(k, x);
}

Block S1(const Block& k, const Block& r1, const Block& r2) {
    // r' = r1' || r2': the low halves, r1's in the most significant position.
    Block r{};
    std::copy_n(r2.begin(), 8, r.begin());
    std::copy_n(r1.begin(), 8, r.begin() + 8);
    return SecurityE(k, r);
}

void RandomBytes(std::span<std::uint8_t> out) {
    // Never hand out what happened to be in the buffer: no randomness, no answer.
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptGenRandom(nullptr, out.data(), static_cast<ULONG>(out.size()), BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG)))
        throw std::runtime_error("BCryptGenRandom failed");
}

}  // namespace WN::Bt
```

`src/bluetooth/Crypto.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Bluetooth security functions on Windows CNG (Core Vol 3 Part H 2.2): values are 128-bit and,
// as on the wire, least significant octet first.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>

namespace WN::Bt {

using Block = std::array<std::uint8_t, 16>;

// e(key, plaintext): AES-128 (also HCI LE Encrypt).
Block SecurityE(const Block& key, const Block& plaintext);

// LE legacy pairing: confirm value c1 and short term key s1.
//   preq / pres: the 7 octets of the Pairing Request / Response PDUs (opcode included)
//   ia / ra: initiator / responder addresses, iat / rat: their types (0 public, 1 random)
Block C1(const Block& k, const Block& r, std::span<const std::uint8_t, 7> preq, std::span<const std::uint8_t, 7> pres, std::uint8_t iat,
         std::uint64_t ia, std::uint8_t rat, std::uint64_t ra);
Block S1(const Block& k, const Block& r1, const Block& r2);

// Cryptographically random bytes.
void RandomBytes(std::span<std::uint8_t> out);

}  // namespace WN::Bt
```

`src/bluetooth/H4.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "bluetooth/H4.h"
#include <algorithm>

namespace WN::Bt {

std::size_t H4Reader::HeaderSize() const {
    switch (static_cast<Hci::PacketType>(m_packet[0])) {
    case Hci::PacketType::Command: return 3;  // opcode(2) length(1)
    case Hci::PacketType::Acl: return 4;      // handle+flags(2) length(2)
    case Hci::PacketType::Sco: return 3;      // handle+flags(2) length(1)
    case Hci::PacketType::Event: return 2;    // code(1) length(1)
    case Hci::PacketType::Iso: return 4;      // handle+flags(2) length(14 bits)
    default: return 0;
    }
}

std::size_t H4Reader::PayloadSize() const {
    const std::uint8_t* h = m_packet.data() + 1;
    switch (static_cast<Hci::PacketType>(m_packet[0])) {
    case Hci::PacketType::Command: return h[2];
    case Hci::PacketType::Acl: return static_cast<std::size_t>(h[2] | (h[3] << 8));
    case Hci::PacketType::Sco: return h[2];
    case Hci::PacketType::Event: return h[1];
    case Hci::PacketType::Iso: return static_cast<std::size_t>((h[2] | (h[3] << 8)) & 0x3FFF);
    default: return 0;
    }
}

bool H4Reader::Feed(std::span<const std::uint8_t> data) {
    while (!data.empty()) {
        if (m_packet.empty()) {
            const std::uint8_t type = data[0];
            if (type < 1 || type > 5) return false;
            m_packet.push_back(type);
            data = data.subspan(1);
            continue;
        }
        const std::size_t header = HeaderSize();
        std::size_t want = 1 + header;
        if (m_packet.size() >= want) want += PayloadSize();
        const std::size_t take = std::min(want - m_packet.size(), data.size());
        m_packet.insert(m_packet.end(), data.begin(), data.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(take));
        data = data.subspan(take);
        if (m_packet.size() == 1 + header) {
            if (PayloadSize() != 0) continue;  // header complete, payload follows
        } else if (m_packet.size() < 1 + header || m_packet.size() < 1 + header + PayloadSize()) {
            continue;
        }
        const auto type = static_cast<Hci::PacketType>(m_packet[0]);
        m_onPacket(type, std::span<const std::uint8_t>(m_packet).subspan(1));
        m_packet.clear();
    }
    return true;
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> H4Frame(Hci::PacketType type, std::span<const std::uint8_t> packet) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> frame;
    frame.reserve(packet.size() + 1);
    frame.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(type));
    frame.insert(frame.end(), packet.begin(), packet.end());
    return frame;
}

}  // namespace WN::Bt
```

```h
// H4 framing over the vsock stream: one packet indicator byte, then the HCI packet. The host
// sends commands, ACL, SCO and ISO data; the bridge answers with events and ACL data.
#pragma once
#include "bluetooth/Hci.h"

class H4Reader {
public:
    using PacketFn = std::function<void(Hci::PacketType, std::span<const std::uint8_t>)>;
    explicit H4Reader(PacketFn onPacket) : m_onPacket(std::move(onPacket)) {}

    // Feeds received bytes; calls onPacket for every complete packet. False: framing is broken
    // (unknown packet indicator) and the connection should be dropped.
    bool Feed(std::span<const std::uint8_t> data);

private:
    // Header length and payload length of the packet being collected (0 = header incomplete).

    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t PayloadSize() const;

    PacketFn m_onPacket;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_packet;  // indicator + header + payload collected so far
};
```

```cpp
#include "bluetooth/Opcodes.inc"
};

std::span<const OpcodeInfo> AllOpcodes() { return kOpcodes; }

const OpcodeInfo* FindOpcode(std::uint16_t opcode) {
    const auto it = std::ranges::find(kOpcodes, opcode, &OpcodeInfo::opcode);
    return it == std::end(kOpcodes) ? nullptr : &*it;
}

std::string_view OpcodeName(std::uint16_t opcode) {
    if (const OpcodeInfo* info = FindOpcode(opcode)) return info->name;
    return (opcode >> 10) == 0x3F ? "VENDOR_SPECIFIC" : "?";
}
```

`src/bluetooth/L2cap.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "bluetooth/L2cap.h"
#include <algorithm>

namespace WN::Bt {
namespace {

constexpr std::uint8_t kPbFirstNonFlushable = 0b00, kPbContinuation = 0b01, kPbFirstFlushable = 0b10;

}  // namespace

std::uint16_t AclHandle(std::span<const std::uint8_t> acl) {
    if (acl.size() < 4) return 0xFFFF;
    return static_cast<std::uint16_t>((acl[0] | (acl[1] << 8)) & 0x0FFF);
}

std::optional<L2capFrame> AclReassembler::Feed(std::span<const std::uint8_t> acl) {
    if (acl.size() < 4) return std::nullopt;
    const std::uint16_t header = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(acl[0] | (acl[1] << 8));
    const std::uint8_t pb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((header >> 12) & 0x3);
    const std::size_t length = static_cast<std::size_t>(acl[2] | (acl[3] << 8));
    const auto data = acl.subspan(4, std::min(length, acl.size() - 4));

    if (pb == kPbFirstNonFlushable || pb == kPbFirstFlushable) {
        m_pending.assign(data.begin(), data.end());
        m_handle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(header & 0x0FFF);
        m_expected = 0;
    } else if (pb == kPbContinuation && !m_pending.empty()) {
        m_pending.insert(m_pending.end(), data.begin(), data.end());
    } else {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (m_expected == 0) {
        if (m_pending.size() < 4) return std::nullopt;
        m_expected = 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(m_pending[0] | (m_pending[1] << 8));
    }
    if (m_pending.size() < m_expected) return std::nullopt;

    L2capFrame frame;
    frame.handle = m_handle;
    frame.cid = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_pending[2] | (m_pending[3] << 8));
    frame.payload.assign(m_pending.begin() + 4, m_pending.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_expected));
    m_pending.clear();
    m_expected = 0;
    return frame;
}

std::vector<std::vector<std::uint8_t>> AclPackets(std::uint16_t handle, std::uint16_t cid, std::span<const std::uint8_t> payload,
                                                  std::size_t maxData) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> frame;
    frame.reserve(payload.size() + 4);
    frame.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(payload.size()));
    frame.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(payload.size() >> 8));
    frame.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(cid));
    frame.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(cid >> 8));
    frame.insert(frame.end(), payload.begin(), payload.end());

    std::vector<std::vector<std::uint8_t>> packets;
    for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < frame.size(); offset += maxData) {
        const std::size_t take = std::min(maxData, frame.size() - offset);
        const std::uint8_t pb = offset == 0 ? kPbFirstFlushable : kPbContinuation;
        const std::uint16_t header = static_cast<std::uint16_t>((handle & 0x0FFF) | (pb << 12));
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> packet{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(header), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(header >> 8),
                                         static_cast<std::uint8_t>(take), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(take >> 8)};
        packet.insert(packet.end(), frame.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset),
                      frame.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset + take));
        packets.push_back(std::move(packet));
    }
    return packets;
}

}  // namespace WN::Bt
```

`src/bluetooth/L2cap.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// L2CAP over HCI ACL for LE links: reassembly of what the host sends, fragmentation of what the
// bridge answers (Bluetooth Core Vol 3 Part A; LE uses the basic frame format only).
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Bt {

// Fixed LE channels.
inline constexpr std::uint16_t kCidAtt = 0x0004;
inline constexpr std::uint16_t kCidLeSignaling = 0x0005;
inline constexpr std::uint16_t kCidSmp = 0x0006;

struct L2capFrame {
    std::uint16_t handle = 0;
    std::uint16_t cid = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> payload;
};

// Collects the ACL fragments of one connection into L2CAP frames.
class AclReassembler {
public:
    // One HCI ACL packet (header included). Returns a frame when it completes one; malformed
    // input drops the partial frame.
    std::optional<L2capFrame> Feed(std::span<const std::uint8_t> acl);

private:
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_pending;  // L2CAP header + payload collected so far
    std::size_t m_expected = 0;           // L2CAP header + payload length of the frame in progress
    std::uint16_t m_handle = 0;
};

// HCI ACL packets (header included) carrying one L2CAP frame, each at most `maxData` bytes of data.
std::vector<std::vector<std::uint8_t>> AclPackets(std::uint16_t handle, std::uint16_t cid, std::span<const std::uint8_t> payload,
                                                  std::size_t maxData);

// Connection handle of an ACL packet (0xFFFF when too short).
std::uint16_t AclHandle(std::span<const std::uint8_t> acl);

}  // namespace WN::Bt
```
