`src/core/Install.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "core/Install.h"
#include "install/Package.h"
#include "install/Setup.h"
#include "install/Unpack.h"
#include "net/Downloader.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "core/Release.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "support/Json.h"
#include "support/Signature.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <ShlObj.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <format>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <sstream>

namespace WN::Core {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
namespace {

// Overall progress: downloads 0-80 %, unpacking 80-97 %, Windows registration 97-100 %.
constexpr int kDownloadShare = 800, kUnpackShare = 170;

class Meter {
public:
    Meter(const ProgressSink& sink) : m_sink(sink) {}
    void Step(std::wstring phase, int step, int steps) {
        m_p.phase = std::move(phase);
        m_p.step = step;
        m_p.steps = steps;
        m_p.done = m_p.total = m_p.speed = 0;
        m_p.eta = 0;
        m_start = Now();
        m_startBytes = 0;
        m_first = true;
        m_lastSent = 0;
    }
    // `base` + `share` * done/total -> permille of the whole job.
    void Bytes(std::uint64_t done, std::uint64_t total, int base, int share) {
        if (m_first) { m_startBytes = done; m_first = false; }  // resumed bytes do not count for the speed
        m_p.done = done;
        m_p.total = total;
        const double elapsed = Seconds(Now() - m_start);
        if (elapsed > 0.5 && done > m_startBytes) {
            m_p.speed = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(static_cast<double>(done - m_startBytes) / elapsed);
            m_p.eta = m_p.speed ? static_cast<double>(total - std::min(done, total)) / static_cast<double>(m_p.speed) : 0;
        }
        m_p.permille = base + (total ? static_cast<int>(static_cast<double>(share) * static_cast<double>(done) / static_cast<double>(total)) : 0);
        const auto now = GetTickCount64();
        if (now - m_lastSent >= 100 || done == total) {  // at most ten updates a second
            m_lastSent = now;
            m_sink(m_p);
        }
    }
    void Phase(std::wstring phase, int permille) {
        m_p.phase = std::move(phase);
        m_p.permille = permille;
        m_p.done = m_p.total = m_p.speed = 0;
        m_p.eta = 0;
        m_p.step = m_p.steps = 0;
        m_sink(m_p);
    }

private:
    using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
    static Clock::time_point Now() { return Clock::now(); }
    static double Seconds(Clock::duration d) { return std::chrono::duration<double>(d).count(); }
    const ProgressSink& m_sink;
    Progress m_p;
    Clock::time_point m_start{};
    std::uint64_t m_startBytes = 0;
    bool m_first = true;
    ULONGLONG m_lastSent = 0;
};

fs::path StatePath(const fs::path& folder) { return folder / Config::kStateFile; }

Result<> WriteState(const fs::path& folder, const InstalledState& state) {
    Json::Object components, entries;
    for (const auto& [id, sha] : state.components) components.emplace(id, Json::Value(sha));
    for (const auto& [id, names] : state.entries) {
        Json::Array list;
        for (const auto& name : names) list.emplace_back(name);
        entries.emplace(id, Json::Value(std::move(list)));
    }
    Json::Object root{{L"format", Json::Value(std::uint64_t{1})},
                      {L"version", Json::Value(state.version)},
                      {L"source", Json::Value(state.source)},
                      {L"components", Json::Value(std::move(components))},
                      {L"entries", Json::Value(std::move(entries))}};
    const std::string text = Json::Write(Json::Value(std::move(root)));
    const fs::path path = StatePath(folder), temp = fs::path(path).concat(L".new");
    {
        std::ofstream out(temp, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out.write(text.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(text.size()));
        if (!out) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_CANNOT_CREATE_FILE, temp.wstring()));
    }
    if (!MoveFileExW(temp.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_REPLACE, path.wstring()), GetLastError()));
    return {};
}

std::wstring TargetName(const Component& c) {
    return c.kind == ComponentKind::Archive ? Text::Format(IDS_COMPONENT_WINDOWS, c.id) : fs::path(c.target).filename().wstring();
}

// First element of a path relative to the install folder ("Tools/kernel" -> "Tools"; "." -> "").
std::wstring TopLevel(const fs::path& relative) {
    for (const auto& part : relative)
        if (!part.empty() && part != L".") return part.wstring();
    return {};
}

// What component `c` wrote into the folder: its target, or for an archive unpacked into the folder
// itself every top-level entry of the archive.
std::vector<std::wstring> EntriesOf(const Component& c, const std::set<std::wstring>* archiveTop) {
    const std::wstring top = TopLevel(c.target);
    if (!top.empty() || !archiveTop) return {top};
    return {archiveTop->begin(), archiveTop->end()};
}


// Replaces `target` with a copy of `source`; a running `target` (the host) is renamed out of the
// way first (allowed for a running executable) and deleted now or at the next restart.
Result<> ReplaceFile(const fs::path& source, const fs::path& target) {
    std::error_code ec;
    const fs::path old = fs::path(target).concat(L".old");
    const bool existed = fs::exists(target, ec);
    if (existed && !MoveFileExW(target.c_str(), old.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_REPLACE, target.wstring()), GetLastError()));
    if (!CopyFileW(source.c_str(), target.c_str(), FALSE)) {
        const DWORD error = GetLastError();
        // The logon task points at `target`: put the previous file back.
        if (existed) MoveFileExW(old.c_str(), target.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING);
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CANNOT_CREATE_FILE, target.wstring()), error));
    }
    if (fs::exists(old, ec) && !DeleteFileW(old.c_str())) MoveFileExW(old.c_str(), nullptr, MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT);
    return {};
}

// WSA-Next.exe and its language files into %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next, wherever Android is: the
// host's logon task runs with the highest privileges, so its executable must be in a folder only
// administrators may change. Then the task pointing there and the host restarted from there -
// for the current user only (`thisUser`); WSA registered for another user keeps that user's task.
// When WSA-Next Setup is installed, its copy there serves the host: Windows Installer owns it.
Result<> InstallHost(const fs::path& folder, InstalledState& state, bool thisUser) {
    const fs::path host = HostFolder();
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::create_directories(host, ec);
    const fs::path self = ModulePath();
    if (!fs::equivalent(self, host / Config::kExeName, ec) && !Install::SetupProduct()) {
        if (auto r = ReplaceFile(self, host / Config::kExeName); !r) return r;
        const fs::path languages = self.parent_path() / L"language";
        if (fs::is_directory(languages, ec)) {
            fs::create_directories(host / L"language", ec);
            for (fs::directory_iterator it(languages, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec))
                if (it->path().extension() == L".lng") (void)ReplaceFile(it->path(), host / L"language" / it->path().filename());
        }
    }
    if (fs::equivalent(folder, host, ec)) {
        state.entries[L"host"] = {Config::kExeName, L"language"};
        if (auto w = WriteState(folder, state); !w) return w;
    }
    if (!thisUser) return {};
    if (auto r = Host::SetAutostart(true); !r) return r;
    return Host::Restart();
}

// A folder in %ProgramFiles% (its ACL lets only administrators change files there).
bool AdminOnlyFolder(const fs::path& folder) {
    PWSTR programFiles = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_ProgramFiles, 0, nullptr, &programFiles))) return false;
    // Windows paths ignore case: compare them lower-cased.
    auto lower = [](fs::path p) {
        std::wstring s = p.lexically_normal().wstring();
        std::ranges::transform(s, s.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(c)); });
        return fs::path(s);
    };
    const fs::path root = lower(programFiles);
    CoTaskMemFree(programFiles);
    const fs::path relative = lower(folder).lexically_relative(root);
    return !relative.empty() && *relative.begin() != L".." && relative != L".";
}

bool Present(const fs::path& folder, const Component& c) {
    std::error_code ec;
    if (c.kind == ComponentKind::Archive) return fs::exists(folder / c.target / Config::kPackageManifest, ec) || c.id != L"windows";
    return fs::exists(folder / c.target, ec);
}

std::uint64_t FreeBytes(const fs::path& folder) {
    fs::path probe = folder;
    std::error_code ec;
    while (!probe.empty() && !fs::exists(probe, ec)) probe = probe.parent_path();
    ULARGE_INTEGER free{};
    if (probe.empty() || !GetDiskFreeSpaceExW(probe.c_str(), &free, nullptr, nullptr)) return UINT64_MAX;
    return free.QuadPart;
}

}  // namespace

bool Plan::UpToDate() const {
    return std::ranges::none_of(items, [](const PlanItem& i) { return i.needed; });
}

fs::path DefaultFolder() {
    PWSTR programFiles = nullptr;
    fs::path folder = L"C:\\Program Files";
    if (SUCCEEDED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_ProgramFiles, 0, nullptr, &programFiles))) folder = programFiles;
    CoTaskMemFree(programFiles);
    return folder / Config::kInstallFolder;
}

InstalledState ReadState(const fs::path& folder) {
    InstalledState state;
    std::ifstream in(StatePath(folder), std::ios::binary);
    if (!in) return state;
    std::stringstream buffer;
    buffer << in.rdbuf();
    auto json = Json::Parse(buffer.str());
    if (!json) return state;
    state.version = json->StringOr(L"version");
    state.source = json->StringOr(L"source");
    for (const auto& [id, sha] : (*json)[L"components"].Members())
        if (auto s = sha.String()) state.components.emplace(id, *s);
    for (const auto& [id, list] : (*json)[L"entries"].Members()) {
        auto& names = state.entries[id];
        for (const auto& item : list.Items())
            if (auto s = item.String()) names.push_back(*s);
    }
    return state;
}

bool InstalledState::EntriesComplete() const {
    return std::ranges::all_of(components, [this](const auto& c) { return entries.contains(c.first); });
}

Plan MakePlan(const Manifest& manifest, const InstalledState& state, const SystemInfo& system, const fs::path& folder) {
    Plan plan;
    for (const Component& c : manifest.components) {
        if (c.optional && !(c.id == L"wsapatch" && system.NeedsPatch())) continue;
        const auto it = state.components.find(c.id);
        const bool same = it != state.components.end() && it->second == c.packedSha256 && Present(folder, c);
        plan.items.push_back({&c, !same});
        if (!same) {
            plan.downloadBytes += c.packedSize;
            plan.diskBytes += c.size;
        }
    }
    return plan;
}

Result<Outcome> Run(const Manifest& manifest, const Options& options, const Callbacks& cb, std::stop_token stop) {
    Outcome outcome;
    Meter meter(cb.progress);
    auto log = [&](Level level, std::wstring text) { cb.log(level, std::move(text)); };
    const fs::path& folder = options.folder;
    const fs::path downloads = folder / Config::kDownloadFolder;

    // --- What this Windows has, what has to be installed ---------------------------------------
    meter.Phase(Text::Get(IDS_PHASE_CHECKING), -1);
    const SystemInfo system = Inspect();
    log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_WINDOWS, system.Version()));
    if (!system.Supported()) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_WINDOWS_TOO_OLD, system.build, Config::kMinWindowsBuild));
    if (manifest.minWindowsBuild > system.build)
        return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_WINDOWS_TOO_OLD, system.build, manifest.minWindowsBuild));

    // An official WSA-Next.exe installs official releases only; a build from the sources installs
    // any release (its own builds), with a warning.
    if (manifest.official) log(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_RELEASE_OFFICIAL));
    else if (Signature::Official()) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_RELEASE_UNOFFICIAL, manifest.source));
    else log(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_RELEASE_UNSIGNED));

    InstalledState state = ReadState(folder);
    const Plan plan = MakePlan(manifest, state, system, folder);
    if (plan.UpToDate()) log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_UP_TO_DATE, manifest.version));
    else log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_PLAN, manifest.version, FormatBytes(plan.downloadBytes), FormatBytes(plan.diskBytes)));

    // Downloads and unpacked disks live on the same volume at the same time (briefly).
    const std::uint64_t free = FreeBytes(folder);
    if (plan.downloadBytes + plan.diskBytes > free)
        return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_NO_SPACE, FormatBytes(plan.downloadBytes + plan.diskBytes), FormatBytes(free)));

    // WSA registered for another Windows user only. Windows lets one user at a time register an
    // unpacked package, so this account cannot register it. From this folder, the installation
    // updates the files for that user (they are shared); from another folder it cannot be done
    // here. Their running WSA is never cut off: they close it first.
    const bool forOtherUser = !system.package && system.otherUser;
    if (forOtherUser) {
        const Install::OtherRegistration& other = *system.otherUser;
        if (std::error_code ec; !fs::equivalent(other.location, folder, ec))
            return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_OTHER_USER_FOLDER, other.user, other.location.wstring()));
        if (Guest::FindWsaVm()) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_OTHER_USER_RUNNING, other.user));
        log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_OTHER_USER, other.user));
    }

    // --- Downloads (WSA may keep running meanwhile) -------------------------------------------
    const int steps = static_cast<int>(std::ranges::count_if(plan.items, [](const PlanItem& i) { return i.needed; }));
    std::uint64_t downloadedBefore = 0;
    int step = 0;
    for (const PlanItem& item : plan.items) {
        if (!item.needed) continue;
        const Component& c = *item.component;
        ++step;
        meter.Step(Text::Format(IDS_PHASE_DOWNLOAD, TargetName(c)), step, steps);
        log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_DOWNLOAD, c.url, FormatBytes(c.packedSize)));
        const std::uint64_t before = downloadedBefore;
        auto r = Net::Download(
            c.url, downloads / (c.id + L".zst"), c.packedSize, c.packedSha256, Config::kDownloadAttempts,
            [&](std::uint64_t done, std::uint64_t total) {
                const std::uint64_t all = std::max<std::uint64_t>(plan.downloadBytes, 1);
                const int base = static_cast<int>(kDownloadShare * static_cast<double>(before) / static_cast<double>(all));
                const int share = static_cast<int>(kDownloadShare * static_cast<double>(c.packedSize) / static_cast<double>(all));
                meter.Bytes(done, total, base, share);
            },
            [&](std::wstring text) { log(Level::Info, std::move(text)); }, stop);
        if (!r) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_DOWNLOAD_FAILED, TargetName(c), r.error()));
        downloadedBefore += c.packedSize;
        log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_VERIFIED, TargetName(c)));
    }

    // --- Unpacking next to the installed files (WSA may keep running meanwhile) ---------------
    // Every component is unpacked to "<name>.new" first; the installed release changes only once
    // all of them are complete, so a failure or a cancellation midway leaves it as it was.
    Install::Staged staged;
    std::map<std::wstring, std::vector<std::wstring>> entries;
    std::vector<const Component*> digested;  // disks whose digest the unpacking has just checked
    step = 0;
    for (const PlanItem& item : plan.items) {
        if (!item.needed) continue;
        const Component& c = *item.component;
        ++step;
        if (stop.stop_requested()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        meter.Step(Text::Format(IDS_PHASE_UNPACK, TargetName(c)), step, steps);
        const int base = kDownloadShare + kUnpackShare * (step - 1) / std::max(steps, 1);
        const int share = kUnpackShare / std::max(steps, 1);
        auto progress = [&](std::uint64_t done, std::uint64_t total) { meter.Bytes(done, total, base, share); };
        const fs::path zst = downloads / (c.id + L".zst");
        if (c.kind == ComponentKind::Archive) {
            auto r = Install::UnpackArchive(zst, folder / c.target, c.size, progress, stop);
            if (!r) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_UNPACK_FAILED, TargetName(c), r.error()));
            log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_UNPACKED_ARCHIVE, TargetName(c), r->files, FormatBytes(r->bytes)));
            entries[c.id] = EntriesOf(c, &r->topLevel);
            staged.Append(std::move(r->staged));
        } else {
            auto r = Install::UnpackFile(zst, folder / c.target, c.size, c.sha256, progress, stop);
            if (!r) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_UNPACK_FAILED, TargetName(c), r.error()));
            log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_UNPACKED, TargetName(c), FormatBytes(r->bytes)));
            entries[c.id] = EntriesOf(c, nullptr);
            staged.Append(std::move(r->staged));
            if (!c.sha256.empty()) digested.push_back(&c);
        }
    }
    if (stop.stop_requested()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));

    // --- The switch: WSA must not use the disks while they are replaced ----------------------
    if (steps) {
        if (system.package) Install::Shutdown(system.package->location, [&](std::wstring t) { log(Level::Info, std::move(t)); });
        else if (forOtherUser && Guest::FindWsaVm()) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_OTHER_USER_RUNNING, system.otherUser->user));  // started meanwhile
        meter.Phase(Text::Get(IDS_PHASE_SWITCH), kDownloadShare + kUnpackShare);
        if (auto r = staged.Commit(); !r) return Fail(r.error());
        // The host checks the installed disks by their digests, taken here while unpacking. They
        // are handed on only where nobody but an administrator could have changed the files since.
        if (AdminOnlyFolder(folder))
            for (const Component* c : digested) Release::Remember(folder / c->target, c->sha256);
    }
    for (const PlanItem& item : plan.items) {
        if (!item.needed) continue;
        const Component& c = *item.component;
        state.entries[c.id] = std::move(entries[c.id]);
        state.components[c.id] = c.packedSha256;
        ++outcome.installed;
    }
    state.version = manifest.version;
    state.source = manifest.source;
    if (auto w = WriteState(folder, state); !w) return Fail(w.error());  // the files have switched
    if (!options.keepDownloads) {
        std::error_code ec;
        for (const PlanItem& item : plan.items)
            if (item.needed) fs::remove(downloads / (item.component->id + L".zst"), ec);
        fs::remove(downloads, ec);  // only when empty
    }
    // The signed manifest stays with the release: the background host checks the images by it.
    if (auto r = Release::Record(folder, manifest); !r) return Fail(r.error());
    if (manifest.official) state.entries[L"release"] = {Release::kInstalledManifest, Release::kInstalledCatalog};
    else state.entries.erase(L"release");
    state.version = manifest.version;
    state.source = manifest.source;
    if (auto w = WriteState(folder, state); !w) return Fail(w.error());
    if (!options.registerPackage) {
        meter.Phase(Text::Get(IDS_PHASE_DONE), 1000);
        return outcome;
    }
    if (forOtherUser) {
        // Their registration and logon task stay as they are; the host's files in Program Files are
        // shared, so the new WSA-Next.exe goes there (their host takes it at their next sign-in).
        if (auto r = InstallHost(folder, state, false); !r) log(Level::Warning, r.error());
        log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_OTHER_USER_DONE, manifest.version, system.otherUser->user));
        meter.Phase(Text::Get(IDS_PHASE_DONE), 1000);
        return outcome;
    }

    // --- Windows: developer mode, Virtual Machine Platform, the package ----------------------
    meter.Phase(Text::Get(IDS_PHASE_REGISTER), kDownloadShare + kUnpackShare);
    if (!system.developerMode) {
        if (!cb.confirm(Text::Get(IDS_ASK_DEVMODE))) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        if (auto r = EnableDeveloperMode(); !r) return Fail(r.error());
        Settings::WriteDword(Config::kEnabledDeveloperMode, 1);
        log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_DEVMODE));
    }
    if (system.virtualMachinePlatform == false) {
        if (!cb.confirm(Text::Get(IDS_ASK_VMP))) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        auto r = EnableVirtualMachinePlatform([&](std::wstring t) { log(Level::Info, std::move(t)); });
        if (!r) return Fail(r.error());
        Settings::WriteDword(Config::kEnabledVmp, 1);
        outcome.restartNeeded = *r;
    }
    if (system.package && !system.package->developmentMode) {
        // WSA from the Microsoft Store: a store package cannot be updated by a development registration.
        if (!cb.confirm(Text::Format(IDS_ASK_REPLACE_STORE, system.package->version))) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        if (auto r = Install::Unregister(*system.package, true); !r) return Fail(r.error());
        log(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_STORE_REMOVED));
    } else if (std::error_code ec; system.package && !fs::equivalent(system.package->location, folder, ec)) {
        // Another unpacked WSA (same identity): registering ours takes its place, the user data stays.
        log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_REPLACES, system.package->location.wstring()));
    }
    auto logFn = [&](std::wstring t) { log(Level::Info, std::move(t)); };
    if (auto r = Install::InstallDependencies(folder, logFn); !r) return Fail(r.error());
    if (auto r = Install::Register(folder, logFn); !r) {
        // Windows may refuse to move a registration to another folder. Then the old registration is
        // removed with its data kept (a development package keeps LocalCache) and ours registered.
        const auto current = Install::FindWsa();
        std::error_code ec;
        if (!current || !current->developmentMode || fs::equivalent(current->location, folder, ec)) return Fail(r.error());
        log(Level::Warning, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_REREGISTER, r.error()));
        if (auto u = Install::Unregister(*current, true); !u) return Fail(u.error());
        if (auto again = Install::Register(folder, logFn); !again) return Fail(again.error());
    }
    log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_REGISTERED, manifest.version));
    Install::DefaultWsaSettings();  // a new WSA starts without its diagnostics question
    if (system.NeedsPatch()) log(Level::Warning, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_PATCH_NEEDED, system.build));

    // The background host (Bluetooth and Windows Hello for Android) starts at logon with the
    // highest privileges, so it must run from a folder only administrators can change.
    if (auto r = InstallHost(folder, state, true); r) log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_HOST_INSTALLED));
    else log(Level::Warning, r.error());
    meter.Phase(Text::Get(IDS_PHASE_DONE), 1000);
    return outcome;
}

}  // namespace WN::Core
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Installing and updating WSA-Next: compares the release manifest with what is installed,
// downloads the changed components (resumable), unpacks them, prepares Windows and registers
// the package.
//
//   <folder>\                      install folder (default %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next)
//     AppxManifest.xml, WsaClient\  ...   the Windows part ("windows" component)
//     system.vhdx, vendor.vhdx ...        Android disks
//     Tools\kernel, Tools\initrd.img      boot files
//     wsa-next.json                       installed components (id -> packedSha256, version)
//     .download\                          compressed downloads in progress
#pragma once
#include "core/Manifest.h"
#include "core/System.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <map>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Core {

// Progress of an installation for the GUI and the command line.
struct Progress {
    std::wstring phase;          // "Downloading system.vhdx"
    int permille = -1;           // whole job, -1 = indeterminate
    int step = 0, steps = 0;     // component n of m
    std::uint64_t done = 0, total = 0;  // bytes of the current step
    std::uint64_t speed = 0;     // bytes per second (downloads)
    double eta = 0;              // seconds left in the current step
};
using ProgressSink = std::function<void(const Progress&)>;

// Installed state (wsa-next.json).
struct InstalledState {
    std::wstring version, source;
    std::map<std::wstring, std::wstring, std::less<>> components;  // id -> packedSha256
    // id -> the top-level names it wrote into the install folder ("Tools", "AppxManifest.xml" ...):
    // a removal deletes these and nothing else of a folder the person may share with other files.
    std::map<std::wstring, std::vector<std::wstring>, std::less<>> entries;
    // True when every installed component has its entries (installations of WSA-Next 0.1.0 before
    // the list existed do not).
    [[nodiscard]] bool EntriesComplete() const;
};
InstalledState ReadState(const std::filesystem::path& folder);

std::filesystem::path DefaultFolder();  // %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next
// Where the background host's WSA-Next.exe is installed: always %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next (only
// administrators may change it), whatever folder Android is installed to.
inline std::filesystem::path HostFolder() { return DefaultFolder(); }

struct PlanItem {
    const Component* component;
    bool needed;  // false: already installed with the same content
};
struct Plan {
    std::vector<PlanItem> items;
    std::uint64_t downloadBytes = 0, diskBytes = 0;
    [[nodiscard]] bool UpToDate() const;
};
// What has to be downloaded into `folder`. Optional components (wsapatch) only when `system` needs them.
Plan MakePlan(const Manifest& manifest, const InstalledState& state, const SystemInfo& system, const std::filesystem::path& folder);

struct Options {
    std::filesystem::path folder;
    bool registerPackage = true;   // false: files only (tests, offline preparation)
    bool keepDownloads = false;    // keep the .zst files after unpacking
};

// Callbacks of a running installation. `confirm` asks the person (UI thread); false = stop.
struct Callbacks {
    ProgressSink progress;
    std::function<void(Level, std::wstring)> log;
    ConfirmFn confirm;
};

struct Outcome {
    bool restartNeeded = false;  // Virtual Machine Platform was just enabled
    unsigned installed = 0;      // components written
};

Result<Outcome> Run(const Manifest& manifest, const Options& options, const Callbacks& cb, std::stop_token stop);

}  // namespace WN::Core
```

`src/core/Manifest.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "core/Manifest.h"
#include "core/Release.h"
#include "install/Unpack.h"
#include "net/Downloader.h"
#include "support/Json.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <format>

namespace WN::Core {
namespace {

bool IsHex64(const std::wstring& s) {
    return s.size() == 64 && std::ranges::all_of(s, [](wchar_t c) { return std::iswxdigit(c) != 0; });
}

// A target must stay inside the install folder.
bool SafeTarget(const std::wstring& path) {
    if (path.empty() || path.find(L':') != std::wstring::npos || path.front() == L'\\' || path.front() == L'/') return false;
    std::size_t start = 0;
    while (start <= path.size()) {
        std::size_t end = path.find_first_of(L"\\/", start);
        if (end == std::wstring::npos) end = path.size();
        const std::wstring_view element(path.data() + start, end - start);
        // "." and empty elements too: a disk or file target names a file (an archive may be ".").
        if (element.empty() || element == L"." || element == L".." || Install::ReservedName(element) || element.find_first_of(L"*?\"<>|") != std::wstring_view::npos) return false;
        start = end + 1;
    }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

const Component* Manifest::Find(std::wstring_view id) const {
    const auto it = std::ranges::find_if(components, [&](const Component& c) { return c.id == id; });
    return it != components.end() ? &*it : nullptr;
}

std::wstring ResolveUrl(const std::wstring& base, const std::wstring& relative) {
    if (relative.find(L"://") != std::wstring::npos) return relative;
    std::wstring dir = base.substr(0, base.find_first_of(L"?#"));
    const std::size_t slash = dir.rfind(L'/');
    if (slash != std::wstring::npos) dir.resize(slash + 1);
    if (!relative.empty() && relative.front() == L'/') {  // host-relative
        const std::size_t scheme = dir.find(L"://");
        const std::size_t host = scheme == std::wstring::npos ? std::wstring::npos : dir.find(L'/', scheme + 3);
        return (host == std::wstring::npos ? dir : dir.substr(0, host)) + relative;
    }
    return dir + relative;
}

Result<Manifest> ParseManifest(std::string_view utf8, const std::wstring& url) {
    auto json = Json::Parse(utf8);
    if (!json) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, json.error()));
    const Json::Value& root = *json;
    if (!root.IsObject()) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, L"object expected"));
    if (root[L"format"].UInt().value_or(0) != 1) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_MANIFEST_FORMAT));

    Manifest m;
    m.source = url;
    m.name = root.StringOr(L"name", L"WSA-Next");
    auto version = root.RequireString(L"version");
    if (!version) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, version.error()));
    m.version = std::move(*version);
    m.android = root.StringOr(L"android");
    m.variant = root.StringOr(L"variant");
    m.minWindowsBuild = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(root[L"minWindowsBuild"].UInt().value_or(0));

    for (const Json::Value& item : root[L"components"].Items()) {
        Component c;
        auto field = [&](std::wstring_view key) -> Result<std::wstring> { return item.RequireString(key); };
        auto id = field(L"id");
        auto kind = field(L"kind");
        auto target = field(L"target");
        auto link = field(L"url");
        auto sha = field(L"packedSha256");
        auto packed = item.RequireUInt(L"packedSize");
        for (const auto* r : {&id, &kind, &target, &link, &sha})
            if (!*r) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, r->error()));
        if (!packed) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, packed.error()));

        c.id = std::move(*id);
        if (*kind == L"disk") c.kind = ComponentKind::Disk;
        else if (*kind == L"file") c.kind = ComponentKind::File;
        else if (*kind == L"archive") c.kind = ComponentKind::Archive;
        else return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, std::format(L"unknown kind \"{}\" of \"{}\"", *kind, c.id)));
        c.target = std::move(*target);
        if (!SafeTarget(c.target) && !(c.kind == ComponentKind::Archive && c.target == L"."))
            return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, std::format(L"unsafe target \"{}\"", c.target)));
        c.url = ResolveUrl(url, *link);
        c.packedSha256 = std::move(*sha);
        std::ranges::transform(c.packedSha256, c.packedSha256.begin(), [](wchar_t ch) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(ch)); });
        if (!IsHex64(c.packedSha256)) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, std::format(L"bad packedSha256 of \"{}\"", c.id)));
        c.packedSize = *packed;
        c.sha256 = item.StringOr(L"sha256");
        std::ranges::transform(c.sha256, c.sha256.begin(), [](wchar_t ch) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(ch)); });
        if (!c.sha256.empty() && !IsHex64(c.sha256)) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, std::format(L"bad sha256 of \"{}\"", c.id)));
        c.size = item[L"size"].UInt().value_or(0);
        c.version = item.StringOr(L"version", m.version);
        c.optional = item[L"optional"].Bool().value_or(false);
        if (m.Find(c.id)) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, std::format(L"component \"{}\" listed twice", c.id)));
        m.components.push_back(std::move(c));
    }
    if (m.components.empty()) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_MANIFEST_INVALID, L"no components"));
    return m;
}

Result<Manifest> LoadManifest(const std::wstring& url, std::stop_token stop) {
    auto body = Net::FetchText(url, 1u << 20, stop);
    if (!body) return Fail(body.error());
    auto manifest = ParseManifest(*body, url);
    if (!manifest) return manifest;
    manifest->raw = std::move(*body);
    // The signature: absent or unreachable means an unofficial release, not a failure.
    if (auto catalog = Net::FetchText(ResolveUrl(url, Release::kCatalogAsset), 1u << 20, stop)) {
        manifest->catalog = std::move(*catalog);
        manifest->official = Release::Vouches(manifest->catalog, manifest->raw);
    }
    return manifest;
}

}  // namespace WN::Core
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// The release manifest: what a WSA-Next release consists of and where each part is.
//
//   {
//     "format": 1,
//     "name": "WSA-Next", "version": "15.0.20261120",
//     "android": "Android 15 (BP1A.250505.005.D1)", "variant": "Google Play",
//     "minWindowsBuild": 22000,
//     "components": [
//       { "id": "system", "kind": "disk", "target": "system.vhdx", "url": "system.vhdx.zst",
//         "packedSize": 431234567, "packedSha256": "...", "size": 1085665280, "version": "15.0.20261120" },
//       ...
//     ]
//   }
//
// Every component is one zstd stream. "disk" and "file" unpack to `target` (a path inside the
// install folder), "archive" is a tar unpacked into the folder `target` ("." = the install folder).
// `url` is relative to the manifest (or absolute), so a release can be mirrored as a whole.
// `packedSha256` identifies the content: an installed component with the same digest is not
// downloaded again. `sha256` is the digest of a disk or file as installed. A release is official
// when manifest.cat next to the manifest - a catalog signed by WSA-Next's publisher - lists the
// manifest's SHA-256 (see core/Release.h).
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Core {

enum class ComponentKind { Disk, File, Archive };

struct Component {
    std::wstring id;       // "system", "system_ext", "product", "vendor", "kernel", "windows", "wsapatch"
    ComponentKind kind = ComponentKind::Disk;
    std::wstring target;   // relative to the install folder
    std::wstring url;      // absolute after loading
    std::uint64_t packedSize = 0;
    std::wstring packedSha256;  // lower-case hex of the .zst file
    std::wstring sha256;        // lower-case hex of the unpacked file (disk, file); may be absent
    std::uint64_t size = 0;     // unpacked size (archive: sum of the files)
    std::wstring version;
    bool optional = false;      // only installed when needed (wsapatch)
};

struct Manifest {
    std::wstring source;  // URL it was loaded from
    std::wstring name, version, android, variant;
    std::uint32_t minWindowsBuild = 0;
    std::vector<Component> components;
    std::string raw;        // the manifest as loaded
    std::string catalog;    // manifest.cat next to it, when there is one
    bool official = false;  // the catalog is signed by WSA-Next's publisher and lists the manifest

    [[nodiscard]] const Component* Find(std::wstring_view id) const;
};

// Resolves `relative` against the URL of the manifest ("a/b/manifest.json" + "x.zst" = "a/b/x.zst").
std::wstring ResolveUrl(const std::wstring& base, const std::wstring& relative);

Result<Manifest> ParseManifest(std::string_view utf8, const std::wstring& url);
Result<Manifest> LoadManifest(const std::wstring& url, std::stop_token stop);

}  // namespace WN::Core
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "core/Release.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Sha256.h"
#include "support/Signature.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <wincrypt.h>
#include <winioctl.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <SoftPub.h>
#include <mscat.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cwctype>
#include <format>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "wintrust.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "bcrypt.lib")

namespace WN::Core::Release {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
namespace {

// The digest cache is machine-wide and only administrators may write it: with a user-writable
// install folder, a cache in HKCU would let any process of the user vouch for a changed disk.
const HKEY kDigestsRoot = HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE;
constexpr wchar_t kDigestsKey[] = L"Software\\KVC\\WSA-Next\\Digests";
constexpr wchar_t kMachineKey[] = L"Software\\KVC\\WSA-Next";
constexpr wchar_t kMachineParent[] = L"Software\\KVC";
constexpr wchar_t kVerdictValue[] = L"ReleaseState";
constexpr char kSha256Oid[] = "2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.1";

std::wstring Digest(std::string_view bytes) {
    Sha256 sha;
    sha.Update(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    return sha.Finish();
}

std::wstring Hex(const BYTE* data, DWORD size) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < size; ++i) out += std::format(L"{:02x}", data[i]);
    return out;
}

// A catalog member is tagged with its upper-case hex digest; its indirect data holds the digest.
// The catalog stays open without write or delete sharing meanwhile: the signature check and the
// member lookup see the same bytes, which nobody can swap in between.
bool VouchesFile(const fs::path& catalog, std::string_view manifest) {
    const FileHandle locked(CreateFileW(catalog.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, nullptr));
    if (!locked) return false;
    FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO attributes{};
    if (!GetFileInformationByHandleEx(locked.get(), FileAttributeTagInfo, &attributes, sizeof attributes) || (attributes.FileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT))
        return false;  // a link, not a catalog
    if (Signature::CheckFile(catalog.c_str(), locked.get()) != Signature::Origin::Official) return false;
    const std::wstring digest = Digest(manifest);
    std::wstring tag = digest;
    std::ranges::transform(tag, tag.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c)); });

    HANDLE cat = CryptCATOpen(const_cast<LPWSTR>(catalog.c_str()), CRYPTCAT_OPEN_EXISTING, 0, CRYPTCAT_VERSION_2, 0);
    if (cat == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
    bool listed = false;
    if (const CRYPTCATMEMBER* member = CryptCATGetMemberInfo(cat, tag.data()); member && member->pIndirectData) {
        const SIP_INDIRECT_DATA& data = *member->pIndirectData;
        listed = data.DigestAlgorithm.pszObjId && std::string_view(data.DigestAlgorithm.pszObjId) == kSha256Oid &&
                 Hex(data.Digest.pbData, data.Digest.cbData) == digest;
    }
    CryptCATClose(cat);
    return listed;
}

std::string ReadAll(const fs::path& path) {
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    std::stringstream text;
    text << in.rdbuf();
    return text.str();
}

Result<> WriteAll(const fs::path& path, std::string_view bytes) {
    const fs::path temp = fs::path(path).concat(L".new");
    {
        std::ofstream out(temp, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out.write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
        if (!out) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_CANNOT_CREATE_FILE, temp.wstring()));
    }
    if (!MoveFileExW(temp.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CANNOT_CREATE_FILE, path.wstring()), GetLastError()));
    return {};
}

// What identifies a file's content without reading it. The change time alone is not enough:
// whoever may write a file may also set its change time back (FileBasicInfo). The USN - the
// file's last record in the NTFS change journal - moves with every change, closing a handle
// included, and nobody can set it. Without a journal there is no identity: the file is read.
struct Identity {
    ULONGLONG volume = 0;
    FILE_ID_128 id{};
    LONGLONG size = 0;
    LONGLONG changed = 0;
    LONGLONG usn = 0;
};

struct Remembered {
    Identity identity;
    wchar_t digest[64];
};

bool IdentityOf(HANDLE file, Identity& out) {
    FILE_ID_INFO id{};
    FILE_BASIC_INFO basic{};
    FILE_STANDARD_INFO standard{};
    if (!GetFileInformationByHandleEx(file, FileIdInfo, &id, sizeof id) || !GetFileInformationByHandleEx(file, FileBasicInfo, &basic, sizeof basic) ||
        !GetFileInformationByHandleEx(file, FileStandardInfo, &standard, sizeof standard))
        return false;
    // FSCTL_READ_FILE_USN_DATA answers with a USN record: version 2 (NTFS, 64-bit file references)
    // or version 3 (ReFS, 128-bit ones - Usn sits further on). Anything else: no identity.
    alignas(8) BYTE record[1024]{};
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(file, FSCTL_READ_FILE_USN_DATA, nullptr, 0, record, sizeof record, &returned, nullptr) ||
        returned < sizeof(USN_RECORD_COMMON_HEADER))
        return false;
    const auto* header = reinterpret_cast<const USN_RECORD_COMMON_HEADER*>(record);
    if (header->MajorVersion == 2 && returned >= sizeof(USN_RECORD_V2)) out.usn = reinterpret_cast<const USN_RECORD_V2*>(record)->Usn;
    else if (header->MajorVersion == 3 && returned >= sizeof(USN_RECORD_V3)) out.usn = reinterpret_cast<const USN_RECORD_V3*>(record)->Usn;
    else return false;
    out.volume = id.VolumeSerialNumber;
    out.id = id.FileId;
    out.size = standard.EndOfFile.QuadPart;
    out.changed = basic.ChangeTime.QuadPart;
    return out.usn != 0;
}

bool Same(const Identity& a, const Identity& b) {
    return a.volume == b.volume && std::ranges::equal(a.id.Identifier, b.id.Identifier) && a.size == b.size && a.changed == b.changed &&
           a.usn == b.usn;
}

std::wstring CacheName(const fs::path& path) {
    std::wstring name = path.lexically_normal().wstring();
    std::ranges::transform(name, name.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(c)); });
    return name;
}

// The file's SHA-256: remembered when the file is the same, otherwise read (at background I/O
// priority) and remembered. Empty when unreadable or canceled.
std::wstring FileDigest(const fs::path& path, const std::function<bool()>& canceled) {
    // No write sharing while reading: the bytes digested are the bytes of the identity remembered.
    const FileHandle file(CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
    if (!file) return {};
    Identity identity;
    const bool identified = IdentityOf(file.get(), identity);

    const std::wstring name = CacheName(path);
    Remembered remembered{};
    DWORD size = sizeof remembered;
    if (identified && RegGetValueW(kDigestsRoot, kDigestsKey, name.c_str(), RRF_RT_REG_BINARY, nullptr, &remembered, &size) == ERROR_SUCCESS &&
        size == sizeof remembered && Same(remembered.identity, identity))
        return std::wstring(remembered.digest, 64);

    Sha256 sha;
    std::vector<char> block(1 << 20);
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_MODE_BACKGROUND_BEGIN);
    bool complete = sha.ok();
    for (DWORD read = 0; complete;) {
        if (canceled && canceled()) complete = false;
        else if (!ReadFile(file.get(), block.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(block.size()), &read, nullptr)) complete = false;
        else if (read == 0) break;
        else sha.Update(block.data(), read);
    }
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_MODE_BACKGROUND_END);
    if (!complete) return {};
    const std::wstring digest = sha.Finish();
    if (identified && digest.size() == 64) {
        remembered.identity = identity;
        std::ranges::copy(digest, remembered.digest);
        RegSetKeyValueW(kDigestsRoot, kDigestsKey, name.c_str(), REG_BINARY, &remembered, sizeof remembered);
    }
    return digest;
}

}  // namespace

bool Vouches(std::string_view catalog, std::string_view manifest) {
    if (catalog.empty() || manifest.empty() || catalog.size() > (16u << 20)) return false;
    // Windows recognizes a catalog by its extension. The temporary folder is the user's: the name
    // is random and created here (CREATE_NEW fails on anything already there, a planted link too).
    wchar_t folder[MAX_PATH]{};
    BYTE random[16]{};
    if (!GetTempPathW(MAX_PATH, folder) ||
        !BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptGenRandom(nullptr, random, sizeof random, BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG)))
        return false;
    const fs::path path = fs::path(folder) / (L"wsn-" + Hex(random, sizeof random) + L".cat");
    bool written = false;
    {
        const FileHandle out(CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TEMPORARY | FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, nullptr));
        if (!out) return false;
        DWORD done = 0;
        written = WriteFile(out.get(), catalog.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(catalog.size()), &done, nullptr) && done == catalog.size();
    }
    const bool vouches = written && VouchesFile(path, manifest);
    DeleteFileW(path.c_str());
    return vouches;
}

void Remember(const fs::path& path, const std::wstring& digest) {
    if (digest.size() != 64) return;
    // Opened without write sharing: nobody changes the file while its identity is read.
    const FileHandle file(CreateFileW(path.c_str(), FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
    Remembered remembered{};
    if (!file || !IdentityOf(file.get(), remembered.identity)) return;
    std::ranges::copy(digest, remembered.digest);
    RegSetKeyValueW(kDigestsRoot, kDigestsKey, CacheName(path).c_str(), REG_BINARY, &remembered, sizeof remembered);
}

Result<> Record(const fs::path& folder, const Manifest& manifest) {
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!manifest.official) {
        fs::remove(folder / kInstalledManifest, ec);
        fs::remove(folder / kInstalledCatalog, ec);
        return {};
    }
    if (auto r = WriteAll(folder / kInstalledManifest, manifest.raw); !r) return r;
    return WriteAll(folder / kInstalledCatalog, manifest.catalog);
}

State VerifyInstalled(const fs::path& folder, const std::function<bool()>& canceled) {
    std::error_code ec;
    if (folder.empty() || !fs::is_directory(folder, ec)) return State::Missing;
    const std::string raw = ReadAll(folder / kInstalledManifest);
    if (raw.empty() || !VouchesFile(folder / kInstalledCatalog, raw)) return State::Unsigned;
    const auto manifest = ParseManifest(raw, (folder / kInstalledManifest).wstring());
    if (!manifest) return State::Unsigned;

    bool checked = false;
    for (const Component& c : manifest->components) {
        if (c.kind == ComponentKind::Archive) continue;  // Microsoft's part of the package
        const fs::path file = folder / c.target;
        if (c.optional && !fs::exists(file, ec)) continue;
        if (c.sha256.empty()) return State::Unsigned;  // a release from before the digests
        const std::wstring digest = FileDigest(file, canceled);
        if (canceled && canceled()) return State::Unknown;
        if (digest != c.sha256) return State::Modified;
        checked = true;
    }
    return checked ? State::Official : State::Unsigned;
}

bool ForgetDigests() {
    const bool removed = RegDeleteTreeW(kDigestsRoot, kDigestsKey) == ERROR_SUCCESS;
    RegDeleteKeyW(kDigestsRoot, kDigestsKey);
    RegDeleteKeyW(kDigestsRoot, kMachineKey);     // only when empty
    RegDeleteKeyW(kDigestsRoot, kMachineParent);  // only when no other KVC tool keeps a key there
    return removed;
}

State HostVerdict() { return static_cast<State>(Settings::ReadDword(kVerdictValue, 0)); }
void SetHostVerdict(State state) { Settings::WriteDword(kVerdictValue, static_cast<DWORD>(state)); }

}  // namespace WN::Core::Release
```

`src/core/Release.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Official WSA-Next releases. A release is official when a catalog signed by WSA-Next's publisher
// (manifest.cat, next to manifest.json) lists the SHA-256 of its manifest. The manifest lists the
// SHA-256 of every Android disk and boot file as installed, so the signature also vouches for the
// images in the install folder:
//
//   - an official WSA-Next.exe installs official releases only;
//   - its background host serves Bluetooth and Windows Hello only to an official release that
//     nobody changed after installing it.
//
// A repackaged image (other branding, other files) is a different image: WSA-Next does not lend
// its features to it.
#pragma once
#include "core/Manifest.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <string_view>

namespace WN::Core::Release {

inline constexpr wchar_t kCatalogAsset[] = L"manifest.cat";       // next to manifest.json
inline constexpr wchar_t kInstalledManifest[] = L"release.json";  // in the install folder
inline constexpr wchar_t kInstalledCatalog[] = L"release.cat";

// Whether `catalog` (a catalog file's bytes) is signed by the publisher and lists `manifest`.
[[nodiscard]] bool Vouches(std::string_view catalog, std::string_view manifest);

// Keeps the installed release's manifest and catalog in the install folder (removes them when
// the release is not official).
Result<> Record(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const Manifest& manifest);

enum class State : DWORD {
    Unknown = 0,
    Official = 1,   // the publisher's release, unchanged
    Checking = 2,   // the host is reading the images (first start after installing)
    Unsigned = 3,   // not an official release (or installed by something else)
    Modified = 4,   // an official release whose files were changed afterwards
    Missing = 5,    // no WSA installed
};

// Whether the package folder holds an official release, unchanged. Each file's digest is
// remembered (HKLM, administrators only) with its identity - volume, file ID, size, change time
// and its NTFS change journal USN, which nobody can set back: only new or changed files are read
// again, and a volume without a change journal is always read. `canceled` is polled between blocks.
[[nodiscard]] State VerifyInstalled(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const std::function<bool()>& canceled);

// Remembers `digest` for the file at `path` as it is now, so that the host does not read it again.
// Only for a folder that only administrators may change (the installer took the digest while it
// wrote the file; in a folder the user may write, the file could have changed since).
void Remember(const std::filesystem::path& path, const std::wstring& digest);

// Removes the digest cache (HKLM, administrators only) on a total removal.
bool ForgetDigests();

// The host's latest verdict for the GUI (HKCU, written by the host).
[[nodiscard]] State HostVerdict();
void SetHostVerdict(State state);

}  // namespace WN::Core::Release
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "core/System.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include "support/Wmi.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <format>

namespace WN::Core {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kCurrentVersion[] = L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion";
constexpr wchar_t kAppModelUnlock[] = L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\AppModelUnlock";

std::wstring RegString(const wchar_t* key, const wchar_t* name) {
    DWORD bytes = 0;
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key, name, RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, nullptr, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS || bytes < 2) return {};
    std::wstring value(bytes / sizeof(wchar_t), L'\0');
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key, name, RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, value.data(), &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return {};
    value.resize(wcsnlen(value.c_str(), value.size()));
    return value;
}

DWORD RegDword(const wchar_t* key, const wchar_t* name, DWORD fallback) {
    DWORD value = 0, bytes = sizeof value;
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key, name, RRF_RT_REG_DWORD, nullptr, &value, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return fallback;
    return value;
}

// RtlGetVersion is not subject to the manifest-based version lie of GetVersionEx.
RTL_OSVERSIONINFOW RealVersion() {
    RTL_OSVERSIONINFOW info{sizeof info};
    using Fn = LONG(WINAPI*)(RTL_OSVERSIONINFOW*);
    if (const HMODULE ntdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll"))
        if (const auto fn = reinterpret_cast<Fn>(GetProcAddress(ntdll, "RtlGetVersion"))) fn(&info);
    return info;
}

std::optional<bool> FeatureEnabled(const wchar_t* name) {
    const Wmi::ComScope com;
    auto svc = Wmi::Service::Connect(L"ROOT\\CIMV2");
    if (!svc) return std::nullopt;
    auto rows = svc->Query(std::format(L"SELECT InstallState FROM Win32_OptionalFeature WHERE Name = '{}'", Wmi::Quote(name)));
    if (!rows || rows->empty()) return std::nullopt;
    const auto state = Wmi::GetU32((*rows)[0].get(), L"InstallState");
    if (!state) return std::nullopt;
    return *state == 1;  // 1 enabled, 2 disabled, 3 absent
}

}  // namespace

bool SystemInfo::Supported() const { return build >= Config::kMinWindowsBuild; }
bool SystemInfo::NeedsPatch() const { return build >= Config::kPatchFromBuild; }

std::wstring SystemInfo::Version() const {
    std::wstring name = edition.empty() ? std::wstring(L"Windows") : edition;
    // The registry still says "Windows 10" in ProductName on Windows 11.
    if (build >= 22000 && name.starts_with(L"Windows 10")) name.replace(8, 2, L"11");
    if (!displayVersion.empty()) name += L" " + displayVersion;
    return std::format(L"{} ({}.{})", name, build, revision);
}

SystemInfo Inspect() {
    SystemInfo info;
    const RTL_OSVERSIONINFOW v = RealVersion();
    info.build = v.dwBuildNumber;
    info.revision = RegDword(kCurrentVersion, L"UBR", 0);
    info.edition = RegString(kCurrentVersion, L"ProductName");
    info.displayVersion = RegString(kCurrentVersion, L"DisplayVersion");
    info.virtualMachinePlatform = FeatureEnabled(L"VirtualMachinePlatform");
    info.developerMode = RegDword(kAppModelUnlock, L"AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense", 0) != 0;
    info.package = Install::FindWsa();
    if (!info.package) info.otherUser = Install::FindWsaOfOtherUser();
    return info;
}

Result<> EnableDeveloperMode() {
    const DWORD one = 1;
    const LSTATUS s = RegSetKeyValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, kAppModelUnlock, L"AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense", REG_DWORD, &one, sizeof one);
    if (s != ERROR_SUCCESS) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_DEVMODE), static_cast<unsigned long>(s)));
    return {};
}

Result<> DisableDeveloperMode() {
    const DWORD zero = 0;
    const LSTATUS s = RegSetKeyValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, kAppModelUnlock, L"AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense", REG_DWORD, &zero, sizeof zero);
    if (s != ERROR_SUCCESS) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_DEVMODE), static_cast<unsigned long>(s)));
    return {};
}

namespace {

// "dism.exe /online /<verb>-feature /featurename:VirtualMachinePlatform"; true = Windows must restart.
Result<bool> VirtualMachinePlatform(bool enable, const LogFn& log) {
    wchar_t system[MAX_PATH]{};
    GetSystemDirectoryW(system, MAX_PATH);
    const std::wstring dism = std::format(L"{}\\dism.exe", system);
    std::wstring command = std::format(L"\"{}\" /online /{}-feature /featurename:VirtualMachinePlatform{} /norestart /quiet", dism,
                                       enable ? L"enable" : L"disable", enable ? L" /all" : L"");
    STARTUPINFOW si{sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
    log(Text::Get(enable ? IDS_LOG_ENABLE_VMP : IDS_LOG_DISABLE_VMP));
    if (!CreateProcessW(dism.c_str(), command.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_VMP), GetLastError()));
    const KernelHandle process(pi.hProcess), thread(pi.hThread);
    WaitForSingleObject(process.get(), INFINITE);
    DWORD code = 0;
    GetExitCodeProcess(process.get(), &code);
    if (code == ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED) return true;
    if (code != 0) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_VMP), code));
    return false;
}

}  // namespace

Result<bool> EnableVirtualMachinePlatform(const LogFn& log) { return VirtualMachinePlatform(true, log); }
Result<bool> DisableVirtualMachinePlatform(const LogFn& log) { return VirtualMachinePlatform(false, log); }

unsigned WslDistributions() {
    HKEY raw = nullptr;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, L"Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Lxss", 0, KEY_READ, &raw) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return 0;
    const RegKey key(raw);
    DWORD subKeys = 0;
    if (RegQueryInfoKeyW(key.get(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, &subKeys, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr) !=
        ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return 0;
    return subKeys;
}

}  // namespace WN::Core
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// What this Windows offers WSA: version, the Virtual Machine Platform feature, developer mode
// (needed to register an unpacked package) and the WSA package already registered, if any.
#pragma once
#include "install/Package.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace WN::Core {

struct SystemInfo {
    std::uint32_t build = 0, revision = 0;  // 26100.4061
    std::wstring edition;                    // "Windows 11 Pro"
    std::wstring displayVersion;             // "24H2"
    std::optional<bool> virtualMachinePlatform;  // nullopt: could not be read
    bool developerMode = false;
    std::optional<Install::PackageInfo> package;
    // Without a package of its own: WSA registered for another Windows user (one user at a time).
    std::optional<Install::OtherRegistration> otherUser;

    [[nodiscard]] bool Supported() const;      // Windows 11
    [[nodiscard]] bool NeedsPatch() const;     // build >= Config::kPatchFromBuild
    [[nodiscard]] std::wstring Version() const;  // "Windows 11 Pro 24H2 (26100.4061)"
};

// Reads everything above. Blocking (WMI, package manager): call it on a worker thread.
SystemInfo Inspect();

// Turns developer mode on (HKLM AppModelUnlock, administrator).
Result<> EnableDeveloperMode();

// Enables the Virtual Machine Platform feature with DISM; true = Windows must restart.
Result<bool> EnableVirtualMachinePlatform(const LogFn& log);

// The reverse, for a total removal of what WSA-Next turned on.
Result<> DisableDeveloperMode();
Result<bool> DisableVirtualMachinePlatform(const LogFn& log);
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "core/Uninstall.h"
#include "core/Release.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "biometrics/Protocol.h"
#include "bluetooth/Bridge.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "install/Package.h"
#include "install/Setup.h"
#include "install/Traces.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>
#include <fstream>
#include <set>
#include <sstream>

namespace WN::Core {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
namespace {

// Added by Windows to a folder it registers a package from (resources compiled for the package).
constexpr wchar_t kPackageMetadata[] = L"microsoft.system.package.metadata";

fs::path Normalized(const fs::path& folder) {
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::path p = fs::absolute(folder, ec).lexically_normal();
    if (!p.has_filename() && p.has_relative_path()) p = p.parent_path();  // "...\WSA-Next\" -> "...\WSA-Next"
    return p;
}

bool IsWsaNext(const Install::PackageInfo& package) {
    std::error_code ec;
    return package.developmentMode && fs::exists(package.location / Config::kStateFile, ec);
}

// "...\WSA-Next" holding the WSA package manifest: a folder WSA-Next created for itself.
bool OwnFolder(const fs::path& folder) {
    if (_wcsicmp(folder.filename().c_str(), Config::kInstallFolder) != 0) return false;
    std::ifstream in(folder / Config::kPackageManifest, std::ios::binary);
    std::stringstream text;
    text << in.rdbuf();
    return text.str().find(std::format("Name=\"{}\"", ToUtf8(Config::kPackageName))) != std::string::npos;
}

// A name directly inside the folder. wsa-next.json can be edited by whoever may write the folder,
// and the removal runs elevated: no paths, no "..".
bool PlainName(std::wstring_view name) {
    return !name.empty() && name != L"." && name != L".." && name.find_first_of(L"\\/:") == std::wstring_view::npos;
}

// A running executable cannot be deleted: when `path` is this program (the installed copy runs
// the removal), it goes at the next restart.
bool ScheduleIfSelf(const fs::path& path) {
    std::error_code ec;
    return fs::equivalent(path, fs::path(ModulePath()), ec) && MoveFileExW(path.c_str(), nullptr, MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT);
}

std::wstring Join(const std::vector<std::wstring>& items) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (const auto& item : items) out += (out.empty() ? L"" : L", ") + item;
    return out;
}

// The install folder: what the installer wrote into it (wsa-next.json lists it), what Windows adds
// to a registered package folder, the downloads; then the folder itself when nothing else is left.
// Installations from before the list existed are removed whole when the folder is WSA-Next's own.
// `setupOwnsProgram`: WSA-Next Setup installed WSA-Next.exe and its language files, and Windows
// Installer removes them (and the folder) after this.
void RemoveFolder(const fs::path& folder, const InstalledState& state, const Callbacks& cb, RemovalOutcome& outcome, bool setupOwnsProgram) {
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!fs::is_directory(folder, ec)) return;
    std::set<std::wstring> names;
    for (const auto& [id, list] : state.entries) names.insert(list.begin(), list.end());
    if (!state.EntriesComplete()) {
        if (OwnFolder(folder)) {
            for (fs::directory_iterator it(folder, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec)) names.insert(it->path().filename().wstring());
        } else {
            cb.log(Level::Warning, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_FOLDER_UNKNOWN, folder.wstring()));
        }
    }
    std::set<std::wstring> all{Config::kStateFile, std::wstring(Config::kStateFile) + L".new", Config::kDownloadFolder, kPackageMetadata};
    for (const auto& name : names) {
        all.insert(name);
        all.insert(name + L".new");  // left by an interrupted unpacking
    }
    if (setupOwnsProgram) {
        for (const wchar_t* program : {Config::kExeName, L"language"}) {
            all.erase(program);
            all.erase(std::wstring(program) + L".new");
        }
    }
    const std::uint64_t before = Install::FolderSize(folder);
    bool selfScheduled = false;
    for (const auto& name : all) {
        if (!PlainName(name)) continue;
        const fs::path path = folder / name;
        if (ScheduleIfSelf(path)) {
            selfScheduled = true;
        } else if (auto r = Install::DeleteWithRetry(path); !r) {
            outcome.leftovers.push_back(path.wstring());
            cb.log(Level::Warning, r.error());
        }
    }
    const std::uint64_t after = Install::FolderSize(folder);
    cb.log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_FILES_REMOVED, folder.wstring(), FormatBytes(before - std::min(before, after))));
    if (selfScheduled) {
        MoveFileExW(folder.c_str(), nullptr, MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT);  // empty by then
    } else if (!RemoveDirectoryW(folder.c_str()) && fs::exists(folder, ec) &&
               !(setupOwnsProgram && fs::equivalent(folder, HostFolder(), ec))) {
        cb.log(Level::Warning, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_FOLDER_KEPT, folder.wstring()));
    }
}

// The background host's copy in %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next when Android was installed elsewhere
// (otherwise the install folder's list holds it): WSA-Next.exe, its language files, the folder
// when nothing else is in it.
void RemoveHostCopy(const fs::path& folder, const Callbacks& cb, RemovalOutcome& outcome) {
    const fs::path host = HostFolder();
    std::error_code ec;
    if (fs::equivalent(Normalized(folder), host, ec) || !fs::exists(host / Config::kExeName, ec)) return;
    const fs::path exe = host / Config::kExeName;
    const bool selfScheduled = ScheduleIfSelf(exe);
    if (!selfScheduled) {
        if (auto r = Install::DeleteWithRetry(exe); !r) {
            outcome.leftovers.push_back(exe.wstring());
            cb.log(Level::Warning, r.error());
        }
    }
    const fs::path languages = host / L"language";
    for (fs::directory_iterator it(languages, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec))
        if (it->path().extension() == L".lng") DeleteFileW(it->path().c_str());
    RemoveDirectoryW(languages.c_str());
    if (selfScheduled) MoveFileExW(host.c_str(), nullptr, MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT);
    else RemoveDirectoryW(host.c_str());
}

// When its package is removed, WSA deletes the Start menu shortcuts, "Installed apps" entries,
// associations and icons of the Android apps, but keeps the marker that says it has created them
// ("pl-PL;" - the languages they were created for). With the Android data kept, the next
// installation would start without any of them. Without the marker WSA creates them again on its
// first start.
void ForgetPopulatedApps(const fs::path& data) {
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove(data / L"LocalState" / L"language_list_for_populated_apps", ec);
}

// HKCU\Software\KVC\WSA-Next, and HKCU\Software\KVC when no other KVC tool keeps anything in it.
void RemoveSettings(const Callbacks& cb) {
    Release::ForgetDigests();  // the background host's digest cache (HKLM)
    if (RegDeleteTreeW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        RegDeleteKeyW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey);
        cb.log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_SETTINGS_REMOVED, Config::kRegKey));
    }
    RegKey parent;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegParent, 0, KEY_READ, parent.put()) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return;
    DWORD keys = 1, values = 1;
    RegQueryInfoKeyW(parent.get(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, &keys, nullptr, nullptr, &values, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
    parent.reset();
    if (keys == 0 && values == 0) RegDeleteKeyW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegParent);
}

}  // namespace

bool Removable(const fs::path& folder, const SystemInfo& system) {
    std::error_code ec;
    return (system.package && IsWsaNext(*system.package)) || fs::exists(folder / Config::kStateFile, ec);
}

Result<RemovalOutcome> Uninstall(const fs::path& requested, Removal mode, const Callbacks& cb) {
    RemovalOutcome outcome;
    const bool everything = mode == Removal::Everything;
    auto log = [&](Level level, std::wstring text) { cb.log(level, std::move(text)); };
    auto info = [&](std::wstring text) { cb.log(Level::Info, std::move(text)); };
    auto warn = [&](std::wstring text) {
        outcome.leftovers.push_back(text);
        cb.log(Level::Warning, std::move(text));
    };
    auto phase = [&](UINT text, int permille = -1) {
        Progress p;
        p.phase = Text::Get(text);
        p.permille = permille;
        cb.progress(p);
    };

    phase(IDS_PHASE_CHECKING);
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::path folder = Normalized(requested);
    const auto package = Install::FindWsa();
    if (package && IsWsaNext(*package)) folder = Normalized(package->location);  // the installation that is registered
    const bool ours = package && package->developmentMode && fs::equivalent(package->location, folder, ec);
    const InstalledState state = ReadState(folder);
    const bool files = fs::exists(folder / Config::kStateFile, ec);
    if (!ours && !files && !everything) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_UNINSTALL_NOTHING, folder.wstring()));
    if (package && !ours) log(Level::Warning, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_FOREIGN_PACKAGE, package->version, package->location.wstring()));
    // WSA registered from this folder for another Windows user (Windows lets one user at a time
    // register an unpacked package): its files, its host's logon task and what it needs in Windows
    // stay - removing them would leave that user a registration without files. That user removes
    // it on their own account. (WSA-Next Setup still removes its program: their WSA keeps running.)
    std::optional<Install::OtherRegistration> other;
    if (!ours) {
        other = Install::FindWsaOfOtherUser();
        if (other && !other->location.empty() && !fs::equivalent(Normalized(other->location), folder, ec)) other.reset();
        if (other) log(Level::Warning, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_OTHER_USER_KEPT, other->user, folder.wstring()));
    }

    // 1. The background host (Bluetooth and Windows Hello for Android) runs WSA-Next.exe from the
    //    install folder: it stops, and stops starting at logon (also the task name of the first
    //    test builds), in both ways of removing.
    const bool hostWasRunning = Host::Running(), hostWasAutostart = Host::AutostartEnabled();
    Host::Stop();
    if (!other) {
        if (auto r = Host::SetAutostart(false); !r && hostWasAutostart) warn(r.error());
    }

    // 2. The package. WSA is shut down first: its disks are about to go.
    const fs::path data = Install::PackageDataFolder();
    if (ours) {
        phase(IDS_PHASE_UNREGISTER);
        Install::Shutdown(folder, info);
        if (auto r = Install::Unregister(*package, !everything); !r) return Fail(r.error());
        if (everything) {
            log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_UNREGISTERED_ALL));
        } else {
            if (!data.empty()) ForgetPopulatedApps(data);
            log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_UNREGISTERED_KEEP, data.wstring(), FormatBytes(Install::FolderSize(data))));
        }
    }

    // 3. The install folder (this program too, when it runs from there: it goes at the next restart),
    //    except what WSA-Next Setup installed: Windows Installer removes that.
    phase(IDS_PHASE_REMOVE_FILES);
    const bool setupOwnsProgram = Install::SetupProduct().has_value();
    if (!other) RemoveFolder(folder, state, cb, outcome, setupOwnsProgram);
    if (!setupOwnsProgram && !other) RemoveHostCopy(folder, cb, outcome);
    if (!everything) {
        phase(IDS_PHASE_DONE, 1000);
        return outcome;
    }

    // 4. The Android data and everything WSA left in Windows - unless another WSA owns them.
    phase(IDS_PHASE_CLEANUP);
    const bool foreign = package && !ours;
    if (foreign) {
        log(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_TRACES_KEPT));
    } else {
        // This user's Android data is this user's own, also when another user's WSA stays.
        if (!data.empty() && fs::exists(data, ec)) {
            const std::uint64_t size = Install::FolderSize(data);
            if (auto r = Install::DeleteWithRetry(data)) log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_PACKAGE_DATA, data.wstring(), FormatBytes(size)));
            else warn(r.error());
        }
        if (!other) {
            const Install::TraceReport report = Install::RemoveTraces(folder, warn);
            log(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_TRACES, report.shortcuts, report.keys, report.values));
        }
    }

    // 5. What WSA-Next turned on in Windows, unless something else needs it now.
    const std::wstring otherWsa = other ? std::format(L"WSA ({})", other->user) : std::wstring();
    if (Settings::ReadDword(Config::kEnabledDeveloperMode, 0)) {
        if (other) log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_DEVMODE_KEPT, otherWsa));
        else if (const auto others = Install::OtherDevelopmentPackages(); !others.empty()) log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_DEVMODE_KEPT, Join(others)));
        else if (auto r = DisableDeveloperMode()) log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_DEVMODE_OFF));
        else warn(r.error());
    }
    if (Settings::ReadDword(Config::kEnabledVmp, 0)) {
        if (WslDistributions() > 0) log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_VMP_KEPT, L"WSL"));
        else if (other) log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_VMP_KEPT, otherWsa));
        else if (foreign) log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_VMP_KEPT, std::format(L"WSA {}", package->version)));
        else if (auto r = DisableVirtualMachinePlatform(info)) {
            outcome.restartNeeded = *r;
            log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_VMP_OFF));
        } else {
            warn(r.error());
        }
    }

    // 6. What the bridges left: Hyper-V socket service registrations of test builds, the log folder.
    const bool bluetoothService = Guest::RemoveLegacyServiceRegistration(Bt::kBridgePort);
    const bool helloService = Guest::RemoveLegacyServiceRegistration(Bio::kBridgePort);
    bool logs = false;
    if (const fs::path logFolder = Bt::LogFolder(); !logFolder.empty() && fs::exists(logFolder, ec)) {
        if (auto r = Install::DeleteWithRetry(logFolder, 5)) logs = true;
        else warn(r.error());
    }
    if (hostWasRunning || hostWasAutostart || bluetoothService || helloService || logs) log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_BLUETOOTH_REMOVED));

    // 7. WSA-Next's own settings.
    RemoveSettings(cb);
    phase(IDS_PHASE_DONE, 1000);
    return outcome;
}

}  // namespace WN::Core
```

`src/core/Uninstall.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Removing WSA-Next, in one of two ways:
//
//   KeepData    the package registration and the install folder go. The Android data disk in the
//               user's profile (apps, accounts, files) and WSA-Next's settings stay, so the next
//               installation continues where this one ended. WSA itself takes the Windows entries
//               of Android apps (Start menu, Installed apps, associations) away with its package;
//               the next start creates them again (see ForgetPopulatedApps in Uninstall.cpp).
//   Everything  also the Android data, everything WSA left in Windows (install/Traces.h), the
//               settings of WSA-Next, and developer mode / Virtual Machine Platform when WSA-Next
//               turned them on. After WSA was removed through Windows Settings this still finds
//               and removes what was left behind.
//
// A WSA package registered from somewhere else (the Microsoft Store, another unpacked build) is
// never touched, and neither is what belongs to it.
#pragma once
#include "core/Install.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Core {

enum class Removal { KeepData, Everything };

struct RemovalOutcome {
    bool restartNeeded = false;           // Virtual Machine Platform was disabled
    std::vector<std::wstring> leftovers;  // what could not be removed (each one is also logged)
};

// `folder` is where WSA-Next was installed; when the registered WSA package is a WSA-Next one from
// another folder, that folder is used. Blocking (package manager): call it on a worker thread with
// COM initialized (multithreaded apartment). Progress is indeterminate (phases only).
Result<RemovalOutcome> Uninstall(const std::filesystem::path& folder, Removal mode, const Callbacks& cb);

// Whether there is anything to remove for `folder` (a WSA-Next package or installed files).
bool Removable(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const SystemInfo& system);

}  // namespace WN::Core

```
