```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "gui/Theme.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <CommCtrl.h>
#include <ShObjIdl.h>
#include <uxtheme.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <unordered_map>

#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")

namespace WN::Ui {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kClass[] = L"WSANext.Dialog";
constexpr int kExtra = 3, kFieldBase = 100, kBrowseBase = 200, kMonospace = 300;

Gdi<HFONT> MakeGdiFont(const Fonts& f, const wchar_t* family, float pixels) {
    return Gdi<HFONT>(CreateFontW(-static_cast<int>(f.F(pixels) + 0.5f), 0, 0, 0, FW_NORMAL, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, DEFAULT_CHARSET,
                                  OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLEARTYPE_QUALITY, DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_DONTCARE, family));
}

std::optional<std::wstring> BrowseFile(HWND owner, const wchar_t* filter, const std::wstring& current) {
    ComPtr<IFileOpenDialog> dialog;
    if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_FileOpenDialog, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(dialog.GetAddressOf()))))
        return std::nullopt;
    std::vector<COMDLG_FILTERSPEC> specs;
    for (const wchar_t* p = filter; p && *p;) {
        const wchar_t* name = p;
        p += wcslen(p) + 1;
        const wchar_t* pattern = p;
        p += wcslen(p) + 1;
        specs.push_back({name, pattern});
    }
    if (!specs.empty()) dialog->SetFileTypes(static_cast<UINT>(specs.size()), specs.data());
    DWORD options = 0;
    dialog->GetOptions(&options);
    dialog->SetOptions(options | FOS_FILEMUSTEXIST | FOS_FORCEFILESYSTEM);
    if (!current.empty() && current.find(L"://") == std::wstring::npos) {
        ComPtr<IShellItem> folder;
        const std::wstring dir = current.substr(0, current.find_last_of(L"\\/"));
        if (SUCCEEDED(SHCreateItemFromParsingName(dir.c_str(), nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(folder.GetAddressOf()))))
            dialog->SetFolder(folder.Get());
    }
    if (FAILED(dialog->Show(owner))) return std::nullopt;
    ComPtr<IShellItem> item;
    if (FAILED(dialog->GetResult(item.GetAddressOf()))) return std::nullopt;
    PWSTR path = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(item->GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH, &path)) || !path) return std::nullopt;
    std::wstring result(path);
    CoTaskMemFree(path);
    return result;
}

class Dialog {
public:
    Dialog(HWND owner, const DialogSpec& spec) : m_owner(owner), m_spec(spec) {}

    DialogResult Run() {
        RegisterOnce();
        m_fonts.Create(GetDpiForWindow(m_owner));
        m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME, kClass, Config::kAppTitle, WS_POPUP | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU | WS_CLIPCHILDREN,
                                 0, 0, 100, 100, m_owner, nullptr, GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), this);
        if (!m_hwnd) return {};
        const bool ownerWasEnabled = !EnableWindow(m_owner, FALSE);
        ShowWindow(m_hwnd, SW_SHOW);
        if (!m_edits.empty()) {
            SetFocus(m_edits.front());
            SendMessageW(m_edits.front(), EM_SETSEL, 0, -1);
        } else {
            SetFocus(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, m_spec.cancelButton ? IDCANCEL : IDOK));
        }
        MSG msg;
        while (!m_done) {
            const BOOL got = GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0);
            if (got <= 0) {
                if (got == 0) PostQuitMessage(static_cast<int>(msg.wParam));
                break;
            }
            if (!IsDialogMessageW(m_hwnd, &msg)) {
                TranslateMessage(&msg);
                DispatchMessageW(&msg);
            }
        }
        if (ownerWasEnabled) EnableWindow(m_owner, TRUE);  // before destroying, so activation returns to the owner
        DestroyWindow(m_hwnd);
        return m_result;
    }

private:
    static void RegisterOnce() {
        WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
        if (GetClassInfoExW(GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), kClass, &wc)) return;
        wc.lpfnWndProc = Proc;
        wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
        wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
        wc.hbrBackground = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));
        wc.lpszClassName = kClass;
        RegisterClassExW(&wc);
    }

    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
        Dialog* self = nullptr;
        if (message == WM_NCCREATE) {
            self = static_cast<Dialog*>(reinterpret_cast<CREATESTRUCTW*>(lParam)->lpCreateParams);
            self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
            SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(self));
        } else {
            self = reinterpret_cast<Dialog*>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));
        }
        if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }

    void Build() {
        ApplyBackdrop(m_hwnd);
        auto& g = Graphics::Get();
        m_fieldBrush.reset(CreateSolidBrush(g.GdiSurface(Color::Control)));
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_spec.fields.size(); ++i) {
            const auto& field = m_spec.fields[i];
            HWND edit = CreateWindowExW(0, L"EDIT", field.value.c_str(), WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | ES_AUTOHSCROLL, 0, 0, 10,
                                        10, m_hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(kFieldBase + i)), nullptr, nullptr);
            if (!field.cue.empty()) SendMessageW(edit, EM_SETCUEBANNER, TRUE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(field.cue.c_str()));
            SendMessageW(edit, EM_SETLIMITTEXT, 4096, 0);
            m_edits.push_back(edit);
            HWND browse = nullptr;
            if (field.filter) {
                browse = CreateButton(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(kBrowseBase + i), Text::Get(IDS_BROWSE).c_str());
                m_looks[browse] = {ButtonKind::Icon, Icon::Folder, false};
            }
            m_browse.push_back(browse);
        }
        if (!m_spec.monospace.empty()) {
            m_mono = CreateWindowExW(0, L"EDIT", nullptr,
                                     WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | WS_VSCROLL | ES_MULTILINE | ES_READONLY | ES_AUTOVSCROLL, 0, 0,
                                     10, 10, m_hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(kMonospace)), nullptr, nullptr);
            SetWindowTheme(m_mono, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
            std::wstring text;
            for (wchar_t c : m_spec.monospace) {  // the EDIT control wants CRLF
                if (c == L'\n') text += L'\r';
                text += c;
            }
            SetWindowTextW(m_mono, text.c_str());
        }
        auto button = [&](int id, const std::wstring& text, ButtonKind kind) {
            HWND b = CreateButton(m_hwnd, id, text.c_str());
            m_looks[b] = {kind, 0, false};
            m_buttons.push_back(b);
        };
        if (!m_spec.extra.empty()) button(kExtra, m_spec.extra, ButtonKind::Standard);
        button(IDOK, m_spec.ok.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_OK) : m_spec.ok, ButtonKind::Accent);
        if (m_spec.cancelButton) button(IDCANCEL, m_spec.cancel.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_CANCEL) : m_spec.cancel, ButtonKind::Standard);
        Layout();
    }

    void Layout() {
        const auto& f = m_fonts;
        m_editFont = MakeGdiFont(f, f.UiFamily(), 13.0f);
        m_monoFont = MakeGdiFont(f, Graphics::Get().HasFamily(L"Cascadia Mono") ? L"Cascadia Mono" : L"Consolas", 11.5f);
        const float width = f.F(static_cast<float>(m_spec.width));
        const float pad = f.F(24), inner = width - 2 * pad;
        float y = pad;
        m_headingRect = {pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(28)};
        y += f.F(36);
        if (!m_spec.message.empty()) {
            const float h = TextHeight(f, Font::Body, m_spec.message, inner);
            m_messageRect = {pad, y, width - pad, y + h};
            y += h + f.F(16);
        }
        m_fieldRects.clear();
        m_labelRects.clear();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_edits.size(); ++i) {
            m_labelRects.push_back({pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(18)});
            y += f.F(22);
            const float browseW = m_browse[i] ? f.F(36) : 0;
            const D2D1_RECT_F box{pad, y, width - pad - (browseW ? browseW + f.F(6) : 0), y + f.F(32)};
            m_fieldRects.push_back(box);
            const int lineH = f.S(18);
            SetWindowPos(m_edits[i], nullptr, static_cast<int>(box.left + f.F(10)), static_cast<int>((box.top + box.bottom) / 2) - lineH / 2,
                         static_cast<int>(box.right - box.left - f.F(20)), lineH, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            SendMessageW(m_edits[i], WM_SETFONT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(m_editFont.get()), TRUE);
            if (m_browse[i])
                SetWindowPos(m_browse[i], nullptr, static_cast<int>(width - pad - browseW), static_cast<int>(box.top),
                             static_cast<int>(browseW), static_cast<int>(f.F(32)), SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            y += f.F(32) + f.F(12);
        }
        if (m_mono) {
            const D2D1_RECT_F box{pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(380)};
            m_monoRect = box;
            SetWindowPos(m_mono, nullptr, static_cast<int>(box.left + f.F(8)), static_cast<int>(box.top + f.F(6)),
                         static_cast<int>(box.right - box.left - f.F(10)), static_cast<int>(box.bottom - box.top - f.F(12)),
                         SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            SendMessageW(m_mono, WM_SETFONT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(m_monoFont.get()), TRUE);
            y = box.bottom + f.F(12);
        }
        m_errorRect = {pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(20)};
        y += f.F(24);
        // Footer with the buttons, right-aligned, all the same width.
        const float footer = f.F(72);
        m_footer = {0, y, width, y + footer};
        const float bw = f.F(124), bh = f.F(32);
        float x = width - pad;
        for (auto it = m_buttons.rbegin(); it != m_buttons.rend(); ++it) {
            x -= bw;
            SetWindowPos(*it, nullptr, static_cast<int>(x), static_cast<int>(y + (footer - bh) / 2), static_cast<int>(bw),
                         static_cast<int>(bh), SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            x -= f.F(8);
        }
        RECT rc{0, 0, static_cast<LONG>(width), static_cast<LONG>(y + footer)};
        AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&rc, static_cast<DWORD>(GetWindowLongPtrW(m_hwnd, GWL_STYLE)), FALSE,
                                 static_cast<DWORD>(GetWindowLongPtrW(m_hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE)), f.dpi());
        RECT owner{};
        GetWindowRect(m_owner, &owner);
        const int w = rc.right - rc.left, h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
        SetWindowPos(m_hwnd, nullptr, owner.left + (owner.right - owner.left - w) / 2, owner.top + (owner.bottom - owner.top - h) / 3, w,
                     h, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    }

    void PaintSurface() {
        PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
        RECT client{};
        GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
        const auto& f = m_fonts;
        HWND focus = GetFocus();
        Paint(
            ps.dc(), client, f,
            [&](Canvas& c) {
                c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Base());
                c.Text(m_spec.heading, m_headingRect, Font::Title, m_spec.danger ? Color::Critical : Color::Text);
                if (!m_spec.message.empty()) c.Paragraph(m_spec.message, m_messageRect, Font::Body, Color::Text2);
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_fieldRects.size(); ++i) {
                    c.Text(m_spec.fields[i].label, m_labelRects[i], Font::Caption, Color::Text2);
                    const D2D1_RECT_F& box = m_fieldRects[i];
                    c.Fill(box, Color::Control, f.F(4));
                    c.Stroke(box, Color::ControlStroke, f.F(4));
                    const bool focused = focus == m_edits[i];
                    c.Fill({box.left + f.F(1), box.bottom - f.F(focused ? 2.0f : 1.0f), box.right - f.F(1), box.bottom},
                           focused ? Color::Accent : White(0.30f));
                }
                if (m_mono) {
                    c.Fill(m_monoRect, Color::Control, f.F(4));
                    c.Stroke(m_monoRect, Color::ControlStroke, f.F(4));
                }
                if (!m_error.empty()) c.Text(m_error, m_errorRect, Font::Caption, Color::Critical);
                c.Fill(m_footer, Black(0.18f));
                c.Line({m_footer.left, m_footer.top + 0.5f}, {m_footer.right, m_footer.top + 0.5f}, White(0.06f));
            },
            [&](HDC dc) {
                // The EDIT controls paint with GDI; the padding around them is filled the same way so
                // field and control are one surface.
                for (const auto& box : m_fieldRects) {
                    const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(box.left + f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(box.top + f.F(3)),
                                 static_cast<LONG>(box.right - f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(box.bottom - f.F(3))};
                    FillRect(dc, &r, m_fieldBrush.get());
                }
                if (m_mono) {
                    const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.left + f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.top + f.F(3)),
                                 static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.right - f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.bottom - f.F(3))};
                    FillRect(dc, &r, m_fieldBrush.get());
                }
            });
    }

    void Finish(int button) {
        std::vector<std::wstring> values;
        for (HWND e : m_edits) {
            const int n = GetWindowTextLengthW(e);
            std::wstring v(static_cast<std::size_t>(n) + 1, L'\0');
            GetWindowTextW(e, v.data(), n + 1);
            v.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
            // Trim surrounding blanks and quotes (paths pasted from Explorer's "Copy as path").
            const auto first = v.find_first_not_of(L" \t\"");
            const auto last = v.find_last_not_of(L" \t\"");
            values.push_back(first == std::wstring::npos ? std::wstring() : v.substr(first, last - first + 1));
        }
        if (button == 1 && m_spec.validate) {
            if (auto error = m_spec.validate(values)) {
                m_error = *error;
                InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
                return;
            }
        }
        m_result = {button, std::move(values)};
        m_done = true;
    }

    LRESULT Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
        switch (message) {
        case WM_CREATE:
            Build();
            return 0;
        case WM_ERASEBKGND:
            return 1;
        case WM_PAINT:
            PaintSurface();
            return 0;
        case WM_DPICHANGED:
            m_fonts.Create(HIWORD(wParam));
            Layout();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
            return 0;
        case WM_CTLCOLOREDIT:
        case WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC: {
            HDC dc = reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wParam);
            SetTextColor(dc, ToColorRef(Color::Text));
            SetBkColor(dc, Graphics::Get().GdiSurface(Color::Control));
            return reinterpret_cast<LRESULT>(m_fieldBrush.get());
        }
        case WM_DRAWITEM: {
            const auto& dis = *reinterpret_cast<const DRAWITEMSTRUCT*>(lParam);
            if (auto it = m_looks.find(dis.hwndItem); it != m_looks.end()) DrawButton(dis, m_fonts, it->second);
            return TRUE;
        }
        case DM_GETDEFID:
            return MAKELRESULT(IDOK, DC_HASDEFID);
        case WM_COMMAND: {
            const int id = LOWORD(wParam), code = HIWORD(wParam);
            if (id >= kFieldBase && id < kFieldBase + 100 && (code == EN_SETFOCUS || code == EN_KILLFOCUS)) {
                InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
                return 0;
            }
            if (id >= kBrowseBase && id < kBrowseBase + 100) {
                const std::size_t i = static_cast<std::size_t>(id - kBrowseBase);
                wchar_t current[4096]{};
                GetWindowTextW(m_edits[i], current, 4096);
                if (auto path = BrowseFile(m_hwnd, m_spec.fields[i].filter, current)) SetWindowTextW(m_edits[i], path->c_str());
                return 0;
            }
            if (id == IDOK) Finish(1);
            else if (id == IDCANCEL) Finish(m_spec.cancelButton ? 0 : 1);
            else if (id == kExtra) Finish(2);
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_CLOSE:
            Finish(m_spec.cancelButton ? 0 : 1);
            return 0;
        }
        return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }

    HWND m_owner;
    const DialogSpec& m_spec;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    Fonts m_fonts;
    Gdi<HFONT> m_editFont, m_monoFont;
    Gdi<HBRUSH> m_fieldBrush;
    std::vector<HWND> m_edits, m_browse, m_buttons;
    HWND m_mono = nullptr;
    std::unordered_map<HWND, ButtonLook> m_looks;
    D2D1_RECT_F m_headingRect{}, m_messageRect{}, m_monoRect{}, m_errorRect{}, m_footer{};
    std::vector<D2D1_RECT_F> m_fieldRects, m_labelRects;
    std::wstring m_error;
    DialogResult m_result;
    bool m_done = false;
};

}  // namespace

DialogResult RunDialog(HWND owner, const DialogSpec& spec) {
    Dialog dialog(owner, spec);
    return dialog.Run();
}

bool Confirm(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message, std::wstring ok, bool danger) {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = std::move(heading);
    spec.message = std::move(message);
    spec.ok = std::move(ok);
    spec.danger = danger;
    return RunDialog(owner, spec).button == 1;
}

void Inform(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message) {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = std::move(heading);
    spec.message = std::move(message);
    spec.cancelButton = false;
    RunDialog(owner, spec);
}

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

`src/gui/Dialogs.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Modal dialogs in the same Mica style as the main window (instead of light MessageBox windows).
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Ui {

struct DialogField {
    std::wstring label;
    std::wstring value;
    std::wstring cue;           // placeholder text
    const wchar_t* filter = nullptr;  // "Name\0*.ext\0..." for the Browse button; nullptr = no button
};

struct DialogSpec {
    std::wstring heading;
    std::wstring message;       // wrapped paragraph, may be empty
    std::wstring monospace;     // scrollable read-only text block (help), may be empty
    std::vector<DialogField> fields;
    std::wstring ok;                  // empty = "OK" in the current language
    std::wstring cancel;              // empty = "Cancel" in the current language
    bool cancelButton = true;         // false: only OK (and the extra button)
    std::wstring extra;               // optional third button (result 2)
    bool danger = false;              // heading in the critical colour
    int width = 460;                  // DIP
    // Returns an error to show (the dialog stays open) or nullopt to accept the values.
    std::function<std::optional<std::wstring>(const std::vector<std::wstring>&)> validate;
};

struct DialogResult {
    int button = 0;  // 0 = cancel / closed, 1 = ok, 2 = extra
    std::vector<std::wstring> values;
};

DialogResult RunDialog(HWND owner, const DialogSpec& spec);

bool Confirm(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message, std::wstring ok, bool danger = false);
void Inform(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message);

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

`src/gui/MainWindow.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Main window: creation, message loop and window procedure.
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/HostEvents.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace WN::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

MainWindow::MainWindow(HINSTANCE instance) : m_instance(instance) {}

MainWindow::~MainWindow() {
    m_worker.request_stop();
    // jthread joins here; the window is gone, so anything the worker still posts is freed by PostOwned.
}

bool MainWindow::Create(int showCommand) {
    WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
    wc.lpfnWndProc = Proc;
    wc.hInstance = m_instance;
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));  // transparent on Mica
    wc.lpszClassName = kClassName;
    // Each size drawn from the best image in icon.ico, not a scaled 32 px one.
    LoadIconWithScaleDown(m_instance, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_APP), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXICON), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYICON), m_icon.put());
    LoadIconWithScaleDown(m_instance, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_APP), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSMICON), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSMICON),
                          m_smallIcon.put());
    wc.hIcon = m_icon ? m_icon.get() : LoadIconW(nullptr, IDI_APPLICATION);
    wc.hIconSm = m_smallIcon.get();
    if (!RegisterClassExW(&wc)) return false;
    if (!Graphics::Get().Ready()) return false;

    m_taskbarCreated = RegisterWindowMessageW(L"TaskbarButtonCreated");
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kClassName, Config::kAppTitle, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_CLIPCHILDREN, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 640,
                             720, nullptr, nullptr, m_instance, this);
    if (!m_hwnd) return false;
    RestorePlacement(showCommand);
    Log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_STARTED, Config::kAppTitle, Config::kAppVersion));
    Refresh();  // Windows and the release are read after the window is visible
    return true;
}

int MainWindow::Run() {
    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) {
        // Alt+letter opens the client-area menu bar (no native menu to do it).
        if (msg.message == WM_SYSCHAR && GetAncestor(msg.hwnd, GA_ROOT) == m_hwnd &&
            m_menu.OpenByMnemonic(m_hwnd, static_cast<wchar_t>(msg.wParam)))
            continue;
        if (m_accel && TranslateAcceleratorW(m_hwnd, m_accel.get(), &msg)) continue;
        if (IsDialogMessageW(m_hwnd, &msg)) continue;
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
    return static_cast<int>(msg.wParam);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK MainWindow::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    MainWindow* self = nullptr;
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE) {
        self = static_cast<MainWindow*>(reinterpret_cast<CREATESTRUCTW*>(lParam)->lpCreateParams);
        self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(self));
    } else {
        self = reinterpret_cast<MainWindow*>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));
    }
    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void MainWindow::OnCreate() {
    ApplyBackdrop(m_hwnd);
    m_fonts.Create(GetDpiForWindow(m_hwnd));
    BuildMenus();
    BuildAccelerators();

    // Creation order is the Tab order: source, folder, the main buttons, the log expander, the log.
    for (const ButtonSpec& b : kButtons) {
        CreateButton(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(b.id), b.text ? Text::Get(b.text).c_str() : L"");
        m_looks[b.id] = b.look;
    }
    m_log.Create(m_hwnd, kIdLog);
    m_logVisible = Settings::ReadDword(L"LogVisible", 0) != 0;
    m_looks[CmdExpand].expanded = m_logVisible;
    ShowWindow(m_log.hwnd(), m_logVisible ? SW_SHOW : SW_HIDE);

    const std::wstring folder = Settings::Read(L"InstallFolder");
    m_folder = folder.empty() ? Core::DefaultFolder() : std::filesystem::path(folder);
    m_state = Core::ReadState(m_folder);
    SetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdSourceMenu), SourceSummary().c_str());
    SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_READING));
    UpdateControls();
    // The background host runs in its own process: it signals its changes (support/HostEvents.h).
    m_hostChanged.reset(CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, kHostChangedEvent));
    if (m_hostChanged)
        RegisterWaitForSingleObject(
            &m_hostWait, m_hostChanged.get(),
            [](void* hwnd, BOOLEAN) { PostMessageW(static_cast<HWND>(hwnd), WM_APP_HOST_CHANGED, 0, 0); }, m_hwnd, INFINITE,
            WT_EXECUTEDEFAULT);
    UpdateBluetoothRunning();
    // Windows Hello (and Bluetooth when it is on) for Android: the background host keeps serving
    // them after this window closes.
    if (auto r = Host::Start(); !r) Log(Level::Warning, r.error());
}

LRESULT MainWindow::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    if (message == m_taskbarCreated && m_taskbarCreated) {
        if (!m_taskbar) CoCreateInstance(CLSID_TaskbarList, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(m_taskbar.GetAddressOf()));
        if (m_taskbar && FAILED(m_taskbar->HrInit())) m_taskbar.Reset();
        return 0;
    }
    switch (message) {
    case WM_CREATE:
        OnCreate();
        return 0;
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        if (wParam != SIZE_MINIMIZED) Layout();
        return 0;
    case WM_GETMINMAXINFO: {
        auto* info = reinterpret_cast<MINMAXINFO*>(lParam);
        RECT r{0, 0, m_fonts.S(560), static_cast<LONG>(m_fonts.F(ContentHeight(false)))};
        AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&r, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, FALSE, 0, m_fonts.dpi());
        info->ptMinTrackSize = {r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top};
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_DPICHANGED: {
        m_fonts.Create(HIWORD(wParam));
        m_menu.Remeasure();
        m_log.Relayout();
        const RECT* r = reinterpret_cast<const RECT*>(lParam);
        SetWindowPos(m_hwnd, nullptr, r->left, r->top, r->right - r->left, r->bottom - r->top, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        Layout();
        RedrawWindow(m_hwnd, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_SETTINGCHANGE:
    case WM_THEMECHANGED:
    case WM_DWMCOMPOSITIONCHANGED:
        ApplyBackdrop(m_hwnd);
        RedrawWindow(m_hwnd, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
        if (!m_trackingMouse) {
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, m_hwnd, 0};
            m_trackingMouse = TrackMouseEvent(&tme) != FALSE;
        }
        if (m_menu.SetHot(m_menu.HitTest({GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)}))) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        m_trackingMouse = false;
        if (m_menu.SetHot(-1)) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
        const int index = m_menu.HitTest({GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)});
        if (index >= 0) m_menu.Open(m_hwnd, index, false);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_SYSCOMMAND:
        if ((wParam & 0xFFF0) == SC_KEYMENU && lParam == 0) {  // Alt alone or F10
            m_menu.Open(m_hwnd, 0, true);
            return 0;
        }
        if ((wParam & 0xFFF0) == SC_KEYMENU && lParam != L' ' && m_menu.OpenByMnemonic(m_hwnd, static_cast<wchar_t>(lParam))) return 0;
        break;
    case WM_MENUSELECT:
        m_menu.OnMenuSelect(wParam, lParam);
        return 0;
    case WM_INITMENUPOPUP:  // every popup (menu bar, source combo, context menus) is updated as it opens
        ApplyMenuState(reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(wParam));
        return 0;
    case WM_MEASUREITEM: {
        auto& mis = *reinterpret_cast<MEASUREITEMSTRUCT*>(lParam);
        if (mis.CtlType == ODT_MENU) m_menu.Measure(mis);
        return TRUE;
    }
    case WM_DRAWITEM: {
        const auto& dis = *reinterpret_cast<const DRAWITEMSTRUCT*>(lParam);
        if (dis.CtlType == ODT_MENU) m_menu.Draw(dis);
        else if (auto it = m_looks.find(dis.CtlID); it != m_looks.end()) DrawButton(dis, m_fonts, it->second);
        return TRUE;
    }
    case WM_CONTEXTMENU: {
        HWND target = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(wParam);
        POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (p.x == -1 && p.y == -1) {  // keyboard: below the focused control
            RECT r{};
            GetWindowRect(target, &r);
            p = {r.left + m_fonts.S(24), r.top + m_fonts.S(24)};
        }
        ShowContextMenu(target, p);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_COMMAND:
        OnCommand(LOWORD(wParam), HIWORD(wParam), reinterpret_cast<HWND>(lParam));
        return 0;
    case WM_APP_HOST_CHANGED:
        UpdateBluetoothRunning();
        return 0;
    case WM_ACTIVATE:
        // Besides the host's notifications: a host that ended without telling (killed) is seen here.
        if (LOWORD(wParam) != WA_INACTIVE) UpdateBluetoothRunning();
        return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    case WM_TIMER:
        if (wParam == kAnimationTimer) {
            const float target = m_progress.permille >= 0 ? static_cast<float>(m_progress.permille) / 1000.0f : m_shown;
            m_shown += (target - m_shown) * 0.18f;
            if (std::abs(target - m_shown) < 0.001f) m_shown = target;
            const bool indeterminate = (m_busy || m_refreshing) && m_progress.permille < 0;
            if (!indeterminate && m_shown == target) KillTimer(m_hwnd, kAnimationTimer);
            const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(m_progressRect.left) - 1, static_cast<LONG>(m_progressRect.top) - 1,
                         static_cast<LONG>(m_progressRect.right) + 1, static_cast<LONG>(m_progressRect.bottom) + 1};
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, &r, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_APP_REFRESHED: {
        auto msg = TakeOwned<RefreshMessage>(lParam);
        if (m_worker.joinable() && !m_busy) m_worker.join();
        m_btAdapter = msg->btAdapter;
        m_btAutostart = msg->btAutostart;
        m_btKnown = true;
        OnRefreshed(std::move(msg->system), std::move(msg->manifest), std::move(msg->manifestError));
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_APP_LOG: {
        auto msg = TakeOwned<LogMessage>(lParam);
        if (msg->level == Level::Warning || msg->level == Level::Error) SetStatus(msg->level, msg->text);
        Log(msg->level, std::move(msg->text));
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_APP_PROGRESS: {
        auto p = TakeOwned<Core::Progress>(lParam);
        m_progress = *p;
        if (p->permille < 0) SetTaskbar(TBPF_INDETERMINATE);
        else SetTaskbar(TBPF_NORMAL, p->permille);
        SetStatus(Level::Info, ProgressText(*p));
        StartAnimation();
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_APP_DONE: {
        auto done = TakeOwned<DoneMessage>(lParam);
        if (m_worker.joinable()) m_worker.join();  // the worker has finished its job by now
        if (done->stop) OnStopDone(*done->stop);
        else if (done->removal) OnUninstallDone(done->ok, done->everything, done->restart, done->leftovers, done->error);
        else OnInstallDone(done->ok, done->canceled, done->restart, done->error);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_APP_CONFIRM: {
        if (m_closing) return 0;
        const auto& question = *reinterpret_cast<const std::wstring*>(lParam);
        const bool yes = Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_CONFIRM_HEADING), question, Text::Get(IDS_CONTINUE));
        return yes ? 1 : 0;
    }
    case WM_CLOSE:
        if (m_removing) return 0;  // a removal takes seconds and cannot stop half-way
        if (m_busy && !Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_CLOSE_HEADING), Text::Get(IDS_CLOSE_MESSAGE), Text::Get(IDS_CLOSE_OK))) return 0;
        m_closing = true;
        m_worker.request_stop();
        if (!m_forgetSettings) SavePlacement();  // after "Remove everything" nothing is written again
        DestroyWindow(m_hwnd);
        return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY:
        KillTimer(m_hwnd, kAnimationTimer);
        if (m_hostWait) {
            UnregisterWaitEx(m_hostWait, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);  // waits for a callback in flight
            m_hostWait = nullptr;
        }
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

`src/gui/MainWindowCommands.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Main window: commands - installation, sources, the install folder, language and the help dialogs.
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "app/Cli.h"
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "core/Uninstall.h"
#include "install/Package.h"
#include "install/Setup.h"
#include "install/Traces.h"
#include "support/Browser.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <ShObjIdl.h>
#include <objbase.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>

#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")

namespace WN::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

void MainWindow::OnCommand(UINT id, UINT /*code*/, HWND /*control*/) {
    if (id == IDCANCEL) id = CmdCancel;  // Esc
    if (id == IDOK) return;               // Enter: no default action
    if (id >= CmdLanguageAuto && id <= CmdLanguageLast) {
        SetLanguage(id);
        return;
    }
    if (!Can(id)) return;
    switch (id) {
    case CmdInstall: StartInstall(); break;
    case CmdUninstall: Uninstall(); break;
    case CmdStopWsa: StopWsa(); break;
    case CmdBtStart: BluetoothStart(); break;
    case CmdBtStop: BluetoothStop(); break;
    case CmdBtToggle:
        if (m_btRunning) BluetoothStop();
        else BluetoothStart();
        break;
    case CmdBtAutostart: BluetoothAutostart(); break;
    case CmdBtLog: BluetoothLog(); break;
    case CmdElevation: ToggleElevation(); break;
    case CmdElevationSu: ToggleElevationSu(); break;
    case CmdHelloRememberOff: SetHelloRemember(0, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_OFF); break;
    case CmdHelloRemember5: SetHelloRemember(5, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_5); break;
    case CmdHelloRemember30: SetHelloRemember(30, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_30); break;
    case CmdHelloRememberLock: SetHelloRemember(Host::kHelloUntilLocked, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_LOCK); break;
    case CmdTray:
        if (auto r = Host::SetTrayEnabled(!Host::TrayEnabled()); !r) Log(Level::Error, r.error());
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        break;
    case CmdCancel:
        m_worker.request_stop();
        SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_CANCELING));
        break;
    case CmdCheck: Refresh(); break;
    case CmdLaunch: Launch(); break;
    case CmdOpenFolder: ShellExecuteW(m_hwnd, L"open", m_folder.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL); break;
    case CmdChangeFolder: ChangeFolder(); break;
    case CmdExit: PostMessageW(m_hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0); break;
    case CmdSourceMenu: {
        RECT r{};
        GetWindowRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdSourceMenu), &r);
        m_menu.TrackContext(m_hwnd, m_sourceMenu, {r.left, r.bottom + m_fonts.S(2)});
        break;
    }
    case CmdSourceGitHub: SetSource(L"github"); break;
    case CmdSourceMirror: SetSource(L"mirror"); break;
    case CmdSourceLocal: SetSource(L"local"); break;
    case CmdSourceCustom: EditCustomSource(); break;
    case CmdReleases: OpenInBrowser(std::format(L"https://github.com/{}/releases", Config::kGitHubRepo).c_str()); break;
    case CmdSupport: OpenInBrowser(Config::kSupportUrl); break;
    case CmdViewLog:
    case CmdExpand: SetLogVisible(!m_logVisible, true); break;
    case CmdCopyLog: CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, m_log.Text()); break;
    case CmdClearLog: m_log.Clear(); UpdateControls(); break;
    case CmdHelpCli: ShowCommandLineHelp(); break;
    case CmdAbout: ShowAbout(); break;
    default: break;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Installation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::BeginWork() {
    if (m_worker.joinable()) m_worker.join();
    m_busy = true;
    m_failed = m_finished = false;
    m_progress = {};
    m_shown = 0;
    m_animStart = GetTickCount64();
    UpdateControls();
    SetTaskbar(TBPF_INDETERMINATE);
    StartAnimation();
}

void MainWindow::StartInstall() {
    if (!m_manifest) return;
    m_removing = false;
    BeginWork();

    HWND hwnd = m_hwnd;
    Core::Options options;
    options.folder = m_folder;
    m_worker = std::jthread([hwnd, manifest = *m_manifest, options](std::stop_token stop) {
        // The package manager's asynchronous operations block: a multithreaded apartment.
        const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        Core::Callbacks cb;
        cb.log = [hwnd](Level level, std::wstring text) {
            PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_LOG, std::make_unique<LogMessage>(LogMessage{level, std::move(text)}));
        };
        cb.progress = [hwnd](const Core::Progress& p) { PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_PROGRESS, std::make_unique<Core::Progress>(p)); };
        cb.confirm = [hwnd](const std::wstring& question) {
            // Synchronous: the worker waits for the answer. Fails (no) when the window is gone.
            return SendMessageW(hwnd, WM_APP_CONFIRM, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&question)) == 1;
        };
        auto result = Core::Run(manifest, options, cb, stop);
        auto done = std::make_unique<DoneMessage>();
        done->ok = result.has_value();
        done->canceled = stop.stop_requested();
        done->restart = result && result->restartNeeded;
        if (!result) done->error = result.error();
        if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
        PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_DONE, std::move(done));
    });
}

void MainWindow::OnInstallDone(bool ok, bool canceled, bool restart, const std::wstring& error) {
    m_busy = false;
    m_failed = !ok && !canceled;
    m_finished = ok;
    m_progress.permille = ok ? 1000 : m_progress.permille;
    StartAnimation();
    SetTaskbar(ok ? TBPF_NOPROGRESS : canceled ? TBPF_NOPROGRESS : TBPF_ERROR, 1000);
    m_state = Core::ReadState(m_folder);
    // The outcome stays in the status line while the window reads the new state.
    const Level level = ok ? Level::Success : canceled ? Level::Warning : Level::Error;
    const std::wstring text = ok         ? Text::Format(restart ? IDS_STATUS_RESTART : IDS_STATUS_DONE, m_manifest ? m_manifest->version : L"")
                              : canceled ? Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_CANCELED)
                                         : Text::Format(IDS_STATUS_FAILED, error);
    Log(level, text);
    SetStatus(level, text);
    if (ok) {
        FLASHWINFO flash{sizeof flash, m_hwnd, FLASHW_TRAY | FLASHW_TIMERNOFG, 0, 0};
        FlashWindowEx(&flash);
        if (restart) {
            const bool now = Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_RESTART_HEADING), text, Text::Get(IDS_RESTART_OK));
            if (now) ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", L"shutdown.exe", L"/r /t 0", nullptr, SW_HIDE);
        }
    }
    Refresh(true);  // the package and the components changed
    SetStatus(level, text);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Uninstallation: keep the Android data, or remove everything (asked twice)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::Uninstall() {
    const std::filesystem::path data = Install::PackageDataFolder();
    const std::wstring dataSize = FormatBytes(Install::FolderSize(data));
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = Text::Get(IDS_UNINSTALL_HEADING);
    spec.message = Text::Format(IDS_UNINSTALL_MESSAGE, m_folder.wstring(), dataSize);
    spec.ok = Text::Get(IDS_UNINSTALL_KEEP);
    spec.extra = Text::Get(IDS_UNINSTALL_ALL);
    spec.width = 560;
    const int choice = RunDialog(m_hwnd, spec).button;
    const bool everything = choice == 2;
    const bool go = choice == 1 || (everything && Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_UNINSTALL_ALL_HEADING),
                                                          Text::Format(IDS_UNINSTALL_ALL_MESSAGE, dataSize),
                                                          Text::Get(IDS_UNINSTALL_ALL_OK), true));
    if (!go) return;

    // Installed with WSA-Next Setup: Windows Installer removes WSA-Next (with its own progress bar)
    // and this window closes, so that WSA-Next.exe is not in use.
    if (const auto product = Install::SetupProduct()) {
        if (auto r = Install::RemoveThroughSetup(*product, everything); !r) {
            Log(Level::Error, r.error());
            SetStatus(Level::Error, r.error());
            return;
        }
        PostMessageW(m_hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
        return;
    }

    m_removing = true;
    BeginWork();
    HWND hwnd = m_hwnd;
    m_worker = std::jthread([hwnd, folder = m_folder, everything](std::stop_token) {
        const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        Core::Callbacks cb;
        cb.log = [hwnd](Level level, std::wstring text) {
            PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_LOG, std::make_unique<LogMessage>(LogMessage{level, std::move(text)}));
        };
        cb.progress = [hwnd](const Core::Progress& p) { PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_PROGRESS, std::make_unique<Core::Progress>(p)); };
        cb.confirm = [](const std::wstring&) { return true; };  // asked before the start
        auto result = Core::Uninstall(folder, everything ? Core::Removal::Everything : Core::Removal::KeepData, cb);
        auto done = std::make_unique<DoneMessage>();
        done->removal = true;
        done->everything = everything;
        done->ok = result.has_value();
        if (result) {
            done->restart = result->restartNeeded;
            done->leftovers = result->leftovers.size();
        } else {
            done->error = result.error();
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
        PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_DONE, std::move(done));
    });
}

void MainWindow::StopWsa() {
    BeginWork();
    SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_WSA_STOPPING));
    HWND hwnd = m_hwnd;
    m_worker = std::jthread([hwnd](std::stop_token) {
        const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        auto done = std::make_unique<DoneMessage>();
        done->stop = Install::Stop();
        done->ok = *done->stop != Guest::VmStop::Failed;
        if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
        PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_DONE, std::move(done));
    });
}

void MainWindow::OnStopDone(Guest::VmStop result) {
    m_busy = false;
    m_failed = result == Guest::VmStop::Failed;
    m_finished = !m_failed;
    m_progress.permille = 1000;
    StartAnimation();
    SetTaskbar(m_failed ? TBPF_ERROR : TBPF_NOPROGRESS, 1000);
    const UINT id = result == Guest::VmStop::ShutDown     ? IDS_STATUS_WSA_STOPPED
                    : result == Guest::VmStop::Terminated ? IDS_STATUS_WSA_TERMINATED
                    : result == Guest::VmStop::NotRunning ? IDS_STATUS_WSA_NOT_RUNNING
                                                          : IDS_STATUS_WSA_STOP_FAILED;
    const Level level = result == Guest::VmStop::Failed ? Level::Error : result == Guest::VmStop::Terminated ? Level::Warning : Level::Success;
    Log(level, Text::Get(id));
    SetStatus(level, Text::Get(id));
    UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::OnUninstallDone(bool ok, bool everything, bool restart, std::size_t leftovers, const std::wstring& error) {
    m_busy = m_removing = false;
    const bool clean = ok && leftovers == 0;
    m_failed = !clean;
    m_finished = clean;
    m_progress.permille = 1000;
    StartAnimation();
    SetTaskbar(clean ? TBPF_NOPROGRESS : TBPF_ERROR, 1000);
    if (ok && everything) m_forgetSettings = true;
    m_state = Core::ReadState(m_folder);
    const std::wstring text = !ok        ? Text::Format(IDS_STATUS_REMOVE_FAILED, error)
                              : everything ? Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_REMOVED_ALL)
                                           : Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_REMOVED);
    const Level level = !ok ? Level::Error : leftovers ? Level::Warning : Level::Success;
    Log(level, text);
    Refresh(true);  // the package and the folder are gone; the release can be installed again
    SetStatus(level, text);
    if (ok && restart) {
        const bool now = Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_RESTART_HEADING), Text::Get(IDS_LOG_VMP_OFF), Text::Get(IDS_RESTART_OK));
        if (now) ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", L"shutdown.exe", L"/r /t 0", nullptr, SW_HIDE);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Bluetooth for Android: a bridge of the background host (src/host), which keeps working after
// this window is closed; "Start with Windows" adds the host's logon task.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::BluetoothStart() {
    if (auto r = Host::SetBluetoothEnabled(true); !r) {
        Log(Level::Error, r.error());
        SetStatus(Level::Error, r.error());
        return;
    }
    Log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_BT_STARTED));
    SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_BT_STARTED));
    UpdateBluetoothRunning();
}

void MainWindow::BluetoothStop() {
    if (auto r = Host::SetBluetoothEnabled(false); !r) Log(Level::Warning, r.error());
    Log(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_BT_STOPPED));
    SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_BT_STOPPED));
    UpdateBluetoothRunning();
}

void MainWindow::BluetoothAutostart() {
    const bool enable = !m_btAutostart;
    if (auto r = Host::SetAutostart(enable); !r) {
        Log(Level::Error, r.error());
        SetStatus(Level::Error, r.error());
        return;
    }
    m_btAutostart = enable;
    Log(Level::Success, enable ? Text::Format(IDS_LOG_BT_AUTOSTART_ON, Host::kAutostartTask) : Text::Get(IDS_LOG_BT_AUTOSTART_OFF));
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

// Root for Android apps: turning it on asks first (what it means is said once, plainly).
void MainWindow::ToggleElevation() {
    const bool enable = !Host::ElevationEnabled();
    if (enable && !Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_ELEVATION_HEADING), Text::Get(IDS_ELEVATION_TEXT), Text::Get(IDS_ELEVATION_OK), true)) return;
    if (auto r = Host::SetElevationEnabled(enable); !r) {
        Log(Level::Error, r.error());
        SetStatus(Level::Error, r.error());
        return;
    }
    Log(Level::Success, Text::Get(enable ? IDS_LOG_ELEVATION_ON : IDS_LOG_ELEVATION_OFF));
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

// "su for root apps": root apps look for su; while on, Android offers it (a link to 0).
void MainWindow::ToggleElevationSu() {
    const bool enable = !Host::ElevationSuEnabled();
    if (auto r = Host::SetElevationSuEnabled(enable); !r) {
        Log(Level::Error, r.error());
        SetStatus(Level::Error, r.error());
        return;
    }
    Log(Level::Success, Text::Get(enable ? IDS_LOG_ELEVATION_SU_ON : IDS_LOG_ELEVATION_SU_OFF));
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

// Remember Windows Hello for Android apps: off by default; turning it on asks first, because
// whoever uses the unlocked PC meanwhile gets into those apps too. Read by the host per request.
void MainWindow::SetHelloRemember(std::uint32_t minutes, UINT choice) {
    if (minutes != 0 && Host::HelloRememberMinutes() == 0 &&
        !Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_HELLO_REMEMBER_HEADING), Text::Get(IDS_HELLO_REMEMBER_TEXT), Text::Get(IDS_HELLO_REMEMBER_OK), true))
        return;
    Host::SetHelloRememberMinutes(minutes);
    Log(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER) + L": " + Text::Get(choice));
}

void MainWindow::BluetoothLog() {
    const std::filesystem::path log = Bt::LogFolder() / L"bluetooth.log";
    ShellExecuteW(m_hwnd, L"open", log.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
}

void MainWindow::Launch() {
    Log(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_LOG_LAUNCH));
    if (auto r = Install::LaunchAndroid(); !r) {
        Log(Level::Error, r.error());
        SetStatus(Level::Error, r.error());
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Source and folder
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::SetSource(const std::wstring& key) {
    Settings::Write(L"Source", key);
    SetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdSourceMenu), SourceSummary().c_str());
    InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdSourceMenu), nullptr, FALSE);
    Log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_SOURCE, SourceSummary()));
    Refresh();
}

void MainWindow::EditCustomSource() {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = Text::Get(IDS_CUSTOM_HEADING);
    spec.message = Text::Get(IDS_CUSTOM_MESSAGE);
    spec.fields = {{Text::Get(IDS_CUSTOM_FIELD), Settings::Read(L"CustomManifest"), L"https://example.org/wsa-next/manifest.json"}};
    spec.width = 560;
    spec.validate = [](const std::vector<std::wstring>& v) -> std::optional<std::wstring> {
        const std::wstring& url = v[0];
        if (url.starts_with(L"https://") || url.starts_with(L"http://localhost/") || url.starts_with(L"http://127.0.0.1/"))
            return std::nullopt;
        return Text::Get(IDS_CUSTOM_INVALID);
    };
    const auto result = RunDialog(m_hwnd, spec);
    if (result.button != 1) return;
    Settings::Write(L"CustomManifest", result.values[0]);
    SetSource(L"custom");
}

void MainWindow::ChangeFolder() {
    ComPtr<IFileOpenDialog> dialog;
    if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_FileOpenDialog, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(dialog.GetAddressOf())))) return;
    DWORD options = 0;
    dialog->GetOptions(&options);
    dialog->SetOptions(options | FOS_PICKFOLDERS | FOS_FORCEFILESYSTEM | FOS_PATHMUSTEXIST);
    dialog->SetTitle(Text::Get(IDS_FOLDER_PICK).c_str());
    ComPtr<IShellItem> start;
    std::error_code ec;
    const std::filesystem::path existing = std::filesystem::exists(m_folder, ec) ? m_folder : m_folder.parent_path();
    if (SUCCEEDED(SHCreateItemFromParsingName(existing.c_str(), nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(start.GetAddressOf())))) dialog->SetFolder(start.Get());
    const HRESULT shown = dialog->Show(m_hwnd);
    if (FAILED(shown)) return;
    ComPtr<IShellItem> item;
    PWSTR path = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(dialog->GetResult(item.GetAddressOf())) || FAILED(item->GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH, &path))) return;
    std::filesystem::path chosen = path;
    CoTaskMemFree(path);
    // A new, empty folder for WSA-Next inside the chosen one, unless it already is one.
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(chosen / Config::kStateFile, ec) && !std::filesystem::is_empty(chosen, ec))
        chosen /= Config::kInstallFolder;
    m_folder = chosen;
    Settings::Write(L"InstallFolder", m_folder.wstring());
    m_state = Core::ReadState(m_folder);
    UpdatePlan();
    StatusFromPlan();
    UpdateControls();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Language
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::SetLanguage(UINT command) {
    const std::wstring code = command == CmdLanguageAuto                         ? std::wstring(L"auto")
                              : command - CmdLanguageFirst < m_languages.size() ? m_languages[command - CmdLanguageFirst].code
                                                                                 : std::wstring();
    if (code.empty() || !Text::Use(code, true)) return;
    ApplyLanguage();
    Log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LANGUAGE_CHANGED, LanguageName(Text::Current())));
}

std::wstring MainWindow::LanguageName(const std::wstring& code) const {
    for (const auto& l : m_languages)
        if (l.code == code) return l.name;
    return code;
}

// Everything that shows text is rebuilt; layout follows (labels change width, buttons stay equal).
void MainWindow::ApplyLanguage() {
    m_menu.Reset();
    BuildMenus();
    for (const ButtonSpec& b : kButtons)
        if (b.text) SetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(b.id)), Text::Get(b.text).c_str());
    SetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdSourceMenu), SourceSummary().c_str());
    UpdatePlan();
    if (!m_busy) StatusFromPlan();
    Layout();
    RedrawWindow(m_hwnd, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Help
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::ShowCommandLineHelp() {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = Text::Get(IDS_CLI_HEADING);
    spec.message = Text::Format(IDS_HELP_MESSAGE, Config::kExeName);
    spec.monospace = Cli::HelpText();  // the command line is English, so is its help
    spec.ok = Text::Get(IDS_CLOSE);
    spec.cancelButton = false;
    spec.extra = Text::Get(IDS_COPY);
    spec.width = 720;
    const auto result = RunDialog(m_hwnd, spec);
    if (result.button == 2) CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, spec.monospace);
}

void MainWindow::ShowAbout() {
    Inform(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_ABOUT_HEADING),
           Text::Format(IDS_ABOUT_TEXT, Config::kAppTitle, Config::kAppVersion, Config::kCopyright, Config::kGitHubRepo));
}
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Internal to the MainWindow*.cpp files: command identifiers, worker messages, layout constants.
#pragma once
#include "core/Install.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <format>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

namespace WN::Ui::MainWindowDetail {

inline constexpr wchar_t kClassName[] = L"WSANext.MainWindow";
inline constexpr UINT_PTR kAnimationTimer = 1;

enum : UINT {
    WM_APP_LOG = WM_APP + 1,  // lParam: LogMessage*
    WM_APP_PROGRESS,          // lParam: Core::Progress*
    WM_APP_DONE,              // lParam: DoneMessage*
    WM_APP_CONFIRM,           // lParam: const std::wstring* (sent, result 1 = yes)
    WM_APP_REFRESHED,         // lParam: RefreshMessage*
    WM_APP_HOST_CHANGED,      // the background host signaled a change (support/HostEvents.h)
};

enum Command : UINT {
    CmdInstall = 1000, CmdCancel, CmdLaunch, CmdCheck, CmdOpenFolder, CmdChangeFolder, CmdExit,
    CmdSourceMenu, CmdSourceLocal, CmdSourceMirror, CmdSourceGitHub, CmdSourceCustom, CmdReleases,
    CmdViewLog, CmdCopyLog, CmdClearLog, CmdExpand,
    CmdHelpCli, CmdAbout, CmdUninstall,
    CmdBtStart, CmdBtStop, CmdBtToggle, CmdBtAutostart, CmdBtLog, CmdStopWsa, CmdElevation, CmdElevationSu, CmdTray,
    CmdHelloRememberOff, CmdHelloRemember5, CmdHelloRemember30, CmdHelloRememberLock,  // Android > Remember Windows Hello
    CmdSupport,  // the "Support" button on the menu bar's line
    CmdLanguageAuto = 1100, CmdLanguageFirst,  // View > language: automatic, then one per available language
    CmdLanguageLast = 1199,
};
inline constexpr int kIdLog = 2001;

struct LogMessage {
    Level level;
    std::wstring text;
};
struct DoneMessage {
    bool ok = false, canceled = false, restart = false;
    std::wstring error;
    bool removal = false, everything = false;  // an uninstallation (Core::Uninstall) instead of Core::Run
    std::size_t leftovers = 0;                 // removal: items that could not be removed
    std::optional<Guest::VmStop> stop;         // stopping WSA (Install::Stop) instead
};
struct RefreshMessage {
    Core::SystemInfo system;
    std::optional<Core::Manifest> manifest;
    std::wstring manifestError;
    std::uint64_t btAdapter = 0;  // address of the PC's Bluetooth adapter, 0 = none
    bool btAutostart = false;     // the bridge starts with Windows
};

// The worker hands objects to the UI thread through the message queue. If posting fails
// (window already gone) the unique_ptr still owns the object and frees it.
template <class T>
void PostOwned(HWND hwnd, UINT message, std::unique_ptr<T> payload) {
    if (PostMessageW(hwnd, message, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(payload.get()))) (void)payload.release();
}
template <class T>
std::unique_ptr<T> TakeOwned(LPARAM lParam) {
    return std::unique_ptr<T>(reinterpret_cast<T*>(lParam));
}

inline std::wstring ProgressText(const Core::Progress& p) {
    if (p.permille < 0) return p.phase + L"\x2026";
    std::wstring text = std::format(L"{}%  \x00B7  ", p.permille / 10);
    if (p.steps > 1) text += std::format(L"{}/{}  ", p.step, p.steps);
    text += p.phase;
    if (p.total) text += std::format(L"  \x00B7  {} / {}", FormatBytes(p.done), FormatBytes(p.total));
    if (p.speed) text += std::format(L"  \x00B7  {}/s", FormatBytes(p.speed));
    if (p.eta > 0) text += L"  \x00B7  " + Text::Format(IDS_PROGRESS_LEFT, FormatDuration(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(p.eta)));
    return text;
}

// Every button of the window: command, string, look. The source "combo" gets its text at runtime.
struct ButtonSpec {
    UINT id;
    UINT text;  // string id, 0 = set later
    ButtonLook look;
};
inline const ButtonSpec kButtons[] = {
    {CmdSourceMenu, 0, {ButtonKind::Combo}},
    {CmdChangeFolder, IDS_BTN_CHANGE, {ButtonKind::Standard, Icon::Folder}},
    {CmdBtToggle, IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, {ButtonKind::Standard, Icon::Bluetooth, true, false, {}, Color::Bluetooth}},
    {CmdCancel, IDS_CANCEL, {ButtonKind::Standard, Icon::Cancel}},
    {CmdLaunch, IDS_BTN_LAUNCH, {ButtonKind::Standard, Icon::Play}},
    {CmdInstall, IDS_BTN_INSTALL, {ButtonKind::Accent, Icon::Download}},
    {CmdExpand, IDS_BTN_LOG, {ButtonKind::Expander, 0, false}},
    // Last in the Tab order; on the window background, a quiet button: its heart is grey like the
    // other icons and turns sponsor pink only under the mouse (green stays for actions and status).
    {CmdSupport, IDS_BTN_SUPPORT, {ButtonKind::Standard, Icon::HeartFill, false, false, {}, {}, {}, Color::Support}},
};

// Layout, in DIP (scaled with the window DPI).
inline constexpr float kMargin = 12, kPad = 14, kButtonW = 120, kButtonH = 30, kRowH = 26, kGap = 8;
inline constexpr float kBarH = 28, kLogH = 180, kRadius = 8;

}  // namespace WN::Ui::MainWindowDetail
```

`src/gui/MainWindowLayout.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Main window: layout, window placement and painting.
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include <dwmapi.h>
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Signature.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WN::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;
namespace {

// Heights inside the cards, DIP.
constexpr float kTitleH = 30, kMetaH = 20, kHeaderH = 22, kSystemRowH = 40, kComponentRowH = 24;
constexpr std::size_t kMinComponentRows = 7;
constexpr float kReleaseH = kPad + kTitleH + kMetaH + 12 + 3 * kRowH + 2 * 6 + 12 + 4 + 12 + kButtonH + kPad;

float LowerCardsHeight(std::size_t components) {
    const float system = kPad + kHeaderH + 8 + 5 * kSystemRowH + kPad - 6;
    const float list = kPad + kHeaderH + 8 + static_cast<float>(std::max(components, kMinComponentRows)) * kComponentRowH + kPad;
    return std::max(system, list);
}

D2D1_COLOR_F LevelColor(Level level) {
    return level == Level::Error     ? Color::Critical
           : level == Level::Warning ? Color::Caution
           : level == Level::Success ? Color::Success
                                     : Color::Text2;
}

}  // namespace

float MainWindow::ContentHeight(bool withLog) const {
    const std::size_t components = m_manifest ? m_manifest->components.size() : 0;
    return 4 + kBarH + 6 + kReleaseH + 10 + LowerCardsHeight(components) + 6 + 28 + kMargin + (withLog ? kLogH : 0);
}

float MainWindow::ButtonWidth() const {
    float widest = m_fonts.F(kButtonW);
    for (UINT id : {CmdCancel, CmdLaunch, CmdInstall, CmdChangeFolder, CmdBtToggle}) {
        wchar_t text[128]{};
        GetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id)), text, static_cast<int>(std::size(text)));
        const auto look = m_looks.find(id);
        const float icon = look != m_looks.end() && look->second.icon ? m_fonts.F(22) : 0;
        widest = std::max(widest, TextWidth(m_fonts, Font::Body, text) + icon + m_fonts.F(30));
    }
    return std::ceil(widest);
}

void MainWindow::Layout() {
    if (!m_log.hwnd()) return;
    RECT rc{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &rc);
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const float W = static_cast<float>(rc.right), H = static_cast<float>(rc.bottom);
    const float m = f.F(kMargin), p = f.F(kPad), bw = ButtonWidth(), bh = f.F(kButtonH), gap = f.F(kGap), row = f.F(kRowH);
    auto place = [&](UINT id, D2D1_RECT_F r) {
        SetWindowPos(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id)), nullptr, static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.left)),
                     static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.top)), static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.right - r.left)),
                     static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.bottom - r.top)), SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    };

    m_menu.Layout(f.F(6), f.F(4), f.F(kBarH));
    // "Support" on the menu bar's line: centred on the menu's text, as far above it as below,
    // under the window's buttons - from the left edge of "minimize" to the cards' right edge, the
    // same in every language (wider only for a label that needs more).
    {
        wchar_t text[64]{};
        GetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdSupport), text, static_cast<int>(std::size(text)));
        const float needed = std::ceil(TextWidth(f, Font::Body, text) + f.F(14 + 8) + f.F(24));
        float left = W - m - needed;
        RECT buttons{}, window{};
        POINT origin{};
        if (SUCCEEDED(DwmGetWindowAttribute(m_hwnd, DWMWA_CAPTION_BUTTON_BOUNDS, &buttons, sizeof buttons)) && buttons.right > buttons.left &&
            GetWindowRect(m_hwnd, &window) && ClientToScreen(m_hwnd, &origin)) {
            // Window-relative bounds -> client coordinates.
            left = std::min(left, static_cast<float>(buttons.left - (origin.x - window.left)));
        }
        const float h = f.F(26), mid = f.F(4 + kBarH / 2);
        place(CmdSupport, {left, mid - h / 2, W - m, mid + h / 2});
    }
    float y = f.F(4 + kBarH + 6);

    // Release card
    const float left = m + p, right = W - m - p;
    m_releaseCard = {m, y, W - m, y + f.F(kReleaseH)};
    float cy = y + p;
    m_titleRect = {left, cy, right, cy + f.F(kTitleH)};
    cy += f.F(kTitleH);
    m_metaRect = {left, cy, right, cy + f.F(kMetaH)};
    cy += f.F(kMetaH + 12);
    m_labelWidth = f.F(80);
    for (UINT id : {IDS_LABEL_SOURCE, IDS_LABEL_FOLDER, IDS_LABEL_DOWNLOAD})
        m_labelWidth = std::max(m_labelWidth, std::ceil(TextWidth(f, Font::Label, Text::Get(id)) + f.F(16)));
    m_rowSource = {left, cy, right, cy + row};
    place(CmdSourceMenu, {left + m_labelWidth, cy, right, cy + row});
    cy += row + f.F(6);
    m_rowFolder = {left, cy, right - bw - gap, cy + row};
    place(CmdChangeFolder, {right - bw, cy, right, cy + row});
    cy += row + f.F(6);
    m_rowDownload = {left, cy, right - bw - gap, cy + row};
    place(CmdBtToggle, {right - bw, cy, right, cy + row});
    cy += row + f.F(12);
    m_progressRect = {left, cy, right, cy + f.F(4)};
    cy += f.F(4 + 12);
    place(CmdInstall, {right - bw, cy, right, cy + bh});
    place(CmdLaunch, {right - 2 * bw - gap, cy, right - bw - gap, cy + bh});
    place(CmdCancel, {right - 3 * bw - 2 * gap, cy, right - 2 * bw - 2 * gap, cy + bh});
    m_statusRect = {left, cy, right - 3 * bw - 2 * gap - f.F(12), cy + bh};

    // Log expander and log at the bottom.
    const float logH = m_logVisible ? std::max(f.F(110), std::min(f.F(kLogH), H * 0.4f)) : 0;
    const float expanderH = f.F(28);
    const float expanderTop = H - m - logH - expanderH - (m_logVisible ? f.F(4) : 0);
    place(CmdExpand, {m - f.F(4), expanderTop, m + f.F(160), expanderTop + expanderH});
    if (m_logVisible) {
        m_logCard = {m, expanderTop + expanderH + f.F(4), W - m, H - m};
        place(kIdLog, Inset(m_logCard, f.F(4), f.F(4)));
    }

    // This PC (left) and Components (right) share the space between.
    y = m_releaseCard.bottom + f.F(10);
    const float bottom = std::max(y + f.F(80), expanderTop - f.F(6));
    const float split = m + (W - 2 * m - f.F(10)) * 0.46f;
    m_systemCard = {m, y, split, bottom};
    m_componentsCard = {split + f.F(10), y, W - m, bottom};
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void MainWindow::SetLogVisible(bool visible, bool resizeWindow) {
    if (visible == m_logVisible) return;
    m_logVisible = visible;
    Settings::WriteDword(L"LogVisible", visible ? 1 : 0);
    if (visible) m_unread = 0;
    m_looks[CmdExpand].expanded = visible;
    m_looks[CmdExpand].badge.clear();
    ShowWindow(m_log.hwnd(), visible ? SW_SHOW : SW_HIDE);
    if (resizeWindow && !IsZoomed(m_hwnd) && !IsIconic(m_hwnd)) {
        // Grow / shrink the window by the log height (like "More details" in the copy dialog).
        RECT wr{};
        GetWindowRect(m_hwnd, &wr);
        const int delta = m_fonts.S(static_cast<int>(kLogH)) * (visible ? 1 : -1);
        MONITORINFO mi{sizeof mi};
        GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromWindow(m_hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST), &mi);
        int height = wr.bottom - wr.top + delta;
        int top = wr.top;
        if (top + height > mi.rcWork.bottom) top = std::max<int>(mi.rcWork.top, mi.rcWork.bottom - height);
        height = std::min<int>(height, mi.rcWork.bottom - mi.rcWork.top);
        SetWindowPos(m_hwnd, nullptr, wr.left, top, wr.right - wr.left, height, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    }
    Layout();
    InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdExpand), nullptr, FALSE);
}

void MainWindow::RestorePlacement(int showCommand) {
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(m_hwnd);
    RECT desired{0, 0, MulDiv(720, static_cast<int>(dpi), 96), MulDiv(static_cast<int>(ContentHeight(m_logVisible)), static_cast<int>(dpi), 96)};
    AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&desired, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, FALSE, 0, dpi);
    int w = desired.right - desired.left, h = desired.bottom - desired.top;
    MONITORINFO mi{sizeof mi};
    GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromWindow(m_hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY), &mi);
    h = std::min<int>(h, mi.rcWork.bottom - mi.rcWork.top);
    int x = mi.rcWork.left + (mi.rcWork.right - mi.rcWork.left - w) / 2;
    int y = mi.rcWork.top + (mi.rcWork.bottom - mi.rcWork.top - h) / 2;

    // Saved position (physical pixels) when it is still on a monitor.
    int sx = 0, sy = 0, sw = 0, sh = 0;
    const std::wstring saved = Settings::Read(L"WindowRect");
    if (swscanf_s(saved.c_str(), L"%d %d %d %d", &sx, &sy, &sw, &sh) == 4 && sw > 200 && sh > 200) {
        const RECT r{sx, sy, sx + sw, sy + sh};
        if (MonitorFromRect(&r, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONULL)) {
            x = sx; y = sy; w = sw; h = sh;
        }
    }
    SetWindowPos(m_hwnd, nullptr, x, y, w, h, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    Layout();
    ShowWindow(m_hwnd, showCommand == SW_SHOWMINIMIZED || showCommand == SW_MINIMIZE ? SW_SHOWNORMAL : showCommand);
    UpdateWindow(m_hwnd);
}

void MainWindow::SavePlacement() {
    WINDOWPLACEMENT wp{sizeof wp};
    if (!GetWindowPlacement(m_hwnd, &wp)) return;
    const RECT& r = wp.rcNormalPosition;
    Settings::Write(L"WindowRect", std::format(L"{} {} {} {}", r.left, r.top, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top));
}

void MainWindow::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    Ui::Paint(ps.dc(), client, m_fonts, [&](Canvas& c) {
        c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Base());
        m_menu.Paint(c);
        PaintReleaseCard(c);
        PaintSystemCard(c);
        PaintComponentsCard(c);
        if (m_logVisible) {
            c.Fill(m_logCard, Color::Card, m_fonts.F(kRadius));
            c.Stroke(m_logCard, Color::CardStroke, m_fonts.F(kRadius));
        }
    });
}

void MainWindow::PaintReleaseCard(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    c.Fill(m_releaseCard, Color::Card, f.F(kRadius));
    c.Stroke(m_releaseCard, Color::CardStroke, f.F(kRadius));

    // Title with a green Android mark, installed release on the right.
    const float dot = f.F(5);
    c.Circle({m_titleRect.left + dot, (m_titleRect.top + m_titleRect.bottom) / 2}, dot, Color::AccentText);
    const D2D1_RECT_F title{m_titleRect.left + 3 * dot, m_titleRect.top, m_titleRect.right, m_titleRect.bottom};
    c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_CARD_RELEASE), title, Font::Title, Color::Text);
    const std::wstring installed =
        m_state.version.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_INSTALLED_NONE) : Text::Format(IDS_INSTALLED_META, m_state.version);
    c.Text(installed, m_titleRect, Font::Caption, m_state.version.empty() ? Color::Text3 : Color::Success, Align::Right);

    std::wstring meta = Text::Get(IDS_RELEASE_NONE);
    if (m_manifest) meta = Text::Format(IDS_RELEASE_META, m_manifest->version, m_manifest->android, m_manifest->variant);
    else if (!m_manifestError.empty()) meta = m_manifestError;
    c.Text(meta, {title.left, m_metaRect.top, m_metaRect.right, m_metaRect.bottom}, Font::Caption,
           m_manifest || m_manifestError.empty() ? Color::Text2 : Color::Caution);

    auto label = [&](const D2D1_RECT_F& r, UINT id) {
        c.Text(Text::Get(id), {r.left, r.top, r.left + m_labelWidth, r.bottom}, Font::Label, Color::Text3);
    };
    label(m_rowSource, IDS_LABEL_SOURCE);
    label(m_rowFolder, IDS_LABEL_FOLDER);
    c.Text(m_folder.wstring(), {m_rowFolder.left + m_labelWidth, m_rowFolder.top, m_rowFolder.right, m_rowFolder.bottom}, Font::Body,
           Color::Text);
    label(m_rowDownload, IDS_LABEL_DOWNLOAD);
    std::wstring summary = L"\x2014";
    if (m_manifest)
        summary = m_plan.UpToDate() ? Text::Get(IDS_SUMMARY_NONE)
                                    : Text::Format(IDS_SUMMARY_DOWNLOAD, FormatBytes(m_plan.downloadBytes), FormatBytes(m_plan.diskBytes));
    c.Text(summary, {m_rowDownload.left + m_labelWidth, m_rowDownload.top, m_rowDownload.right, m_rowDownload.bottom}, Font::Body,
           Color::Text);

    // Progress: track, determinate fill (animated) or an indeterminate sliding segment.
    const D2D1_RECT_F& t = m_progressRect;
    const float radius = (t.bottom - t.top) / 2;
    c.Fill(t, Color::Track, radius);
    const D2D1_COLOR_F fill = m_failed ? Color::Critical : (m_finished && !m_busy) ? Color::Success : Color::AccentText;
    if ((m_busy || m_refreshing) && m_progress.permille < 0) {
        const float width = t.right - t.left, segment = width * 0.28f;
        const float phase = static_cast<float>((GetTickCount64() - m_animStart) % 1600) / 1600.0f;
        const float x = t.left - segment + (width + segment) * phase;
        c.PushClip(t);
        c.Fill({std::max(x, t.left), t.top, std::min(x + segment, t.right), t.bottom}, fill, radius);
        c.PopClip();
    } else if (m_shown > 0.001f) {
        c.Fill({t.left, t.top, t.left + (t.right - t.left) * std::min(m_shown, 1.0f), t.bottom}, fill, radius);
    }
    c.Text(m_status, m_statusRect, Font::Caption, LevelColor(m_statusLevel));
}

void MainWindow::PaintSystemCard(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const D2D1_RECT_F& card = m_systemCard;
    c.Fill(card, Color::Card, f.F(kRadius));
    c.Stroke(card, Color::CardStroke, f.F(kRadius));
    const float left = card.left + f.F(kPad), right = card.right - f.F(kPad);
    float y = card.top + f.F(kPad);
    c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_CARD_SYSTEM), {left, y, right, y + f.F(kHeaderH)}, Font::Strong, Color::Text);
    y += f.F(kHeaderH + 8);

    // A row: status mark, label, value; `note` (what the installation will change) sits right of the label.
    enum class Mark { Ok, Todo, Bad, Wait };
    auto rowAt = [&](UINT labelId, const std::wstring& value, Mark mark, const std::wstring& note = {}) {
        const D2D1_COLOR_F color = mark == Mark::Ok ? Color::Success : mark == Mark::Todo ? Color::Caution
                                   : mark == Mark::Bad ? Color::Critical : Color::Text3;
        const wchar_t glyph = mark == Mark::Ok ? Icon::StatusOk : mark == Mark::Bad ? Icon::StatusError : mark == Mark::Todo ? Icon::Info : Icon::Refresh;
        const float icon = f.F(22);
        c.Text(std::wstring(1, glyph), {left, y + f.F(2), left + icon, y + f.F(20)}, Font::IconSmall, color, Align::Left);
        const std::wstring label = Text::Get(labelId);
        c.Text(label, {left + icon, y, right, y + f.F(18)}, Font::Label, Color::Text3);
        if (!note.empty()) {
            const float x = left + icon + c.Width(label, Font::Label) + f.F(12);
            c.Text(note, {x, y, right, y + f.F(18)}, Font::Caption, Color::Caution, Align::Right);
        }
        c.Text(value, {left + icon, y + f.F(18), right, y + f.F(kSystemRowH - 4)}, Font::Body, mark == Mark::Bad ? Color::Critical : Color::Text);
        y += f.F(kSystemRowH);
    };

    if (!m_system) {
        for (UINT id : {IDS_SYS_WINDOWS, IDS_SYS_VMP, IDS_SYS_DEVMODE, IDS_SYS_PACKAGE, IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH})
            rowAt(id, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_READING), Mark::Wait);
        return;
    }
    const Core::SystemInfo& s = *m_system;
    if (!s.Supported()) rowAt(IDS_SYS_WINDOWS, s.Version(), Mark::Bad, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_UNSUPPORTED));
    else if (s.NeedsPatch()) rowAt(IDS_SYS_WINDOWS, s.Version(), Mark::Todo, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_PATCH));
    else rowAt(IDS_SYS_WINDOWS, s.Version(), Mark::Ok);

    if (!s.virtualMachinePlatform) rowAt(IDS_SYS_VMP, Text::Get(IDS_UNKNOWN), Mark::Wait);
    else if (*s.virtualMachinePlatform) rowAt(IDS_SYS_VMP, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_ENABLED), Mark::Ok);
    else rowAt(IDS_SYS_VMP, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_DISABLED), Mark::Todo, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_VMP_OFF));
    if (s.developerMode) rowAt(IDS_SYS_DEVMODE, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_DEVMODE_ON), Mark::Ok);
    else rowAt(IDS_SYS_DEVMODE, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_DEVMODE_DISABLED), Mark::Todo, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_DEVMODE_OFF));

    std::error_code ec;
    const std::wstring replaced = Text::Get(IDS_SYS_PKG_REPLACED);
    if (!s.package) rowAt(IDS_SYS_PACKAGE, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_PKG_NONE), Mark::Todo);
    else if (!s.package->developmentMode) rowAt(IDS_SYS_PACKAGE, Text::Format(IDS_SYS_PKG_STORE, s.package->version), Mark::Todo, replaced);
    else if (std::filesystem::equivalent(s.package->location, m_folder, ec)) rowAt(IDS_SYS_PACKAGE, Text::Format(IDS_SYS_PKG_OURS, s.package->version), Mark::Ok);
    else rowAt(IDS_SYS_PACKAGE, Text::Format(IDS_SYS_PKG_FOLDER, s.package->version, s.package->location.wstring()), Mark::Todo, replaced);

    // Bluetooth for Android: the PC's adapter through the background bridge.
    if (!m_btKnown) {
        rowAt(IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_READING), Mark::Wait);
    } else if (!m_btAdapter) {
        rowAt(IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_BT_NONE), Mark::Wait);
    } else if (!Signature::OfficialFeatures()) {
        rowAt(IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_BT_UNOFFICIAL), Mark::Wait);
    } else if (m_release == Core::Release::State::Checking) {
        rowAt(IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_BT_CHECKING), Mark::Wait);
    } else if (m_release == Core::Release::State::Unsigned || m_release == Core::Release::State::Modified) {
        rowAt(IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_BT_RELEASE), Mark::Wait);
    } else if (m_btRunning) {
        rowAt(IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, Text::Get(m_btConnected ? IDS_SYS_BT_CONNECTED : IDS_SYS_BT_ON), m_btConnected ? Mark::Ok : Mark::Wait,
              m_btAutostart ? Text::Get(IDS_SYS_BT_AUTOSTART) : std::wstring());
    } else {
        rowAt(IDS_SYS_BLUETOOTH, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_BT_OFF), Mark::Todo, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_BT_HINT));
    }
}

void MainWindow::PaintComponentsCard(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const D2D1_RECT_F& card = m_componentsCard;
    c.Fill(card, Color::Card, f.F(kRadius));
    c.Stroke(card, Color::CardStroke, f.F(kRadius));
    const float left = card.left + f.F(kPad), right = card.right - f.F(kPad);
    float y = card.top + f.F(kPad);
    c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_CARD_COMPONENTS), {left, y, right, y + f.F(kHeaderH)}, Font::Strong, Color::Text);
    y += f.F(kHeaderH + 8);
    if (!m_manifest) {
        c.Paragraph(Text::Get(IDS_COMPONENTS_EMPTY), {left, y, right, card.bottom - f.F(kPad)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
        return;
    }
    c.PushClip({card.left, y, card.right, card.bottom - f.F(6)});
    // The state pills share one width, wide enough for the longest state in this language.
    float badgeW = f.F(78);
    for (const UINT id : {IDS_COMP_INSTALLED, IDS_COMP_UPDATE, IDS_COMP_NEW}) badgeW = std::max(badgeW, c.Width(Text::Get(id), Font::Caption) + f.F(16));
    const float sizeW = f.F(70);
    for (const Core::PlanItem& item : m_plan.items) {
        const Core::Component& comp = *item.component;
        const bool installed = !item.needed;
        const bool known = m_state.components.contains(comp.id);
        const UINT stateId = installed ? IDS_COMP_INSTALLED : known ? IDS_COMP_UPDATE : IDS_COMP_NEW;
        const D2D1_COLOR_F stateColor = installed ? Color::Success : known ? Color::AccentText : Color::Text2;
        const D2D1_RECT_F rowRect{left, y, right, y + f.F(kComponentRowH)};
        c.Text(ComponentName(comp), {rowRect.left, rowRect.top, rowRect.right - badgeW - sizeW - f.F(8), rowRect.bottom}, Font::Body, Color::Text);
        c.Text(FormatBytes(comp.packedSize), {rowRect.right - badgeW - sizeW, rowRect.top, rowRect.right - badgeW - f.F(8), rowRect.bottom},
               Font::Caption, Color::Text3, Align::Right);
        // State as a small pill.
        const float pillH = f.F(18);
        const D2D1_RECT_F pill{rowRect.right - badgeW, (rowRect.top + rowRect.bottom - pillH) / 2, rowRect.right,
                               (rowRect.top + rowRect.bottom + pillH) / 2};
        c.Fill(pill, D2D1_COLOR_F{stateColor.r, stateColor.g, stateColor.b, 0.14f}, pillH / 2);
        c.Text(Text::Get(stateId), pill, Font::Caption, stateColor, Align::Center);
        y += f.F(kComponentRowH);
    }
    c.PopClip();
}

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Main window: menu bar, context menus, accelerators and the enabled / checked state of items.
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
```
