```cpp
void MainWindow::BuildMenus() {
    auto& m = m_menu;
    auto item = [&m](HMENU menu, UINT id, UINT text, const wchar_t* shortcut = L"", bool radio = false) {
        m.AddItem(menu, id, Text::Get(text), shortcut, radio);
    };

    HMENU file = m.AddMenu(Text::Get(IDS_MENU_FILE));
    item(file, CmdInstall, IDS_MI_INSTALL, L"Ctrl+I");
    item(file, CmdCancel, IDS_CANCEL, L"Esc");
    item(file, CmdCheck, IDS_MI_CHECK, L"F5");
    m.AddSeparator(file);
    item(file, CmdLaunch, IDS_MI_LAUNCH, L"Ctrl+R");
    item(file, CmdStopWsa, IDS_MI_STOP_WSA, L"Ctrl+Shift+R");
    item(file, CmdOpenFolder, IDS_MI_OPEN_FOLDER);
    item(file, CmdChangeFolder, IDS_MI_CHANGE_FOLDER);
    m.AddSeparator(file);
    item(file, CmdUninstall, IDS_MI_UNINSTALL);
    m.AddSeparator(file);
    item(file, CmdExit, IDS_MI_EXIT, L"Ctrl+Q");

    m_sourceMenu = m.AddMenu(Text::Get(IDS_MENU_SOURCE));
    item(m_sourceMenu, CmdSourceGitHub, IDS_MI_SRC_GITHUB, L"", true);
    item(m_sourceMenu, CmdSourceMirror, IDS_MI_SRC_MIRROR, L"", true);
    item(m_sourceMenu, CmdSourceLocal, IDS_MI_SRC_LOCAL, L"", true);
    item(m_sourceMenu, CmdSourceCustom, IDS_MI_SRC_CUSTOM, L"Ctrl+E", true);
    m.AddSeparator(m_sourceMenu);
    item(m_sourceMenu, CmdReleases, IDS_MI_RELEASES);

    HMENU bluetooth = m.AddMenu(Text::Get(IDS_MENU_BLUETOOTH));
    item(bluetooth, CmdBtStart, IDS_MI_BT_START, L"Ctrl+B");
    item(bluetooth, CmdBtStop, IDS_MI_BT_STOP);
    m.AddSeparator(bluetooth);
    item(bluetooth, CmdBtAutostart, IDS_MI_BT_AUTOSTART);
    m.AddSeparator(bluetooth);
    item(bluetooth, CmdBtLog, IDS_MI_BT_LOG);

    HMENU android = m.AddMenu(Text::Get(IDS_MENU_ANDROID));
    item(android, CmdElevation, IDS_MI_ELEVATION);
    item(android, CmdElevationSu, IDS_MI_ELEVATION_SU);
    m.AddSeparator(android);
    HMENU remember = m.AddSubmenu(android, Text::Get(IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER));
    item(remember, CmdHelloRememberOff, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_OFF, L"", true);
    item(remember, CmdHelloRemember5, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_5, L"", true);
    item(remember, CmdHelloRemember30, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_30, L"", true);
    item(remember, CmdHelloRememberLock, IDS_MI_HELLO_REMEMBER_LOCK, L"", true);
    m.AddSeparator(android);
    item(android, CmdTray, IDS_MI_TRAY);

    HMENU view = m.AddMenu(Text::Get(IDS_MENU_VIEW));
    item(view, CmdViewLog, IDS_MI_LOG, L"Ctrl+L");
    item(view, CmdCopyLog, IDS_MI_COPY_LOG);
    item(view, CmdClearLog, IDS_MI_CLEAR_LOG);
    // Language: follow Windows, or English (built in) / one of the language files, each named in itself
    // and with its coverage, so a half-done translation is visible. Long lists continue in columns.
    m.AddSeparator(view);
    HMENU language = m.AddSubmenu(view, Text::Get(IDS_MI_LANGUAGE));
    m_languages = Text::Available();
    m.AddItem(language, CmdLanguageAuto, Text::Format(IDS_LANGUAGE_AUTO, LanguageName(Text::Detect())), {}, true);
    m.AddSeparator(language);
    constexpr std::size_t kPerColumn = 20;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_languages.size() && CmdLanguageFirst + i <= CmdLanguageLast; ++i) {
        const Text::Language& l = m_languages[i];
        m.AddItem(language, static_cast<UINT>(CmdLanguageFirst + i), l.name, l.code == L"en" ? std::wstring() : std::format(L"{}%", l.Coverage()),
                  true, i > 0 && i % kPerColumn == 0);
    }

    HMENU help = m.AddMenu(Text::Get(IDS_MENU_HELP));
    item(help, CmdHelpCli, IDS_MI_HELP_CLI, L"F1");
    item(help, CmdAbout, IDS_MI_ABOUT);

    m_logMenu = m.CreatePopup();
    item(m_logMenu, CmdCopyLog, IDS_MI_COPY_LOG, L"Ctrl+C");
    item(m_logMenu, CmdClearLog, IDS_MI_CLEAR_LOG);

    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    if (client.right > 0) Layout();  // the menu bar width depends on the language
}

void MainWindow::BuildAccelerators() {
    ACCEL keys[] = {
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'I', CmdInstall}, {FVIRTKEY, VK_F5, CmdCheck},          {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'R', CmdLaunch},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'Q', CmdExit},    {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'E', CmdSourceCustom}, {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'L', CmdViewLog},
        {FVIRTKEY, VK_F1, CmdHelpCli},          {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'B', CmdBtStart},      {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL | FSHIFT, 'R', CmdStopWsa},
    };
    m_accel.reset(CreateAcceleratorTableW(keys, static_cast<int>(std::size(keys))));
}

// Enabled / checked state of every item of `menu`, from the same rules as the buttons.
void MainWindow::ApplyMenuState(HMENU menu) const {
    const std::wstring source = SourceKey();
    const bool automatic = Text::Automatic();
    const std::wstring language = Text::Current();
    const std::uint32_t remember = Host::HelloRememberMinutes();
    for (int i = 0; i < GetMenuItemCount(menu); ++i) {
        const UINT id = GetMenuItemID(menu, i);
        if (id == static_cast<UINT>(-1) || id == 0) continue;  // separator or submenu
        EnableMenuItem(menu, id, MF_BYCOMMAND | (Can(id) ? MF_ENABLED : MF_GRAYED));
        bool checked = false;
        if (id == CmdLanguageAuto) {
            checked = automatic;
        } else if (id >= CmdLanguageFirst && id <= CmdLanguageLast) {
            const std::size_t index = id - CmdLanguageFirst;
            checked = !automatic && index < m_languages.size() && m_languages[index].code == language;
        } else {
            switch (id) {
            case CmdSourceGitHub: checked = source == L"github"; break;
            case CmdSourceMirror: checked = source == L"mirror"; break;
            case CmdSourceLocal: checked = source == L"local"; break;
            case CmdSourceCustom: checked = source == L"custom"; break;
            case CmdViewLog: checked = m_logVisible; break;
            case CmdBtAutostart: checked = m_btAutostart; break;
            case CmdElevation: checked = Host::ElevationEnabled(); break;
            case CmdElevationSu: checked = Host::ElevationSuEnabled(); break;
            case CmdTray: checked = Host::TrayEnabled(); break;
            case CmdHelloRememberOff: checked = remember == 0; break;
            case CmdHelloRemember5: checked = remember == 5; break;
            case CmdHelloRemember30: checked = remember == 30; break;
            case CmdHelloRememberLock: checked = remember == Host::kHelloUntilLocked; break;
            default: continue;
            }
        }
        CheckMenuItem(menu, id, MF_BYCOMMAND | (checked ? MF_CHECKED : MF_UNCHECKED));
    }
}

void MainWindow::ShowContextMenu(HWND target, POINT screen) {
    if (target == m_log.hwnd()) m_menu.TrackContext(m_hwnd, m_logMenu, screen);
}
```

`src/gui/MainWindowState.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Main window: what is known about Windows and the release, what is possible right now,
// status and log.
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "app/Cli.h"
#include "bluetooth/Bridge.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "core/Release.h"
#include "support/Signature.h"
#include "bluetooth/Scanner.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "core/Uninstall.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <objbase.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>

namespace WN::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

std::wstring MainWindow::SourceKey() const {
    const std::wstring key = Settings::Read(L"Source", L"github");
    return key == L"local" || key == L"mirror" || key == L"custom" ? key : std::wstring(L"github");
}

std::wstring MainWindow::SourceUrl() const {
    const std::wstring key = SourceKey();
    return key == L"custom" ? Settings::Read(L"CustomManifest") : Cli::SourceUrl(key);
}

std::wstring MainWindow::SourceSummary() const {
    const std::wstring key = SourceKey();
    if (key == L"local") return Text::Format(IDS_SOURCE_LOCAL, Config::kLocalManifest);
    if (key == L"mirror") return Text::Format(IDS_SOURCE_MIRROR, Config::kMirrorManifest);
    if (key == L"custom") return Text::Format(IDS_SOURCE_CUSTOM, Settings::Read(L"CustomManifest"));
    return Text::Format(IDS_SOURCE_GITHUB, Config::kGitHubRepo);
}

std::wstring MainWindow::ComponentName(const Core::Component& c) const {
    static constexpr std::pair<std::wstring_view, UINT> kNames[] = {
        {L"system", IDS_COMPNAME_SYSTEM}, {L"system_ext", IDS_COMPNAME_SYSTEM_EXT}, {L"product", IDS_COMPNAME_PRODUCT},
        {L"vendor", IDS_COMPNAME_VENDOR}, {L"kernel", IDS_COMPNAME_KERNEL},         {L"initrd", IDS_COMPNAME_INITRD},
        {L"windows", IDS_COMPNAME_WINDOWS}, {L"wsapatch", IDS_COMPNAME_WSAPATCH},
    };
    for (const auto& [id, text] : kNames)
        if (c.id == id) return Text::Get(text);
    return c.id;
}

// Windows and the manifest are read on a worker (WMI, package manager and the network block).
// After a job the bar keeps showing its result; otherwise it slides while reading.
void MainWindow::Refresh(bool keepResult) {
    if (m_busy || m_refreshing) return;
    m_refreshing = true;
    if (!keepResult) m_progress = {};
    m_animStart = GetTickCount64();
    StartAnimation();
    SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_READING));
    UpdateControls();
    if (m_worker.joinable()) m_worker.join();
    HWND hwnd = m_hwnd;
    const std::wstring url = SourceUrl();
    m_worker = std::jthread([hwnd, url](std::stop_token stop) {
        const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        auto msg = std::make_unique<RefreshMessage>();
        msg->system = Core::Inspect();
        msg->btAdapter = Bt::Scanner::AdapterAddress();
        msg->btAutostart = Host::AutostartEnabled();
        if (url.empty()) {
            msg->manifestError = Text::Get(IDS_CUSTOM_INVALID);
        } else if (auto m = Core::LoadManifest(url, stop)) {
            msg->manifest = std::move(*m);
        } else {
            msg->manifestError = m.error();
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
        PostOwned(hwnd, WM_APP_REFRESHED, std::move(msg));
    });
}

void MainWindow::OnRefreshed(Core::SystemInfo system, std::optional<Core::Manifest> manifest, std::wstring error) {
    m_refreshing = false;
    m_system = std::move(system);
    m_manifest = std::move(manifest);
    m_manifestError = std::move(error);
    m_state = Core::ReadState(m_folder);
    if (m_manifest) {
        Log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_MANIFEST, m_manifest->version, m_manifest->android, m_manifest->variant, m_manifest->source));
    } else {
        Log(Level::Error, Text::Format(IDS_STATUS_NO_MANIFEST, m_manifestError));
    }
    Log(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_LOG_WINDOWS, m_system->Version()));
    UpdatePlan();
    StatusFromPlan();
    Layout();  // the components card grows with the release
    UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::UpdatePlan() {
    m_plan = m_manifest && m_system ? Core::MakePlan(*m_manifest, m_state, *m_system, m_folder) : Core::Plan{};
    const bool installedBefore = !m_state.components.empty();
    const bool upToDate = installedBefore && m_plan.UpToDate();
    const UINT label = !installedBefore ? IDS_BTN_INSTALL : upToDate ? IDS_BTN_REINSTALL : IDS_BTN_UPDATE;
    SetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdInstall), Text::Get(label).c_str());
    m_looks[CmdInstall].icon = label == IDS_BTN_REINSTALL ? Icon::Repair : label == IDS_BTN_UPDATE ? Icon::Sync : Icon::Download;
    m_looks[CmdInstall].kind = upToDate ? ButtonKind::Standard : ButtonKind::Accent;
    m_looks[CmdLaunch].kind = upToDate ? ButtonKind::Accent : ButtonKind::Standard;
    InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdInstall), nullptr, FALSE);
    InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdLaunch), nullptr, FALSE);
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void MainWindow::StatusFromPlan() {
    if (m_system && !m_system->Supported()) {
        SetStatus(Level::Error, Text::Format(IDS_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED, Text::Get(IDS_SYS_UNSUPPORTED)));
    } else if (!m_manifest) {
        SetStatus(Level::Error, Text::Get(IDS_STATUS_NO_RELEASE));  // the reason is shown in the card
    } else if (m_plan.UpToDate()) {
        SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_STATUS_UPTODATE, m_manifest->version));
    } else if (m_state.components.empty()) {
        SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_STATUS_READY, m_manifest->version, FormatBytes(m_plan.downloadBytes)));
    } else {
        SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Format(IDS_STATUS_UPDATE, m_manifest->version, FormatBytes(m_plan.downloadBytes)));
    }
}

bool MainWindow::Can(UINT command) const {
    const bool idle = !m_busy && !m_refreshing;
    switch (command) {
    case CmdInstall: return idle && m_manifest && m_system && m_system->Supported();
    case CmdCancel: return m_busy && !m_removing;
    case CmdUninstall: return idle && m_system && Core::Removable(m_folder, *m_system);
    case CmdBtStart: return !m_removing && m_btAdapter && !m_btRunning && Signature::OfficialFeatures();
    case CmdBtStop: return m_btRunning;
    case CmdBtToggle: return !m_removing && m_btAdapter != 0 && Signature::OfficialFeatures();
    case CmdBtAutostart: return !m_removing && m_btAdapter && Signature::OfficialFeatures();
    case CmdBtLog: { std::error_code ec; return std::filesystem::exists(Bt::LogFolder() / L"bluetooth.log", ec); }
    case CmdElevation: return !m_removing && Signature::OfficialFeatures();
    case CmdTray: return !m_removing && Signature::OfficialFeatures();
    case CmdHelloRememberOff: case CmdHelloRemember5: case CmdHelloRemember30: case CmdHelloRememberLock:
        return !m_removing && Signature::OfficialFeatures();
    case CmdElevationSu: return !m_removing && Signature::OfficialFeatures() && Host::ElevationEnabled();
    case CmdCheck: return idle;
    case CmdLaunch: return !m_busy && m_system && m_system->package;
    case CmdStopWsa: return !m_busy && m_system && m_system->package;
    case CmdOpenFolder: { std::error_code ec; return std::filesystem::exists(m_folder, ec); }
    case CmdChangeFolder:
    case CmdSourceMenu:
    case CmdSourceLocal: case CmdSourceMirror: case CmdSourceGitHub: case CmdSourceCustom: return idle;
    case CmdCopyLog: case CmdClearLog: return m_log.Count() > 0;
    default: return true;
    }
}

void MainWindow::UpdateControls() {
    for (UINT id : {CmdInstall, CmdCancel, CmdLaunch, CmdChangeFolder, CmdSourceMenu, CmdBtToggle}) {
        HWND b = GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id));
        const bool enable = Can(id);
        if ((IsWindowEnabled(b) != FALSE) != enable) {
            // Never disable the control that has the focus without moving the focus first.
            if (!enable && GetFocus() == b) SendMessageW(m_hwnd, WM_NEXTDLGCTL, 0, FALSE);
            EnableWindow(b, enable);
        }
    }
    if (auto it = m_looks.find(CmdBtToggle); it != m_looks.end()) {
        const std::optional<D2D1_COLOR_F> glow = m_btRunning ? std::optional<D2D1_COLOR_F>(Color::Bluetooth) : std::nullopt;
        if (it->second.glowColor.has_value() != glow.has_value()) {
            it->second.glowColor = glow;
            InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdBtToggle), nullptr, FALSE);
        }
    }
}

void MainWindow::SetStatus(Level level, std::wstring text) {
    m_statusLevel = level;
    m_status = std::move(text);
    const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(m_statusRect.left), static_cast<LONG>(m_statusRect.top), static_cast<LONG>(m_statusRect.right),
                 static_cast<LONG>(m_statusRect.bottom)};
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, &r, FALSE);
}

void MainWindow::Log(Level level, std::wstring text) {
    m_log.Append(level, std::move(text));
    if (!m_logVisible) {
        ++m_unread;
        m_looks[CmdExpand].badge = m_unread > 99 ? std::wstring(L"99+") : std::to_wstring(m_unread);
        InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdExpand), nullptr, FALSE);
    }
}

void MainWindow::SetTaskbar(TBPFLAG state, int permille) {
    if (!m_taskbar) return;
    m_taskbar->SetProgressState(m_hwnd, state);
    if (state == TBPF_NORMAL || state == TBPF_ERROR) m_taskbar->SetProgressValue(m_hwnd, static_cast<ULONGLONG>(std::max(permille, 0)), 1000);
}

void MainWindow::StartAnimation() { SetTimer(m_hwnd, kAnimationTimer, 15, nullptr); }

void MainWindow::UpdateBluetoothRunning() {
    const bool running = Host::Running() && Host::BluetoothEnabled();
    const bool connected = running && Bt::AndroidConnected();
    const Core::Release::State release = Core::Release::HostVerdict();
    if (running == m_btRunning && connected == m_btConnected && release == m_release) return;
    m_btRunning = running;
    m_btConnected = connected;
    m_release = release;
    UpdateControls();
    InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdBtToggle), nullptr, FALSE);
    const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(m_systemCard.left), static_cast<LONG>(m_systemCard.top), static_cast<LONG>(m_systemCard.right),
                 static_cast<LONG>(m_systemCard.bottom)};
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, &r, FALSE);
}

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "gui/Menus.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>

namespace WN::Ui {
namespace {
MenuBar* g_tracking = nullptr;  // the bar whose menu loop is running (one per thread at most)
}

MenuBar::MenuBar(const Fonts& fonts) : m_fonts(fonts), m_background(CreateSolidBrush(ToColorRef(Color::Flyout))) {}

MenuBar::~MenuBar() = default;

void MenuBar::Prepare(HMENU menu) {
    MENUINFO info{sizeof info};
    info.fMask = MIM_BACKGROUND | MIM_STYLE;
    info.hbrBack = m_background.get();
    info.dwStyle = MNS_CHECKORBMP;
    SetMenuInfo(menu, &info);
}

HMENU MenuBar::AddMenu(std::wstring label) {
    wchar_t mnemonic = 0;
    if (const std::size_t amp = label.find(L'&'); amp != std::wstring::npos && amp + 1 < label.size()) {
        mnemonic = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(label[amp + 1]));
        label.erase(amp, 1);
    }
    MenuHandle menu(CreatePopupMenu());
    HMENU handle = menu.get();
    Prepare(handle);
    m_tops.push_back({std::move(label), mnemonic, std::move(menu), {}});
    return handle;
}

void MenuBar::Reset() {
    m_tops.clear();    // menus first: their items point into m_data
    m_popups.clear();
    m_data.clear();
    m_hot = m_open = -1;
}

HMENU MenuBar::CreatePopup() {
    MenuHandle menu(CreatePopupMenu());
    HMENU handle = menu.get();
    Prepare(handle);
    m_popups.push_back(std::move(menu));
    return handle;
}

void MenuBar::AddItem(HMENU menu, UINT id, std::wstring text, std::wstring shortcut, bool radio, bool column) {
    auto data = std::make_unique<Data>(Data{std::move(text), std::move(shortcut), false, radio});
    MENUITEMINFOW item{sizeof item};
    item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE | MIIM_ID | MIIM_DATA | MIIM_STRING;
    item.fType = MFT_OWNERDRAW | (radio ? MFT_RADIOCHECK : 0) | (column ? MFT_MENUBREAK : 0);
    item.wID = id;
    item.dwItemData = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(data.get());
    item.dwTypeData = data->text.data();  // kept for accessibility tools
    InsertMenuItemW(menu, GetMenuItemCount(menu), TRUE, &item);
    m_data.push_back(std::move(data));
}

HMENU MenuBar::AddSubmenu(HMENU menu, std::wstring text) {
    HMENU child = CreatePopup();
    auto data = std::make_unique<Data>(Data{std::move(text), {}, false, false, true});
    MENUITEMINFOW item{sizeof item};
    item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE | MIIM_SUBMENU | MIIM_DATA | MIIM_STRING;
    item.fType = MFT_OWNERDRAW;
    item.hSubMenu = child;
    item.dwItemData = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(data.get());
    item.dwTypeData = data->text.data();
    InsertMenuItemW(menu, GetMenuItemCount(menu), TRUE, &item);
    m_data.push_back(std::move(data));
    return child;
}

void MenuBar::OnMenuSelect(WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    m_activePopup = reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(lParam);
    m_selectionIsSubmenu = HIWORD(wParam) != 0xFFFF && (HIWORD(wParam) & MF_POPUP);
}

void MenuBar::AddSeparator(HMENU menu) {
    auto data = std::make_unique<Data>(Data{{}, {}, true, false});
    MENUITEMINFOW item{sizeof item};
    item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE | MIIM_DATA;
    item.fType = MFT_OWNERDRAW | MFT_SEPARATOR;
    item.dwItemData = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(data.get());
    InsertMenuItemW(menu, GetMenuItemCount(menu), TRUE, &item);
    m_data.push_back(std::move(data));
}

void MenuBar::Remeasure() {
    auto touch = [](HMENU menu) {
        for (int i = 0; i < GetMenuItemCount(menu); ++i) {
            MENUITEMINFOW item{sizeof item};
            item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE;
            if (GetMenuItemInfoW(menu, static_cast<UINT>(i), TRUE, &item)) SetMenuItemInfoW(menu, static_cast<UINT>(i), TRUE, &item);
        }
    };
    for (auto& t : m_tops) touch(t.menu.get());
    for (auto& p : m_popups) touch(p.get());
}

void MenuBar::Layout(float left, float top, float height) {
    float x = left;
    for (auto& t : m_tops) {
        const float w = TextWidth(m_fonts, Font::Body, t.label) + m_fonts.F(20);
        t.rect = {x, top, x + w, top + height};
        x += w + m_fonts.F(2);
    }
}

D2D1_RECT_F MenuBar::Bounds() const {
    if (m_tops.empty()) return {};
    return {m_tops.front().rect.left, m_tops.front().rect.top, m_tops.back().rect.right, m_tops.back().rect.bottom};
}

void MenuBar::Paint(Canvas& c) const {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_tops.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& t = m_tops[i];
        const int index = static_cast<int>(i);
        if (index == m_open) c.Fill(t.rect, Color::Selected, m_fonts.F(4));
        else if (index == m_hot) c.Fill(t.rect, Color::Hover, m_fonts.F(4));
        c.Text(t.label, t.rect, Font::Body, index == m_open || index == m_hot ? Color::Text : Color::Text2, Align::Center);
    }
}

int MenuBar::HitTest(POINT p) const {
    const float x = static_cast<float>(p.x), y = static_cast<float>(p.y);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_tops.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& r = m_tops[i].rect;
        if (x >= r.left && x < r.right && y >= r.top && y < r.bottom) return static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    return -1;
}

bool MenuBar::SetHot(int index) {
    if (index == m_hot) return false;
    m_hot = index;
    return true;
}

void MenuBar::Invalidate() const {
    if (!m_owner) return;
    const D2D1_RECT_F b = Bounds();
    RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(b.left) - 2, static_cast<LONG>(b.top) - 2, static_cast<LONG>(b.right) + 2, static_cast<LONG>(b.bottom) + 2};
    InvalidateRect(m_owner, &r, FALSE);
    UpdateWindow(m_owner);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK MenuBar::Filter(int code, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    MenuBar* self = g_tracking;
    if (code == MSGF_MENU && self && self->m_open >= 0) {
        const MSG& msg = *reinterpret_cast<const MSG*>(lParam);
        const int count = static_cast<int>(self->m_tops.size());
        const bool inSubmenu = self->m_activePopup && self->m_activePopup != self->m_tops[static_cast<std::size_t>(self->m_open)].menu.get();
        const bool toSubmenu = msg.wParam == VK_RIGHT && self->m_selectionIsSubmenu;
        const bool fromSubmenu = msg.wParam == VK_LEFT && inSubmenu;
        if (msg.message == WM_KEYDOWN && (msg.wParam == VK_LEFT || msg.wParam == VK_RIGHT) && !toSubmenu && !fromSubmenu) {
            self->m_switchTo = (self->m_open + (msg.wParam == VK_RIGHT ? 1 : count - 1)) % count;
            self->m_switchByKeyboard = true;
            EndMenu();
            return TRUE;
        }
        if (msg.message == WM_MOUSEMOVE || msg.message == WM_LBUTTONDOWN) {
            POINT p = msg.pt;
            ScreenToClient(self->m_owner, &p);
            const int index = self->HitTest(p);
            if (msg.message == WM_MOUSEMOVE && index >= 0 && index != self->m_open) {
                self->m_switchTo = index;
                self->m_switchByKeyboard = false;
                EndMenu();
                return TRUE;
            }
            if (msg.message == WM_LBUTTONDOWN && index == self->m_open) {
                self->m_switchTo = -1;  // clicking the open menu's title closes it
                EndMenu();
                return TRUE;
            }
        }
    }
    return CallNextHookEx(nullptr, code, wParam, lParam);
}

void MenuBar::Open(HWND owner, int index, bool keyboard) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int>(m_tops.size()) || g_tracking) return;
    m_owner = owner;
    UINT command = 0;
    while (index >= 0) {
        m_open = index;
        m_switchTo = -1;
        m_activePopup = nullptr;
        m_selectionIsSubmenu = false;
        Invalidate();
        const auto& t = m_tops[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
        POINT topLeft{static_cast<LONG>(t.rect.left), static_cast<LONG>(t.rect.top)};
        POINT bottomRight{static_cast<LONG>(t.rect.right), static_cast<LONG>(t.rect.bottom)};
        ClientToScreen(owner, &topLeft);
        ClientToScreen(owner, &bottomRight);
        TPMPARAMS params{sizeof params, {topLeft.x, topLeft.y, bottomRight.x, bottomRight.y}};
        if (keyboard) PostMessageW(owner, WM_KEYDOWN, VK_DOWN, 0);  // highlight the first item
        g_tracking = this;
        {
            const HookHandle hook(SetWindowsHookExW(WH_MSGFILTER, Filter, nullptr, GetCurrentThreadId()));
            command = static_cast<UINT>(TrackPopupMenuEx(t.menu.get(), TPM_LEFTALIGN | TPM_TOPALIGN | TPM_VERTICAL | TPM_RETURNCMD,
                                                         topLeft.x, bottomRight.y, owner, &params));
        }
        g_tracking = nullptr;
        if (command) break;
        index = m_switchTo;
        keyboard = m_switchByKeyboard;
    }
    m_open = -1;
    POINT cursor{};
    GetCursorPos(&cursor);
    ScreenToClient(owner, &cursor);
    m_hot = HitTest(cursor);
    Invalidate();
    if (command) PostMessageW(owner, WM_COMMAND, MAKEWPARAM(command, 0), 0);
}

bool MenuBar::OpenByMnemonic(HWND owner, wchar_t key) {
    key = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(key));
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_tops.size(); ++i) {
        if (m_tops[i].mnemonic && m_tops[i].mnemonic == key) {
            Open(owner, static_cast<int>(i), true);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void MenuBar::TrackContext(HWND owner, HMENU menu, POINT screen) {
    const UINT command = static_cast<UINT>(TrackPopupMenuEx(menu, TPM_LEFTALIGN | TPM_TOPALIGN | TPM_RIGHTBUTTON | TPM_RETURNCMD,
                                                            screen.x, screen.y, owner, nullptr));
    if (command) PostMessageW(owner, WM_COMMAND, MAKEWPARAM(command, 0), 0);
}

void MenuBar::Measure(MEASUREITEMSTRUCT& mis) const {
    const auto* data = reinterpret_cast<const Data*>(mis.itemData);
    if (!data) return;
    if (data->separator) {
        mis.itemWidth = static_cast<UINT>(m_fonts.S(40));
        mis.itemHeight = static_cast<UINT>(m_fonts.S(9));
        return;
    }
    const float text = TextWidth(m_fonts, Font::Body, data->text);
    const float shortcut = data->submenu ? m_fonts.F(28)
                           : data->shortcut.empty() ? 0 : TextWidth(m_fonts, Font::Caption, data->shortcut) + m_fonts.F(32);
    mis.itemWidth = static_cast<UINT>(m_fonts.F(36) + text + shortcut + m_fonts.F(16));
    mis.itemHeight = static_cast<UINT>(m_fonts.S(30));
}

void MenuBar::Draw(const DRAWITEMSTRUCT& dis) const {
    const auto* data = reinterpret_cast<const Data*>(dis.itemData);
    if (!data) return;
    const bool disabled = dis.itemState & (ODS_DISABLED | ODS_GRAYED);
    const bool selected = (dis.itemState & ODS_SELECTED) && !disabled;
    const bool checked = dis.itemState & ODS_CHECKED;
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    Ui::Paint(dis.hDC, dis.rcItem, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        const D2D1_RECT_F r = ToF(dis.rcItem);
        c.Clear(Color::Flyout);
        if (data->separator) {
            const float y = std::floor((r.top + r.bottom) / 2) + 0.5f;
            c.Line({r.left + f.F(4), y}, {r.right - f.F(4), y}, Color::FlyoutStroke);
            return;
        }
        if (selected) c.Fill(Inset(r, f.F(4), f.F(2)), Color::FlyoutHot, f.F(4));
        const D2D1_COLOR_F fg = disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text;
        if (checked) {
            if (data->radio) {
                c.Circle({r.left + f.F(20), (r.top + r.bottom) / 2}, f.F(3.5f), disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::AccentText);
            } else {
                c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Check), {r.left + f.F(10), r.top, r.left + f.F(30), r.bottom}, Font::IconSmall, fg,
                       Align::Center);
            }
        }
        c.Text(data->text, {r.left + f.F(36), r.top, r.right - f.F(12), r.bottom}, Font::Body, fg);
        if (data->submenu)
            c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::ChevronRight), {r.right - f.F(28), r.top, r.right - f.F(10), r.bottom}, Font::IconSmall,
                   disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text2, Align::Center);
        else if (!data->shortcut.empty())
            c.Text(data->shortcut, {r.left, r.top, r.right - f.F(16), r.bottom}, Font::Caption,
                   disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text3, Align::Right);
    });
    // Windows paints its own (light) submenu arrow after WM_DRAWITEM; keep it out of the item.
    if (data->submenu) ExcludeClipRect(dis.hDC, dis.rcItem.left, dis.rcItem.top, dis.rcItem.right, dis.rcItem.bottom);
}

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

`src/gui/Menus.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Menus in the dark palette: a menu bar drawn in the client area (it sits on the Mica backdrop,
// where a native menu bar cannot draw correctly) and owner-drawn popup menus.
//
// Keyboard: Alt+mnemonic or F10 opens a menu, Left/Right switch between menus, Esc closes.
// Mouse: click opens, moving across the bar while a menu is open switches to the menu under it.
#pragma once
#include "gui/Theme.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Ui {

class MenuBar {
public:
    explicit MenuBar(const Fonts& fonts);
    ~MenuBar();
    MenuBar(const MenuBar&) = delete;
    MenuBar& operator=(const MenuBar&) = delete;

    // Builders. In a top-level label '&' marks the Alt key ("&File", "Pomo&c").
    HMENU AddMenu(std::wstring label);
    HMENU CreatePopup();  // context menus, owned by the bar as well
    // `column` starts a new column (long lists such as the languages).
    void AddItem(HMENU menu, UINT id, std::wstring text, std::wstring shortcut = {}, bool radio = false, bool column = false);
    HMENU AddSubmenu(HMENU menu, std::wstring text);
    void AddSeparator(HMENU menu);
    void Remeasure();  // after a DPI change (Windows caches owner-draw item sizes)
    void Reset();      // drops every menu (language switch); build them again afterwards

    // Bar in client coordinates.
    void Layout(float left, float top, float height);
    void Paint(Canvas& c) const;
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_RECT_F Bounds() const;
    [[nodiscard]] int HitTest(POINT client) const;
    bool SetHot(int index);  // true = repaint needed

    // Modal menu loop; the chosen command is posted to `owner` as WM_COMMAND afterwards.
    void Open(HWND owner, int index, bool keyboard);
    bool OpenByMnemonic(HWND owner, wchar_t key);
    void TrackContext(HWND owner, HMENU menu, POINT screen);

    // Owner-draw (forward from the owner's WM_MEASUREITEM / WM_DRAWITEM with CtlType == ODT_MENU).
    void Measure(MEASUREITEMSTRUCT& mis) const;
    void Draw(const DRAWITEMSTRUCT& dis) const;
    // Forward WM_MENUSELECT: Left/Right then open and close submenus instead of switching menus.
    void OnMenuSelect(WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);

private:
    struct Data {
        std::wstring text, shortcut;
        bool separator = false, radio = false, submenu = false;
    };
    struct Top {
        std::wstring label;
        wchar_t mnemonic;
        MenuHandle menu;
        D2D1_RECT_F rect{};
    };
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Filter(int code, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);
    void Prepare(HMENU menu);
    void Invalidate() const;

    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    Gdi<HBRUSH> m_background;
    std::vector<Top> m_tops;
    std::vector<MenuHandle> m_popups;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Data>> m_data;
    int m_hot = -1, m_open = -1, m_switchTo = -1;
    bool m_switchByKeyboard = false;
    bool m_selectionIsSubmenu = false;  // highlighted item opens a submenu
    HMENU m_activePopup = nullptr;      // popup that has the highlight
    HWND m_owner = nullptr;
};

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

`src/gui/Theme.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "gui/Theme.h"
#include <dwmapi.h>
#include <uxtheme.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

#pragma comment(lib, "d2d1.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dwrite.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dwmapi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "uxtheme.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")

namespace WN::Ui {

COLORREF ToColorRef(D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    auto byte = [](float v) { return static_cast<BYTE>(std::lround(std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f)); };
    return RGB(byte(c.r), byte(c.g), byte(c.b));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Graphics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Graphics& Graphics::Get() {
    static Graphics instance;
    return instance;
}

Graphics::Graphics() {
    D2D1_FACTORY_OPTIONS options{};
    D2D1CreateFactory(D2D1_FACTORY_TYPE_SINGLE_THREADED, __uuidof(ID2D1Factory), &options,
                      reinterpret_cast<void**>(m_d2d.GetAddressOf()));
    DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, __uuidof(IDWriteFactory),
                        reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(m_dwrite.GetAddressOf()));
}

Graphics::~Graphics() {
    if (m_memDc && m_oldBitmap) SelectObject(m_memDc.get(), m_oldBitmap);
    m_dib.reset();
    m_memDc.reset();
}

ID2D1DCRenderTarget* Graphics::Target() {
    if (!m_target && m_d2d) {
        // Software rendering: no GPU read-back per paint and no device-loss handling for a small UI.
        const auto props = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
            D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE, D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            96.0f, 96.0f);
        m_d2d->CreateDCRenderTarget(&props, m_target.GetAddressOf());
    }
    return m_target.Get();
}

bool Graphics::HasFamily(const wchar_t* family) const {
    if (!m_dwrite) return false;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontCollection> fonts;
    if (FAILED(m_dwrite->GetSystemFontCollection(fonts.GetAddressOf(), FALSE))) return false;
    UINT32 index = 0;
    BOOL exists = FALSE;
    return SUCCEEDED(fonts->FindFamilyName(family, &index, &exists)) && exists;
}

D2D1_COLOR_F Graphics::Surface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept {
    if (mica) return layer;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F b = Color::OpaqueBase;
    return {layer.r * layer.a + b.r * (1 - layer.a), layer.g * layer.a + b.g * (1 - layer.a),
            layer.b * layer.a + b.b * (1 - layer.a), 1.0f};
}

COLORREF Graphics::GdiSurface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept {
    if (!mica) return ToColorRef(Surface(layer));
    // Premultiplied value with alpha 0: DWM adds it to the backdrop, matching the D2D layer.
    return ToColorRef({layer.r * layer.a, layer.g * layer.a, layer.b * layer.a, 1.0f});
}

HDC Graphics::Buffer(int width, int height) {
    width = std::max(width, 1);
    height = std::max(height, 1);
    if (m_memDc && width <= m_bufferWidth && height <= m_bufferHeight) return m_memDc.get();
    if (!m_memDc) m_memDc.reset(CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr));
    if (!m_memDc) return nullptr;
    if (m_oldBitmap) SelectObject(m_memDc.get(), m_oldBitmap);
    m_oldBitmap = nullptr;
    m_dib.reset();
    // Round up to avoid reallocating on every pixel of a window resize. The size is remembered only
    // once the bitmap exists: a failed allocation must not look like a big enough buffer next time.
    const int bufferWidth = std::max(m_bufferWidth, (width + 255) & ~255);
    const int bufferHeight = std::max(m_bufferHeight, (height + 255) & ~255);
    BITMAPINFO info{};
    info.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof info.bmiHeader;
    info.bmiHeader.biWidth = bufferWidth;
    info.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bufferHeight;  // top-down
    info.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    info.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    info.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    m_dib.reset(CreateDIBSection(m_memDc.get(), &info, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0));
    if (!m_dib) {
        m_bufferWidth = m_bufferHeight = 0;
        return nullptr;
    }
    m_bufferWidth = bufferWidth;
    m_bufferHeight = bufferHeight;
    m_oldBitmap = SelectObject(m_memDc.get(), m_dib.get());
    return m_memDc.get();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fonts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void Fonts::Create(UINT dpi) {
    m_dpi = dpi ? dpi : 96;
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();
    if (!g.DWrite()) return;
    m_uiFamily = g.HasFamily(L"Segoe UI Variable Text") ? L"Segoe UI Variable Text" : L"Segoe UI";
    const wchar_t* display = g.HasFamily(L"Segoe UI Variable Display") ? L"Segoe UI Variable Display" : L"Segoe UI";
    const wchar_t* mono = g.HasFamily(L"Cascadia Mono") ? L"Cascadia Mono" : L"Consolas";
    const wchar_t* icons = g.HasFamily(L"Segoe Fluent Icons") ? L"Segoe Fluent Icons" : L"Segoe MDL2 Assets";

    struct Spec {
        Font font;
        const wchar_t* family;
        float size;
        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT weight;
    };
    const Spec specs[] = {
        {Font::Body, m_uiFamily, 13.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Strong, m_uiFamily, 13.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD},
        {Font::Caption, m_uiFamily, 11.5f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Label, m_uiFamily, 10.5f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD},
        {Font::Mono, mono, 11.5f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Icon, icons, 13.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::IconSmall, icons, 10.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Title, display, 19.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD},
    };
    ComPtr<IDWriteInlineObject> ellipsis;
    for (const Spec& s : specs) {
        auto& slot = m_formats[static_cast<std::size_t>(s.font)];
        slot.Reset();
        const float size = F(s.size);
        m_sizes[static_cast<std::size_t>(s.font)] = size;
        if (FAILED(g.DWrite()->CreateTextFormat(s.family, nullptr, s.weight, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
                                                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, size, L"en-us", slot.GetAddressOf())))
            continue;
        slot->SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP);
        slot->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
        if (g.DWrite()->CreateEllipsisTrimmingSign(slot.Get(), ellipsis.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()) == S_OK) {
            const DWRITE_TRIMMING trimming{DWRITE_TRIMMING_GRANULARITY_CHARACTER, 0, 0};
            slot->SetTrimming(&trimming, ellipsis.Get());
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Canvas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Canvas::Canvas(ID2D1RenderTarget& target, const Fonts& fonts) : m_rt(target), m_fonts(fonts) {}

ID2D1SolidColorBrush* Canvas::Brush(D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    if (!m_brush) m_rt.CreateSolidColorBrush(c, m_brush.GetAddressOf());
    else m_brush->SetColor(c);
    return m_brush.Get();
}

void Canvas::Clear(D2D1_COLOR_F c) { m_rt.Clear(c); }

void Canvas::Fill(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius) {
    if (r.right <= r.left || r.bottom <= r.top) return;
    if (radius > 0) m_rt.FillRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(r, radius, radius), Brush(c));
    else m_rt.FillRectangle(r, Brush(c));
}

void Canvas::Stroke(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius, float width) {
    const D2D1_RECT_F in = Inset(r, width / 2, width / 2);  // keep the stroke inside, on pixel centres
    if (in.right <= in.left || in.bottom <= in.top) return;
    if (radius > 0) m_rt.DrawRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(in, radius, radius), Brush(c), width);
    else m_rt.DrawRectangle(in, Brush(c), width);
}

void Canvas::Line(D2D1_POINT_2F a, D2D1_POINT_2F b, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float width) { m_rt.DrawLine(a, b, Brush(c), width); }

void Canvas::Circle(D2D1_POINT_2F center, float radius, D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    m_rt.FillEllipse(D2D1::Ellipse(center, radius, radius), Brush(c));
}

void Canvas::Text(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c, Align align) {
    IDWriteTextFormat* format = m_fonts[font];
    if (!format || text.empty() || r.right <= r.left) return;
    format->SetTextAlignment(align == Align::Center ? DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
                             : align == Align::Right ? DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_TRAILING
                                                     : DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING);
    m_rt.DrawText(text.data(), static_cast<UINT32>(text.size()), format, r, Brush(c), D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
}

namespace {
ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> Layout(IDWriteTextFormat* format, std::wstring_view text, float width, bool wrap) {
    ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> layout;
    auto* dw = Graphics::Get().DWrite();
    if (!dw || !format) return layout;
    if (FAILED(dw->CreateTextLayout(text.data(), static_cast<UINT32>(text.size()), format, std::max(width, 1.0f), 1.0e6f,
                                    layout.GetAddressOf())))
        return layout;
    layout->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR);
    layout->SetTextAlignment(DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING);
    if (wrap) {
        layout->SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_WRAP);
        const DWRITE_TRIMMING none{DWRITE_TRIMMING_GRANULARITY_NONE, 0, 0};
        layout->SetTrimming(&none, nullptr);
    }
    return layout;
}
}  // namespace

float TextWidth(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text) {
    auto layout = Layout(fonts[font], text, 1.0e6f, false);
    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS m{};
    if (!layout || FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&m))) return 0;
    return m.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
}

float Canvas::Width(std::wstring_view text, Font font) { return TextWidth(m_fonts, font, text); }

float TextHeight(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text, float width) {
    auto layout = Layout(fonts[font], text, width, true);
    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS m{};
    if (!layout || FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&m))) return 0;
    return m.height;
}

float Canvas::ParagraphHeight(std::wstring_view text, float width, Font font) { return TextHeight(m_fonts, font, text, width); }

float Canvas::Paragraph(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    auto layout = Layout(m_fonts[font], text, r.right - r.left, true);
    if (!layout) return 0;
    m_rt.DrawTextLayout({r.left, r.top}, layout.Get(), Brush(c), D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS m{};
    layout->GetMetrics(&m);
    return m.height;
}

void Canvas::PushClip(const D2D1_RECT_F& r) { m_rt.PushAxisAlignedClip(r, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_ALIASED); }
void Canvas::PopClip() { m_rt.PopAxisAlignedClip(); }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paint
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void Paint(HDC dc, const RECT& rect, const Fonts& fonts, const std::function<void(Canvas&)>& draw,
           const std::function<void(HDC)>& gdi) {
    const int width = rect.right - rect.left, height = rect.bottom - rect.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();
    HDC buffer = g.Buffer(width, height);
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* target = g.Target();
    if (!buffer || !target) return;

    const RECT local{0, 0, width, height};
    if (FAILED(target->BindDC(buffer, &local))) return;
    target->BeginDraw();
    target->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(static_cast<float>(-rect.left), static_cast<float>(-rect.top)));
    target->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
    {
        Canvas canvas(*target, fonts);
        draw(canvas);
    }
    if (target->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) g.ResetTarget();
    if (gdi) {
        const int saved = SaveDC(buffer);
        SetViewportOrgEx(buffer, -rect.left, -rect.top, nullptr);
        gdi(buffer);
        RestoreDC(buffer, saved);
    }
    BitBlt(dc, rect.left, rect.top, width, height, buffer, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Window backdrop
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void ApplyBackdrop(HWND window) {
    const BOOL dark = TRUE;
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(window, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &dark, sizeof dark);
    HIGHCONTRASTW contrast{sizeof contrast};
    const bool highContrast = SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST, sizeof contrast, &contrast, 0) &&
                              (contrast.dwFlags & HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON);
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();
    const DWM_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE backdrop = highContrast ? DWMSBT_NONE : DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW;
    g.mica = SUCCEEDED(DwmSetWindowAttribute(window, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, &backdrop, sizeof backdrop)) && !highContrast;
    const MARGINS margins = g.mica ? MARGINS{-1, -1, -1, -1} : MARGINS{0, 0, 0, 0};
    DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea(window, &margins);
    if (!g.mica) {
        const COLORREF caption = ToColorRef(Color::OpaqueBase);  // Windows 11 without Mica: seamless caption
        DwmSetWindowAttribute(window, DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR, &caption, sizeof caption);
    }
}

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Rendering foundation: palette, DPI-scaled DirectWrite fonts and a Direct2D canvas.
//
// Mica needs per-pixel alpha in the window's redirection surface, which GDI cannot produce
// (it writes alpha 0). Every surface is therefore painted with Direct2D into a premultiplied
// 32-bit DIB and copied to the window as a whole: transparent pixels show the Mica backdrop,
// cards are translucent layers on top of it, text is anti-aliased with correct alpha.
#pragma once
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <d2d1.h>
#include <dwrite.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>
#include <array>
#include <functional>
#include <string_view>

namespace WN::Ui {

using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;

constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Rgb(unsigned hex, float alpha = 1.0f) {
    return {static_cast<float>((hex >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0f, static_cast<float>((hex >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0f,
            static_cast<float>(hex & 0xFF) / 255.0f, alpha};
}
constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F White(float alpha) { return {1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, alpha}; }
constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Black(float alpha) { return {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, alpha}; }

// Windows 11 dark-theme layer values, with the Android green as the accent (deep enough for
// white text on accent buttons; the light Android green is used for text on dark layers).
namespace Color {
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Card = White(0.050f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F CardStroke = White(0.075f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Control = White(0.061f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlHot = White(0.090f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlPressed = White(0.035f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlDisabled = White(0.040f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlStroke = White(0.075f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Text = White(1.000f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Text2 = White(0.786f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Text3 = White(0.545f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F TextDisabled = White(0.363f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Accent = Rgb(0x1F8F55);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F AccentHot = Rgb(0x26A563);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F AccentPressed = Rgb(0x197646);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F AccentText = Rgb(0x3DDC84);  // Android green, for text on dark layers
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Bluetooth = Rgb(0x3BA4FF);   // Bluetooth blue, for icon on dark layers
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Support = Rgb(0xDB61A2);     // sponsor pink (GitHub Sponsors' heart), apart from green = action
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Success = Rgb(0x6CCB5F);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Caution = Rgb(0xFCE100);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Critical = Rgb(0xFF99A4);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Hover = White(0.045f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Selected = White(0.080f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Track = White(0.100f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Flyout = Rgb(0x2C2C2C);  // popup menus are opaque windows
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F FlyoutHot = Rgb(0x3A3A3A);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F FlyoutStroke = Rgb(0x454545);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F OpaqueBase = Rgb(0x202020);  // window background without Mica
}  // namespace Color

COLORREF ToColorRef(D2D1_COLOR_F c);  // opaque colours only

enum class Font : std::size_t { Body, Strong, Caption, Label, Mono, Icon, IconSmall, Title, Count };

// DirectWrite formats for one DPI. Sizes are in physical pixels (render targets run at 96 DPI).
class Fonts {
public:
    void Create(UINT dpi);
    [[nodiscard]] IDWriteTextFormat* operator[](Font f) const { return m_formats[static_cast<std::size_t>(f)].Get(); }
    [[nodiscard]] UINT dpi() const noexcept { return m_dpi; }
    [[nodiscard]] int S(int v) const noexcept { return MulDiv(v, static_cast<int>(m_dpi), 96); }
    [[nodiscard]] float F(float v) const noexcept { return v * static_cast<float>(m_dpi) / 96.0f; }
    [[nodiscard]] float Size(Font f) const { return m_sizes[static_cast<std::size_t>(f)]; }
    [[nodiscard]] const wchar_t* UiFamily() const noexcept { return m_uiFamily; }

private:
    UINT m_dpi = 96;
    const wchar_t* m_uiFamily = L"Segoe UI";
    std::array<ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat>, static_cast<std::size_t>(Font::Count)> m_formats;
    std::array<float, static_cast<std::size_t>(Font::Count)> m_sizes{};
};

// Process-wide graphics objects (UI thread only).
class Graphics {
public:
    static Graphics& Get();
    [[nodiscard]] bool Ready() const noexcept { return m_d2d && m_dwrite; }
    [[nodiscard]] ID2D1Factory* D2D() const noexcept { return m_d2d.Get(); }
    [[nodiscard]] IDWriteFactory* DWrite() const noexcept { return m_dwrite.Get(); }
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* Target();
    void ResetTarget() { m_target.Reset(); }
    bool HasFamily(const wchar_t* family) const;

    // Mica is decided per process: either every window gets it or none does.
    bool mica = false;
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_COLOR_F Base() const noexcept { return mica ? Black(0.0f) : Color::OpaqueBase; }
    // The pixel value a child window must fill with to look like `layer` drawn over the base.
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_COLOR_F Surface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept;
    // GDI colour that reproduces `layer` (GDI pixels have alpha 0: on Mica they add to the backdrop).
    [[nodiscard]] COLORREF GdiSurface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept;

    // Reusable 32-bit top-down DIB (grows only).
    HDC Buffer(int width, int height);

private:
    Graphics();
    ~Graphics();
    ComPtr<ID2D1Factory> m_d2d;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> m_dwrite;
    ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> m_target;
    MemoryDc m_memDc;  // destroyed after the DIB is deselected (see ~Graphics)
    Gdi<HBITMAP> m_dib;
    HGDIOBJ m_oldBitmap = nullptr;
    int m_bufferWidth = 0, m_bufferHeight = 0;
};

enum class Align { Left, Center, Right };

class Canvas {
public:
    Canvas(ID2D1RenderTarget& target, const Fonts& fonts);
    [[nodiscard]] const Fonts& fonts() const noexcept { return m_fonts; }
    [[nodiscard]] ID2D1RenderTarget& target() noexcept { return m_rt; }

    void Clear(D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    void Fill(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius = 0);
    void Stroke(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius = 0, float width = 1);
    void Line(D2D1_POINT_2F a, D2D1_POINT_2F b, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float width = 1);
    void Circle(D2D1_POINT_2F center, float radius, D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    // Single line, vertically centred, ellipsis when it does not fit.
    void Text(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c, Align align = Align::Left);
    // Wrapped paragraph from the top of `r`; returns the height used.
    float Paragraph(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    float Width(std::wstring_view text, Font font);
    float ParagraphHeight(std::wstring_view text, float width, Font font);
    void PushClip(const D2D1_RECT_F& r);
    void PopClip();

private:
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* Brush(D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    ID2D1RenderTarget& m_rt;
    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> m_brush;
};

// Text width without a render target (layout and menus measure before painting).
float TextWidth(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text);
float TextHeight(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text, float width);  // wrapped

// Paints `rect` (client coordinates of `dc`) through the shared DIB.
// `gdi` runs after Direct2D on the same buffer, for areas that must match GDI-drawn child controls.
void Paint(HDC dc, const RECT& rect, const Fonts& fonts, const std::function<void(Canvas&)>& draw,
           const std::function<void(HDC)>& gdi = {});

constexpr D2D1_RECT_F ToF(const RECT& r) {
    return {static_cast<float>(r.left), static_cast<float>(r.top), static_cast<float>(r.right), static_cast<float>(r.bottom)};
}
constexpr D2D1_RECT_F Inset(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, float dx, float dy) { return {r.left + dx, r.top + dy, r.right - dx, r.bottom - dy}; }

// Applies dark title bar + Mica (or the opaque fallback) to a top-level window.
void ApplyBackdrop(HWND window);

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

`src/gui/Widgets.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <CommCtrl.h>
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

#pragma comment(lib, "comctl32.lib")

namespace WN::Ui {
namespace {

HINSTANCE Instance() { return GetModuleHandleW(nullptr); }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Button hover tracking. Only one control can be under the mouse, so one HWND is enough.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HWND g_hotButton = nullptr;

LRESULT CALLBACK ButtonProc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, UINT_PTR id, DWORD_PTR) {
    switch (message) {
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE:
        if (g_hotButton != hwnd) {
            if (HWND old = std::exchange(g_hotButton, hwnd)) InvalidateRect(old, nullptr, FALSE);
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, hwnd, 0};
            TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        break;
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        if (g_hotButton == hwnd) {
            g_hotButton = nullptr;
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        break;
    case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK:
        // Owner-drawn buttons turn a quick second click into BN_DOUBLECLICKED; treat it as a click
        // so "Move up" pressed twice quickly moves twice.
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, WM_LBUTTONDOWN, wParam, lParam);
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_ENABLE:
        if (!wParam && g_hotButton == hwnd) g_hotButton = nullptr;
        break;
    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        if (g_hotButton == hwnd) g_hotButton = nullptr;
        RemoveWindowSubclass(hwnd, ButtonProc, id);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

D2D1_COLOR_F Mix(D2D1_COLOR_F c, float alpha) { return {c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a * alpha}; }

float WheelStep(const Fonts& f, float rowHeight) {
    UINT lines = 3;
    SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETWHEELSCROLLLINES, 0, &lines, 0);
    if (lines == WHEEL_PAGESCROLL) lines = 10;
    return std::max(rowHeight, f.F(18)) * static_cast<float>(std::max(lines, 1u)) / 2.0f;
}

}  // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Buttons
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HWND CreateButton(HWND parent, int id, const wchar_t* text) {
    HWND b = CreateWindowExW(0, L"BUTTON", text, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | BS_OWNERDRAW, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), Instance(), nullptr);
    if (b) SetWindowSubclass(b, ButtonProc, 1, 0);
    return b;
}

void DrawButton(const DRAWITEMSTRUCT& dis, const Fonts& f, const ButtonLook& look) {
    const bool disabled = dis.itemState & ODS_DISABLED;
    const bool pressed = (dis.itemState & ODS_SELECTED) && !disabled;
    const bool focus = (dis.itemState & ODS_FOCUS) && !(dis.itemState & ODS_NOFOCUSRECT);
    const bool hot = g_hotButton == dis.hwndItem && !disabled;
    wchar_t label[160]{};
    GetWindowTextW(dis.hwndItem, label, static_cast<int>(std::size(label)));
    const std::wstring_view text(label);
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();

    Paint(dis.hDC, dis.rcItem, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        const D2D1_RECT_F r = ToF(dis.rcItem);
        c.Clear(look.onCard ? g.Surface(Color::Card) : g.Base());
        const float radius = f.F(4);
        D2D1_COLOR_F fg = disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : pressed ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text;

        switch (look.kind) {
        case ButtonKind::Accent: {
            const D2D1_COLOR_F fill = disabled ? Color::ControlDisabled : pressed ? Color::AccentPressed : hot ? Color::AccentHot : Color::Accent;
            c.Fill(r, fill, radius);
            if (disabled) c.Stroke(r, Color::ControlStroke, radius);
            else fg = pressed ? White(0.8f) : Color::Text;
            break;
        }
        case ButtonKind::Expander:
        case ButtonKind::Icon:
            if (hot || pressed) c.Fill(r, pressed ? Color::ControlPressed : Color::Hover, radius);
            break;
        default:
            if (!disabled && look.glowColor) {
                const D2D1_COLOR_F& gl = *look.glowColor;
                c.Fill(r, Mix(gl, pressed ? 0.14f : hot ? 0.28f : 0.20f), radius);
                c.Stroke(Inset(r, f.F(1.0f), f.F(1.0f)), Mix(gl, 0.22f), radius, f.F(2.5f));
                c.Stroke(r, Mix(gl, hot ? 0.90f : 0.72f), radius);
            } else {
                c.Fill(r, disabled ? Color::ControlDisabled : pressed ? Color::ControlPressed : hot ? Color::ControlHot : Color::Control, radius);
                c.Stroke(r, Color::ControlStroke, radius);
            }
            break;
        }

        const float pad = f.F(10);
        if (look.kind == ButtonKind::Combo) {
            c.Text(text, {r.left + pad, r.top, r.right - f.F(30), r.bottom}, Font::Body, fg);
            c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::ChevronDown), {r.right - f.F(28), r.top, r.right - f.F(8), r.bottom}, Font::IconSmall,
                   disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text2, Align::Center);
        } else if (look.kind == ButtonKind::Expander) {
            const wchar_t chevron = look.expanded ? Icon::ChevronDown : Icon::ChevronRight;
            c.Text(std::wstring(1, chevron), {r.left + f.F(4), r.top, r.left + f.F(20), r.bottom}, Font::IconSmall, Color::Text2,
                   Align::Center);
            const float tw = c.Width(text, Font::Strong);
            c.Text(text, {r.left + f.F(24), r.top, r.right, r.bottom}, Font::Strong, fg);
            if (!look.badge.empty()) {
                const float bw = c.Width(look.badge, Font::Label) + f.F(12);
                const D2D1_RECT_F b{r.left + f.F(30) + tw, r.top + f.F(6), r.left + f.F(30) + tw + bw, r.bottom - f.F(6)};
                c.Fill(b, Mix(Color::Accent, 0.9f), (b.bottom - b.top) / 2);
                c.Text(look.badge, b, Font::Label, Color::Text, Align::Center);
            }
        } else if (look.kind == ButtonKind::Icon) {
            c.Text(std::wstring(1, look.icon), r, Font::Icon, fg, Align::Center);
        } else {
            // Icon + label, centred as one group.
            const float iconW = look.icon ? f.F(14) + f.F(8) : 0;
            const float tw = std::min(c.Width(text, Font::Body), r.right - r.left - 2 * pad - iconW);
            float x = r.left + (r.right - r.left - iconW - tw) / 2;
            if (look.icon) {
                const D2D1_COLOR_F iconFg = disabled                                          ? fg
                                            : look.iconHotColor && (hot || pressed || focus) ? *look.iconHotColor
                                            : look.iconColor                                  ? *look.iconColor
                                            : look.kind == ButtonKind::Accent                 ? fg
                                                                                              : Color::Text2;
                c.Text(std::wstring(1, look.icon), {x, r.top, x + f.F(14), r.bottom}, Font::Icon, iconFg, Align::Center);
                x += iconW;
            }
            c.Text(text, {x, r.top, x + tw + 1, r.bottom}, Font::Body, fg);
        }
        if (focus) c.Stroke(r, Color::Text, radius, f.F(1.5f));
    });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Scroller
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void Scroller::Clamp() { offset = std::clamp(offset, 0.0f, Max()); }

void Scroller::EnsureVisible(float top, float bottom) {
    if (top < offset) offset = top;
    else if (bottom > offset + view) offset = bottom - view;
    Clamp();
}

D2D1_RECT_F Scroller::Track(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f) const {
    return {static_cast<float>(client.right) - f.F(9), static_cast<float>(client.top) + f.F(3),
            static_cast<float>(client.right) - f.F(2), static_cast<float>(client.bottom) - f.F(3)};
}

D2D1_RECT_F Scroller::Thumb(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f) const {
    const D2D1_RECT_F t = Track(client, f);
    const float h = t.bottom - t.top;
    const float thumb = std::max(f.F(24), h * (content > 0 ? view / content : 1.0f));
    const float y = t.top + (Max() > 0 ? (h - thumb) * offset / Max() : 0);
    return {t.left, y, t.right, y + thumb};
}

void Scroller::Draw(Canvas& c, const RECT& client) const {
    if (!Visible()) return;
    const auto& f = c.fonts();
    D2D1_RECT_F t = Thumb(client, f);
    const float w = (hot || dragging) ? f.F(6) : f.F(3);
    t.left = t.right - w;
    c.Fill(t, White(hot || dragging ? 0.50f : 0.30f), w / 2);
}

bool Scroller::MouseDown(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f) {
    if (!Visible()) return false;
    const D2D1_RECT_F t = Track(client, f);
    if (static_cast<float>(p.x) < t.left - f.F(3)) return false;
    const D2D1_RECT_F thumb = Thumb(client, f);
    const float y = static_cast<float>(p.y);
    if (y < thumb.top) offset -= view;
    else if (y > thumb.bottom) offset += view;
    Clamp();
    dragging = true;
    grabY = y;
    grabOffset = offset;
    return true;
}

bool Scroller::MouseMove(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f) {
    if (dragging) {
        const D2D1_RECT_F t = Track(client, f), thumb = Thumb(client, f);
        const float range = (t.bottom - t.top) - (thumb.bottom - thumb.top);
        const float before = offset;
        if (range > 0) offset = grabOffset + (static_cast<float>(p.y) - grabY) * Max() / range;
        Clamp();
        return offset != before;
    }
    const bool now = Visible() && static_cast<float>(p.x) >= Track(client, f).left - f.F(3);
    if (now == hot) return false;
    hot = now;
    return true;
}

bool Scroller::Wheel(int delta, float step) {
    const float before = offset;
    offset -= static_cast<float>(delta) / WHEEL_DELTA * step;
    Clamp();
    return offset != before;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Child window classes
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace {
constexpr wchar_t kLogClass[] = L"WSANext.LogView";

void RegisterClassOnce(const wchar_t* name, WNDPROC proc) {
    WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
    if (GetClassInfoExW(Instance(), name, &wc)) return;
    wc.style = CS_DBLCLKS;
    wc.lpfnWndProc = proc;
    wc.hInstance = Instance();
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.lpszClassName = name;
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
}

template <class T>
T* FromWindow(HWND hwnd, UINT message, LPARAM lParam) {
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE) {
        auto* self = static_cast<T*>(reinterpret_cast<CREATESTRUCTW*>(lParam)->lpCreateParams);
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(self));
        return self;
    }
    return reinterpret_cast<T*>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));
}
}  // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// LogView
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HWND LogView::Create(HWND parent, int id) {
    RegisterClassOnce(kLogClass, Proc);
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kLogClass, L"Log", WS_CHILD | WS_TABSTOP, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), Instance(), this);
    return m_hwnd;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK LogView::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    auto* self = FromWindow<LogView>(hwnd, message, lParam);
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE && self) self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        if (self) self->m_hwnd = nullptr;
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void LogView::Append(Level level, std::wstring text) {
    SYSTEMTIME t{};
    GetLocalTime(&t);
    constexpr std::size_t kMaxLines = 5000;
    if (m_lines.size() >= kMaxLines) m_lines.erase(m_lines.begin(), m_lines.begin() + kMaxLines / 10);
    m_lines.push_back({std::format(L"{:02}:{:02}:{:02}", t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond), std::move(text), level});
    if (m_hwnd && IsWindowVisible(m_hwnd)) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void LogView::Clear() {
    m_lines.clear();
    m_scroll = {};
    m_follow = true;
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

std::wstring LogView::Text() const {
    std::wstring out;
    for (const auto& l : m_lines) out += std::format(L"{}  {}\r\n", l.time, l.text);
    return out;
}

void LogView::Relayout() {
    m_measuredWidth = -1;
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void LogView::Measure(Canvas* c) {
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const float width = static_cast<float>(client.right) - m_fonts.F(84);
    const bool all = width != m_measuredWidth;
    m_measuredWidth = width;
    float total = m_fonts.F(6);
    const float minimum = m_fonts.F(17);
    for (auto& l : m_lines) {
        if (all || l.height <= 0) l.height = std::max(minimum, c->ParagraphHeight(l.text, width, Font::Mono) + m_fonts.F(2));
        total += l.height;
    }
    m_scroll.content = total + m_fonts.F(6);
    m_scroll.view = static_cast<float>(client.bottom);
    if (m_follow) m_scroll.offset = m_scroll.Max();
    m_scroll.Clamp();
}

void LogView::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    Ui::Paint(ps.dc(), client, m_fonts, [&](Canvas& c) {
        c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Surface(Color::Card));
        Measure(&c);
        if (m_lines.empty()) {
            c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_LOG_EMPTY), ToF(client), Font::Caption, Color::Text3, Align::Center);
            return;
        }
        const auto& f = m_fonts;
        const float right = static_cast<float>(client.right) - f.F(14);
        float y = f.F(6) - m_scroll.offset;
        c.PushClip(ToF(client));
        for (const auto& l : m_lines) {
            if (y + l.height >= 0 && y <= static_cast<float>(client.bottom)) {
                const D2D1_COLOR_F color = l.level == Level::Error     ? Color::Critical
                                           : l.level == Level::Warning ? Color::Caution
                                           : l.level == Level::Success ? Color::Success
                                                                       : Color::Text2;
                c.Text(l.time, {f.F(10), y, f.F(70), y + f.F(17)}, Font::Mono, Color::Text3);
                c.Paragraph(l.text, {f.F(70), y + f.F(1), right, y + l.height}, Font::Mono, color);
            }
            y += l.height;
        }
        c.PopClip();
        m_scroll.Draw(c, client);
    });
}

LRESULT LogView::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    auto changed = [&] {
        m_follow = m_scroll.offset >= m_scroll.Max() - 1;
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
    };
    switch (message) {
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_GETDLGCODE:
        return DLGC_WANTARROWS;
    case WM_KEYDOWN: {
        const float line = m_fonts.F(17);
        if (wParam == 'C' && (GetKeyState(VK_CONTROL) & 0x8000)) {
            CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, Text());
            return 0;
        }
        const float before = m_scroll.offset;
        switch (wParam) {
        case VK_UP: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset - line); break;
        case VK_DOWN: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset + line); break;
        case VK_PRIOR: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset - m_scroll.view); break;
        case VK_NEXT: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset + m_scroll.view); break;
        case VK_HOME: m_scroll.ScrollTo(0); break;
        case VK_END: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.Max()); break;
        default: return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
        }
        if (m_scroll.offset != before) changed();
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
        SetFocus(m_hwnd);
        const POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (m_scroll.MouseDown(p, client, m_fonts)) {
            SetCapture(m_hwnd);
            changed();
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
        TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, m_hwnd, 0};
        TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
        if (m_scroll.MouseMove({GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)}, client, m_fonts)) changed();
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        if (m_scroll.hot) {
            m_scroll.hot = false;
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (m_scroll.dragging) {
            m_scroll.dragging = false;
            ReleaseCapture();
            changed();
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        m_scroll.dragging = false;
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
        if (m_scroll.Wheel(GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(wParam), WheelStep(m_fonts, m_fonts.F(17)))) changed();
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Clipboard
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool CopyToClipboard(HWND owner, const std::wstring& text) {
    if (!OpenClipboard(owner)) return false;
    const ScopeExit close([] { CloseClipboard(); });
    EmptyClipboard();
    const std::size_t bytes = (text.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t);
    struct GlobalFreer {
        void operator()(void* h) const noexcept { GlobalFree(h); }
    };
    std::unique_ptr<void, GlobalFreer> memory(GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, bytes));
    if (!memory) return false;
    if (void* p = GlobalLock(memory.get())) {
        std::memcpy(p, text.c_str(), bytes);
        GlobalUnlock(memory.get());
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    if (!SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, memory.get())) return false;
    memory.release();  // owned by the clipboard now
    return true;
}

}  // namespace WN::Ui
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Controls drawn with the Direct2D canvas: owner-drawn push buttons and the log view. All of them are real child windows, so Tab, focus and keyboard work as usual.

// Buttons (BS_OWNERDRAW, drawn from the parent's WM_DRAWITEM)

    ButtonKind kind = ButtonKind::Standard;
    wchar_t icon = 0;        // Segoe Fluent Icons code point
    bool onCard = true;      // sits on a card layer (else directly on the window background)

inline constexpr wchar_t ArrowUp = 0xE74A, ArrowDown = 0xE74B, Delete = 0xE74D, Add = 0xE710;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vertical scrolling shared by the list and the log.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Scroller {
    float offset = 0, content = 0, view = 0;
    bool dragging = false, hot = false;
    float grabY = 0, grabOffset = 0;

    [[nodiscard]] float Max() const { return content > view ? content - view : 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool Visible() const { return content > view + 0.5f; }
    void Clamp();
    void ScrollTo(float y) { offset = y; Clamp(); }
    void EnsureVisible(float top, float bottom);
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_RECT_F Track(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f) const;
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_RECT_F Thumb(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f) const;
    void Draw(Canvas& c, const RECT& client) const;
    bool MouseDown(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f);  // true = handled (capture)
    bool MouseMove(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f);  // true = offset changed
    bool Wheel(int delta, float step);                              // true = offset changed
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Log view: timestamped, coloured, wrapped lines. Ctrl+C / context menu copy the whole log.

class LogView {
public:

    void Relayout();

private:
    struct Line {
        std::wstring time, text;
        Level level;
        float height = 0;  // cached for m_measuredWidth
    };
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    LRESULT Handle(UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    void Measure(Canvas* c);
    void Paint();

    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    std::vector<Line> m_lines;

    bool m_follow = true;  // stay at the bottom while new lines arrive
```
