```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <hvsocket.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include <computecore.h>
#include <objbase.h>
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/HostEvents.h"
#include "support/Json.h"
#include <string>

#pragma comment(lib, "computecore.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")

namespace WN::Guest {
namespace {

// While WSA is not running: how often to look for its VM (no HCS notification exists for that).
constexpr DWORD kVmLookupMs = 5000;
// While Android boots and its HAL does not listen yet: the connect attempt waits this long.
constexpr DWORD kConnectTimeoutMs = 2000;

GUID ServiceGuid(std::uint32_t port) {
    // vsock port P of a Linux guest = Hyper-V service "PPPPPPPP-FACB-11E6-BD58-64006A7986D3".
    return GUID{port, 0xFACB, 0x11E6, {0xBD, 0x58, 0x64, 0x00, 0x6A, 0x79, 0x86, 0xD3}};
}

std::string Utf8(std::wstring_view text) {
    if (text.empty()) return {};
    const int size = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string out(static_cast<std::size_t>(size), '\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), out.data(), size, nullptr, nullptr);
    return out;
}

std::string GuidText(const GUID& guid) {
    wchar_t text[64]{};
    StringFromGUID2(guid, text, 64);
    return Utf8(text);
}

bool ContainsNoCase(std::wstring text, std::wstring part) {
    for (auto* s : {&text, &part})
        for (auto& c : *s) c = static_cast<wchar_t>(towlower(c));
    return text.find(part) != std::wstring::npos;
}

// Signals `event` when the compute system ends (HCS notification). Without access to the system
// (watching() false) the caller looks at the VM list instead.
class VmExitWatch {
public:
    VmExitWatch(const GUID& id, HANDLE event) {
        wchar_t text[64]{};
        StringFromGUID2(id, text, 64);
        const std::wstring bare(text + 1, wcslen(text) - 2);  // HCS ids have no braces
        if (FAILED(HcsOpenComputeSystem(bare.c_str(), GENERIC_ALL, &m_system))) {
            m_system = nullptr;
            return;
        }
        if (FAILED(HcsSetComputeSystemCallback(m_system, HcsEventOptionNone, event, &VmExitWatch::OnEvent))) {
            HcsCloseComputeSystem(m_system);
            m_system = nullptr;
        }
    }
    ~VmExitWatch() {
        if (m_system) HcsCloseComputeSystem(m_system);  // also ends the callbacks
    }
    VmExitWatch(const VmExitWatch&) = delete;
    VmExitWatch& operator=(const VmExitWatch&) = delete;
    [[nodiscard]] bool watching() const { return m_system != nullptr; }

    // Ends the compute system at once (like a power cut); its end is then notified as usual.
    bool Terminate() {
        const HCS_OPERATION operation = HcsCreateOperation(nullptr, nullptr);
        if (!operation) return false;
        HRESULT hr = HcsTerminateComputeSystem(m_system, operation, nullptr);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
            PWSTR result = nullptr;
            hr = HcsWaitForOperationResult(operation, 15000, &result);
            if (result) LocalFree(result);
        }
        HcsCloseOperation(operation);
        return SUCCEEDED(hr);
    }

private:
    static void CALLBACK OnEvent(HCS_EVENT* event, void* context) {
        if (event->Type == HcsEventSystemExited || event->Type == HcsEventServiceDisconnect) SetEvent(static_cast<HANDLE>(context));
    }
    HCS_SYSTEM m_system = nullptr;
};

// One connection attempt to the guest's port (blocking, at most kConnectTimeoutMs).
SOCKET Connect(const GUID& vm, std::uint32_t port) {
    SOCKET s = socket(AF_HYPERV, SOCK_STREAM, HV_PROTOCOL_RAW);
    if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) return s;
    const DWORD timeout = kConnectTimeoutMs;
    setsockopt(s, HV_PROTOCOL_RAW, HVSOCKET_CONNECT_TIMEOUT, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&timeout), sizeof timeout);
    SOCKADDR_HV address{};
    address.Family = AF_HYPERV;
    address.VmId = vm;
    address.ServiceId = ServiceGuid(port);
    if (connect(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), sizeof address) != 0) {
        closesocket(s);
        return INVALID_SOCKET;
    }
    return s;
}

}  // namespace

std::wstring ComputeSystemsJson() {
    HCS_OPERATION operation = HcsCreateOperation(nullptr, nullptr);
    if (!operation) return {};
    PWSTR result = nullptr;
    HRESULT hr = HcsEnumerateComputeSystems(nullptr, operation);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = HcsWaitForOperationResult(operation, 10000, &result);
    HcsCloseOperation(operation);
    std::wstring json = SUCCEEDED(hr) && result ? std::wstring(result) : std::wstring();
    if (result) LocalFree(result);
    return json;
}

std::optional<WsaVm> FindWsaVm() {
    const std::wstring text = ComputeSystemsJson();
    if (text.empty()) return std::nullopt;
    const auto json = Json::Parse(Utf8(text));
    if (!json) return std::nullopt;

    // An array of compute system summaries: {"Id":..., "SystemType":..., "Owner":..., "State":...}.
    // WSA's VM has no name; its owner is WSA's localized product name ("Windows Subsystem for
    // Android™", "Podsystem Windows dla systemu Android™" ...): "Android" is in every language.
    // Hyper-V Manager's VMs are owned by "VMMS", whatever their name.
    for (const Json::Value& system : json->Items()) {
        const std::wstring owner = system.StringOr(L"Owner"), state = system.StringOr(L"State");
        if (!ContainsNoCase(owner, L"android") || system.StringOr(L"SystemType") != L"VirtualMachine") continue;
        if (!state.empty() && state != L"Running") continue;
        const std::wstring id = L"{" + system.StringOr(L"Id") + L"}";
        WsaVm vm;
        if (IIDFromString(id.c_str(), &vm.id) != S_OK) continue;
        vm.name = Utf8(owner);
        return vm;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

void Serve(std::uint32_t port, const char* peerName, const std::function<void(std::uintptr_t, std::stop_token)>& session,
           std::stop_token stop) {
    WSADATA wsa{};
    WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa);
    const KernelHandle stopEvent(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr));
    const std::stop_callback onStop(stop, [event = stopEvent.get()] { SetEvent(event); });
    const KernelHandle vmExited(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr));
    bool waitingLogged = false;
    while (!stop.stop_requested()) {
        const auto vm = FindWsaVm();
        if (!vm) {
            if (!waitingLogged) Bt::Log("host: waiting for WSA to start ({})", peerName);
            waitingLogged = true;
            WaitForSingleObject(stopEvent.get(), kVmLookupMs);
            continue;
        }
        waitingLogged = false;
        ResetEvent(vmExited.get());
        const VmExitWatch exitWatch(vm->id, vmExited.get());
        Bt::Log("host: WSA VM {} ({}), connecting to vsock port 0x{:08X}", GuidText(vm->id), vm->name, port);
        NotifyHostChanged();  // Android is up (the window and the icon show it)

        while (!stop.stop_requested() && WaitForSingleObject(vmExited.get(), 0) != WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
            const ULONGLONG attempt = GetTickCount64();
            const SOCKET s = Connect(vm->id, port);
            if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) {
                // Android is booting (its HAL does not listen yet) or WSA is ending. A refusal can
                // come at once: wait out the rest of the attempt so retries stay paced.
                const ULONGLONG spent = GetTickCount64() - attempt;
                if (spent < kConnectTimeoutMs) {
                    const HANDLE events[] = {stopEvent.get(), vmExited.get()};
                    WaitForMultipleObjects(2, events, FALSE, static_cast<DWORD>(kConnectTimeoutMs - spent));
                }
                if (!exitWatch.watching()) {
                    const auto now = FindWsaVm();
                    if (!now || !IsEqualGUID(now->id, vm->id)) break;
                }
                continue;
            }
            Bt::Log("host: {} connected", peerName);
            {
                // Ends the session's blocking reads when stopping or when the VM ends.
                const std::stop_callback cancel(stop, [s] { shutdown(s, SD_BOTH); });
                session(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(s), stop);
            }
            closesocket(s);
            Bt::Log("host: {} disconnected", peerName);
        }
        if (!stop.stop_requested()) Bt::Log("host: WSA VM ended ({})", peerName);
        NotifyHostChanged();
    }
    WSACleanup();
}

VmStop StopVm(const std::function<void()>& request, unsigned graceMs) {
    const auto vm = FindWsaVm();
    if (!vm) return VmStop::NotRunning;
    const KernelHandle exited(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr));
    if (!exited) return VmStop::Failed;
    VmExitWatch watch(vm->id, exited.get());
    if (!watch.watching()) return VmStop::Failed;
    request();
    if (WaitForSingleObject(exited.get(), graceMs) == WAIT_OBJECT_0) return VmStop::ShutDown;
    if (!watch.Terminate()) return VmStop::Failed;
    return WaitForSingleObject(exited.get(), 15000) == WAIT_OBJECT_0 ? VmStop::Terminated : VmStop::Failed;
}

bool RemoveLegacyServiceRegistration(std::uint32_t port) {
    wchar_t guid[64]{};
    StringFromGUID2(ServiceGuid(port), guid, 64);
    const std::wstring key = std::wstring(L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Virtualization\\GuestCommunicationServices\\") + guid;
    if (RegDeleteTreeW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key.c_str()) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return false;
    RegDeleteKeyW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key.c_str());
    return true;
}

}  // namespace WN::Guest
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Connections from the Windows host into WSA's Android over Hyper-V sockets (vsock in the guest).
//
// Android's HALs listen on vsock ports; the bridges here connect to them as soon as WSA's VM is
// up, so nothing on either side polls while both run. Finding the VM is the only place that
// needs a timed wait: the Host Compute Service has no notification for a new compute system, so
// it is looked for every few seconds while WSA is not running; the end of the VM is a
// notification. While Android boots, its HAL may not listen yet: the connect timeout paces the
// attempts. Connecting needs no registration in the registry (only listening on the host does).
#pragma once
#include <guiddef.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>

namespace WN::Guest {

struct WsaVm {
    GUID id{};
    std::string name;
};

// The running WSA VM, if any (Host Compute Service; administrator).
std::optional<WsaVm> FindWsaVm();

// Raw summary of all compute systems from the Host Compute Service (diagnostics).
std::wstring ComputeSystemsJson();

// Keeps a connection to the guest's vsock `port` until `stop`: connects whenever WSA runs and
// runs `session(socket, stop)` for each connection, with blocking I/O that a stop request ends
// (the socket is shut down). Reconnects when the session ends while WSA keeps running.
void Serve(std::uint32_t port, const char* peerName, const std::function<void(std::uintptr_t socket, std::stop_token)>& session,
           std::stop_token stop);

// Ends WSA's VM. `request` asks Android to shut down (without waiting for it); the end of the VM
// is an HCS notification. A VM still running after `graceMs` is terminated (like a power cut).
enum class VmStop { NotRunning, ShutDown, Terminated, Failed };
VmStop StopVm(const std::function<void()>& request, unsigned graceMs);

// Removes the Hyper-V socket service registration that test builds of 2026-11-20 made for
// listening on the host (total removal of WSA-Next); true when there was one.
bool RemoveLegacyServiceRegistration(std::uint32_t port);

}  // namespace WN::Guest
```

```cpp
void Signal(const wchar_t* name) {
    const KernelHandle event(OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE, FALSE, name));
    if (event) SetEvent(event.get());
}

// A bridge on its own thread, in the multithreaded apartment its WinRT calls need.
template <class Bridge>
std::jthread StartBridge(Bridge bridge) {
    return std::jthread([bridge](std::stop_token stop) {
        const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        bridge(stop);
        if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
    });
}

// BSTR owner for the Task Scheduler interfaces.
class Bstr {
public:
    explicit Bstr(const std::wstring& text) : m_value(SysAllocStringLen(text.data(), static_cast<UINT>(text.size()))) {}
    ~Bstr() { SysFreeString(m_value); }
    Bstr(const Bstr&) = delete;
    Bstr& operator=(const Bstr&) = delete;
    operator BSTR() const { return m_value; }

private:
    BSTR m_value;
};

std::wstring XmlEscape(std::wstring_view text) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (wchar_t c : text) {
        switch (c) {
        case L'&': out += L"&amp;"; break;
        case L'<': out += L"&lt;"; break;
        case L'>': out += L"&gt;"; break;
        case L'"': out += L"&quot;"; break;
        default: out += c; break;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

std::wstring CurrentUser() {
    ULONG size = 0;
    GetUserNameExW(NameSamCompatible, nullptr, &size);
    std::wstring name(size, L'\0');
    if (!GetUserNameExW(NameSamCompatible, name.data(), &size)) return {};
    name.resize(size);
    return name;
}

Result<ComPtr<ITaskFolder>> RootFolder() {
    const auto fail = [](HRESULT hr) { return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_BT_TASK), static_cast<unsigned long>(hr))); };
    ComPtr<ITaskService> service;
    HRESULT hr = CoCreateInstance(CLSID_TaskScheduler, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(service.GetAddressOf()));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return fail(hr);
    VARIANT empty;
    VariantInit(&empty);
    if (FAILED(hr = service->Connect(empty, empty, empty, empty))) return fail(hr);
    ComPtr<ITaskFolder> root;
    if (FAILED(hr = service->GetFolder(Bstr(L"\\"), root.GetAddressOf()))) return fail(hr);
    return root;
}

}  // namespace

int RunBackground() {
    const KernelHandle mutex(CreateMutexW(nullptr, TRUE, kMutex));
    if (!mutex || GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) return 0;  // another instance serves this session
    const KernelHandle stopEvent(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, kStopEvent));
    const KernelHandle reloadEvent(CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, kReloadEvent));
    if (!stopEvent || !reloadEvent) return 1;
    ResetEvent(stopEvent.get());
    if (!Signature::OfficialFeatures()) {
        Bt::Log("host: this WSA-Next.exe is not an official build (no publisher signature): "
                "Bluetooth and Windows Hello for Android are not available");
        return 3;
    }
    Bt::Log("host: started");

    // The bridges serve an official WSA-Next release only, as published: the WSA package's folder
    // must hold the publisher-signed manifest and every Android disk with the digest listed in it.
    // Digests are remembered per file, so this reads the disks only after they changed.
    using Core::Release::State;
    Core::Release::SetHostVerdict(State::Checking);
    NotifyHostChanged();
    const auto package = Install::FindWsa();
    const State verdict = Core::Release::VerifyInstalled(package ? package->location : std::filesystem::path(),
                                                         [&] { return WaitForSingleObject(stopEvent.get(), 0) == WAIT_OBJECT_0; });
    Core::Release::SetHostVerdict(verdict);
    NotifyHostChanged();
    if (verdict == State::Unknown) return 0;  // stopped while checking
    if (verdict != State::Official) {
        Bt::Log("host: the installed Android is {} - Bluetooth and Windows Hello are not served",
                verdict == State::Modified  ? "an official release changed after installing"
                : verdict == State::Missing ? "missing"
                                            : "not an official WSA-Next release");
#ifndef _DEBUG
        return 4;
#endif
    }

    std::jthread hello = StartBridge([](std::stop_token stop) { (void)Bio::RunBridge(stop); });
    // Google Play registration of a new installation: offered in a Windows notification
    // (host/Registration.h); a click on Android's own notification does not come back to Android.
    std::jthread registration = StartBridge([](std::stop_token stop) { RunRegistration(stop); });
    // The PC's modem as Android's SIM, network and SMS (ends at once on a PC without one).
    std::jthread modem = StartBridge([](std::stop_token stop) { Tel::RunBridge(stop); });
    std::jthread bluetooth, elevation;
    std::unique_ptr<Tray> tray;
    NotifyHostChanged();
    // A bridge that follows its setting: started when turned on, stopped (and joined) when off.
    auto follow = [](std::jthread& bridge, bool wanted, auto run) {
        if (wanted && !bridge.joinable()) {
            bridge = StartBridge(run);
        } else if (!wanted && bridge.joinable()) {
            bridge.request_stop();
            bridge.join();
            bridge = {};
        }
    };
    bool su = ElevationSuEnabled();
    for (;;) {
        follow(bluetooth, BluetoothEnabled(), [](std::stop_token stop) { (void)Bt::RunBridge(stop); });
        if (const bool now = ElevationSuEnabled(); now != su) {
            su = now;
            if (elevation.joinable()) {  // reconnects below with the new setting
                elevation.request_stop();
                elevation.join();
                elevation = {};
            }
        }
        follow(elevation, ElevationEnabled(), [su](std::stop_token stop) { Bio::Elevation::RunBridge(stop, su); });
        if (TrayEnabled() && !tray) tray = std::make_unique<Tray>(stopEvent.get());
        else if (!TrayEnabled()) tray.reset();
        NotifyHostChanged();
        const HANDLE events[] = {stopEvent.get(), reloadEvent.get()};
        if (WaitForMultipleObjects(2, events, FALSE, INFINITE) != WAIT_OBJECT_0 + 1) break;
    }
    Bt::Log("host: stopping");
    tray.reset();
    elevation = {};  // stops and joins the bridges
    bluetooth = {};
    modem = {};
    registration = {};
    hello = {};
    NotifyHostChanged();
    return 0;
}

bool Running() {
    const KernelHandle mutex(OpenMutexW(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, kMutex));
    return static_cast<bool>(mutex);
}

std::wstring Executable() {
    const std::filesystem::path installed = Core::HostFolder() / Config::kExeName;
    std::error_code ec;
    return std::filesystem::exists(installed, ec) ? installed.wstring() : ModulePath();
}

Result<> Start() {
    if (Running()) return {};
    const std::wstring exe = Executable();
    std::wstring command = std::format(L"\"{}\" host --background", exe);
    STARTUPINFOW si{sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
    if (!CreateProcessW(exe.c_str(), command.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW | DETACHED_PROCESS, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_BT_START), GetLastError()));
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    return {};
}

void Stop() {
    // Waiting for the host's mutex returns when the host has ended (it is then abandoned); release
    // and close it at once so that a new host can create it.
    const KernelHandle mutex(OpenMutexW(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, kMutex));
    if (!mutex) return;
    Signal(kStopEvent);
    const DWORD wait = WaitForSingleObject(mutex.get(), 10000);
    if (wait == WAIT_OBJECT_0 || wait == WAIT_ABANDONED) ReleaseMutex(mutex.get());
}

Result<> Restart() {
    Stop();
    return Start();
}

bool BluetoothEnabled() { return Settings::ReadDword(kBluetoothSetting, 0) != 0; }

Result<> SetBluetoothEnabled(bool enabled) {
    Settings::WriteDword(kBluetoothSetting, enabled ? 1 : 0);
    if (Running()) {
        Signal(kReloadEvent);
        return {};
    }
    return Start();
}

bool AutostartEnabled() {
    auto root = RootFolder();
    if (!root) return false;
    ComPtr<IRegisteredTask> task;
    return SUCCEEDED((*root)->GetTask(Bstr(kAutostartTask), task.GetAddressOf()));
}

Result<> SetAutostart(bool enable) {
    auto root = RootFolder();
    if (!root) return Fail(root.error());
    (void)(*root)->DeleteTask(Bstr(kOldAutostartTask), 0);
    if (!enable) {
        const HRESULT hr = (*root)->DeleteTask(Bstr(kAutostartTask), 0);
        if (FAILED(hr) && hr != HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND))
            return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_BT_TASK), static_cast<unsigned long>(hr)));
        return {};
    }
    const std::wstring user = XmlEscape(CurrentUser());
    const std::wstring xml = std::format(
        LR"(<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>
<Task version="1.4" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
  <RegistrationInfo><Description>Gives Android in WSA-Next this PC's Bluetooth adapter and Windows Hello.</Description></RegistrationInfo>
  <Triggers><LogonTrigger><Enabled>true</Enabled><UserId>{0}</UserId></LogonTrigger></Triggers>
  <Principals><Principal id="Author"><UserId>{0}</UserId><LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType><RunLevel>HighestAvailable</RunLevel></Principal></Principals>
  <Settings>
    <MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy>
    <DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>
    <StopIfGoingOnBatteries>false</StopIfGoingOnBatteries>
    <ExecutionTimeLimit>PT0S</ExecutionTimeLimit>
    <AllowStartOnDemand>true</AllowStartOnDemand>
    <Priority>7</Priority>
  </Settings>
  <Actions Context="Author"><Exec><Command>"{1}"</Command><Arguments>host --background</Arguments></Exec></Actions>
</Task>
)",
        user, XmlEscape(Executable()));
    VARIANT empty;
    VariantInit(&empty);
    ComPtr<IRegisteredTask> task;
    const HRESULT hr = (*root)->RegisterTask(Bstr(kAutostartTask), Bstr(xml), TASK_CREATE_OR_UPDATE, empty, empty,
                                             TASK_LOGON_INTERACTIVE_TOKEN, empty, task.GetAddressOf());
    if (FAILED(hr)) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_BT_TASK), static_cast<unsigned long>(hr)));
    return {};
}
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// The Windows side of WSA-Next's Android integration: one background process of the user's
// session, "WSA-Next.exe host --background", running
//   the Windows Hello bridge   always: Android's fingerprint sensor (src/biometrics); it answers
//                              "not available" while Windows Hello is not set up
//   the Bluetooth bridge       while Bluetooth for Android is on (setting "Bluetooth", src/bluetooth)
//   the elevation bridge       while root for Android apps is on (setting "Elevation"): every
//                              request confirmed with Windows Hello (src/biometrics)
// One instance per session (named mutex). The window and the command line control it through
// named events (stop, reload settings); the Task Scheduler task "WSA-Next" starts it at logon with
// the highest privileges (both bridges need administrator rights). Closing the window does not
// stop it: Android keeps its Bluetooth and fingerprint.
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <cstdint>

namespace WN::Host {

inline constexpr wchar_t kAutostartTask[] = L"WSA-Next";

// Body of "host --background". Returns at once when another instance already runs.
int RunBackground();

[[nodiscard]] bool Running();
Result<> Start();    // starts it unless it runs (the caller is elevated, so is the child)
void Stop();         // asks it to stop and waits until it has
Result<> Restart();  // from the installed WSA-Next.exe (after an update of it)

// The WSA-Next.exe the host and its logon task run: the installed copy in %ProgramFiles%\WSA-Next
// (only administrators may change it) when there is one, otherwise this executable.
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Executable();

// Bluetooth for Android: the setting, applied to the running host (started if needed).
[[nodiscard]] bool BluetoothEnabled();
Result<> SetBluetoothEnabled(bool enabled);

// Root for Android apps, each request confirmed with Windows Hello (setting "Elevation", off by
// default): applied to the running host like Bluetooth.
[[nodiscard]] bool ElevationEnabled();
Result<> SetElevationEnabled(bool enabled);

// "su for root apps" (setting "ElevationSu", off): while root is on, Android also offers apps the
// name su (a link to 0) - root apps work, and root checks of other apps see it too.
[[nodiscard]] bool ElevationSuEnabled();
Result<> SetElevationSuEnabled(bool enabled);

// How long a Windows Hello verification is remembered for Android apps that ask for a fingerprint
// (setting "HelloRemember", in minutes; 0 = ask every time, the default; kHelloUntilLocked = until
// Windows is locked). Locking Windows, signing out or disconnecting always forgets it. Read by the
// Windows Hello bridge for every request; root for Android apps (the elevation bridge) always asks.
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kHelloUntilLocked = 0xFFFFFFFF;
[[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t HelloRememberMinutes();
void SetHelloRememberMinutes(std::uint32_t minutes);

// The host's icon in the notification area (setting "Tray", on by default; src/host/Tray.h).
[[nodiscard]] bool TrayEnabled();
Result<> SetTrayEnabled(bool enabled);

// Start with Windows: the logon task for the current user.
[[nodiscard]] bool AutostartEnabled();
Result<> SetAutostart(bool enable);

}  // namespace WN::Host
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include "host/Registration.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "support/Browser.h"
#include "support/HostEvents.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <format>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

namespace WN::Host {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kPage[] = L"https://www.google.com/android/uncertified";
constexpr wchar_t kDoneSetting[] = L"GooglePlayRegistered";  // a digest of the ID registered last

std::mutex g_lock;
std::wstring g_pending;  // the ID Android offered last
std::wstring g_shown;    // the ID whose notification this host has shown (Android offers it at
                         // every start and every check-in of Play services: several in seconds)

// FNV-1a, 64 bits: stable between runs; the ID itself is not kept.
std::wstring Digest(const std::wstring& id) {
    std::uint64_t hash = 0xCBF29CE484222325ull;
    for (const wchar_t c : id) {
        hash ^= static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c);
        hash *= 0x100000001B3ull;
    }
    return std::format(L"{:016X}", hash);
}

bool RecvAll(SOCKET socket, char* data, std::size_t size) {
    for (std::size_t done = 0; done < size;) {
        const int n = recv(socket, data + done, static_cast<int>(size - done), 0);
        if (n <= 0) return false;
        done += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

bool CopyToClipboard(HWND owner, const std::wstring& text) {
    if (!OpenClipboard(owner)) return false;
    bool copied = false;
    EmptyClipboard();
    if (const HGLOBAL memory = GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, (text.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t))) {
        if (void* target = GlobalLock(memory)) {
            std::memcpy(target, text.c_str(), (text.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t));
            GlobalUnlock(memory);
            copied = SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, memory) != nullptr;
        }
        if (!copied) GlobalFree(memory);  // the clipboard owns it once set
    }
    CloseClipboard();
    return copied;
}

// One connection from wsa-elevated: "RGID", one length byte and the decimal ID, any number of
// times; one reply byte for each.
void Serve(SOCKET socket) {
    for (;;) {
        char magic[4]{};
        unsigned char length = 0;
        if (!RecvAll(socket, magic, sizeof magic) || std::memcmp(magic, "RGID", 4) != 0) return;
        if (!RecvAll(socket, reinterpret_cast<char*>(&length), 1) || length == 0 || length > 20) return;
        std::string digits(length, '\0');
        if (!RecvAll(socket, digits.data(), digits.size()) || digits.find_first_not_of("0123456789") != std::string::npos) return;
        const std::wstring id(digits.begin(), digits.end());
        bool shownBefore = false;
        {
            std::lock_guard guard(g_lock);
            g_pending = id;
            shownBefore = g_shown == id;
        }
        char reply = 'O';
        if (Settings::Read(kDoneSetting) == Digest(id)) {
            Bt::Log("host: Google Play registration - this installation was registered from Windows before");
        } else if (shownBefore) {
            reply = 'S';  // the notification is out already
        } else if (HostRegistrationNotice()) {
            reply = 'S';
            std::lock_guard guard(g_lock);
            g_shown = id;
            Bt::Log("host: Google Play registration - offered in a Windows notification");
        } else {
            reply = 'N';
            Bt::Log("host: Google Play registration - no notification-area icon, Android shows its own notification");
        }
        if (::send(socket, &reply, 1, 0) != 1) return;
    }
}

}  // namespace

void RunRegistration(std::stop_token stop) {
    Guest::Serve(kRegistrationPort, "Android registration helper", [](std::uintptr_t socket, std::stop_token) { Serve(static_cast<SOCKET>(socket)); },
                 stop);
}

std::wstring PendingRegistrationId() {
    std::lock_guard guard(g_lock);
    return g_pending;
}

bool RegisterWithGoogle(void* owner) {
    const std::wstring id = PendingRegistrationId();
    if (id.empty()) return false;
    const bool copied = CopyToClipboard(static_cast<HWND>(owner), id);
    OpenInBrowser(kPage);  // unelevated, its window to the front (the user's click allows it)
    Settings::Write(kDoneSetting, Digest(id));
    Bt::Log("host: Google Play registration page opened{}", copied ? ", device ID copied" : ", the device ID could not be copied");
    return true;
}

}  // namespace WN::Host
```

`src/host/Registration.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Google Play registration of a new installation (Google Play variant). Google knows a new
// installation as an uncertified device until its Google Services Framework ID is entered on
// Google's page. Android's notifications reach Windows, but a click on one does not come back to
// Android for an app without a launcher activity, so the notice is Windows' own:
//
//   WsaNextRegistration (Play services checked in)  --/dev/socket/wsa_elevate "RGWN"-->
//   wsa-elevated (reads the ID)  --vsock "WSRG": "RGID", length, digits-->  this host
//
// The host's notification-area icon shows a notification; a click on it (or its menu item)
// copies the ID to the clipboard and opens Google's page in the user's browser, unelevated. After
// that click a digest of the ID is remembered (not the ID), and that ID is not offered again.
// Reply to Android: 'S' shown, 'O' done before, 'N' no icon to show it (Android then shows its
// own notification with the ID).
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>

namespace WN::Host {

inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRegistrationPort = 0x57535247;  // "WSRG" (device/wsa/wsa_x86_64/elevate)

// Serves Android's registration helper until `stop`. Runs in the multithreaded apartment.
void RunRegistration(std::stop_token stop);

// The ID Android last offered in this host's lifetime; empty when none.
std::wstring PendingRegistrationId();

// Copies the pending ID to the clipboard (`owner`: a window of this thread) and opens Google's
// page in the user's browser; remembers the ID as done. False without a pending ID.
bool RegisterWithGoogle(void* owner);

}  // namespace WN::Host
```

`src/host/Tray.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "host/Tray.h"
#include "bluetooth/Bridge.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "host/Host.h"
#include "host/Registration.h"
#include "install/Package.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/HostEvents.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <commctrl.h>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

#pragma comment(lib, "comctl32.lib")

namespace WN::Host {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kClass[] = L"WSA-Next.Tray";
constexpr UINT kIconId = 1;
constexpr UINT kTrayMessage = WM_APP + 1;  // from Explorer: clicks on the icon
constexpr UINT kRefresh = WM_APP + 2;      // from the host: the state changed
constexpr UINT kNotice = WM_APP + 3;       // from a bridge: a notification to show
constexpr UINT kRegistration = WM_APP + 4; // from the registration helper: offer Google Play registration

enum : UINT { CmdOpen = 1, CmdRegister, CmdBluetooth, CmdRoot, CmdSu, CmdStopWsa, CmdLog, CmdHide, CmdExit };

struct Notice {
    std::wstring title, text;
};

// The one icon of the process; the listeners reach its window through this.
std::atomic<HWND> g_window{nullptr};

void OnHostChanged() {
    if (const HWND hwnd = g_window.load()) PostMessageW(hwnd, kRefresh, 0, 0);
}

void OnNotice(const std::wstring& title, const std::wstring& text) {
    const HWND hwnd = g_window.load();
    if (!hwnd) return;
    auto notice = std::make_unique<Notice>(Notice{title, text});
    if (PostMessageW(hwnd, kNotice, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(notice.get()))) notice.release();
}

bool OnRegistration() {
    const HWND hwnd = g_window.load();
    return hwnd && PostMessageW(hwnd, kRegistration, 0, 0);
}

// A notification-area string: at most `size` characters with the terminator.
template <std::size_t N>
void Copy(wchar_t (&field)[N], const std::wstring& text) {
    wcsncpy_s(field, text.c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
}

}  // namespace

Tray::Tray(HANDLE stopHost) : m_stopHost(stopHost) {
    m_thread = std::jthread([this] { Run(); });
}

Tray::~Tray() {
    if (const HWND hwnd = g_window.load()) PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
    if (m_thread.joinable()) m_thread.join();
}

void Tray::Run() {
    const HINSTANCE instance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
    WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
    wc.lpfnWndProc = &Tray::Proc;
    wc.hInstance = instance;
    wc.lpszClassName = kClass;
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);  // a second icon in the same process finds it registered
    // A hidden top-level window (a message-only one would miss "TaskbarCreated", a broadcast).
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW, kClass, L"WSA-Next", WS_POPUP, 0, 0, 0, 0, nullptr, nullptr, instance, this);
    if (!m_hwnd) return;
    // Elevated process, Explorer at medium integrity: let its messages for the icon through.
    m_taskbarCreated = RegisterWindowMessageW(L"TaskbarCreated");
    ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(m_hwnd, kTrayMessage, MSGFLT_ALLOW, nullptr);
    ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(m_hwnd, m_taskbarCreated, MSGFLT_ALLOW, nullptr);
    AddIcon();
    g_window = m_hwnd;
    g_hostChangedListener = &OnHostChanged;
    g_hostNoticeListener = &OnNotice;
    g_hostRegistrationListener = &OnRegistration;
    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
}

LRESULT CALLBACK Tray::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE) {
        // The first message, before CreateWindowExW returns: the window is known from here on
        // (DefWindowProc must get it - with no window it fails the creation).
        auto* created = reinterpret_cast<Tray*>(reinterpret_cast<CREATESTRUCTW*>(lParam)->lpCreateParams);
        created->m_hwnd = hwnd;
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(created));
    }
    auto* self = reinterpret_cast<Tray*>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

LRESULT Tray::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    if (message == m_taskbarCreated && m_taskbarCreated) {  // Explorer restarted: the icon is gone
        AddIcon();
        return 0;
    }
    switch (message) {
    case kTrayMessage:
        switch (LOWORD(lParam)) {
        case NIN_SELECT:
        case NIN_KEYSELECT:
        case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK: Command(CmdOpen); break;
        case WM_CONTEXTMENU: ShowMenu(); break;
        case NIN_BALLOONUSERCLICK:
            if (m_registrationShown) Command(CmdRegister);
            break;
        default: break;
        }
        return 0;
    case kRefresh:
        Refresh();
        return 0;
    case kNotice: {
        const std::unique_ptr<Notice> notice(reinterpret_cast<Notice*>(lParam));
        ShowBalloon(notice->title, notice->text);
        m_registrationShown = false;
        return 0;
    }
    case kRegistration:
        ShowBalloon(Text::Get(IDS_TRAY_REGISTER_TITLE), Text::Get(IDS_TRAY_REGISTER_TEXT));
        m_registrationShown = true;  // a click on it registers
        return 0;
    case WM_COMMAND:
        Command(LOWORD(wParam));
        return 0;
    case WM_CLOSE:
        DestroyWindow(m_hwnd);
        return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY: {
        g_hostChangedListener = nullptr;
        g_hostNoticeListener = nullptr;
        g_hostRegistrationListener = nullptr;
        g_window = nullptr;
        NOTIFYICONDATAW data{sizeof data};
        data.hWnd = m_hwnd;
        data.uID = kIconId;
        Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &data);
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }
    default: return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
}

void Tray::AddIcon() {
    NOTIFYICONDATAW data{sizeof data};
    data.hWnd = m_hwnd;
    data.uID = kIconId;
    data.uFlags = NIF_MESSAGE | NIF_ICON | NIF_TIP | NIF_SHOWTIP;
    data.uCallbackMessage = kTrayMessage;
    LoadIconMetric(GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_APP), LIM_SMALL, &data.hIcon);
    Copy(data.szTip, L"WSA-Next");
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &data);  // a leftover of an earlier instance
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_ADD, &data);
    data.uVersion = NOTIFYICON_VERSION_4;
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_SETVERSION, &data);
    if (data.hIcon) DestroyIcon(data.hIcon);
    Refresh();
}

void Tray::ShowBalloon(const std::wstring& title, const std::wstring& text) {
    NOTIFYICONDATAW data{sizeof data};
    data.hWnd = m_hwnd;
    data.uID = kIconId;
    data.uFlags = NIF_INFO;
    data.dwInfoFlags = NIIF_INFO;
    Copy(data.szInfoTitle, title);
    Copy(data.szInfo, text);
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, &data);
}

// The tooltip: what runs. Read on each change notice (WSA's VM, the bridges, the settings).
void Tray::Refresh() {
    const bool android = Guest::FindWsaVm().has_value();
    const UINT bluetooth = !BluetoothEnabled() ? IDS_TRAY_BT_OFF : Bt::AndroidConnected() ? IDS_TRAY_BT_CONNECTED : IDS_TRAY_BT_ON;
    const std::wstring tip = L"WSA-Next\n" + Text::Get(android ? IDS_TRAY_ANDROID_ON : IDS_TRAY_ANDROID_OFF) + L"\n" + Text::Get(bluetooth) + L"\n" +
                             Text::Get(ElevationEnabled() ? IDS_TRAY_ROOT_ON : IDS_TRAY_ROOT_OFF);
    NOTIFYICONDATAW data{sizeof data};
    data.hWnd = m_hwnd;
    data.uID = kIconId;
    data.uFlags = NIF_TIP | NIF_SHOWTIP;
    Copy(data.szTip, tip);
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, &data);
}

void Tray::ShowMenu() {
    const HMENU menu = CreatePopupMenu();
    if (!menu) return;
    const bool root = ElevationEnabled();
    const bool android = Guest::FindWsaVm().has_value();
    auto item = [&](UINT id, UINT text, bool checked = false, bool enabled = true) {
        AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING | (checked ? MF_CHECKED : 0) | (enabled ? 0 : MF_GRAYED), id, Text::Get(text).c_str());
    };
    item(CmdOpen, IDS_TRAY_OPEN);
    SetMenuDefaultItem(menu, CmdOpen, FALSE);
    if (!PendingRegistrationId().empty()) item(CmdRegister, IDS_TRAY_REGISTER);
    AppendMenuW(menu, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, nullptr);
    item(CmdBluetooth, IDS_TRAY_BLUETOOTH, BluetoothEnabled());
    item(CmdRoot, IDS_MI_ELEVATION, root);
    item(CmdSu, IDS_MI_ELEVATION_SU, ElevationSuEnabled(), root);
    AppendMenuW(menu, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, nullptr);
    item(CmdStopWsa, IDS_MI_STOP_WSA, false, android);
    item(CmdLog, IDS_MI_BT_LOG);
    AppendMenuW(menu, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, nullptr);
    item(CmdHide, IDS_TRAY_HIDE);
    item(CmdExit, IDS_TRAY_EXIT);
    POINT at{};
    GetCursorPos(&at);
    SetForegroundWindow(m_hwnd);  // so that the menu closes when the user clicks elsewhere
    TrackPopupMenuEx(menu, TPM_RIGHTBUTTON | TPM_BOTTOMALIGN, at.x, at.y, m_hwnd, nullptr);
    PostMessageW(m_hwnd, WM_NULL, 0, 0);
    DestroyMenu(menu);
}

void Tray::Command(UINT id) {
    switch (id) {
    case CmdOpen: ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", Executable().c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL); break;
    case CmdRegister:
        m_registrationShown = false;
        (void)RegisterWithGoogle(m_hwnd);
        break;
    case CmdBluetooth: (void)SetBluetoothEnabled(!BluetoothEnabled()); break;
    case CmdRoot:
        if (ElevationEnabled()) {
            (void)SetElevationEnabled(false);
        } else if (MessageBoxW(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_ELEVATION_TEXT).c_str(), Text::Get(IDS_ELEVATION_HEADING).c_str(),
                               MB_YESNO | MB_ICONWARNING | MB_DEFBUTTON2 | MB_SETFOREGROUND) == IDYES) {
            (void)SetElevationEnabled(true);
        }
        break;
    case CmdSu: (void)SetElevationSuEnabled(!ElevationSuEnabled()); break;
    case CmdStopWsa:
        // Up to half a minute: off the window's thread. The VM's end comes back as a change notice.
        std::thread([] { (void)Install::Stop(); }).detach();
        break;
    case CmdLog: ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", (Bt::LogFolder() / L"bluetooth.log").c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL); break;
    case CmdHide: (void)SetTrayEnabled(false); break;
    case CmdExit: SetEvent(m_stopHost); break;
    default: break;
    }
    Refresh();
}

}  // namespace WN::Host
```

`src/host/Tray.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// The background host's icon in the notification area: the state at a glance (Android, Bluetooth,
// root), quick switches, and a notification whenever an Android app was granted root - so every
// grant stays visible after the fact. Its own thread and a hidden window; it reacts to the host's
// change notices and never polls. The host runs elevated: the icon's callback message and
// "TaskbarCreated" (Explorer restarted) are let through the message filter explicitly.
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

namespace WN::Host {

class Tray {
public:
    explicit Tray(HANDLE stopHost);  // shows the icon (its thread starts at once)
    ~Tray();                         // removes it
    Tray(const Tray&) = delete;
    Tray& operator=(const Tray&) = delete;

private:
    void Run();
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);
    LRESULT Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);
    void AddIcon();
    void ShowBalloon(const std::wstring& title, const std::wstring& text);
    void Refresh();
    void ShowMenu();
    void Command(UINT id);

    HANDLE m_stopHost;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    UINT m_taskbarCreated = 0;
    bool m_registrationShown = false;  // the last notification offers Google Play registration
    std::jthread m_thread;
};

}  // namespace WN::Host
```

`src/install/Package.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "install/Package.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <ShlObj.h>
#include <sddl.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.ApplicationModel.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Foundation.Collections.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Foundation.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Management.Core.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Management.Deployment.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Storage.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.System.h>
#include <format>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <regex>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "windowsapp.lib")

namespace WN::Install {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using namespace winrt::Windows::Management::Deployment;
using winrt::Windows::Foundation::Uri;
namespace {

std::wstring VersionText(const winrt::Windows::ApplicationModel::PackageVersion& v) {
    return std::format(L"{}.{}.{}.{}", v.Major, v.Minor, v.Build, v.Revision);
}

// "1.2.3.4" -> comparable 64-bit value
std::uint64_t VersionKey(std::wstring_view text) {
    std::uint64_t key = 0;
    int parts = 0;
    std::size_t pos = 0;
    while (parts < 4) {
        std::uint64_t n = 0;
        while (pos < text.size() && text[pos] >= L'0' && text[pos] <= L'9') n = n * 10 + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(text[pos++] - L'0');
        key = (key << 16) | (n & 0xFFFF);
        ++parts;
        if (pos >= text.size() || text[pos] != L'.') break;
        ++pos;
    }
    return key << (16 * (4 - parts));
}

// Waits for a deployment operation and turns its failure into an error with the system's text.
Result<> Await(const winrt::Windows::Foundation::IAsyncOperationWithProgress<DeploymentResult, DeploymentProgress>& op,
               std::wstring_view what) {
    try {
        const DeploymentResult result = op.get();
        if (FAILED(result.ExtendedErrorCode())) {
            std::wstring text = std::wstring(result.ErrorText());
            return Fail(std::format(L"{}: {} (0x{:08X})", what, text, static_cast<unsigned>(result.ExtendedErrorCode())));
        }
        return {};
    } catch (const winrt::hresult_error& e) {
        return Fail(std::format(L"{}: {} (0x{:08X})", what, std::wstring(e.message()), static_cast<unsigned>(e.code())));
    }
}

struct Dependency {
    std::wstring name, minVersion;
};

std::vector<Dependency> ReadDependencies(const fs::path& manifest) {
    std::ifstream in(manifest, std::ios::binary);
    std::stringstream buffer;
    buffer << in.rdbuf();
    const std::wstring xml = FromUtf8(buffer.str());
    std::vector<Dependency> out;
    const std::wregex dep(LR"rx(<PackageDependency\s+[^>]*Name="([^"]+)"[^>]*MinVersion="([^"]+)")rx");
    for (std::wsregex_iterator it(xml.begin(), xml.end(), dep), end; it != end; ++it) out.push_back({(*it)[1].str(), (*it)[2].str()});
    return out;
}

}  // namespace

std::optional<PackageInfo> FindWsa() {
    try {
        PackageManager manager;
        for (const auto& package : manager.FindPackagesForUser(L"")) {
            if (package.Id().FamilyName() != Config::kPackageFamily) continue;
            PackageInfo info;
            info.fullName = package.Id().FullName();
            info.version = VersionText(package.Id().Version());
            info.location = std::wstring(package.InstalledLocation().Path());
            info.developmentMode = package.IsDevelopmentMode();
            return info;
        }
    } catch (const winrt::hresult_error&) {
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

namespace {

// The current user's SID as text ("S-1-5-21-...").
std::wstring CurrentUserSid() {
    HANDLE token = nullptr;
    if (!OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &token)) return {};
    const KernelHandle owned(token);
    DWORD size = 0;
    GetTokenInformation(token, TokenUser, nullptr, 0, &size);
    std::vector<std::byte> buffer(size);
    if (!size || !GetTokenInformation(token, TokenUser, buffer.data(), size, &size)) return {};
    PWSTR text = nullptr;
    if (!ConvertSidToStringSidW(reinterpret_cast<TOKEN_USER*>(buffer.data())->User.Sid, &text)) return {};
    std::wstring sid(text);
    LocalFree(text);
    return sid;
}

// The account name of a SID ("Marek"); the SID itself when it has none.
std::wstring AccountName(const std::wstring& sidText) {
    PSID sid = nullptr;
    if (!ConvertStringSidToSidW(sidText.c_str(), &sid)) return sidText;
    wchar_t name[256]{}, domain[256]{};
    DWORD nameSize = 256, domainSize = 256;
    SID_NAME_USE use{};
    const bool found = LookupAccountSidW(nullptr, sid, name, &nameSize, domain, &domainSize, &use);
    LocalFree(sid);
    return found ? std::wstring(name) : sidText;
}

}  // namespace

std::optional<OtherRegistration> FindWsaOfOtherUser() {
    try {
        PackageManager manager;
        const std::wstring self = CurrentUserSid();
        std::optional<OtherRegistration> other;
        for (const auto& package : manager.FindPackages(Config::kPackageFamily)) {  // every user's
            for (const auto& user : manager.FindUsers(package.Id().FullName())) {
                const std::wstring sid(user.UserSecurityId());
                if (_wcsicmp(sid.c_str(), self.c_str()) == 0) return std::nullopt;  // the current user's too
                if (!other) {
                    std::wstring location;
                    try {
                        location = std::wstring(package.InstalledLocation().Path());
                    } catch (const winrt::hresult_error&) {
                    }
                    other = OtherRegistration{AccountName(sid), location};
                }
            }
        }
        return other;
    } catch (const winrt::hresult_error&) {
        return std::nullopt;  // not an administrator: Windows lists only the current user's packages
    }
}

Result<> InstallDependencies(const fs::path& folder, const LogFn& log) {
    PackageManager manager;
    for (const Dependency& dep : ReadDependencies(folder / Config::kPackageManifest)) {
        std::wstring installed;
        try {
            for (const auto& p : manager.FindPackagesForUser(L"")) {
                if (p.Id().Name() != dep.name || p.Id().Architecture() != winrt::Windows::System::ProcessorArchitecture::X64) continue;
                const std::wstring v = VersionText(p.Id().Version());
                if (VersionKey(v) > VersionKey(installed)) installed = v;
            }
        } catch (const winrt::hresult_error&) {
        }
        if (!installed.empty() && VersionKey(installed) >= VersionKey(dep.minVersion)) {
            log(Text::Format(IDS_LOG_DEP_OK, dep.name, installed));
            continue;
        }
        const fs::path appx = folder / (dep.name + L"_x64.appx");
        if (!fs::exists(appx)) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_DEP_MISSING, dep.name, dep.minVersion));
        log(Text::Format(IDS_LOG_DEP_INSTALL, dep.name, dep.minVersion));
        auto r = Await(manager.AddPackageAsync(Uri(appx.wstring()), nullptr,
                                               DeploymentOptions::ForceApplicationShutdown | DeploymentOptions::ForceUpdateFromAnyVersion),
                       dep.name);
        if (!r) return r;
    }
    return {};
}

Result<> Register(const fs::path& folder, const LogFn& log) {
    PackageManager manager;
    const fs::path manifest = folder / Config::kPackageManifest;
    log(Text::Format(IDS_LOG_REGISTER, manifest.wstring()));
    return Await(manager.RegisterPackageAsync(Uri(manifest.wstring()), nullptr,
                                              DeploymentOptions::DevelopmentMode | DeploymentOptions::ForceApplicationShutdown |
                                                  DeploymentOptions::ForceUpdateFromAnyVersion),
                 Text::Get(IDS_CTX_REGISTER));
}

Result<> Unregister(const PackageInfo& package, bool keepData) {
    PackageManager manager;
    return Await(manager.RemovePackageAsync(package.fullName, keepData ? RemovalOptions::PreserveApplicationData : RemovalOptions::None),
                 Text::Get(IDS_CTX_UNREGISTER));
}

std::vector<std::wstring> OtherDevelopmentPackages() {
    std::vector<std::wstring> names;
    try {
        PackageManager manager;
        for (const auto& package : manager.FindPackagesForUser(L""))
            if (package.IsDevelopmentMode() && package.Id().FamilyName() != Config::kPackageFamily) names.emplace_back(package.Id().Name());
    } catch (const winrt::hresult_error&) {
    }
    return names;
}

namespace {

// WSA's own way of shutting Android down: "WsaClient /shutdown", through the package's app
// execution alias. Started as a plain file, WsaClient runs outside the package and does not find
// the DLLs of the package root (gfxstream_backend.dll) - Windows then shows "system error" instead
// of shutting anything down. No alias: WSA is not registered. Returns the WsaClient process.
KernelHandle StartShutdown(const fs::path& folder) {
    PWSTR local = nullptr;
    fs::path client;
    if (SUCCEEDED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_LocalAppData, 0, nullptr, &local)))
        client = fs::path(local) / L"Microsoft" / L"WindowsApps" / Config::kPackageFamily / L"WsaClient.exe";
    CoTaskMemFree(local);
    std::error_code ec;
    if (client.empty() || !fs::exists(fs::symlink_status(client, ec))) return {};
    std::wstring command = std::format(L"\"{}\" /shutdown", client.wstring());
    STARTUPINFOW si{sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
    const wchar_t* directory = !folder.empty() && fs::is_directory(folder, ec) ? folder.c_str() : nullptr;
    if (!CreateProcessW(client.c_str(), command.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, directory, &si, &pi)) return {};
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    return KernelHandle(pi.hProcess);
}

}  // namespace

void Shutdown(const fs::path& folder, const LogFn& log) {
    const KernelHandle process = StartShutdown(folder);
    if (!process) return;
    log(Text::Get(IDS_LOG_SHUTDOWN));
    WaitForSingleObject(process.get(), 60000);
}

Guest::VmStop Stop() {
    const auto package = FindWsa();
    if (!package) return Guest::VmStop::NotRunning;
    KernelHandle client;
    return Guest::StopVm([&] { client = StartShutdown(package->location); }, 30000);
}

void DefaultWsaSettings() {
    // WSA Settings' own names, in the package's LocalSettings (Settings\settings.dat).
    constexpr const wchar_t* kOffByDefault[] = {L"DeveloperModeEnabled", L"OptionalDiagnosticDataEnabled"};
    try {
        const auto data = winrt::Windows::Management::Core::ApplicationDataManager::CreateForPackageFamily(Config::kPackageFamily);
        auto values = data.LocalSettings().Values();
        for (const wchar_t* name : kOffByDefault)
            if (!values.HasKey(name)) values.Insert(name, winrt::box_value(false));
    } catch (const winrt::hresult_error&) {
        // no data store yet: WSA keeps its own defaults
    }
}

Result<> LaunchAndroid() {
    // The installed release names its variant ("variant": "Google Play") in release.json.
    bool googlePlay = false;
    if (const auto package = FindWsa()) {
        std::ifstream file(package->location / L"release.json", std::ios::binary);
        const std::string raw((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
        std::smatch variant;
        static const std::regex kVariant(R"re("variant"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)")re");
        googlePlay = std::regex_search(raw, variant, kVariant) && variant[1].str().find("Google") != std::string::npos;
    }
    return OpenUri(googlePlay ? L"wsa://com.android.vending" : L"wsa://com.android.settings");
}

Result<> OpenUri(const std::wstring& uri) {
    SHELLEXECUTEINFOW info{sizeof info};
    info.fMask = SEE_MASK_NOASYNC | SEE_MASK_FLAG_NO_UI;
    info.lpVerb = L"open";
    info.lpFile = uri.c_str();
    info.nShow = SW_SHOWNORMAL;
    if (!ShellExecuteExW(&info)) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_OPEN, uri), GetLastError()));
    return {};
}

}  // namespace WN::Install
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// The WSA package in Windows: finding it, its dependencies, registering the unpacked folder,
// shutting WSA down and starting it. Calls block; run them on a worker thread (not the UI's STA).
#pragma once
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Install {

struct PackageInfo {
    std::wstring fullName;
    std::wstring version;            // "2407.40000.4.0"
    std::filesystem::path location;  // folder the package was registered from
    bool developmentMode = false;    // registered from a folder (ours or another unpacked build)
};

// The WSA package of the current user, if any.
std::optional<PackageInfo> FindWsa();

// WSA registered for another Windows user of this PC and not for the current one: that user's
// account name and the folder it was registered from. Windows lets one user at a time register
// an unpacked package (a second one gets 0x80073CFB). Administrator; nullopt without the right.
struct OtherRegistration {
    std::wstring user;
    std::filesystem::path location;
};
std::optional<OtherRegistration> FindWsaOfOtherUser();

// Installs the dependency packages named in <folder>\AppxManifest.xml (VCLibs, UI.Xaml) from the
// "<Name>_x64.appx" files next to it, when the installed version is older than required.
Result<> InstallDependencies(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const LogFn& log);

// Registers <folder>\AppxManifest.xml in development mode (the package keeps Microsoft's identity;
// an existing registration is updated in place and the user's data stays).
Result<> Register(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const LogFn& log);

// Defaults for a WSA that has no settings yet (a new installation); a choice already made in
// WSA's settings stays:
//  - developer mode off, as in the Microsoft Store version (WSA Settings showed it on);
//  - optional diagnostic data off: WSA waits at its first start until the user answers that
//    question, and with nothing left to send it to (WSA is discontinued) "no" is the answer
//    that changes nothing - it can be turned on in WSA's settings.
void DefaultWsaSettings();

// Removes the package registration (`keepData`: the Android data disk in LocalCache stays).
Result<> Unregister(const PackageInfo& package, bool keepData);

// Other packages of the current user registered in development mode (they need developer mode).
std::vector<std::wstring> OtherDevelopmentPackages();

// Asks a running WSA to shut down (WsaClient /shutdown through the package's app execution alias)
// and waits for it. `folder` (the install folder) is only its working directory.
void Shutdown(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const LogFn& log);

// Stops WSA without removing anything, to free what its VM holds (memory, CPU): Android shuts
// down the way WSA's own settings do it, the VM's end is awaited as a notification; a VM still
// running after 30 s is terminated. WSA starts again with the next Android app. Administrator.
Guest::VmStop Stop();

// Starts Android and shows its first app: the Play Store on the Google Play variant, Android's
// Settings otherwise. Opening WSA Settings would not start Android, and Windows learns of the
// Android apps (Start menu, installed apps) only once Android has run.
Result<> LaunchAndroid();
Result<> OpenUri(const std::wstring& uri);  // also an Android app: "wsa://<package>"

}  // namespace WN::Install
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "install/Setup.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <Msi.h>
#include <format>

#pragma comment(lib, "msi.lib")

namespace WN::Install {

std::optional<std::wstring> SetupProduct() {
    wchar_t product[39]{};  // a GUID in braces
    for (DWORD i = 0; MsiEnumRelatedProductsW(Config::kSetupUpgradeCode, 0, i, product) == ERROR_SUCCESS; ++i) {
        const INSTALLSTATE state = MsiQueryProductStateW(product);
        if (state == INSTALLSTATE_DEFAULT || state == INSTALLSTATE_LOCAL) return std::wstring(product);
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

Result<> RemoveThroughSetup(const std::wstring& product, bool everything) {
    wchar_t system[MAX_PATH]{};
    GetSystemDirectoryW(system, MAX_PATH);
    const std::wstring msiexec = std::format(L"{}\\msiexec.exe", system);
    std::wstring command = std::format(L"\"{}\" /x {} /passive{}", msiexec, product, everything ? L" REMOVEDATA=1" : L"");
    STARTUPINFOW si{sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
    if (!CreateProcessW(msiexec.c_str(), command.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, 0, nullptr, system, &si, &pi))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_SETUP), GetLastError()));
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    return {};
}

}  // namespace WN::Install
```

`src/install/Traces.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "install/Traces.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <ShlObj.h>
#include <ShObjIdl.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cwctype>
#include <format>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Install {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;
namespace {

constexpr std::wstring_view kFamily = Config::kPackageFamily;
constexpr wchar_t kCurrentVersion[] = L"Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion";

bool SameChar(wchar_t a, wchar_t b) { return std::towlower(a) == std::towlower(b); }

bool Contains(std::wstring_view text, std::wstring_view part) {
    return !part.empty() && !std::ranges::search(text, part, SameChar).empty();
}

bool StartsWith(std::wstring_view text, std::wstring_view prefix) {
    return !prefix.empty() && text.size() >= prefix.size() && std::ranges::equal(text.substr(0, prefix.size()), prefix, SameChar);
}

fs::path KnownFolder(REFKNOWNFOLDERID id) {
    PWSTR raw = nullptr;
    fs::path path;
    if (SUCCEEDED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(id, KF_FLAG_DONT_VERIFY, nullptr, &raw))) path = raw;
    CoTaskMemFree(raw);
    return path;
}

// --- Registry (HKCU only) ---------------------------------------------------------------------

std::vector<std::wstring> SubKeys(const std::wstring& path) {
    std::vector<std::wstring> names;
    RegKey key;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path.c_str(), 0, KEY_ENUMERATE_SUB_KEYS, key.put()) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return names;
    wchar_t name[256];  // registry key names have at most 255 characters
    for (DWORD i = 0;; ++i) {
        DWORD length = static_cast<DWORD>(std::size(name));
        const LSTATUS s = RegEnumKeyExW(key.get(), i, name, &length, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
        if (s == ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS) break;
        if (s == ERROR_SUCCESS) names.emplace_back(name, length);
    }
    return names;
}

// Collected before anything is deleted: deleting a value shifts the enumeration indexes.
std::vector<std::wstring> ValueNames(const std::wstring& path) {
    std::vector<std::wstring> names;
    RegKey key;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path.c_str(), 0, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, key.put()) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return names;
    DWORD longest = 0;
    if (RegQueryInfoKeyW(key.get(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, &longest, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr) !=
        ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return names;
    std::vector<wchar_t> name(longest + 1);
    for (DWORD i = 0;; ++i) {
        DWORD length = static_cast<DWORD>(name.size());
        const LSTATUS s = RegEnumValueW(key.get(), i, name.data(), &length, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
        if (s == ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS) break;
        if (s == ERROR_SUCCESS) names.emplace_back(name.data(), length);
    }
    return names;
}

std::wstring StringValue(const std::wstring& path, const wchar_t* name) {
    constexpr DWORD kFlags = RRF_RT_REG_SZ | RRF_RT_REG_EXPAND_SZ | RRF_NOEXPAND;
    DWORD bytes = 0;
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path.c_str(), name, kFlags, nullptr, nullptr, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS || bytes < sizeof(wchar_t))
        return {};
    std::wstring value(bytes / sizeof(wchar_t), L'\0');
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path.c_str(), name, kFlags, nullptr, value.data(), &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return {};
    value.resize(wcsnlen(value.c_str(), value.size()));
    return value;
}

class Cleaner {
public:
    explicit Cleaner(const LogFn& log) : m_log(log) {}

    void Key(const std::wstring& path) {
        const LSTATUS s = RegDeleteTreeW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path.c_str());
        if (s == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            RegDeleteKeyW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path.c_str());  // RegDeleteTree normally takes the key itself too
            ++m_report.keys;
        } else if (s != ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) {
            m_log(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_DELETE, L"HKCU\\" + path), static_cast<unsigned long>(s)));
        }
    }

    void Value(const std::wstring& path, const std::wstring& name) {
        RegKey key;
        if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path.c_str(), 0, KEY_SET_VALUE, key.put()) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return;
        const LSTATUS s = RegDeleteValueW(key.get(), name.c_str());
        if (s == ERROR_SUCCESS) ++m_report.values;
        else if (s != ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND)
            m_log(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_DELETE, std::format(L"HKCU\\{}\\{}", path, name)), static_cast<unsigned long>(s)));
    }

    void KeysStartingWith(const std::wstring& parent, std::wstring_view prefix) {
        for (const auto& name : SubKeys(parent))
            if (StartsWith(name, prefix)) Key(parent + L"\\" + name);
    }

    void ValuesStartingWith(const std::wstring& key, std::wstring_view prefix) {
        for (const auto& name : ValueNames(key))
            if (StartsWith(name, prefix)) Value(key, name);
    }

    void Shortcut(const fs::path& lnk) {
        std::error_code ec;
        if (fs::remove(lnk, ec)) ++m_report.shortcuts;
        else if (ec) m_log(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_DELETE, lnk.wstring()), static_cast<unsigned long>(ec.value())));
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const TraceReport& Report() const { return m_report; }

private:
    const LogFn& m_log;
    TraceReport m_report;
};

// A shortcut that starts an Android app (WsaClient through the package's app execution alias) or
// a program of the install folder.
bool StartsWsa(const fs::path& lnk, std::wstring_view folderPrefix) {
    ComPtr<IShellLinkW> link;
    ComPtr<IPersistFile> file;
    if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_ShellLink, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(link.GetAddressOf()))) ||
        FAILED(link.As(&file)) || FAILED(file->Load(lnk.c_str(), STGM_READ)))
        return false;
    wchar_t target[MAX_PATH * 2]{};
    wchar_t arguments[1024]{};
    // The raw path: the alias it points to is gone once the package is removed.
    if (link->GetPath(target, static_cast<int>(std::size(target)), nullptr, SLGP_RAWPATH) != S_OK) target[0] = 0;
    if (FAILED(link->GetArguments(arguments, static_cast<int>(std::size(arguments))))) arguments[0] = 0;
    const std::wstring_view path(target);
    return Contains(path, kFamily) || StartsWith(path, folderPrefix) ||
           (path.ends_with(L"\\WsaClient.exe") && Contains(arguments, L"wsa://"));
}

void RemoveShortcuts(Cleaner& clean, const fs::path& folder, bool recursive, std::wstring_view folderPrefix) {
    std::error_code ec;
    if (folder.empty() || !fs::is_directory(folder, ec)) return;
    std::vector<fs::path> found;
    auto consider = [&](const fs::directory_entry& entry) {
        std::error_code e;
        if (entry.is_regular_file(e) && _wcsicmp(entry.path().extension().c_str(), L".lnk") == 0 && StartsWsa(entry.path(), folderPrefix))
            found.push_back(entry.path());
    };
    const auto options = fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied;
    if (recursive) {
        for (fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(folder, options, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec)) consider(*it);
    } else {
        for (fs::directory_iterator it(folder, options, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec)) consider(*it);
    }
    for (const auto& lnk : found) clean.Shortcut(lnk);
}

}  // namespace

TraceReport RemoveTraces(const fs::path& folder, const LogFn& log) {
    Cleaner clean(log);
    const std::wstring cv = kCurrentVersion;
    const std::wstring family(kFamily);
    const std::wstring appPrefix = family + L"!";  // application user model IDs of the package
    std::wstring folderPrefix;
    if (!folder.empty()) {
        folderPrefix = folder.lexically_normal().wstring();
        if (!folderPrefix.ends_with(L'\\')) folderPrefix += L'\\';
    }

    // Android apps in "Installed apps": the entries whose icon lives in WSA's package data. Their
    // RegisteredApplications values point to the entries' Capabilities.
    const std::wstring uninstall = cv + L"\\Uninstall";
    std::set<std::wstring> apps;
    for (const auto& name : SubKeys(uninstall))
        if (Contains(StringValue(uninstall + L"\\" + name, L"DisplayIcon"), L"\\Packages\\" + family + L"\\")) apps.insert(name);
    const std::wstring registered = L"Software\\RegisteredApplications";
    const std::wstring capabilitiesPrefix = uninstall + L"\\";
    for (const auto& name : ValueNames(registered)) {
        const std::wstring target = StringValue(registered, name.c_str());
        if (!StartsWith(target, capabilitiesPrefix)) continue;
        const std::wstring app = target.substr(capabilitiesPrefix.size(), target.find(L'\\', capabilitiesPrefix.size()) - capabilitiesPrefix.size());
        if (apps.contains(app)) clean.Value(registered, name);
    }
    for (const auto& app : apps) clean.Key(uninstall + L"\\" + app);

    // File and link associations: ProgIDs "wsa.<hash>" that open an Android app, and the references
    // to them in the per-user "Open with" lists of file types.
    const std::wstring classes = L"Software\\Classes";
    const auto classKeys = SubKeys(classes);
    std::set<std::wstring> progIds;
    for (const auto& name : classKeys)
        if (StartsWith(name, L"wsa.") && Contains(StringValue(classes + L"\\" + name + L"\\Shell\\Open\\Command", nullptr), family))
            progIds.insert(name);
    if (!progIds.empty()) {
        for (const auto& type : classKeys) {
            if (!type.starts_with(L'.')) continue;
            const std::wstring openWith = classes + L"\\" + type + L"\\OpenWithProgids";
            for (const auto& value : ValueNames(openWith))
                if (progIds.contains(value)) clean.Value(openWith, value);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& id : progIds) clean.Key(classes + L"\\" + id);

    // Per-app records named after the package: notifications, Start tiles, window sizes, background
    // access, privacy consent (and the consent of the install folder's executables).
    clean.KeysStartingWith(cv + L"\\Notifications\\Settings", appPrefix);
    clean.KeysStartingWith(cv + L"\\Start\\TileProperties", L"P~" + appPrefix);
    clean.KeysStartingWith(L"Software\\Microsoft\\Phone\\ShellUI\\WindowSizing", appPrefix);
    clean.Key(cv + L"\\BackgroundAccessApplications\\" + family);
    const std::wstring consent = cv + L"\\CapabilityAccessManager\\ConsentStore";
    std::wstring consentPrefix = folderPrefix;  // "C:#Program Files#WSA-Next#..."
    std::ranges::replace(consentPrefix, L'\\', L'#');
    for (const auto& capability : SubKeys(consent)) {
        clean.Key(consent + L"\\" + capability + L"\\" + family);
        clean.KeysStartingWith(consent + L"\\" + capability + L"\\NonPackaged", consentPrefix);
    }

    // WsaClient's App Paths entry (written for the package's app execution alias).
    const std::wstring appPath = cv + L"\\App Paths\\WsaClient.exe";
    if (Contains(StringValue(appPath, nullptr), family)) clean.Key(appPath);

    // Windows' caches keyed by the install folder or the package: executable names and versions,
    // the program compatibility assistant, taskbar usage, the compiled resources of resources.pri
    // ("C:%5CProgram Files%5CWSA-Next%5Cresources.pri").
    clean.ValuesStartingWith(L"Software\\Classes\\Local Settings\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Shell\\MuiCache", folderPrefix);
    clean.ValuesStartingWith(L"Software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\AppCompatFlags\\Compatibility Assistant\\Store", folderPrefix);
    const std::wstring usage = cv + L"\\Explorer\\FeatureUsage";
    for (const auto& kind : SubKeys(usage)) {
        clean.ValuesStartingWith(usage + L"\\" + kind, folderPrefix);
        clean.ValuesStartingWith(usage + L"\\" + kind, appPrefix);
    }
    std::wstring mrtPrefix;
    for (wchar_t c : folderPrefix) mrtPrefix += c == L'\\' ? std::wstring(L"%5C") : std::wstring(1, c);
    clean.KeysStartingWith(L"Software\\Classes\\Local Settings\\MrtCache", mrtPrefix);

    // Shortcuts: Start menu, desktop, taskbar pins.
    RemoveShortcuts(clean, KnownFolder(FOLDERID_Programs), true, folderPrefix);
    RemoveShortcuts(clean, KnownFolder(FOLDERID_Desktop), false, folderPrefix);
    RemoveShortcuts(clean, KnownFolder(FOLDERID_UserPinned), true, folderPrefix);

    const TraceReport& report = clean.Report();
    if (report.shortcuts || report.keys || report.values) SHChangeNotify(SHCNE_ASSOCCHANGED, SHCNF_IDLIST, nullptr, nullptr);
    return report;
}

fs::path PackageDataFolder() {
    const fs::path local = KnownFolder(FOLDERID_LocalAppData);
    return local.empty() ? fs::path() : local / L"Packages" / kFamily;
}

std::uint64_t FolderSize(const fs::path& folder) {
    std::uint64_t total = 0;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(folder, fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec), end; !ec && it != end;
         it.increment(ec)) {
        std::error_code e;
        if (it->is_regular_file(e)) total += it->file_size(e);
    }
    return total;
}

Result<> DeleteWithRetry(const fs::path& path, int seconds) {
    std::error_code ec;
    for (int attempt = 0;; ++attempt) {
        ec.clear();
        if (!fs::exists(fs::symlink_status(path, ec))) return {};
        fs::remove_all(path, ec);
        if (!ec) return {};
        if (attempt >= seconds) break;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));
    }
    return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_DELETE, path.wstring()), static_cast<unsigned long>(ec.value())));
}

}  // namespace WN::Install
```

`src/install/Traces.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// What WSA leaves in Windows outside its package registration. Removing the package takes its own
// registry and files with it, but WsaClient also writes, per user and on its own:
//   - a Start menu shortcut for every Android app (WsaClient.exe /launch wsa://<app>)
//   - an "Installed apps" entry for every Android app (HKCU ...\Uninstall\<app>), its
//     RegisteredApplications value and its file and link associations (HKCU\Software\Classes\wsa.*)
//   - notification settings of every Android app (<family>!<app>)
// and Windows keeps per-app records of its own (tiles, window sizes, privacy consent, the resource
// cache of the install folder, compatibility and "friendly name" caches of its executables).
// None of them is touched while a WSA package is still registered: they belong to it.
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <filesystem>

namespace WN::Install {

struct TraceReport {
    unsigned shortcuts = 0;  // .lnk files deleted
    unsigned keys = 0;       // registry keys deleted (with their subkeys)
    unsigned values = 0;     // registry values deleted
};

// Removes the per-user traces listed above. `folder` is the install folder (Windows caches entries
// under its path). Never fails as a whole: what cannot be removed is reported through `log`.
TraceReport RemoveTraces(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const LogFn& log);

// %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\<family>: the Android data disk (apps, accounts, files) and WSA's state.
std::filesystem::path PackageDataFolder();

// Total size of the files below `folder` (0 when it does not exist).
std::uint64_t FolderSize(const std::filesystem::path& folder);

// Deletes `path` (file or folder tree). Disks of a VM that has just stopped may stay locked for a
// few seconds, so locked files are retried for up to `seconds`.
Result<> DeleteWithRetry(const std::filesystem::path& path, int seconds = 20);

}  // namespace WN::Install
```
