`src/install/Unpack.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "install/Unpack.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Sha256.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <zstd.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cwctype>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Install {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
namespace {

struct DStreamFree {
    void operator()(ZSTD_DStream* d) const noexcept { ZSTD_freeDStream(d); }
};

// Streams the decompressed bytes of `zst` to `sink`; progress follows the compressed input.
Result<> Decompress(const fs::path& zst, const ProgressFn& progress, std::stop_token stop,
                    const std::function<Result<>(const char*, std::size_t)>& sink) {
    FileHandle in(CreateFileW(zst.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
    if (!in) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_OPEN, zst.wstring()), GetLastError()));
    LARGE_INTEGER total{};
    GetFileSizeEx(in.get(), &total);

    const std::unique_ptr<ZSTD_DStream, DStreamFree> ds(ZSTD_createDStream());
    if (!ds) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_ZSTD_MEMORY));
    ZSTD_initDStream(ds.get());
    // Releases are compressed with --long=31 (2 GB window).
    ZSTD_DCtx_setParameter(ds.get(), ZSTD_d_windowLogMax, 31);

    std::vector<char> input(ZSTD_DStreamInSize() * 8), output(ZSTD_DStreamOutSize() * 8);
    std::uint64_t consumed = 0;
    // ZSTD_decompressStream returns 0 once a frame is decoded and completely flushed, otherwise how
    // much is still to come. It is called again while input is left, or while the last call filled
    // the output buffer of an unfinished frame (more output is pending). It must not be called
    // after a finished frame with no input: that starts a new frame and returns its header size.
    std::size_t ret = 1;
    for (;;) {
        if (stop.stop_requested()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        DWORD read = 0;
        if (!ReadFile(in.get(), input.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(input.size()), &read, nullptr))
            return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_READ, zst.wstring()), GetLastError()));
        if (!read) break;
        ZSTD_inBuffer src{input.data(), read, 0};
        bool outputFull = false;
        do {
            ZSTD_outBuffer dst{output.data(), output.size(), 0};
            ret = ZSTD_decompressStream(ds.get(), &dst, &src);
            if (ZSTD_isError(ret)) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_ZSTD_ERROR, FromUtf8(ZSTD_getErrorName(ret))));
            if (dst.pos)
                if (auto r = sink(output.data(), dst.pos); !r) return r;
            outputFull = dst.pos == dst.size;
        } while (src.pos < src.size || (outputFull && ret != 0));
        consumed += read;
        progress(consumed, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(total.QuadPart));
    }
    if (ret != 0) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_ZSTD_TRUNCATED));
    return {};
}

}  // namespace

// Output file written through "<name>.new". It stays open without sharing from creation until
// it is in place: Finish flushes it, Place renames it over the target through the same handle,
// so nobody can change or swap the bytes in between - not even in a folder the user may write.
// Destroyed before Place, it deletes the ".new".
class NewFile {
public:
    Result<> Open(const fs::path& target) {
        m_target = target;
        m_temp = target;
        m_temp += L".new";
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::create_directories(target.parent_path(), ec);
        m_file.reset(CreateFileW(m_temp.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE | DELETE | FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
        if (!m_file) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_CREATE, m_temp.wstring()), GetLastError()));
        return {};
    }
    Result<> Write(const char* data, std::size_t n) {
        while (n) {
            const DWORD chunk = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<std::size_t>(n, 1u << 30));
            DWORD written = 0;
            if (!WriteFile(m_file.get(), data, chunk, &written, nullptr) || written != chunk)
                return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_WRITE, m_temp.wstring()), GetLastError()));
            data += chunk;
            n -= chunk;
            m_bytes += chunk;
        }
        return {};
    }
    Result<> Finish() {
        if (!FlushFileBuffers(m_file.get())) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_WRITE, m_temp.wstring()), GetLastError()));
        return {};
    }
    Result<> Place() {
        // A read-only target (copied from a read-only source) would block the rename.
        SetFileAttributesW(m_target.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
        const std::wstring name = m_target.wstring();
        std::vector<std::byte> buffer(sizeof(FILE_RENAME_INFO) + name.size() * sizeof(wchar_t));
        auto* info = reinterpret_cast<FILE_RENAME_INFO*>(buffer.data());
        info->ReplaceIfExists = TRUE;
        info->RootDirectory = nullptr;
        info->FileNameLength = static_cast<DWORD>(name.size() * sizeof(wchar_t));
        std::memcpy(info->FileName, name.data(), info->FileNameLength);
        if (!SetFileInformationByHandle(m_file.get(), FileRenameInfo, info, static_cast<DWORD>(buffer.size())))
            return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_REPLACE, m_target.wstring()), GetLastError()));
        m_temp.clear();
        return {};
    }
    ~NewFile() {
        m_file.reset();
        if (!m_temp.empty()) DeleteFileW(m_temp.c_str());
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t bytes() const noexcept { return m_bytes; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool placed() const noexcept { return m_temp.empty(); }

private:
    fs::path m_target, m_temp;
    FileHandle m_file;
    std::uint64_t m_bytes = 0;
};

Staged::Staged() = default;
Staged::~Staged() = default;
Staged::Staged(Staged&&) noexcept = default;
Staged& Staged::operator=(Staged&&) noexcept = default;

void Staged::Add(std::unique_ptr<NewFile> file) { m_files.push_back(std::move(file)); }

void Staged::Append(Staged&& other) {
    for (auto& file : other.m_files) m_files.push_back(std::move(file));
    other.m_files.clear();
}

Result<> Staged::Commit() {
    for (auto& file : m_files)
        if (!file->placed())
            if (auto r = file->Place(); !r) return r;
    m_files.clear();  // closes them
    return {};
}

bool ReservedName(std::wstring_view element) {
    if (element.empty() || element == L"." || element == L"..") return false;
    if (element.back() == L'.' || element.back() == L' ') return true;  // Windows would drop them
    // A device name counts up to the first dot ("NUL.txt" is NUL), whatever the case.
    std::wstring base(element.substr(0, element.find(L'.')));
    while (!base.empty() && base.back() == L' ') base.pop_back();
    for (auto& c : base) c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c));
    static constexpr std::wstring_view kDevices[] = {L"CON", L"PRN", L"AUX", L"NUL", L"CONIN$", L"CONOUT$"};
    if (std::ranges::find(kDevices, std::wstring_view(base)) != std::end(kDevices)) return true;
    if (base.size() == 4 && (base.starts_with(L"COM") || base.starts_with(L"LPT"))) {
        const wchar_t n = base[3];
        return (n >= L'0' && n <= L'9') || n == 0x00B9 || n == 0x00B2 || n == 0x00B3;  // also superscript 1-3
    }
    return false;
}

namespace {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Streaming tar reader (ustar, pax and GNU long names).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
constexpr std::size_t kBlock = 512;

std::string CString(const char* p, std::size_t max) {
    std::size_t n = 0;
    while (n < max && p[n]) ++n;
    return std::string(p, n);
}

std::uint64_t ParseOctal(const char* p, std::size_t len) {
    if (static_cast<unsigned char>(p[0]) & 0x80) {  // GNU base-256
        std::uint64_t v = static_cast<unsigned char>(p[0]) & 0x7F;
        for (std::size_t i = 1; i < len; ++i) v = (v << 8) | static_cast<unsigned char>(p[i]);
        return v;
    }
    std::uint64_t v = 0;
    std::size_t i = 0;
    while (i < len && (p[i] == ' ' || p[i] == '\0')) ++i;
    for (; i < len && p[i] >= '0' && p[i] <= '7'; ++i) v = v * 8 + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(p[i] - '0');
    return v;
}

bool ChecksumOk(const char* h) {
    const std::uint64_t expected = ParseOctal(h + 148, 8);
    std::uint64_t sum = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kBlock; ++i) sum += (i >= 148 && i < 156) ? ' ' : static_cast<unsigned char>(h[i]);
    return sum == expected;
}

Result<fs::path> SafePath(const std::string& name) {
    std::wstring wide = FromUtf8(name);
    std::ranges::replace(wide, L'/', L'\\');
    fs::path result;
    std::size_t start = 0;
    while (start <= wide.size()) {
        std::size_t end = wide.find(L'\\', start);
        if (end == std::wstring::npos) end = wide.size();
        const std::wstring part = wide.substr(start, end - start);
        start = end + 1;
        if (part.empty() || part == L".") continue;
        if (part == L".." || part.find_first_of(L":*?\"<>|") != std::wstring::npos || ReservedName(part) ||
            std::ranges::any_of(part, [](wchar_t c) { return c < 0x20; }))
            return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_TAR_UNSAFE, wide));
        result /= part;
    }
    return result;
}

class TarWriter {
public:
    TarWriter(fs::path folder, std::uint64_t limit) : m_folder(std::move(folder)), m_limit(limit) {}

    Result<> Feed(const char* data, std::size_t n) {
        while (n) {
            if (m_ended) return {};  // trailing zero blocks and padding
            if (m_fileLeft) {        // file content
                const std::size_t take = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(m_fileLeft, n));
                if (m_out) {
                    m_written += take;
                    if (m_limit && m_written > m_limit) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_UNPACK_TOO_LARGE, m_folder.wstring(), m_limit));
                    if (auto r = m_out->Write(data, take); !r) return r;
                }
                if (m_record) m_recordData.append(data, take);
                data += take; n -= take; m_fileLeft -= take;
                if (!m_fileLeft)
                    if (auto r = FinishEntry(); !r) return r;
                continue;
            }
            if (m_padLeft) {
                const std::size_t take = std::min(m_padLeft, n);
                data += take; n -= take; m_padLeft -= take;
                continue;
            }
            const std::size_t take = std::min(kBlock - m_header.size(), n);
            m_header.append(data, take);
            data += take; n -= take;
            if (m_header.size() == kBlock) {
                auto r = Header();
                m_header.clear();
                if (!r) return r;
            }
        }
        return {};
    }

    Result<ArchiveReport> Finish() {
        if (m_fileLeft || !m_header.empty()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_TAR_TRUNCATED));
        return std::move(m_report);
    }

private:
    Result<> Header() {
        const char* h = m_header.data();
        if (std::all_of(h, h + kBlock, [](char c) { return c == 0; })) { m_ended = true; return {}; }
        if (!ChecksumOk(h)) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_TAR_CHECKSUM));
        const std::uint64_t size = ParseOctal(h + 124, 12);
        const char type = h[156];
        std::string name = CString(h, 100);
        if (std::memcmp(h + 257, "ustar\0", 6) == 0) {
            const std::string prefix = CString(h + 345, 155);
            if (!prefix.empty()) name = prefix + "/" + name;
        }
        const std::size_t pad = static_cast<std::size_t>((kBlock - size % kBlock) % kBlock);

        if (type == 'L' || type == 'x' || type == 'g') {  // metadata records for the next entry
            if (size > (1u << 20)) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_TAR_PAX));
            m_record = type;
            m_recordData.clear();
            return Begin(size, pad, nullptr);
        }
        if (!m_longName.empty()) name = m_longName;
        if (!m_paxPath.empty()) name = m_paxPath;
        const std::uint64_t entrySize = m_paxSize.value_or(size);
        m_longName.clear(); m_paxPath.clear(); m_paxSize.reset();

        auto path = SafePath(name);
        if (!path) return Fail(path.error());
        if (!path->empty()) m_report.topLevel.insert(path->begin()->wstring());
        if (type == '5') {
            std::error_code ec;
            if (!path->empty()) fs::create_directories(m_folder / *path, ec);
            return {};
        }
        if (type != '0' && type != '\0') return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_TAR_TYPE, static_cast<wchar_t>(type)));
        if (path->empty()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_TAR_UNSAFE));
        auto out = std::make_unique<NewFile>();
        if (auto r = out->Open(m_folder / *path); !r) return r;
        const std::size_t entryPad = static_cast<std::size_t>((kBlock - entrySize % kBlock) % kBlock);
        return Begin(entrySize, entryPad, std::move(out));
    }

    Result<> Begin(std::uint64_t size, std::size_t pad, std::unique_ptr<NewFile> out) {
        m_out = std::move(out);
        m_fileLeft = size;
        m_pendingPad = pad;
        if (!size) return FinishEntry();
        return {};
    }

    Result<> FinishEntry() {
        m_padLeft = m_pendingPad;
        if (m_record) {
            if (m_record == 'L') m_longName = CString(m_recordData.data(), m_recordData.size());
            else if (m_record == 'x') ParsePax();
            m_record = 0;
        }
        if (m_out) {
            if (auto r = m_out->Finish(); !r) return r;
            m_report.bytes += m_out->bytes();
            ++m_report.files;
            m_report.staged.Add(std::move(m_out));
        }
        return {};
    }

    // "<len> key=value\n" records
    void ParsePax() {
        std::size_t pos = 0;
        const std::string& data = m_recordData;
        while (pos < data.size()) {
            const std::size_t space = data.find(' ', pos);
            if (space == std::string::npos) break;
            const auto len = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::strtoull(data.c_str() + pos, nullptr, 10));
            if (len == 0 || pos + len > data.size()) break;
            const std::string record = data.substr(space + 1, pos + len - space - 2);
            const std::size_t eq = record.find('=');
            if (eq != std::string::npos) {
                const std::string key = record.substr(0, eq), value = record.substr(eq + 1);
                if (key == "path") m_paxPath = value;
                else if (key == "size") m_paxSize = std::strtoull(value.c_str(), nullptr, 10);
            }
            pos += len;
        }
    }

    fs::path m_folder;
    std::uint64_t m_limit = 0, m_written = 0;
    std::string m_header;
    std::unique_ptr<NewFile> m_out;
    std::uint64_t m_fileLeft = 0;
    std::size_t m_padLeft = 0, m_pendingPad = 0;
    char m_record = 0;
    std::string m_recordData, m_longName, m_paxPath;
    std::optional<std::uint64_t> m_paxSize;
    bool m_ended = false;
    ArchiveReport m_report;
};

}  // namespace

Result<FileReport> UnpackFile(const fs::path& zst, const fs::path& target, std::uint64_t expectedSize, const std::wstring& expectedSha256,
                              const ProgressFn& progress, std::stop_token stop) {
    auto out = std::make_unique<NewFile>();
    if (auto r = out->Open(target); !r) return Fail(r.error());
    // The digest is taken from the bytes on their way to the disk: no second read.
    std::optional<Sha256> sha;
    if (!expectedSha256.empty()) {
        sha.emplace();
        if (!sha->ok()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_SHA_UNAVAILABLE));
    }
    auto r = Decompress(zst, progress, stop, [&](const char* data, std::size_t n) -> Result<> {
        if (expectedSize && out->bytes() + n > expectedSize)
            return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_UNPACK_TOO_LARGE, target.filename().wstring(), expectedSize));
        if (sha) sha->Update(data, n);
        return out->Write(data, n);
    });
    if (!r) return Fail(r.error());
    if (expectedSize && out->bytes() != expectedSize)
        return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_UNPACK_SIZE, target.filename().wstring(), out->bytes(), expectedSize));
    if (sha && sha->Finish() != expectedSha256) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_UNPACK_DIGEST, target.filename().wstring()));
    if (auto f = out->Finish(); !f) return Fail(f.error());
    FileReport report;
    report.bytes = out->bytes();
    report.staged.Add(std::move(out));
    return report;
}

Result<ArchiveReport> UnpackArchive(const fs::path& zst, const fs::path& folder, std::uint64_t expectedSize, const ProgressFn& progress,
                                    std::stop_token stop) {
    TarWriter tar(folder, expectedSize);
    auto r = Decompress(zst, progress, stop, [&](const char* data, std::size_t n) { return tar.Feed(data, n); });
    if (!r) return Fail(r.error());
    return tar.Finish();
}

}  // namespace WN::Install

// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Unpacking of downloaded components: one zstd stream, written either to one file (a disk image,
// the kernel) or, for a tar inside, to a folder tree (the Windows part of WSA).
//
// Nothing replaces an existing file before the whole release is unpacked: files are written to
// "<name>.new" and flushed (Staged), and only Staged::Commit renames them over the old ones. The
// installer commits after every component has unpacked, so a failure or a cancellation midway
// leaves the previous release as it was.
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Install {

class NewFile;

// Files written as "<name>.new" and not in place yet. Destroyed uncommitted, it deletes them.
class Staged {
public:
    Staged();
    ~Staged();
    Staged(Staged&&) noexcept;
    Staged& operator=(Staged&&) noexcept;
    Staged(const Staged&) = delete;
    Staged& operator=(const Staged&) = delete;

    void Add(std::unique_ptr<NewFile> file);
    void Append(Staged&& other);
    // Renames every file over its target. Stops at the first failure (the rest stay staged).
    Result<> Commit();
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t size() const noexcept { return m_files.size(); }

private:
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<NewFile>> m_files;
};

struct FileReport {
    std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    Staged staged;
};

// Decompresses `zst` into target + ".new". `expectedSize` (0 = unknown) bounds the output while it
// is written; `expectedSha256` (lower-case hex, empty = none) is checked once it is complete.
Result<FileReport> UnpackFile(const std::filesystem::path& zst, const std::filesystem::path& target, std::uint64_t expectedSize,
                              const std::wstring& expectedSha256, const ProgressFn& progress, std::stop_token stop);

struct ArchiveReport {
    std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    unsigned files = 0;
    std::set<std::wstring> topLevel;  // first path element of every entry (what a removal deletes)
    Staged staged;
};

// Decompresses `zst` and extracts the ustar/pax/GNU tar inside into `folder` (each file staged).
// Paths are checked (no "..", no drive letters, no device names); regular files and folders only.
// `expectedSize` (0 = unknown) bounds the bytes of all files together.
Result<ArchiveReport> UnpackArchive(const std::filesystem::path& zst, const std::filesystem::path& folder, std::uint64_t expectedSize,
                                    const ProgressFn& progress, std::stop_token stop);

// A path element Windows would not keep as written: a device name (CON, NUL, COM1 ... also with an
// extension), or a name ending in a dot or a space.
[[nodiscard]] bool ReservedName(std::wstring_view element);

}  // namespace WN::Install

`src/net/Downloader.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "net/Downloader.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Sha256.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <winhttp.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <format>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "winhttp.lib")

namespace WN::Net {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
namespace {

struct InternetCloser {
    void operator()(HINTERNET h) const noexcept { if (h) WinHttpCloseHandle(h); }
};
using Internet = std::unique_ptr<std::remove_pointer_t<HINTERNET>, InternetCloser>;

struct Http {
    Internet session, connection, request;
    DWORD status = 0;
};

bool IsLoopback(std::wstring host) {
    std::ranges::transform(host, host.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(c)); });
    return host == L"localhost" || host == L"127.0.0.1" || host == L"[::1]" || host == L"::1";
}

// Sends one request. `from` > 0 asks for the bytes from that offset on (Range).
Result<Http> Open(const std::wstring& url, const wchar_t* verb, std::uint64_t from, DWORD connectMs, DWORD ioMs) {
    wchar_t host[256]{}, path[2048]{}, extra[2048]{};
    URL_COMPONENTSW uc{};
    uc.dwStructSize = sizeof uc;
    uc.lpszHostName = host;     uc.dwHostNameLength = 256;
    uc.lpszUrlPath = path;      uc.dwUrlPathLength = 2048;
    uc.lpszExtraInfo = extra;   uc.dwExtraInfoLength = 2048;
    if (!WinHttpCrackUrl(url.c_str(), 0, 0, &uc)) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_INVALID_URL), GetLastError()));
    const bool secure = uc.nScheme == INTERNET_SCHEME_HTTPS;
    if (!secure && !(uc.nScheme == INTERNET_SCHEME_HTTP && IsLoopback(host))) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_HTTPS_ONLY));
    const std::wstring target = std::wstring(path) + extra;

    Http http;
    const std::wstring agent = std::format(L"WSA-Next/{}", Config::kAppVersion);
    http.session.reset(WinHttpOpen(agent.c_str(), WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_AUTOMATIC_PROXY, WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_NAME,
                                   WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_BYPASS, 0));
    if (!http.session) return Fail(ErrorText(L"WinHttpOpen", GetLastError()));
    WinHttpSetTimeouts(http.session.get(), static_cast<int>(connectMs), static_cast<int>(connectMs), static_cast<int>(ioMs),
                       static_cast<int>(ioMs));
    DWORD protocols = WINHTTP_PROTOCOL_FLAG_HTTP2;  // GitHub's CDN speaks HTTP/2
    WinHttpSetOption(http.session.get(), WINHTTP_OPTION_ENABLE_HTTP_PROTOCOL, &protocols, sizeof protocols);

    http.connection.reset(WinHttpConnect(http.session.get(), host, uc.nPort, 0));
    if (!http.connection) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_CONNECT), GetLastError()));
    http.request.reset(WinHttpOpenRequest(http.connection.get(), verb, target.c_str(), nullptr, WINHTTP_NO_REFERER,
                                          WINHTTP_DEFAULT_ACCEPT_TYPES, secure ? WINHTTP_FLAG_SECURE : 0));
    if (!http.request) return Fail(ErrorText(L"WinHttpOpenRequest", GetLastError()));
    DWORD redirectPolicy = WINHTTP_OPTION_REDIRECT_POLICY_DISALLOW_HTTPS_TO_HTTP;
    WinHttpSetOption(http.request.get(), WINHTTP_OPTION_REDIRECT_POLICY, &redirectPolicy, sizeof redirectPolicy);

    const std::wstring range = from ? std::format(L"Range: bytes={}-\r\n", from) : std::wstring();
    if (!WinHttpSendRequest(http.request.get(), range.empty() ? WINHTTP_NO_ADDITIONAL_HEADERS : range.c_str(),
                            range.empty() ? 0 : static_cast<DWORD>(-1L), WINHTTP_NO_REQUEST_DATA, 0, 0, 0) ||
        !WinHttpReceiveResponse(http.request.get(), nullptr))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_REQUEST), GetLastError()));
    DWORD size = sizeof http.status;
    if (!WinHttpQueryHeaders(http.request.get(), WINHTTP_QUERY_STATUS_CODE | WINHTTP_QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER, WINHTTP_HEADER_NAME_BY_INDEX,
                             &http.status, &size, WINHTTP_NO_HEADER_INDEX))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_STATUS), GetLastError()));
    return http;
}

// Reads the response body in chunks; `sink` returns false to stop with an error already set.
Result<> ReadBody(HINTERNET request, std::stop_token stop, const std::function<Result<>(const char*, DWORD)>& sink) {
    std::vector<char> buffer(1u << 20);
    for (;;) {
        if (stop.stop_requested()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        DWORD available = 0;
        if (!WinHttpQueryDataAvailable(request, &available)) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_DOWNLOADING), GetLastError()));
        if (!available) return {};
        DWORD read = 0;
        if (!WinHttpReadData(request, buffer.data(), std::min<DWORD>(available, static_cast<DWORD>(buffer.size())), &read))
            return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Get(IDS_CTX_DOWNLOADING), GetLastError()));
        if (!read) return {};
        if (auto r = sink(buffer.data(), read); !r) return r;
    }
}

// Hashes the bytes already in `file` (a resumed download continues the same digest).
Result<> HashExisting(const fs::path& file, std::uint64_t bytes, Sha256& hash, std::stop_token stop) {
    FileHandle in(CreateFileW(file.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
    if (!in) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_OPEN, file.wstring()), GetLastError()));
    std::vector<char> buffer(1u << 20);
    while (bytes) {
        if (stop.stop_requested()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        DWORD read = 0;
        const DWORD want = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(bytes, buffer.size()));
        if (!ReadFile(in.get(), buffer.data(), want, &read, nullptr) || read != want)
            return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_READ, file.wstring()), GetLastError()));
        hash.Update(buffer.data(), read);
        bytes -= read;
    }
    return {};
}

// One attempt: continues `part` from its current size.
Result<> Attempt(const std::wstring& url, const fs::path& part, std::uint64_t expectedSize, std::unique_ptr<Sha256>& hash, std::uint64_t& done,
                 const ProgressFn& progress, std::stop_token stop) {
    auto http = Open(url, L"GET", done, 15000, 60000);
    if (!http) return Fail(http.error());
    if (done && http->status == 200) {  // server ignored the range: start over
        done = 0;
        hash = std::make_unique<Sha256>();
    } else if (done && http->status == 416) {  // nothing left to send
        return {};
    } else if (http->status != (done ? 206u : 200u)) {
        return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_HTTP_STATUS, http->status));
    }

    FileHandle file(CreateFileW(part.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
    if (!file) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_CREATE, part.wstring()), GetLastError()));
    LARGE_INTEGER position{};
    position.QuadPart = static_cast<LONGLONG>(done);
    if (!SetFilePointerEx(file.get(), position, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN) || !SetEndOfFile(file.get()))
        return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_WRITE, part.wstring()), GetLastError()));

    progress(done, expectedSize);
    return ReadBody(http->request.get(), stop, [&](const char* data, DWORD n) -> Result<> {
        if (done + n > expectedSize) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_DOWNLOAD_TOO_LARGE));
        DWORD written = 0;
        if (!WriteFile(file.get(), data, n, &written, nullptr) || written != n)
            return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_WRITE, part.wstring()), GetLastError()));
        hash->Update(data, n);
        done += n;
        progress(done, expectedSize);
        return {};
    });
}

}  // namespace

Result<std::string> FetchText(const std::wstring& url, std::size_t limit, std::stop_token stop) {
    auto http = Open(url, L"GET", 0, 10000, 20000);
    if (!http) return Fail(http.error());
    if (http->status != 200) return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_HTTP_STATUS_URL, http->status, url));
    std::string body;
    auto r = ReadBody(http->request.get(), stop, [&](const char* data, DWORD n) -> Result<> {
        if (body.size() + n > limit) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_DOWNLOAD_TOO_LARGE));
        body.append(data, n);
        return {};
    });
    if (!r) return Fail(r.error());
    return body;
}

Result<> Download(const std::wstring& url, const fs::path& part, std::uint64_t expectedSize, const std::wstring& expectedSha256,
                  int attempts, const ProgressFn& progress, const LogFn& log, std::stop_token stop) {
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::create_directories(part.parent_path(), ec);
    auto hash = std::make_unique<Sha256>();
    if (!hash->ok()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_SHA_UNAVAILABLE));

    std::uint64_t done = fs::exists(part, ec) ? fs::file_size(part, ec) : 0;
    if (ec || done > expectedSize) done = 0;
    if (done) {
        log(Text::Format(IDS_LOG_RESUME, FormatBytes(done), FormatBytes(expectedSize)));
        if (auto r = HashExisting(part, done, *hash, stop); !r) return r;
    }

    Result<> last;
    for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= std::max(attempts, 1); ++attempt) {
        if (done == expectedSize) { last = {}; break; }
        last = Attempt(url, part, expectedSize, hash, done, progress, stop);
        if (stop.stop_requested()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        if (last && done == expectedSize) break;
        if (last) last = Fail(Text::Get(IDS_INCOMPLETE));
        if (attempt < attempts) {
            log(Text::Format(IDS_LOG_RETRY, attempt, attempts, last.error()));
            for (int i = 0; i < 20 && !stop.stop_requested(); ++i) Sleep(100 * attempt);
        }
    }
    if (!last) return last;

    const std::wstring actual = hash->Finish();
    if (actual != expectedSha256) {
        fs::remove(part, ec);  // a damaged file must not be resumed
        return Fail(Text::Format(IDS_SHA_MISMATCH, expectedSha256, actual));
    }
    return {};
}

Result<std::wstring> HashFile(const fs::path& file, const ProgressFn& progress, std::stop_token stop) {
    std::error_code ec;
    const std::uint64_t size = fs::file_size(file, ec);
    if (ec) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_OPEN, file.wstring()), static_cast<unsigned long>(ec.value())));
    Sha256 hash;
    if (!hash.ok()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_SHA_UNAVAILABLE));
    FileHandle in(CreateFileW(file.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
    if (!in) return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_OPEN, file.wstring()), GetLastError()));
    std::vector<char> buffer(1u << 20);
    std::uint64_t done = 0;
    for (;;) {
        if (stop.stop_requested()) return Fail(Text::Get(IDS_CANCELED));
        DWORD read = 0;
        if (!ReadFile(in.get(), buffer.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buffer.size()), &read, nullptr))
            return Fail(ErrorText(Text::Format(IDS_CTX_READ, file.wstring()), GetLastError()));
        if (!read) break;
        hash.Update(buffer.data(), read);
        done += read;
        progress(done, size);
    }
    return hash.Finish();
}

}  // namespace WN::Net

`src/net/Downloader.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// HTTP downloads (WinHTTP). HTTPS everywhere; plain HTTP only to this computer (a test server on
// localhost). https -> http redirects are refused.
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>

namespace WN::Net {

// Small text resource (the manifest), at most `limit` bytes, returned as received (UTF-8).
Result<std::string> FetchText(const std::wstring& url, std::size_t limit, std::stop_token stop);

// Downloads `url` into `part`, resuming a partial file with an HTTP range request, retrying up to
// `attempts` times after network errors. The finished file must have `expectedSize` bytes and the
// SHA-256 `expectedSha256` (lower-case hex); otherwise it is deleted and an error returned.
// `progress` gets bytes of the whole file (resumed bytes included).
Result<> Download(const std::wstring& url, const std::filesystem::path& part, std::uint64_t expectedSize,
                  const std::wstring& expectedSha256, int attempts, const ProgressFn& progress, const LogFn& log,
                  std::stop_token stop);

// SHA-256 of a file (lower-case hex), with progress.
Result<std::wstring> HashFile(const std::filesystem::path& file, const ProgressFn& progress, std::stop_token stop);

}  // namespace WN::Net

Her istek bu bilgisayarda uygulamayı ve komutu gösteren bir Windows Hello penceresi açar: parmak iziniz, yüzünüz ya da PIN'iniz olmadan hiçbir şey root olarak çalışmaz.\n\nYalnızca güvendiğiniz uygulamaları onaylayın: root, Android'deki her şeyi okuyabilir ve değiştirebilir. Android görüntüleri değişmeden kalır (Magisk yok).
15025=Aç
15026=Windows Hello'yu hatırla
15027=Windows Hello ile bir kez onayladıktan sonra parmak izinizi isteyen Android uygulamaları (örneğin bir banka veya aracı kurum) seçtiğiniz süre boyunca yeniden sormadan girer. Bu sürede bu bilgisayarı kullanan herkes de girer.\n\nWindows'u kilitlemek (Win+L), oturum açmalı uyku ve oturumu kapatmak bunu her zaman sonlandırır. Android uygulamaları için root (0) yine her seferinde sorar.\n\nYalnızca bunu kabul ediyorsanız, sorumluluk size ait olmak üzere açın.
15028=Hatırla

`src/support/Browser.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include <Windows.h>
#include <ShlObj.h>
#include <exdisp.h>
#include <shldisp.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>
#include "support/Browser.h"

#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "oleaut32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "uuid.lib")

namespace WN {
namespace {
using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;

// The shell's own ShellExecute, reached through the desktop window's view: Explorer starts the
// program, with its rights.
bool OpenThroughExplorer(const wchar_t* url) {
    const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED);
    bool opened = false;
    {
        ComPtr<IShellWindows> windows;
        ComPtr<IDispatch> desktop;
        ComPtr<IServiceProvider> provider;
        ComPtr<IShellBrowser> browser;
        ComPtr<IShellView> view;
        ComPtr<IDispatch> background;
        ComPtr<IShellFolderViewDual> folderView;
        ComPtr<IDispatch> application;
        ComPtr<IShellDispatch2> shell;
        VARIANT empty{};
        long hwnd = 0;
        if (SUCCEEDED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_ShellWindows, nullptr, CLSCTX_LOCAL_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(windows.GetAddressOf()))) &&
            windows->FindWindowSW(&empty, &empty, SWC_DESKTOP, &hwnd, SWFO_NEEDDISPATCH, desktop.GetAddressOf()) == S_OK && desktop &&
            SUCCEEDED(desktop.As(&provider)) &&
            SUCCEEDED(provider->QueryService(SID_STopLevelBrowser, IID_PPV_ARGS(browser.GetAddressOf()))) &&
            SUCCEEDED(browser->QueryActiveShellView(view.GetAddressOf())) &&
            SUCCEEDED(view->GetItemObject(SVGIO_BACKGROUND, IID_PPV_ARGS(background.GetAddressOf()))) &&
            SUCCEEDED(background.As(&folderView)) && SUCCEEDED(folderView->get_Application(application.GetAddressOf())) &&
            SUCCEEDED(application.As(&shell))) {
            BSTR file = SysAllocString(url);
            VARIANT none{}, show{};
            show.vt = VT_I4;
            show.lVal = SW_SHOWNORMAL;
#pragma push_macro("ShellExecute")
#undef ShellExecute  // the COM method, not shellapi.h's ShellExecuteW
            opened = file && SUCCEEDED(shell->ShellExecute(file, none, none, none, show));
#pragma pop_macro("ShellExecute")
            SysFreeString(file);
        }
    }  // the interfaces are released before COM is
    if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
    return opened;
}

}  // namespace

void OpenInBrowser(const wchar_t* url) {
    AllowSetForegroundWindow(ASFW_ANY);  // Explorer's browser window may come to the front
    if (!OpenThroughExplorer(url)) ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", url, nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
}

}  // namespace WN

```

// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Opening a web page from WSA-Next, which runs elevated (the window and the background host):
// the page opens with the desktop's rights, through Explorer, so the browser never runs as
// administrator. Explorer may be missing (a shell replacement): then the page opens directly.
#pragma once

namespace WN {

// Opens `url` in the user's default browser. The caller may pass on its right to bring a window
// to the front (a click it just handled) - the browser is started by Explorer, not by it.
void OpenInBrowser(const wchar_t* url);

}  // namespace WN

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <format>
#include <memory>

namespace WN {

std::wstring ErrorText(std::wstring_view what, unsigned long code) {
    struct LocalFreer {
        void operator()(wchar_t* p) const noexcept { LocalFree(p); }
    };
    auto load = [code](DWORD flags, HMODULE source, DWORD language) {
        wchar_t* buffer = nullptr;
        const DWORD length = FormatMessageW(flags | FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER | FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS, source, code,
                                            language, reinterpret_cast<LPWSTR>(&buffer), 0, nullptr);
        const std::unique_ptr<wchar_t, LocalFreer> owner(buffer);
        return length && buffer ? std::wstring(buffer, length) : std::wstring();
    };
    // In the language of the interface when Windows has it, otherwise the system default.
    const DWORD language = Text::SystemLanguage();
    std::wstring message = load(FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM, nullptr, language);
    if (message.empty() && language) message = load(FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM, nullptr, 0);
    if (message.empty()) {
        // WMI (WBEM_E_*) error codes are not in the system message table; they live in wmiutils.dll.
        static const HMODULE wmi = LoadLibraryExW(L"wmiutils.dll", nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_AS_DATAFILE | LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
        if (wmi) message = load(FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_HMODULE, wmi, 0);
    }
    while (!message.empty() && (message.back() == L'\r' || message.back() == L'\n' || message.back() == L' ')) message.pop_back();
    if (message.empty()) message = Text::Get(IDS_UNKNOWN_ERROR);
    // HRESULTs read better in hex.
    const std::wstring shown = code >= 0x80000000ul ? std::format(L"0x{:08X}", code) : std::format(L"{}", code);
    return Text::Format(IDS_ERROR_FORMAT, what, message, shown);
}

std::wstring Capitalize(std::wstring_view text) {
    std::wstring out(text);
    if (!out.empty()) CharUpperBuffW(out.data(), 1);
    return out;
}

std::wstring FormatBytes(std::uint64_t bytes) {
    constexpr double kMiB = 1024.0 * 1024.0;
    if (bytes >= (1ull << 30)) return std::format(L"{:.2f} GB", static_cast<double>(bytes) / (kMiB * 1024.0));
    if (bytes >= (1ull << 20)) return std::format(L"{:.1f} MB", static_cast<double>(bytes) / kMiB);
    return std::format(L"{:.1f} KB", static_cast<double>(bytes) / 1024.0);
}

std::wstring FormatDuration(std::uint64_t seconds) {
    const std::uint64_t h = seconds / 3600, m = seconds / 60 % 60, s = seconds % 60;
    return h ? std::format(L"{}:{:02}:{:02}", h, m, s) : std::format(L"{}:{:02}", m, s);
}

std::string ToUtf8(std::wstring_view text) {
    if (text.empty()) return {};
    const int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string out(static_cast<std::size_t>(n > 0 ? n : 0), '\0');
    if (n > 0) WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), out.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
    return out;
}

std::wstring FromUtf8(std::string_view text) {
    if (text.empty()) return {};
    const int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), nullptr, 0);
    std::wstring out(static_cast<std::size_t>(n > 0 ? n : 0), L'\0');
    if (n > 0) MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), out.data(), n);
    return out;
}

std::wstring ModulePath() {
    std::wstring path(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    for (;;) {
        const DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, path.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(path.size()));
        if (n == 0) return {};
        if (n < path.size()) {
            path.resize(n);
            return path;
        }
        path.resize(path.size() * 2);
    }
}

bool IsElevated() {
    HANDLE token = nullptr;
    if (!OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &token)) return false;
    TOKEN_ELEVATION elevation{};
    DWORD size = 0;
    const bool ok = GetTokenInformation(token, TokenElevation, &elevation, sizeof elevation, &size) && elevation.TokenIsElevated;
    CloseHandle(token);
    return ok;
}

}  // namespace WN

// Shared helpers: Result type and error formatting.
#pragma once

using Result = std::expected<T, std::wstring>;

inline std::unexpected<std::wstring> Fail(std::wstring message) {
    return std::unexpected<std::wstring>(std::move(message));
}

// "what: <system message> (code N)"
std::wstring ErrorText(std::wstring_view what, unsigned long code);

// "123.4 MB" style size formatting.
std::wstring FormatBytes(std::uint64_t bytes);

// First character upper-cased ("image" -> "Image"), for names at the start of a sentence.
std::wstring Capitalize(std::wstring_view text);

// "1:05" / "1:02:03" style duration.
std::wstring FormatDuration(std::uint64_t seconds);

std::string ToUtf8(std::wstring_view text);

// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// RAII owners for Win32 resources. Every handle the program opens is owned by one of these.
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <memory>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>

namespace WN {

// Generic owner. Traits supplies the handle type, its "no handle" value and how to close it.
template <class Traits>
class Unique {
public:
    using Type = typename Traits::Type;

    Unique() noexcept = default;
    explicit Unique(Type value) noexcept : m_value(value) {}
    Unique(const Unique&) = delete;
    Unique& operator=(const Unique&) = delete;
    Unique(Unique&& other) noexcept : m_value(std::exchange(other.m_value, Traits::Invalid())) {}
    Unique& operator=(Unique&& other) noexcept {
        if (this != &other) reset(std::exchange(other.m_value, Traits::Invalid()));
        return *this;
    }
    ~Unique() { reset(); }

    [[nodiscard]] Type get() const noexcept { return m_value; }
    [[nodiscard]] explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return m_value != Traits::Invalid(); }
    [[nodiscard]] Type* put() noexcept { reset(); return &m_value; }
    Type release() noexcept { return std::exchange(m_value, Traits::Invalid()); }
    void reset(Type value = Traits::Invalid()) noexcept {
        if (m_value != Traits::Invalid()) Traits::Close(m_value);
        m_value = value;
    }

private:
    Type m_value = Traits::Invalid();
};

namespace traits {
template <class T, auto CloseFn>
struct NullIsInvalid {
    using Type = T;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return nullptr; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { CloseFn(h); }
};
struct File {  // CreateFile / FindFirstVolume report failure as INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE
    using Type = HANDLE;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { CloseHandle(h); }
};
struct VolumeFind {
    using Type = HANDLE;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { FindVolumeClose(h); }
};
inline void CloseKernel(HANDLE h) noexcept { CloseHandle(h); }
inline void CloseKey(HKEY h) noexcept { RegCloseKey(h); }
inline void DeleteGdi(HGDIOBJ h) noexcept { DeleteObject(h); }
inline void DestroyMenuHandle(HMENU h) noexcept { DestroyMenu(h); }
inline void DestroyAccel(HACCEL h) noexcept { DestroyAcceleratorTable(h); }
inline void Unhook(HHOOK h) noexcept { UnhookWindowsHookEx(h); }
inline void DeleteMemoryDc(HDC h) noexcept { DeleteDC(h); }
inline void DestroyIconHandle(HICON h) noexcept { DestroyIcon(h); }
}  // namespace traits

using FileHandle = Unique<traits::File>;
using VolumeFind = Unique<traits::VolumeFind>;
using KernelHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HANDLE, traits::CloseKernel>>;
using RegKey = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HKEY, traits::CloseKey>>;
using MenuHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HMENU, traits::DestroyMenuHandle>>;
using AccelHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HACCEL, traits::DestroyAccel>>;
using HookHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HHOOK, traits::Unhook>>;
using MemoryDc = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HDC, traits::DeleteMemoryDc>>;  // CreateCompatibleDC
using IconHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HICON, traits::DestroyIconHandle>>;
template <class T>
using Gdi = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<T, traits::DeleteGdi>>;  // HBRUSH, HPEN, HFONT, HBITMAP ...

// Window DC from GetDC, released on scope exit.
class WindowDc {
public:
    explicit WindowDc(HWND window) noexcept : m_window(window), m_dc(GetDC(window)) {}
    WindowDc(const WindowDc&) = delete;
    WindowDc& operator=(const WindowDc&) = delete;
    ~WindowDc() { if (m_dc) ReleaseDC(m_window, m_dc); }
    [[nodiscard]] HDC get() const noexcept { return m_dc; }

private:
    HWND m_window;
    HDC m_dc;
};

// Selects an object into a DC and restores the previous one.
class SelectGuard {
public:
    SelectGuard(HDC dc, HGDIOBJ object) noexcept : m_dc(dc), m_old(SelectObject(dc, object)) {}
    SelectGuard(const SelectGuard&) = delete;
    SelectGuard& operator=(const SelectGuard&) = delete;
    ~SelectGuard() { if (m_old) SelectObject(m_dc, m_old); }

private:
    HDC m_dc;
    HGDIOBJ m_old;
};

// BeginPaint / EndPaint.
class PaintScope {
public:
    explicit PaintScope(HWND window) noexcept : m_window(window) { BeginPaint(window, &m_ps); }
    PaintScope(const PaintScope&) = delete;
    PaintScope& operator=(const PaintScope&) = delete;
    ~PaintScope() { EndPaint(m_window, &m_ps); }
    [[nodiscard]] HDC dc() const noexcept { return m_ps.hdc; }
    [[nodiscard]] const RECT& area() const noexcept { return m_ps.rcPaint; }

private:
    HWND m_window;
    PAINTSTRUCT m_ps{};
};

// Runs a callable on scope exit (for the rare one-off cleanups that have no handle type).
template <class F>
class [[nodiscard]] ScopeExit {
public:
    explicit ScopeExit(F f) noexcept(std::is_nothrow_move_constructible_v<F>) : m_f(std::move(f)) {}
    ScopeExit(const ScopeExit&) = delete;
    ScopeExit& operator=(const ScopeExit&) = delete;
    ~ScopeExit() { if (m_active) m_f(); }
    void dismiss() noexcept { m_active = false; }

private:
    F m_f;
    bool m_active = true;
};

}  // namespace WN

`src/support/HostEvents.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Named events between the background host (src/host) and the window, instead of polling:
// the host and its bridges signal "something changed" (Bluetooth bridge started or stopped,
// Android connected or gone, WSA's VM up or down, host ending); the window waits for it and
// reads the state again. Inside the host, its notification-area icon listens the same way.
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <string>

namespace WN {

// Auto-reset; created by the window (the only waiter). Signaling it without a window is a no-op.
inline constexpr wchar_t kHostChangedEvent[] = L"Local\\WSA-Next.Host.Changed";

// In-process listeners of the background host (its icon): set while it exists.
inline std::atomic<void (*)()> g_hostChangedListener{nullptr};
inline std::atomic<void (*)(const std::wstring& title, const std::wstring& text)> g_hostNoticeListener{nullptr};

inline void NotifyHostChanged() {
    if (const HANDLE event = OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE, FALSE, kHostChangedEvent)) {
        SetEvent(event);
        CloseHandle(event);
    }
    if (const auto listener = g_hostChangedListener.load()) listener();
}

inline std::atomic<bool (*)()> g_hostRegistrationListener{nullptr};

// Something the user should see happen (a root grant): a notification from the host's icon.
inline void HostNotice(const std::wstring& title, const std::wstring& text) {
    if (const auto listener = g_hostNoticeListener.load()) listener(title, text);
}

// "Register this PC with Google Play" from the host's icon (host/Registration.h); false without
// the icon.
inline bool HostRegistrationNotice() {
    const auto listener = g_hostRegistrationListener.load();
    return listener && listener();
}

}  // namespace WN

`src/support/Json.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "support/Json.h"
#include <cwctype>
#include <format>

namespace WN::Json {
namespace {

const Value kNull;
const Array kNoItems;
const Object kNoMembers;

class Parser {
public:
    explicit Parser(std::wstring text) : m_s(std::move(text)) {}

    Result<Value> Document() {
        auto v = ParseValue(0);
        if (!v) return v;
        SkipSpace();
        if (m_pos != m_s.size()) return Error(L"unexpected text after the value");
        return v;
    }

private:
    static constexpr int kMaxDepth = 64;

    std::unexpected<std::wstring> Error(std::wstring_view what) const {
        // Line and column for the message (the manifest is edited by hand).
        std::size_t line = 1, column = 1;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_pos && i < m_s.size(); ++i) {
            if (m_s[i] == L'\n') { ++line; column = 1; }
            else ++column;
        }
        return Fail(std::format(L"JSON: {} (line {}, column {})", what, line, column));
    }

    void SkipSpace() {
        while (m_pos < m_s.size() && (m_s[m_pos] == L' ' || m_s[m_pos] == L'\t' || m_s[m_pos] == L'\n' || m_s[m_pos] == L'\r'))
            ++m_pos;
    }

    bool Consume(std::wstring_view word) {
        if (m_s.compare(m_pos, word.size(), word) != 0) return false;
        m_pos += word.size();
        return true;
    }

    Result<Value> ParseValue(int depth) {
        if (depth > kMaxDepth) return Error(L"nested too deeply");
        SkipSpace();
        if (m_pos >= m_s.size()) return Error(L"value expected");
        const wchar_t c = m_s[m_pos];
        if (c == L'{') return ParseObject(depth);
        if (c == L'[') return ParseArray(depth);
        if (c == L'"') {
            auto s = ParseString();
            if (!s) return std::unexpected(s.error());
            return Value(std::move(*s));
        }
        if (Consume(L"true")) return Value(true);
        if (Consume(L"false")) return Value(false);
        if (Consume(L"null")) return Value();
        if (c == L'-' || std::iswdigit(c)) return ParseNumber();
        return Error(L"value expected");
    }

    Result<Value> ParseNumber() {
        const std::size_t start = m_pos;
        if (m_s[m_pos] == L'-') ++m_pos;
        auto digits = [&] {
            const std::size_t from = m_pos;
            while (m_pos < m_s.size() && std::iswdigit(m_s[m_pos])) ++m_pos;
            return m_pos > from;
        };
        if (!digits()) return Error(L"digit expected");
        if (m_pos < m_s.size() && m_s[m_pos] == L'.') {
            ++m_pos;
            if (!digits()) return Error(L"digit expected");
        }
        if (m_pos < m_s.size() && (m_s[m_pos] == L'e' || m_s[m_pos] == L'E')) {
            ++m_pos;
            if (m_pos < m_s.size() && (m_s[m_pos] == L'+' || m_s[m_pos] == L'-')) ++m_pos;
            if (!digits()) return Error(L"digit expected");
        }
        return Value::Number(m_s.substr(start, m_pos - start));
    }

    Result<std::wstring> ParseString() {
        ++m_pos;  // opening quote
        std::wstring out;
        while (m_pos < m_s.size()) {
            const wchar_t c = m_s[m_pos++];
            if (c == L'"') return out;
            if (c < 0x20) return Error(L"control character in a string");
            if (c != L'\\') {
                out.push_back(c);
                continue;
            }
            if (m_pos >= m_s.size()) break;
            const wchar_t e = m_s[m_pos++];
            switch (e) {
            case L'"': out.push_back(L'"'); break;
            case L'\\': out.push_back(L'\\'); break;
            case L'/': out.push_back(L'/'); break;
            case L'b': out.push_back(L'\b'); break;
            case L'f': out.push_back(L'\f'); break;
            case L'n': out.push_back(L'\n'); break;
            case L'r': out.push_back(L'\r'); break;
            case L't': out.push_back(L'\t'); break;
            case L'u': {
                if (m_pos + 4 > m_s.size()) return Error(L"incomplete \\u escape");
                unsigned code = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                    const wchar_t h = m_s[m_pos++];
                    code <<= 4;
                    if (h >= L'0' && h <= L'9') code |= static_cast<unsigned>(h - L'0');
                    else if (h >= L'a' && h <= L'f') code |= static_cast<unsigned>(h - L'a' + 10);
                    else if (h >= L'A' && h <= L'F') code |= static_cast<unsigned>(h - L'A' + 10);
                    else return Error(L"bad \\u escape");
                }
                out.push_back(static_cast<wchar_t>(code));  // UTF-16 code unit; surrogate pairs come as two
                break;
            }
            default: return Error(L"bad escape");
            }
        }
        return Error(L"unterminated string");
    }

    Result<Value> ParseArray(int depth) {
        ++m_pos;
        Array items;
        SkipSpace();
        if (m_pos < m_s.size() && m_s[m_pos] == L']') { ++m_pos; return Value(std::move(items)); }
        for (;;) {
            auto v = ParseValue(depth + 1);
            if (!v) return v;
            items.push_back(std::move(*v));
            SkipSpace();
            if (m_pos < m_s.size() && m_s[m_pos] == L',') { ++m_pos; continue; }
            if (m_pos < m_s.size() && m_s[m_pos] == L']') { ++m_pos; return Value(std::move(items)); }
            return Error(L"',' or ']' expected");
        }
    }

    Result<Value> ParseObject(int depth) {
        ++m_pos;
        Object members;
        SkipSpace();
        if (m_pos < m_s.size() && m_s[m_pos] == L'}') { ++m_pos; return Value(std::move(members)); }
        for (;;) {
            SkipSpace();
            if (m_pos >= m_s.size() || m_s[m_pos] != L'"') return Error(L"member name expected");
            auto key = ParseString();
            if (!key) return std::unexpected(key.error());
            SkipSpace();
            if (m_pos >= m_s.size() || m_s[m_pos] != L':') return Error(L"':' expected");
            ++m_pos;
            auto v = ParseValue(depth + 1);
            if (!v) return v;
            members.insert_or_assign(std::move(*key), std::move(*v));
            SkipSpace();
            if (m_pos < m_s.size() && m_s[m_pos] == L',') { ++m_pos; continue; }
            if (m_pos < m_s.size() && m_s[m_pos] == L'}') { ++m_pos; return Value(std::move(members)); }
            return Error(L"',' or '}' expected");
        }
    }

    std::wstring m_s;
    std::size_t m_pos = 0;
};

void Escape(std::wstring& out, const std::wstring& s) {
    out.push_back(L'"');
    for (const wchar_t c : s) {
        switch (c) {
        case L'"': out += L"\\\""; break;
        case L'\\': out += L"\\\\"; break;
        case L'\n': out += L"\\n"; break;
        case L'\r': out += L"\\r"; break;
        case L'\t': out += L"\\t"; break;
        default:
            if (c < 0x20) out += std::format(L"\\u{:04x}", static_cast<unsigned>(c));
            else out.push_back(c);
        }
    }
    out.push_back(L'"');
}

void WriteValue(std::wstring& out, const Value& v, int indent) {
    const std::wstring pad(static_cast<std::size_t>(indent + 2), L' '), close(static_cast<std::size_t>(indent), L' ');
    switch (v.kind()) {
    case Value::Kind::Null: out += L"null"; break;
    case Value::Kind::Bool: out += *v.Bool() ? L"true" : L"false"; break;
    case Value::Kind::Number:
    case Value::Kind::String: {
        if (v.kind() == Value::Kind::String) Escape(out, *v.String());
        else out += v.UInt() ? std::to_wstring(*v.UInt()) : L"0";
        break;
    }
    case Value::Kind::Array: {
        if (v.Items().empty()) { out += L"[]"; break; }
        out += L"[\n";
        bool first = true;
        for (const Value& item : v.Items()) {
            if (!first) out += L",\n";
            first = false;
            out += pad;
            WriteValue(out, item, indent + 2);
        }
        out += L"\n" + close + L"]";
        break;
    }
    case Value::Kind::Object: {
        if (v.Members().empty()) { out += L"{}"; break; }
        out += L"{\n";
        bool first = true;
        for (const auto& [key, item] : v.Members()) {
            if (!first) out += L",\n";
            first = false;
            out += pad;
            Escape(out, key);
            out += L": ";
            WriteValue(out, item, indent + 2);
        }
        out += L"\n" + close + L"}";
        break;
    }
    }
}

}  // namespace

std::optional<std::wstring> Value::String() const {
    if (m_kind != Kind::String) return std::nullopt;
    return m_text;
}

std::optional<std::uint64_t> Value::UInt() const {
    if (m_kind != Kind::Number || m_text.empty() || m_text[0] == L'-') return std::nullopt;
    std::uint64_t n = 0;
    for (const wchar_t c : m_text) {
        if (c < L'0' || c > L'9') return std::nullopt;  // fractions and exponents are not sizes
        const std::uint64_t digit = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(c - L'0');
        if (n > (UINT64_MAX - digit) / 10) return std::nullopt;
        n = n * 10 + digit;
    }
    return n;
}

std::optional<bool> Value::Bool() const {
    if (m_kind != Kind::Bool) return std::nullopt;
    return m_bool;
}

const Array& Value::Items() const { return m_array ? *m_array : kNoItems; }
const Object& Value::Members() const { return m_object ? *m_object : kNoMembers; }

const Value& Value::operator[](std::wstring_view key) const {
    if (!m_object) return kNull;
    const auto it = m_object->find(key);
    return it != m_object->end() ? it->second : kNull;
}

Result<std::wstring> Value::RequireString(std::wstring_view key) const {
    if (auto s = (*this)[key].String()) return std::move(*s);
    return Fail(std::format(L"\"{}\" (text) is missing", key));
}

Result<std::uint64_t> Value::RequireUInt(std::wstring_view key) const {
    if (auto n = (*this)[key].UInt()) return *n;
    return Fail(std::format(L"\"{}\" (number) is missing", key));
}

std::wstring Value::StringOr(std::wstring_view key, std::wstring fallback) const {
    auto s = (*this)[key].String();
    return s ? std::move(*s) : std::move(fallback);
}

Result<Value> Parse(std::string_view utf8) {
    if (utf8.size() >= 3 && static_cast<unsigned char>(utf8[0]) == 0xEF && static_cast<unsigned char>(utf8[1]) == 0xBB &&
        static_cast<unsigned char>(utf8[2]) == 0xBF)
        utf8.remove_prefix(3);  // BOM written by some editors
    return Parser(FromUtf8(utf8)).Document();
}

std::string Write(const Value& value) {
    std::wstring out;
    WriteValue(out, value, 0);
    out += L"\n";
    return ToUtf8(out);
}

}  // namespace WN::Json

// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Minimal JSON reader and writer for the release manifest and the install state (RFC 8259,
// UTF-8). Numbers keep their text, so 64-bit sizes are read exactly.
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <variant>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Json {

class Value;
using Array = std::vector<Value>;
using Object = std::map<std::wstring, Value, std::less<>>;

class Value {
public:
    enum class Kind { Null, Bool, Number, String, Array, Object };

    Value() = default;
    Value(bool b) : m_kind(Kind::Bool), m_bool(b) {}
    Value(std::wstring s) : m_kind(Kind::String), m_text(std::move(s)) {}
    Value(const wchar_t* s) : Value(std::wstring(s)) {}
    Value(std::uint64_t n) : m_kind(Kind::Number), m_text(std::to_wstring(n)) {}
    Value(Array a) : m_kind(Kind::Array), m_array(std::make_shared<Array>(std::move(a))) {}
    Value(Object o) : m_kind(Kind::Object), m_object(std::make_shared<Object>(std::move(o))) {}
    static Value Number(std::wstring text) {
        Value v;
        v.m_kind = Kind::Number;
        v.m_text = std::move(text);
        return v;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Kind kind() const noexcept { return m_kind; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsObject() const noexcept { return m_kind == Kind::Object; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsArray() const noexcept { return m_kind == Kind::Array; }

    // Typed access: nullopt when the value has another type.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::wstring> String() const;
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::uint64_t> UInt() const;
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<bool> Bool() const;
    [[nodiscard]] const Array& Items() const;   // empty unless an array
    [[nodiscard]] const Object& Members() const;  // empty unless an object
    // Object member, or a null value.
    [[nodiscard]] const Value& operator[](std::wstring_view key) const;

    // Helpers for required members (the message names the missing key).
    [[nodiscard]] Result<std::wstring> RequireString(std::wstring_view key) const;
    [[nodiscard]] Result<std::uint64_t> RequireUInt(std::wstring_view key) const;
    [[nodiscard]] std::wstring StringOr(std::wstring_view key, std::wstring fallback = {}) const;

private:
    Kind m_kind = Kind::Null;
    bool m_bool = false;
    std::wstring m_text;  // string value or number text
    std::shared_ptr<Array> m_array;
    std::shared_ptr<Object> m_object;
};

// Parses UTF-8 JSON text.
Result<Value> Parse(std::string_view utf8);
// Pretty-printed UTF-8 JSON (two-space indent, members in key order).
std::string Write(const Value& value);

}  // namespace WN::Json

// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Config.h"
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Settings {

std::wstring Read(const wchar_t* name, std::wstring_view fallback) {
    DWORD bytes = 0;
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey, name, RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, nullptr, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS ||
        bytes < sizeof(wchar_t))
        return std::wstring(fallback);
    std::vector<wchar_t> buffer(bytes / sizeof(wchar_t) + 1, L'\0');
    bytes = static_cast<DWORD>(buffer.size() * sizeof(wchar_t));
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey, name, RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, buffer.data(), &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return std::wstring(fallback);
    return buffer.data();
}

void Write(const wchar_t* name, const std::wstring& value) {
    RegSetKeyValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey, name, REG_SZ, value.c_str(),
                    static_cast<DWORD>((value.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t)));
}

DWORD ReadDword(const wchar_t* name, DWORD fallback) {
    DWORD value = 0, bytes = sizeof value;
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey, name, RRF_RT_REG_DWORD, nullptr, &value, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return fallback;
    return value;
}

void WriteDword(const wchar_t* name, DWORD value) {
    RegSetKeyValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey, name, REG_DWORD, &value, sizeof value);
}

bool Exists(const wchar_t* name) {
    return RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, Config::kRegKey, name, RRF_RT_ANY, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr) == ERROR_SUCCESS;
}

}  // namespace WN::Settings

`src/support/Sha256.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "support/Sha256.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>

#pragma comment(lib, "bcrypt.lib")

namespace WN {

Sha256::Sha256() {
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE alg = nullptr;
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&alg, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, nullptr, 0))) return;
    m_alg = alg;
    DWORD objectLength = 0, got = 0;
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptGetProperty(alg, BCRYPT_OBJECT_LENGTH, reinterpret_cast<PUCHAR>(&objectLength),
                                          sizeof objectLength, &got, 0)))
        return;
    m_object.resize(objectLength);
    BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE hash = nullptr;
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptCreateHash(alg, &hash, m_object.data(), objectLength, nullptr, 0, 0))) return;
    m_hash = hash;
}

Sha256::~Sha256() {
    if (m_hash) BCryptDestroyHash(static_cast<BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE>(m_hash));
    if (m_alg) BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(static_cast<BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE>(m_alg), 0);
}

bool Sha256::Update(const void* data, std::size_t size) {
    if (!m_hash) return false;
    return BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptHashData(static_cast<BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE>(m_hash),
                                         static_cast<PUCHAR>(const_cast<void*>(data)), static_cast<ULONG>(size), 0));
}

std::wstring Sha256::Finish() {
    if (!m_hash) return {};
    unsigned char digest[32]{};
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(BCryptFinishHash(static_cast<BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE>(m_hash), digest, sizeof digest, 0))) return {};
    constexpr wchar_t kHex[] = L"0123456789abcdef";
    std::wstring out;
    out.reserve(64);
    for (unsigned char b : digest) {
        out.push_back(kHex[b >> 4]);
        out.push_back(kHex[b & 0xF]);
    }
    return out;
}

}  // namespace WN

```

    bool Update(const void* data, std::size_t size);

`src/support/Signature.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "support/Signature.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <SoftPub.h>
#include <WinTrust.h>
#include "support/Sha256.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "wintrust.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "crypt32.lib")

namespace WN::Signature {
namespace {

// The publisher's code signing certificate (Certum Open Source Code Signing). The subject stays
// the same when the certificate is renewed; the chain must lead to Certum's trusted network root
// ("Certum Trusted Network CA 2", which Windows may continue through its cross-signed
// predecessor "Certum Trusted Network CA").
constexpr wchar_t kPublisher[] = L"Open Source Developer Marek Wesołowski";
constexpr std::wstring_view kRootPrefix = L"Certum Trusted Network CA";
// The roots themselves, by the SHA-256 of their public key (SubjectPublicKeyInfo): a name alone
// would also match a look-alike root someone added to the certificate store.
constexpr std::wstring_view kRootKeys[] = {
    L"6b3b57e9ec88d1bb3d01637ff33c7698b3c9758255e9f01ea9178f3e7f3b2b52",  // Certum Trusted Network CA 2
    L"aa2630a7b617b04d0a294bab7a8caaa5016e6dbe604837a83a85719fab667eb5",  // Certum Trusted Network CA
};

std::wstring KeyDigest(PCCERT_CONTEXT cert) {
    DWORD size = 0;
    if (!CryptEncodeObjectEx(X509_ASN_ENCODING, X509_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO, &cert->pCertInfo->SubjectPublicKeyInfo, 0, nullptr, nullptr, &size))
        return {};
    std::vector<BYTE> der(size);
    if (!CryptEncodeObjectEx(X509_ASN_ENCODING, X509_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO, &cert->pCertInfo->SubjectPublicKeyInfo, 0, nullptr, der.data(), &size))
        return {};
    Sha256 sha;
    if (!sha.ok() || !sha.Update(der.data(), size)) return {};
    return sha.Finish();
}

std::wstring NameOf(PCCERT_CONTEXT cert, DWORD flags = 0) {
    const DWORD size = CertGetNameStringW(cert, CERT_NAME_SIMPLE_DISPLAY_TYPE, flags, nullptr, nullptr, 0);
    std::wstring name(size, L'\0');
    CertGetNameStringW(cert, CERT_NAME_SIMPLE_DISPLAY_TYPE, flags, nullptr, name.data(), size);
    if (!name.empty() && name.back() == L'\0') name.pop_back();
    return name;
}

bool TrustedRoot(PCCERT_CONTEXT root) {
    if (!NameOf(root).starts_with(kRootPrefix)) return false;
    const std::wstring key = KeyDigest(root);
    return std::ranges::find(kRootKeys, std::wstring_view(key)) != std::end(kRootKeys);
}

}  // namespace

Origin CheckFile(const wchar_t* path, void* handle) {
    WINTRUST_FILE_INFO file{};
    file.cbStruct = sizeof file;
    file.pcwszFilePath = path;
    file.hFile = static_cast<HANDLE>(handle);  // the bytes the caller holds open, when given
    WINTRUST_DATA data{};
    data.cbStruct = sizeof data;
    data.dwUIChoice = WTD_UI_NONE;
    data.fdwRevocationChecks = WTD_REVOKE_NONE;  // offline: no network access at every start
    data.dwUnionChoice = WTD_CHOICE_FILE;
    data.pFile = &file;
    data.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_VERIFY;
    data.dwProvFlags = WTD_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL;
    GUID action = WINTRUST_ACTION_GENERIC_VERIFY_V2;
    const LONG status = WinVerifyTrust(static_cast<HWND>(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE), &action, &data);

    Origin origin = Origin::Invalid;
    if (status == TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE || status == TRUST_E_SUBJECT_FORM_UNKNOWN || status == TRUST_E_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN) {
        origin = Origin::Unsigned;
    } else if (status == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        origin = Origin::OtherSigner;
        const CRYPT_PROVIDER_DATA* provider = WTHelperProvDataFromStateData(data.hWVTStateData);
        const CRYPT_PROVIDER_SGNR* signer = provider ? WTHelperGetProvSignerFromChain(const_cast<CRYPT_PROVIDER_DATA*>(provider), 0, FALSE, 0) : nullptr;
        if (signer && signer->csCertChain > 1 && NameOf(signer->pasCertChain[0].pCert) == kPublisher &&
            TrustedRoot(signer->pasCertChain[signer->csCertChain - 1].pCert))
            origin = Origin::Official;
    }
    data.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_CLOSE;
    WinVerifyTrust(static_cast<HWND>(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE), &action, &data);
    return origin;
}

Origin Check() {
    static const Origin origin = [] {
        const std::wstring path = ModulePath();
        return path.empty() ? Origin::Invalid : CheckFile(path.c_str());
    }();
    return origin;
}

}  // namespace WN::Signature

`src/support/Signature.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// WSA-Next's publisher signature. An official WSA-Next.exe carries a valid Authenticode signature
// by the publisher; the binary's bytes change when it is signed, so a build from the sources is
// recognizable as such - it works, but without the features that only official builds offer
// (Bluetooth and Windows Hello for Android). Official releases of the Android images carry a
// catalog signed the same way (see core/Release.h).
#pragma once

namespace WN::Signature {

enum class Origin {
    Official,       // signed by the publisher, signature intact (timestamped: valid after expiry too)
    Unsigned,       // a build from the sources
    OtherSigner,    // a valid signature of someone else
    Invalid,        // a signature that does not match the file (modified after signing)
};

// Who signed a file (an executable, a catalog): WinVerifyTrust, no network access. `handle`
// (optional): the file opened by the caller, so that exactly those bytes are checked.
[[nodiscard]] Origin CheckFile(const wchar_t* path, void* handle = nullptr);

// This WSA-Next.exe, checked once per process.
[[nodiscard]] Origin Check();
[[nodiscard]] inline bool Official() { return Check() == Origin::Official; }

// The features reserved for official builds (Bluetooth and Windows Hello for Android). Debug
// builds (WSA-Next_debug.exe, development only) have them unsigned.
[[nodiscard]] inline bool OfficialFeatures() {
#ifdef _DEBUG
    return true;
#else
    return Official();
#endif
}

}  // namespace WN::Signature
