`src/support/Text.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "support/Text.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <shared_mutex>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace WN::Text {
namespace {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

constexpr LANGID kEnglish = MAKELANGID(LANG_ENGLISH, SUBLANG_ENGLISH_US);

struct State {
    std::shared_mutex lock;  // the worker thread reads strings while the UI may switch language
    std::wstring code = L"en";
    bool automatic = false;
    std::unordered_map<UINT, std::wstring> strings;  // the .lng file; empty = English
};

State& S() {
    static State state;
    return state;
}

std::wstring Lower(std::wstring_view s) {
    std::wstring out(s);
    for (auto& c : out) c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(c));
    return out;
}

HMODULE Module() {
    static const HMODULE module = [] {
        HMODULE m = nullptr;
        GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                           reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(&Module), &m);
        return m;
    }();
    return module;
}

// String tables are stored in blocks of 16 length-prefixed strings.
std::wstring LoadResourceString(UINT id, LANGID language) {
    HMODULE module = Module();
    HRSRC info = FindResourceExW(module, RT_STRING, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(id / 16 + 1), language);
    if (!info) return {};
    HGLOBAL data = LoadResource(module, info);
    const auto* p = static_cast<const WCHAR*>(data ? LockResource(data) : nullptr);
    if (!p) return {};
    const WCHAR* end = p + SizeofResource(module, info) / sizeof(WCHAR);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < id % 16 && p < end; ++i) p += 1 + *p;
    if (p >= end || p + 1 + *p > end) return {};
    return std::wstring(p + 1, *p);
}

// Every id of the English table, ascending (read once).
const std::vector<UINT>& EnglishIds() {
    static const std::vector<UINT> ids = [] {
        std::vector<UINT> blocks, result;
        EnumResourceNamesW(
            Module(), RT_STRING,
            [](HMODULE, LPCWSTR, LPWSTR name, LONG_PTR param) -> BOOL {
                if (IS_INTRESOURCE(name))
                    reinterpret_cast<std::vector<UINT>*>(param)->push_back(static_cast<UINT>(reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(name)));
                return TRUE;
            },
            reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(&blocks));
        std::ranges::sort(blocks);
        for (UINT block : blocks)
            for (UINT i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
                if (const UINT id = (block - 1) * 16 + i; !LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish).empty()) result.push_back(id);
        return result;
    }();
    return ids;
}

fs::path LanguageDirectory() {
    std::wstring self(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    for (;;) {
        const DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(Module(), self.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(self.size()));
        if (n == 0) return {};
        if (n < self.size()) {
            self.resize(n);
            break;
        }
        self.resize(self.size() * 2);
    }
    return fs::path(self).parent_path() / L"language";
}

std::wstring Widen(std::string_view utf8) {
    if (utf8.empty()) return {};
    const int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), nullptr, 0);
    std::wstring out(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(n, 0)), L'\0');
    if (n > 0) MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), out.data(), n);
    return out;
}

std::string Narrow(std::wstring_view text) {
    if (text.empty()) return {};
    const int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string out(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(n, 0)), '\0');
    if (n > 0) WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), out.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
    return out;
}

std::wstring Unescape(std::wstring_view raw) {
    std::wstring out;
    out.reserve(raw.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < raw.size(); ++i) {
        if (raw[i] == L'\\' && i + 1 < raw.size()) {
            switch (raw[i + 1]) {
            case L'n': out += L'\n'; ++i; continue;
            case L'r': out += L'\r'; ++i; continue;
            case L't': out += L'\t'; ++i; continue;
            case L'\\': out += L'\\'; ++i; continue;
            default: break;
            }
        }
        out += raw[i];
    }
    return out;
}

std::wstring Escape(std::wstring_view text) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (wchar_t c : text) {
        switch (c) {
        case L'\n': out += L"\\n"; break;
        case L'\r': out += L"\\r"; break;
        case L'\t': out += L"\\t"; break;
        case L'\\': out += L"\\\\"; break;
        default: out += c; break;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

bool ValidCode(std::wstring_view code) {
    return !code.empty() && code.size() <= 16 &&
           std::ranges::all_of(code, [](wchar_t c) { return std::iswalnum(c) || c == L'-' || c == L'_'; });
}

struct LngFile {
    Language language;
    fs::path path;
    std::unordered_map<UINT, std::wstring> strings;
};

// Parses a .lng file: "#name=", "#locale=" headers and (when `strings`) the ID=text lines.
bool ReadLng(const fs::path& path, LngFile& out, bool strings) {
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!in) return false;
    out.path = path;
    out.language.code = Lower(path.stem().wstring());
    std::string line;
    bool first = true;
    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        if (first && line.starts_with("\xEF\xBB\xBF")) line.erase(0, 3);  // UTF-8 BOM
        first = false;
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        if (line.starts_with("#name=")) {
            out.language.name = Widen(std::string_view(line).substr(6));
            continue;
        }
        if (line.starts_with("#locale=")) {
            const std::wstring list = Lower(Widen(std::string_view(line).substr(8)));
            for (std::size_t start = 0; start <= list.size();) {
                std::size_t end = list.find(L',', start);
                if (end == std::wstring::npos) end = list.size();
                std::wstring tag = list.substr(start, end - start);
                std::erase_if(tag, [](wchar_t c) { return std::iswspace(c) != 0; });
                std::ranges::replace(tag, L'_', L'-');
                if (!tag.empty()) out.language.locales.push_back(std::move(tag));
                start = end + 1;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (!strings || line.empty() || line[0] == '#') continue;
        const std::size_t eq = line.find('=');
        if (eq == std::string::npos || eq == 0 || eq > 9) continue;
        UINT id = 0;
        bool numeric = true;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < eq; ++i) {
            if (line[i] < '0' || line[i] > '9') { numeric = false; break; }
            id = id * 10 + static_cast<UINT>(line[i] - '0');
        }
        if (numeric) out.strings[id] = Unescape(Widen(std::string_view(line).substr(eq + 1)));
    }
    if (out.language.name.empty()) out.language.name = out.language.code;
    return true;
}

std::vector<LngFile> ScanFiles(bool strings) {
    std::vector<LngFile> files;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(LanguageDirectory(), ec)) {
        if (!entry.is_regular_file(ec) || Lower(entry.path().extension().wstring()) != L".lng") continue;
        const std::wstring code = Lower(entry.path().stem().wstring());
        if (!ValidCode(code) || code == L"en") continue;
        LngFile file;
        if (ReadLng(entry.path(), file, strings)) files.push_back(std::move(file));
    }
    return files;
}

// {...} replacement fields of a std::format pattern.
struct Fields {
    std::size_t automatic = 0;          // "{}" / "{:spec}"
    std::vector<std::size_t> indexed;   // "{n}" / "{n:spec}"
    std::vector<std::wstring> specs;    // ":spec" parts
    bool valid = true;
};

Fields ParseFields(std::wstring_view s) {
    Fields f;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == L'{') {
            if (i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == L'{') { ++i; continue; }  // "{{" escape
            const std::size_t close = s.find(L'}', i);
            if (close == std::wstring_view::npos) { f.valid = false; break; }
            const std::wstring_view inside = s.substr(i + 1, close - i - 1);
            const std::size_t colon = inside.find(L':');
            const std::wstring_view id = inside.substr(0, colon);
            if (colon != std::wstring_view::npos) f.specs.emplace_back(inside.substr(colon));
            if (id.empty()) {
                ++f.automatic;
            } else if (std::ranges::all_of(id, [](wchar_t c) { return c >= L'0' && c <= L'9'; })) {
                f.indexed.push_back(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::wcstoul(std::wstring(id).c_str(), nullptr, 10)));
            } else {
                f.valid = false;
            }
            i = close;
        } else if (s[i] == L'}') {
            if (i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == L'}') { ++i; continue; }  // "}}" escape
            f.valid = false;
        }
    }
    if (f.automatic && !f.indexed.empty()) f.valid = false;  // std::format forbids mixing the two
    return f;
}

// A translation may leave values out (word order, case forms), but may not reference values the
// English pattern does not pass, use another format spec or be malformed.
bool CompatibleFields(std::wstring_view english, std::wstring_view translation) {
    const Fields en = ParseFields(english), tr = ParseFields(translation);
    if (!tr.valid) return false;
    std::size_t args = en.automatic;
    for (std::size_t i : en.indexed) args = std::max(args, i + 1);
    // Numbered patterns always receive a name twice, {0} in lower case and {1} capitalised; English
    // may use only one of them ("the {0}"), a translation the other ("{1}: ...").
    if (!en.indexed.empty()) args = std::max<std::size_t>(args, 2);
    if (tr.automatic > args) return false;
    if (std::ranges::any_of(tr.indexed, [&](std::size_t i) { return i >= args; })) return false;
    return std::ranges::all_of(tr.specs, [&](const std::wstring& s) { return std::ranges::contains(en.specs, s); });
}

}  // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Choosing the language
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
std::wstring Detect() {
    ULONG count = 0, size = 0;
    if (!GetUserPreferredUILanguages(MUI_LANGUAGE_NAME, &count, nullptr, &size) || !size) return L"en";
    std::wstring buffer(size, L'\0');
    if (!GetUserPreferredUILanguages(MUI_LANGUAGE_NAME, &count, buffer.data(), &size)) return L"en";

    const std::vector<LngFile> files = ScanFiles(false);
    auto declared = [&](const std::wstring& tag) -> const LngFile* {
        for (const auto& f : files)
            if (std::ranges::contains(f.language.locales, tag)) return &f;
        return nullptr;
    };
    auto named = [&](const std::wstring& stem) -> const LngFile* {
        for (const auto& f : files)
            if (f.language.code == stem) return &f;
        return nullptr;
    };
    auto localeName = [](const wchar_t* tag, LCTYPE type) {
        wchar_t value[16]{};
        return GetLocaleInfoEx(tag, type, value, static_cast<int>(std::size(value))) ? Lower(value) : std::wstring();
    };

    // The user's display languages in their order (Settings > Time & language > Language).
    for (const wchar_t* p = buffer.c_str(); *p; p += wcslen(p) + 1) {
        const std::wstring tag = Lower(p);                           // "pt-br"
        const std::wstring primary = tag.substr(0, tag.find(L'-'));  // "pt"
        if (primary == L"en") return L"en";
        const LngFile* match = declared(tag);
        if (!match) match = named(tag);
        if (!match) match = declared(primary);
        if (!match) match = named(primary);
        if (!match) match = named(localeName(p, LOCALE_SISO639LANGNAME2));  // "por", "pol", "deu"
        if (!match) match = named(localeName(p, LOCALE_SABBREVLANGNAME));   // "ptb", "plk", "deu"
        if (match) return match->language.code;
    }
    return L"en";
}

bool Automatic() {
    std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
    return S().automatic;
}

bool Use(std::wstring_view requested, bool save) {
    std::wstring code = Lower(requested);
    const bool automatic = code.empty() || code == L"auto";
    if (automatic) code = Detect();
    LngFile file;
    bool ok = true;
    if (code != L"en") {
        // Only a plain file name, never a path (no "..\" tricks).
        ok = ValidCode(code) && ReadLng(LanguageDirectory() / (code + L".lng"), file, true);
        if (!ok) code = L"en";
    }
    {
        std::unique_lock guard(S().lock);
        S().code = code;
        S().automatic = automatic;
        S().strings = std::move(file.strings);
    }
    if (save && ok) Settings::Write(L"Language", automatic ? std::wstring(L"auto") : code);
    return ok;
}

void UseSaved() {
    // A saved language that has gone (its .lng file was removed) falls back to the Windows language.
    if (!Use(Settings::Read(L"Language", L"auto"))) Use(L"auto");
}

std::wstring Current() {
    std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
    return S().code;
}

std::vector<Language> Available() {
    const auto& ids = EnglishIds();
    std::vector<Language> list;
    for (auto& f : ScanFiles(true)) {
        f.language.total = ids.size();
        f.language.translated = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::ranges::count_if(ids, [&](UINT id) {
            const auto it = f.strings.find(id);
            return it != f.strings.end() && !it->second.empty();
        }));
        list.push_back(std::move(f.language));
    }
    std::ranges::sort(list, [](const Language& a, const Language& b) {
        return CompareStringEx(LOCALE_NAME_INVARIANT, LINGUISTIC_IGNORECASE, a.name.c_str(), -1, b.name.c_str(), -1, nullptr, nullptr, 0) ==
               CSTR_LESS_THAN;
    });
    Language english{L"en", L"English", {L"en"}, ids.size(), ids.size()};
    list.insert(list.begin(), std::move(english));
    return list;
}

LANGID SystemLanguage() {
    std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
    if (S().code == L"en") return kEnglish;
    const LCID lcid = LocaleNameToLCID(S().code.c_str(), 0);  // "pl" -> Polish, "pt-br" -> Portuguese (Brazil)
    return lcid ? LANGIDFROMLCID(lcid) : 0;                  // 0 = the user's default
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Strings
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
std::wstring English(UINT id) {
    std::wstring text = LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish);
    return text.empty() ? std::format(L"#{}", id) : text;
}

std::wstring Get(UINT id) {
    {
        std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
        if (auto it = S().strings.find(id); it != S().strings.end() && !it->second.empty()) return it->second;
    }
    return English(id);
}

namespace detail {
std::wstring VFormat(UINT id, std::wformat_args args) {
    const std::wstring pattern = Get(id);
    try {
        return std::vformat(pattern, args);
    } catch (const std::format_error&) {
        try {
            return std::vformat(English(id), args);  // the translation has a broken placeholder
        } catch (const std::format_error&) {
            return pattern;
        }
    }
}
}  // namespace detail

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tools for translators
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool ExportTemplate(const std::wstring& path) {
    std::ofstream out(fs::path(path), std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    if (!out) return false;
    out << Narrow(L"# WSA-Next language file. Translate the text after '=', keep the numbers and the {...} fields:\n"
                  L"# they may move or be left out, never add new ones. In numbered patterns {0} is a name in lower case\n"
                  L"# and {1} the same name capitalised (\"image\" / \"Image\") - use the one your grammar needs.\n"
                  L"# UTF-8. Escapes: \\n \\r \\t \\\\\n"
                  L"# Save as language\\<code>.lng next to WSA-Next.exe, e.g. language\\de.lng, and check it with\n"
                  L"#   WSA-Next.exe lng-check language\\de.lng\n"
                  L"# #name   = the language's own name for the menu, e.g. Deutsch\n"
                  L"# #locale = the Windows display languages this file is for, e.g. de or pt-BR,pt\n"
                  L"#name=English\n#locale=en\n\n");
    for (UINT id : EnglishIds()) out << Narrow(std::format(L"{}={}\n", id, Escape(LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish))));
    return static_cast<bool>(out);
}

std::vector<Report> Check(const std::wstring& path) {
    std::vector<LngFile> files;
    if (path.empty()) {
        files = ScanFiles(true);
    } else if (LngFile f; ReadLng(fs::path(path), f, true)) {
        files.push_back(std::move(f));
    }
    const auto& ids = EnglishIds();
    const std::unordered_set<UINT> known(ids.begin(), ids.end());
    std::vector<Report> reports;
    for (auto& f : files) {
        Report r;
        r.file = f.path.wstring();
        for (UINT id : ids) {
            const auto it = f.strings.find(id);
            if (it == f.strings.end() || it->second.empty()) r.missing.push_back(id);
            else if (!CompatibleFields(LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish), it->second)) r.placeholders.push_back(id);
        }
        for (const auto& [id, text] : f.strings)
            if (!known.contains(id)) r.unknown.push_back(id);
        std::ranges::sort(r.unknown);
        r.language = std::move(f.language);
        r.language.total = ids.size();
        r.language.translated = ids.size() - r.missing.size();
        reports.push_back(std::move(r));
    }
    return reports;
}

}  // namespace WN::Text
```

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// User-visible text. English is built in (STRINGTABLE, src/resources/lang/en.rc) and always works;
// every other language is a separate file next to the executable (like IrfanView's language files),
// in the format of the SFTP plugin:
//
//   language\<file>.lng    UTF-8, one "ID=text" per line, '#' comments, escapes \n \r \t \\
//     #name=Polski         the name shown in the menu (in that language)
//     #locale=pl           Windows languages the file covers, comma separated (pl, pt-BR, sr-Latn ...)
//
// Automatic choice: the user's preferred Windows display languages, in their order; for each one a
// file that declares it in #locale, else one named after it (pt-br.lng, pt.lng, por.lng - ISO 639-2 -
// or ptb.lng - the Windows abbreviation). Nothing matches: English. The user can also pick a language
// by hand. A missing or broken string falls back to English one by one, so a partial file still works.
//
// The command line is always English (scripts parse it). `lng-export` writes the English template,
// `lng-check` reports coverage and broken placeholders of the language files.
#pragma once
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstddef>
#include <format>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Text {

struct Language {
    std::wstring code;                  // "en" or the file name without .lng ("pl", "pt-br", "deu" ...)
    std::wstring name;                  // "English", "Polski" ...
    std::vector<std::wstring> locales;  // declared by #locale (lower case)
    std::size_t translated = 0;         // strings of the English table present in the file
    std::size_t total = 0;              // strings in the English table
    [[nodiscard]] int Coverage() const { return total ? static_cast<int>(translated * 100 / total) : 100; }
};

// GUI: the saved choice (setting "Language"); "auto" or nothing saved = the Windows language.
void UseSaved();
// Switches to `code` ("en", a file code such as "pl", or "auto") and optionally remembers it.
// False (and English) when the language is not available.
bool Use(std::wstring_view code, bool save = false);
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Detect();   // the automatic choice, see above
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Current();  // effective code
[[nodiscard]] bool Automatic();        // following the Windows language
[[nodiscard]] std::vector<Language> Available();  // English first, then the files sorted by name
// Language for system error messages (FormatMessage); English when the UI runs in English.
[[nodiscard]] LANGID SystemLanguage();

[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Get(UINT id);
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring English(UINT id);

// Writes every English string as "ID=text" (the starting point of a new .lng file).
bool ExportTemplate(const std::wstring& path);

// Translation report of one .lng file against the English table.
struct Report {
    Language language;
    std::wstring file;
    std::vector<UINT> missing;       // in English, not in the file
    std::vector<UINT> unknown;       // in the file, not in English (old or mistyped ids)
    std::vector<UINT> placeholders;  // {...} fields differ from English - would fall back to English
};
[[nodiscard]] std::vector<Report> Check(const std::wstring& file = {});  // one file, or every file in language\

namespace detail {
std::wstring VFormat(UINT id, std::wformat_args args);
}

// std::format with a translated pattern. A translation with a broken pattern falls back to English.
template <class... Args>
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Format(UINT id, const Args&... args) {
    return detail::VFormat(id, std::make_wformat_args(args...));
}

}  // namespace WN::Text
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "support/Wmi.h"
#include <cwchar>

#pragma comment(lib, "wbemuuid.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "oleaut32.lib")

namespace WN::Wmi {
namespace {

void Blanket(IUnknown* proxy) {
    CoSetProxyBlanket(proxy, RPC_C_AUTHN_WINNT, RPC_C_AUTHZ_NONE, nullptr, RPC_C_AUTHN_LEVEL_CALL, RPC_C_IMP_LEVEL_IMPERSONATE,
                      nullptr, EOAC_NONE);
}

std::wstring Hr(std::wstring_view what, HRESULT hr) { return ErrorText(what, static_cast<unsigned long>(hr)); }

template <class F>
void ForEachElement(SAFEARRAY* array, F&& f) {
    if (!array) return;
    LONG lower = 0, upper = -1;
    SafeArrayGetLBound(array, 1, &lower);
    SafeArrayGetUBound(array, 1, &upper);
    for (LONG i = lower; i <= upper; ++i) f(i);
}

}  // namespace

std::optional<std::uint32_t> GetU32(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name) {
    Variant var;
    if (!obj || FAILED(obj->Get(name, 0, &var.v, nullptr, nullptr))) return std::nullopt;
    switch (var.v.vt) {
    case VT_I4: return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(var.v.lVal);
    case VT_UI4: return var.v.ulVal;
    case VT_I2: return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(var.v.iVal));
    case VT_UI2: return var.v.uiVal;
    case VT_UI1: return var.v.bVal;
    default: return std::nullopt;
    }
}

std::optional<std::uint64_t> GetU64(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name) {
    Variant var;
    if (!obj || FAILED(obj->Get(name, 0, &var.v, nullptr, nullptr))) return std::nullopt;
    if (var.v.vt == VT_BSTR && var.v.bstrVal) {
        wchar_t* end = nullptr;
        const unsigned long long value = std::wcstoull(var.v.bstrVal, &end, 10);
        if (end == var.v.bstrVal) return std::nullopt;
        return value;
    }
    if (var.v.vt == VT_UI8) return var.v.ullVal;
    if (var.v.vt == VT_I8) return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(var.v.llVal);
    if (const auto narrow = GetU32(obj, name)) return *narrow;
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::optional<bool> GetBool(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name) {
    Variant var;
    if (!obj || FAILED(obj->Get(name, 0, &var.v, nullptr, nullptr)) || var.v.vt != VT_BOOL) return std::nullopt;
    return var.v.boolVal != VARIANT_FALSE;
}

std::wstring GetString(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name) {
    Variant var;
    if (!obj || FAILED(obj->Get(name, 0, &var.v, nullptr, nullptr)) || var.v.vt != VT_BSTR || !var.v.bstrVal) return {};
    return std::wstring(var.v.bstrVal, SysStringLen(var.v.bstrVal));
}

std::vector<std::wstring> GetStrings(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name) {
    std::vector<std::wstring> out;
    Variant var;
    if (!obj || FAILED(obj->Get(name, 0, &var.v, nullptr, nullptr)) || var.v.vt != (VT_ARRAY | VT_BSTR)) return out;
    ForEachElement(var.v.parray, [&](LONG i) {
        BSTR element = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(SafeArrayGetElement(var.v.parray, &i, &element)) && element) {
            out.emplace_back(element, SysStringLen(element));
            SysFreeString(element);
        }
    });
    return out;
}

Object GetEmbedded(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name) {
    Variant var;
    if (!obj || FAILED(obj->Get(name, 0, &var.v, nullptr, nullptr)) || var.v.vt != VT_UNKNOWN || !var.v.punkVal) return {};
    Object result;
    var.v.punkVal->QueryInterface(IID_IWbemClassObject, reinterpret_cast<void**>(result.put()));
    return result;
}

std::vector<Object> GetEmbeddedArray(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name) {
    std::vector<Object> out;
    Variant var;
    if (!obj || FAILED(obj->Get(name, 0, &var.v, nullptr, nullptr)) || var.v.vt != (VT_ARRAY | VT_UNKNOWN)) return out;
    ForEachElement(var.v.parray, [&](LONG i) {
        IUnknown* element = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(SafeArrayGetElement(var.v.parray, &i, &element)) && element) {
            Object item;
            if (SUCCEEDED(element->QueryInterface(IID_IWbemClassObject, reinterpret_cast<void**>(item.put())))) out.push_back(std::move(item));
            element->Release();
        }
    });
    return out;
}

HRESULT PutU32(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name, std::uint32_t value) {
    VARIANT v;
    VariantInit(&v);
    v.vt = VT_I4;
    v.lVal = static_cast<LONG>(value);
    return obj->Put(name, 0, &v, 0);
}

HRESULT PutU64(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name, std::uint64_t value) {
    return PutString(obj, name, std::to_wstring(value));  // CIM uint64 travels as a decimal string
}

HRESULT PutBool(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name, bool value) {
    VARIANT v;
    VariantInit(&v);
    v.vt = VT_BOOL;
    v.boolVal = value ? VARIANT_TRUE : VARIANT_FALSE;
    return obj->Put(name, 0, &v, 0);
}

HRESULT PutString(IWbemClassObject* obj, const wchar_t* name, std::wstring_view value) {
    VARIANT v;
    VariantInit(&v);
    v.vt = VT_BSTR;
    v.bstrVal = SysAllocStringLen(value.data(), static_cast<UINT>(value.size()));
    const HRESULT hr = obj->Put(name, 0, &v, 0);
    VariantClear(&v);
    return hr;
}

std::uint32_t ReturnValue(IWbemClassObject* out) { return GetU32(out, L"ReturnValue").value_or(0); }

std::wstring Quote(std::wstring_view text) {
    std::wstring out;
    out.reserve(text.size() + 8);
    for (const wchar_t c : text) {
        if (c == L'\\' || c == L'"' || c == L'\'') out += L'\\';
        out += c;
    }
    return out;
}

Result<Service> Service::Connect(const wchar_t* ns) {
    Ptr<IWbemLocator> locator;
    HRESULT hr = CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WbemLocator, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_IWbemLocator, reinterpret_cast<void**>(locator.put()));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return Fail(Hr(L"CoCreateInstance(WbemLocator)", hr));
    Service service;
    hr = locator->ConnectServer(Bstr(ns), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr, service.m_svc.put());
    if (FAILED(hr)) return Fail(Hr(std::wstring(L"WMI ") + ns, hr));
    Blanket(service.m_svc.get());
    return service;
}

Result<std::vector<Object>> Service::Query(std::wstring_view wql) const {
    Ptr<IEnumWbemClassObject> items;
    const HRESULT hr = m_svc->ExecQuery(Bstr(L"WQL"), Bstr(wql), WBEM_FLAG_FORWARD_ONLY | WBEM_FLAG_RETURN_IMMEDIATELY, nullptr, items.put());
    if (FAILED(hr)) return Fail(Hr(wql, hr));
    Blanket(items.get());
    std::vector<Object> out;
    for (;;) {
        Object object;
        ULONG returned = 0;
        if (items->Next(WBEM_INFINITE, 1, object.put(), &returned) != S_OK || returned == 0) break;
        out.push_back(std::move(object));
    }
    return out;
}

Result<Object> Service::InParams(const wchar_t* className, const wchar_t* method) const {
    Object cls;
    HRESULT hr = m_svc->GetObject(Bstr(className), 0, nullptr, cls.put(), nullptr);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return Fail(Hr(className, hr));
    Object definition;
    hr = cls->GetMethod(method, 0, definition.put(), nullptr);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return Fail(Hr(std::wstring(className) + L"." + method, hr));
    Object in;
    if (definition && FAILED(hr = definition->SpawnInstance(0, in.put()))) return Fail(Hr(method, hr));
    return in;
}

Result<Object> Service::Call(std::wstring_view objectPath, const wchar_t* method, IWbemClassObject* in) const {
    Object out;
    const HRESULT hr = m_svc->ExecMethod(Bstr(objectPath), Bstr(method), 0, nullptr, in, out.put(), nullptr);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return Fail(Hr(method, hr));
    return out;
}

}  // namespace WN::Wmi
```

`src/support/Wmi.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// Minimal WMI client over COM (no comdef.h / comsupp): connect to a namespace, query, call methods.
// Used for BitLocker (root\CIMV2\Security\MicrosoftVolumeEncryption), the Windows Storage
// Management API (root\Microsoft\Windows\Storage) and the BCD store (root\WMI).
#pragma once
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <wbemidl.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Wmi {

// Owning COM interface pointer (move-only).
template <class T>
class Ptr {
public:
    Ptr() = default;
    Ptr(const Ptr&) = delete;
    Ptr& operator=(const Ptr&) = delete;
    Ptr(Ptr&& other) noexcept : m_p(std::exchange(other.m_p, nullptr)) {}
    Ptr& operator=(Ptr&& other) noexcept {
        if (this != &other) {
            reset();
            m_p = std::exchange(other.m_p, nullptr);
        }
        return *this;
    }
    ~Ptr() { reset(); }

    // Takes over a reference the caller already owns.
    static Ptr Attach(T* p) {
        Ptr result;
        result.m_p = p;
        return result;
    }
    T** put() {
        reset();
        return &m_p;
    }
    T* get() const { return m_p; }
    T* operator->() const { return m_p; }
    explicit operator bool() const { return m_p != nullptr; }
    void reset() {
        if (m_p) {
            m_p->Release();
            m_p = nullptr;
        }
    }

private:
    T* m_p = nullptr;
};

class Bstr {
public:
    explicit Bstr(std::wstring_view text) : m_s(SysAllocStringLen(text.data(), static_cast<UINT>(text.size()))) {}
    Bstr(const Bstr&) = delete;
    Bstr& operator=(const Bstr&) = delete;
    ~Bstr() { SysFreeString(m_s); }
    operator BSTR() const { return m_s; }

private:
    BSTR m_s;
};

struct Variant {
    VARIANT v;
    Variant() { VariantInit(&v); }
    Variant(const Variant&) = delete;
    Variant& operator=(const Variant&) = delete;
    ~Variant() { VariantClear(&v); }
};

    ComScope(const ComScope&) = delete;
    ComScope& operator=(const ComScope&) = delete;
    ~ComScope() {
        if (m_uninit) CoUninitialize();
    }

};
```

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include "telephony/AtModem.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <charconv>
#include <climits>
#include <format>

namespace WN::Tel {
namespace {

constexpr std::string_view kNotSupported = "+CME ERROR: 4";  // operation not supported
constexpr std::string_view kNoSim = "+CME ERROR: 10";        // SIM not inserted
// The serving cell is not known through the mobile broadband API: fixed identifiers (hex).
constexpr std::string_view kAreaCode = "0001";
constexpr std::string_view kCellId = "00000001";

bool StartsWith(std::string_view text, std::string_view prefix) {
    if (text.size() < prefix.size()) return false;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < prefix.size(); ++i)
        if (std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i])) != std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(prefix[i]))) return false;
    return true;
}

// The comma separated integers after '=' ("+CRSM=176,12258,0,0,10" -> 176 12258 0 0 10).
std::vector<int> Numbers(std::string_view command) {
    std::vector<int> values;
    const std::size_t equals = command.find('=');
    if (equals == std::string_view::npos) return values;
    std::string_view rest = command.substr(equals + 1);
    while (!rest.empty()) {
        const std::size_t comma = rest.find(',');
        const std::string_view field = rest.substr(0, comma);
        int value = 0;
        std::from_chars(field.data(), field.data() + field.size(), value);
        values.push_back(value);
        if (comma == std::string_view::npos) break;
        rest.remove_prefix(comma + 1);
    }
    return values;
}

bool Registered(const ModemState& s) { return s.registration == 1 || s.registration == 5; }

// The length of the MNC in the operator's MCC + MNC (Poland's 260 06: two digits).
unsigned MncLength(const ModemState& s) { return s.operatorId.size() == 6 ? 3 : 2; }

}  // namespace

const SimCard& AtModem::Sim(const ModemState& s) {
    if (!m_sim) m_sim.emplace(s.iccid, MncLength(s));
    return *m_sim;
}

std::string AtModem::Registration(std::string_view prefix, int mode, const ModemState& s) const {
    std::string line = std::format("{} {},{}", prefix, mode, s.registration);
    if (mode == 2 && Registered(s)) line += std::format(",\"{}\",\"{}\",{}", kAreaCode, kCellId, s.accessTechnology);
    return line;
}

// Cuttlefish's AT+CSQ: 22 values for every radio technology (TS 27.007 8.5 has only the first
// two). The modem reports one RSSI; it goes to GSM, LTE and WCDMA, LTE also gets an RSRP derived
// from it (a 20 MHz carrier: RSRP ~ RSSI - 27 dB), everything else is "unknown".
std::string AtModem::SignalStrength(const ModemState& s) {
    const int rssi = s.rssi;
    int rsrp = INT_MAX;
    if (rssi >= 0 && rssi <= 31) rsrp = std::clamp(113 - 2 * rssi + 27, 44, 140);  // dBm * -1
    return std::format("+CSQ: {},99,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},99,{},{},{},{},{},{}", rssi, rssi, rsrp, INT_MAX, INT_MAX, INT_MAX,
                       INT_MAX, INT_MAX, rssi, INT_MAX, INT_MAX, INT_MAX, INT_MAX, INT_MAX, INT_MAX);
}

AtModem::Reply AtModem::Command(std::string_view line) {
    Reply reply;
    if (!StartsWith(line, "AT")) return reply;  // not a command (noise)
    std::string_view rest = line.substr(2);
    if (StartsWith(rest, "D") || (StartsWith(rest, "A") && rest.size() == 1)) {  // ATD...: dial, ATA: answer
        reply.lines.emplace_back(kNotSupported);
        return reply;
    }
    if (StartsWith(rest, "+CMGS=")) {  // the PDU follows the prompt
        const std::vector<int> values = Numbers(rest);
        m_smsLength = values.empty() ? 0 : static_cast<unsigned>(values[0]);
        reply.smsPrompt = true;
        return reply;
    }
    // Commands chained with ';' ("AT+COPS=3,0;+COPS?;+COPS=3,1;+COPS?"): each answers, one final result.
    while (true) {
        const std::size_t semicolon = rest.find(';');
        bool ok = true;
        std::vector<std::string> lines = Single(rest.substr(0, semicolon), ok);
        if (!ok) {
            reply.lines.push_back(lines.empty() ? std::string(kNotSupported) : lines.back());
            return reply;
        }
        reply.lines.insert(reply.lines.end(), lines.begin(), lines.end());
        if (semicolon == std::string_view::npos) break;
        rest.remove_prefix(semicolon + 1);
    }
    reply.lines.emplace_back("OK");
    return reply;
}

// One command without "AT" ("+CREG?", "E0Q0V1"). `ok` false: the last line is the error.
std::vector<std::string> AtModem::Single(std::string_view c, bool& ok) {
    auto fail = [&ok](std::string_view error) {
        ok = false;
        return std::vector<std::string>{std::string(error)};
    };

    // Settings this modem accepts and keeps no state for.
    for (std::string_view accepted : {"E", "S0=", "H", "+CMEE=", "+CCWA=", "+CMOD=", "+CMUT=", "+CSSN=", "+COLP=", "+CSCS=", "+CUSD=",
                                      "+CGEREP=", "+CMGF=0", "+CNMI=", "+CSMS=", "+CSCB=", "%CPI=", "%CSTAT=", "%CTZV=", "%CPHS=",
                                      "+CLIR=", "+CGQREQ=", "+CGQMIN=", "+WSOS=", "+CSCA=", "+CREG=", "+CGREG=", "+CEREG="}) {
        if (!StartsWith(c, accepted)) continue;
        if (StartsWith(c, "+CREG=")) m_cregMode = Numbers(c).empty() ? 0 : Numbers(c)[0];
        if (StartsWith(c, "+CGREG=")) m_cgregMode = Numbers(c).empty() ? 0 : Numbers(c)[0];
        if (StartsWith(c, "+CEREG=")) m_ceregMode = Numbers(c).empty() ? 0 : Numbers(c)[0];
        return {};
    }
    if (c.empty()) return {};  // plain "AT"

    if (StartsWith(c, "+CFUN?")) return {std::format("+CFUN: {}", m_radio)};
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CFUN=")) {
        const std::vector<int> v = Numbers(c);
        m_radio = !v.empty() && v[0] != 0 ? 1 : 0;
        return {};
    }

    const ModemState s = m_modem.State();  // the commands below answer from the modem
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CPIN?")) return s.simReady ? std::vector<std::string>{"+CPIN: READY"} : fail(kNoSim);
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CIMI")) return s.simReady ? std::vector<std::string>{s.imsi} : fail(kNoSim);
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CICCID")) return s.simReady ? std::vector<std::string>{s.iccid} : fail(kNoSim);
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CGSN")) return {s.imei};
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CRSM=")) {
        if (!s.simReady) return fail(kNoSim);
        const std::vector<int> v = Numbers(c);
        if (v.size() < 5) return fail(kNotSupported);
        return {Sim(s).Command(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4])};
    }
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CLCK=\"SC\",2") || StartsWith(c, "+CLCK=\"FD\",2")) return {"+CLCK: 0"};  // no PIN lock, no FDN

    if (StartsWith(c, "+COPS?")) {
        if (!Registered(s) || m_radio == 0) return {"+COPS: 0"};
        const std::string& value = m_copsFormat == 2 ? s.operatorId : s.operatorName;
        return {std::format("+COPS: 0,{},\"{}\",{}", m_copsFormat, value, s.accessTechnology)};
    }
    if (StartsWith(c, "+COPS=?")) {
        if (!Registered(s)) return {"+COPS: "};
        return {std::format("+COPS: (2,\"{}\",\"{}\",\"{}\",{})", s.operatorName, s.operatorName, s.operatorId, s.accessTechnology)};
    }
    if (StartsWith(c, "+COPS=")) {
        const std::vector<int> v = Numbers(c);
        if (!v.empty() && v[0] == 3 && v.size() > 1) m_copsFormat = v[1];  // the format of +COPS?
        else if (!v.empty() && v[0] == 1) return fail(kNotSupported);  // manual selection: the PC's modem chooses
        return {};
    }
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CREG?")) return {Registration("+CREG:", m_cregMode, s)};
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CGREG?")) return {Registration("+CGREG:", m_cgregMode, s)};
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CEREG?")) return {Registration("+CEREG:", m_ceregMode, s)};
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CSQ")) return {SignalStrength(s)};
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CSCA?")) {
        if (s.smsc.empty()) return fail("+CMS ERROR: 330");  // SMSC address unknown
        return {std::format("+CSCA: \"{}\",{}", s.smsc, s.smsc.starts_with('+') ? 145 : 129)};
    }
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CNMA")) {
        const std::vector<int> v = Numbers(c);
        if (!m_unacknowledged.empty()) {
            const unsigned index = m_unacknowledged.front();
            m_unacknowledged.pop_front();
            if (v.empty() || v[0] != 2) m_modem.Delete(index);  // Android has it
            else m_modem.Release(index);                         // refused (e.g. Android's storage is full): kept for later
        }
        return {};
    }
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CMUT?")) return {"+CMUT: 0"};
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CLCC") || StartsWith(c, "+CGACT?") || StartsWith(c, "+CGDCONT?") || StartsWith(c, "+CNUM")) return {};  // none
    if (StartsWith(c, "+CUSATD?")) return {"+CUSATD: 0,0"};

    // Calls, packet data, CDMA, the card's channels and anything else: not this modem.
    Bt::Log("modem: unsupported AT{}", std::string(c.substr(0, 40)));
    return fail(kNotSupported);
}

AtModem::Reply AtModem::SmsPdu(std::string_view pdu) {
    Reply reply;
    // The RIL writes the service centre part ("00": the default one) and the TPDU, as AT+CMGS
    // takes them; the mobile broadband API takes the same, with the TPDU's length.
    std::string hex(pdu);
    std::erase_if(hex, [](char ch) { return std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)) != 0; });
    if (!hex.empty() && m_modem.Send(hex, m_smsLength)) {
        reply.lines.push_back(std::format("+CMGS: {}", m_messageReference));
        m_messageReference = (m_messageReference + 1) % 256;
        reply.lines.emplace_back("OK");
    } else {
        reply.lines.emplace_back("+CMS ERROR: 500");  // unknown error
    }
    return reply;
}

std::vector<std::string> AtModem::NewMessage(const std::string& pduHex, unsigned index) {
    // 27.005 +CMT: ,<length> with the TPDU's length (the PDU minus the service centre part).
    unsigned smscOctets = 0;
    if (pduHex.size() >= 2) std::from_chars(pduHex.data(), pduHex.data() + 2, smscOctets, 16);
    const std::size_t octets = pduHex.size() / 2;
    if (octets <= smscOctets + 1) {
        m_modem.Release(index);  // not a PDU Android could take
        return {};
    }
    m_unacknowledged.push_back(index);
    return {std::format("+CMT: ,{}", octets - smscOctets - 1), pduHex};
}

std::vector<std::string> AtModem::Changes() {
    std::vector<std::string> lines;
    const ModemState s = m_modem.State();
    if (s.registration != m_lastRegistration || s.accessTechnology != m_lastTechnology) {
        m_lastRegistration = s.registration;
        m_lastTechnology = s.accessTechnology;
        // The unsolicited form has no <n>: "+CREG: <stat>[,<lac>,<ci>,<AcT>]".
        auto unsolicited = [&](std::string_view prefix, int mode) {
            if (mode == 0) return;
            std::string line = std::format("{} {}", prefix, s.registration);
            if (mode == 2 && Registered(s)) line += std::format(",\"{}\",\"{}\",{}", kAreaCode, kCellId, s.accessTechnology);
            lines.push_back(std::move(line));
        };
        unsolicited("+CREG:", m_cregMode);
        unsolicited("+CGREG:", m_cgregMode);
    }
    if (s.rssi != m_lastRssi) {
        m_lastRssi = s.rssi;
        lines.push_back(SignalStrength(s));
    }
    return lines;
}

}  // namespace WN::Tel
```

`src/telephony/AtModem.h`:

```h
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
// The AT side of the bridge: answers the commands of Cuttlefish's reference RIL (27.007 / 27.005,
// SMS in PDU mode) from the PC's modem. Formats follow Cuttlefish's modem simulator, which that
// RIL is written against. No calls and no packet data: dialing and data contexts answer
// "operation not supported", so Android keeps both off.
#pragma once
#include "telephony/Modem.h"
#include "telephony/SimCard.h"
#include <deque>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace WN::Tel {

class AtModem {
public:
    explicit AtModem(Modem& modem) : m_modem(modem) {}

    struct Reply {
        std::vector<std::string> lines;  // each sent as "\r\n<line>\r\n"
        bool smsPrompt = false;          // then "> ": the next input is a PDU ended by Ctrl-Z
    };
    // One command line from the RIL (without its terminator).
    Reply Command(std::string_view line);
    // The PDU (hex) the RIL wrote after AT+CMGS's prompt: sends it. Blocks until the modem
    // answers; safe to call without the lock that guards Command and Changes.
    Reply SmsPdu(std::string_view pdu);

    // An incoming SMS-DELIVER PDU (hex, with the service centre): the +CMT lines. `index` is
    // deleted from the modem's store once the RIL acknowledges the message (AT+CNMA=1).
    std::vector<std::string> NewMessage(const std::string& pduHex, unsigned index);
    // Unsolicited lines for changes of registration or signal since the last ones sent.
    std::vector<std::string> Changes();

private:
    std::vector<std::string> Single(std::string_view command, bool& ok);
    std::string Registration(std::string_view prefix, int mode, const ModemState& s) const;
    static std::string SignalStrength(const ModemState& s);
    const SimCard& Sim(const ModemState& s);

    Modem& m_modem;
    int m_cregMode = 0, m_cgregMode = 0, m_ceregMode = 0;  // 27.007 <n> of +CREG / +CGREG / +CEREG
    int m_copsFormat = 0;                                  // +COPS=3,<format>: 0 long, 1 short, 2 numeric
    int m_radio = 1;                                       // +CFUN
    unsigned m_smsLength = 0;                              // TPDU octets announced by +CMGS
    unsigned m_messageReference = 0;
    std::optional<SimCard> m_sim;
    std::deque<unsigned> m_unacknowledged;  // store indexes of messages given to the RIL
    // What the RIL last heard unsolicited (registration, technology, signal).
    int m_lastRegistration = -1, m_lastTechnology = -1, m_lastRssi = -1;
};

}  // namespace WN::Tel
```

`src/telephony/MmsRelay.cpp`:

```cpp
// WSA-Next © 2026 Marek Wesołowski - wesmar
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include <iphlpapi.h>
#include <netioapi.h>
#include <windns.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Foundation.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Networking.Connectivity.h>
#include "telephony/MmsRelay.h"
#include "bluetooth/Log.h"
#include "host/Guest.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "telephony/Protocol.h"
#include <charconv>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "dnsapi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "iphlpapi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "windowsapp.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")

namespace WN::Tel {
namespace {
using namespace winrt::Windows::Networking::Connectivity;

constexpr std::size_t kMaxRequest = 2048;
// A guard: Windows gives the APN's new interface its address within seconds.
constexpr DWORD kAddressWaitMs = 15'000;

// "MMS\t<apn>\t<auth type>\t<user>\t<password>\t<host>\t<port>" (WsaMmsRelay.java). The auth type
// is Android's (ApnSetting.AUTH_TYPE_*: -1 unset, 0 none, 1 PAP, 2 CHAP, 3 PAP or CHAP).
struct Request {
    std::string apn;
    int authType = -1;
    std::string user, password, host;
    unsigned short port = 0;
};

std::optional<Request> Parse(std::string_view line) {
    std::vector<std::string_view> fields;
    for (std::size_t start = 0;;) {
        const std::size_t tab = line.find('\t', start);
        fields.push_back(line.substr(start, tab == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view::npos : tab - start));
        if (tab == std::string_view::npos) break;
        start = tab + 1;
    }
    if (fields.size() != 7 || fields[0] != "MMS" || fields[1].empty() || fields[5].empty()) return std::nullopt;
    Request r;
    r.apn = fields[1];
    (void)std::from_chars(fields[2].data(), fields[2].data() + fields[2].size(), r.authType);  // unset stays -1
    r.user = fields[3];
    r.password = fields[4];
    r.host = fields[5];
    const std::from_chars_result port = std::from_chars(fields[6].data(), fields[6].data() + fields[6].size(), r.port);
    if (port.ec != std::errc{} || r.port == 0) return std::nullopt;
    return r;
}

bool SendAll(SOCKET socket, const char* data, std::size_t size) {
    for (std::size_t done = 0; done < size;) {
        const int n = ::send(socket, data + done, static_cast<int>(size - done), 0);
        if (n <= 0) return false;
        done += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

bool Reply(SOCKET android, std::string_view line) {
    const std::string text = std::string(line) + "\n";
    return SendAll(android, text.data(), text.size());
}

// The request line. The connection stays idle until Android has an MMS to move; one byte at a
// time, so nothing after the line is taken.
std::optional<std::string> ReadLine(SOCKET android) {
    std::string line;
    while (line.size() < kMaxRequest) {
        char c = 0;
        if (recv(android, &c, 1, 0) <= 0) return std::nullopt;
        if (c == '\n') return line;
        line += c;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

CellularApnAuthenticationType AuthType(const Request& r) {
    switch (r.authType) {
    case 0: return CellularApnAuthenticationType::None;
    case 1: return CellularApnAuthenticationType::Pap;
    case 2:
    case 3: return CellularApnAuthenticationType::Chap;
    default:  // unset: Android tries PAP or CHAP when the APN has a user name
        return r.user.empty() ? CellularApnAuthenticationType::None : CellularApnAuthenticationType::Pap;
    }
}

std::size_t AddressSize(const SOCKADDR_INET& address) {
    return address.si_family == AF_INET ? sizeof(SOCKADDR_IN) : sizeof(SOCKADDR_IN6);
}

// The interface's usable address of `family` (IPv6: not link-local).
std::optional<SOCKADDR_INET> InterfaceAddress(const NET_LUID& luid, ADDRESS_FAMILY family) {
    PMIB_UNICASTIPADDRESS_TABLE table = nullptr;
    if (GetUnicastIpAddressTable(family, &table) != NO_ERROR) return std::nullopt;
    std::optional<SOCKADDR_INET> found;
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < table->NumEntries && !found; ++i) {
        const MIB_UNICASTIPADDRESS_ROW& row = table->Table[i];
        if (row.InterfaceLuid.Value != luid.Value || row.DadState != IpDadStatePreferred) continue;
        if (family == AF_INET6 && IN6_IS_ADDR_LINKLOCAL(&row.Address.Ipv6.sin6_addr)) continue;
        found = row.Address;
    }
    FreeMibTable(table);
    return found;
}

void CALLBACK OnAddressChange(PVOID context, PMIB_UNICASTIPADDRESS_ROW, MIB_NOTIFICATION_TYPE) {
    SetEvent(static_cast<HANDLE>(context));
}

// The new interface's address (IPv4 first); Windows may assign it just after the connection.
std::optional<SOCKADDR_INET> WaitForAddress(const NET_LUID& luid) {
    const KernelHandle changed(CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr));
    HANDLE notification = nullptr;
    if (NotifyUnicastIpAddressChange(AF_UNSPEC, &OnAddressChange, changed.get(), FALSE, &notification) != NO_ERROR) notification = nullptr;
    const ULONGLONG deadline = GetTickCount64() + kAddressWaitMs;
    std::optional<SOCKADDR_INET> address;
    for (;;) {
        address = InterfaceAddress(luid, AF_INET);
        if (!address) address = InterfaceAddress(luid, AF_INET6);
        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
        if (address || !notification || now >= deadline) break;
        WaitForSingleObject(changed.get(), static_cast<DWORD>(deadline - now));
    }
    if (notification) CancelMibChangeNotify2(notification);
    return address;
}

// The APN opened on the modem: a connection of its own, with its own interface.
struct ApnLink {
    ConnectionSession session{nullptr};
    NET_IFINDEX index = 0;
    SOCKADDR_INET address{};

    ApnLink() = default;
    ApnLink(const ApnLink&) = delete;
    ApnLink& operator=(const ApnLink&) = delete;
    ApnLink(ApnLink&&) = default;
    ApnLink& operator=(ApnLink&&) = default;
    ~ApnLink() {
        try {
            if (session) session.Close();  // Windows ends the packet context
        } catch (const winrt::hresult_error&) {
        }
    }
};

std::optional<ApnLink> OpenApn(const Request& r) {
    try {
        CellularApnContext context;
        context.AccessPointName(winrt::to_hstring(r.apn));
        context.UserName(winrt::to_hstring(r.user));
        context.Password(winrt::to_hstring(r.password));
        context.AuthenticationType(AuthType(r));
        ApnLink link;
        link.session = ConnectivityManager::AcquireConnectionAsync(context).get();
        ConnectionProfile profile{nullptr};
        if (link.session) profile = link.session.ConnectionProfile();
        NetworkAdapter adapter{nullptr};
        if (profile) adapter = profile.NetworkAdapter();
        if (!adapter) {
            Bt::Log("mms: Windows opened APN {} but gave no interface", r.apn);
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        const winrt::guid adapterId = adapter.NetworkAdapterId();
        GUID id{};
        std::memcpy(&id, &adapterId, sizeof id);
        NET_LUID luid{};
        if (ConvertInterfaceGuidToLuid(&id, &luid) != NO_ERROR || ConvertInterfaceLuidToIndex(&luid, &link.index) != NO_ERROR) {
            Bt::Log("mms: the interface of APN {} is not known to the network stack", r.apn);
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        const auto address = WaitForAddress(luid);
        if (!address) {
            Bt::Log("mms: APN {} got no address within {} s", r.apn, kAddressWaitMs / 1000);
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        link.address = *address;
        return link;
    } catch (const winrt::hresult_error& e) {
        Bt::Log("mms: Windows did not open APN {} (0x{:08X})", r.apn, static_cast<unsigned>(e.code()));
        return std::nullopt;
    }
}

// The server's addresses in the APN's address family: a literal, or the name looked up through
// the APN's own name servers (an operator's MMS server may have a name only its network knows).
std::vector<SOCKADDR_INET> Resolve(const Request& r, const ApnLink& link) {
    const ADDRESS_FAMILY family = link.address.si_family;
    SOCKADDR_INET target{};
    target.si_family = family;
    if (family == AF_INET) target.Ipv4.sin_port = htons(r.port);
    else target.Ipv6.sin6_port = htons(r.port);
    void* literal = family == AF_INET ? static_cast<void*>(&target.Ipv4.sin_addr) : static_cast<void*>(&target.Ipv6.sin6_addr);
    if (InetPtonA(family, r.host.c_str(), literal) == 1) return {target};

    std::vector<SOCKADDR_INET> found;
    const std::wstring name = FromUtf8(r.host);
    DNS_QUERY_REQUEST request{};
    request.Version = DNS_QUERY_REQUEST_VERSION1;
    request.QueryName = name.c_str();
    request.QueryType = family == AF_INET ? DNS_TYPE_A : DNS_TYPE_AAAA;
    request.QueryOptions = DNS_QUERY_STANDARD;
    request.InterfaceIndex = link.index;
    DNS_QUERY_RESULT result{};
    result.Version = DNS_QUERY_RESULTS_VERSION1;
    if (DnsQueryEx(&request, &result, nullptr) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        for (PDNS_RECORD record = result.pQueryRecords; record; record = record->pNext) {
            if (family == AF_INET && record->wType == DNS_TYPE_A) {
                target.Ipv4.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr = record->Data.A.IpAddress;
                found.push_back(target);
            } else if (family == AF_INET6 && record->wType == DNS_TYPE_AAAA) {
                std::memcpy(&target.Ipv6.sin6_addr, &record->Data.AAAA.Ip6Address, sizeof target.Ipv6.sin6_addr);
                found.push_back(target);
            }
        }
        if (result.pQueryRecords) DnsRecordListFree(result.pQueryRecords, DnsFreeRecordList);
    }
    if (found.empty()) Bt::Log("mms: the name {} is not known through APN {}", r.host, r.apn);
    return found;
}

// A connection out of the APN's interface only: from its address, with the interface pinned.
SOCKET ConnectThrough(const ApnLink& link, const std::vector<SOCKADDR_INET>& targets) {
    for (const SOCKADDR_INET& target : targets) {
        const SOCKET s = socket(target.si_family, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
        if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) continue;
        if (target.si_family == AF_INET) {
            const DWORD index = htonl(link.index);  // IPv4 wants it in network order
            setsockopt(s, IPPROTO_IP, IP_UNICAST_IF, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&index), sizeof index);
        } else {
            const DWORD index = link.index;
            setsockopt(s, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_UNICAST_IF, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&index), sizeof index);
        }
        if (bind(s, reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&link.address), static_cast<int>(AddressSize(link.address))) == 0 &&
            connect(s, reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&target), static_cast<int>(AddressSize(target))) == 0)
            return s;
        closesocket(s);
    }
    return INVALID_SOCKET;
}

// Bytes both ways. The server's end of data goes to Android as a half-close; Android's end ends
// the exchange (MmsService closes the tunnel once it has the answer), which also ends the
// server's direction.
void Pipe(SOCKET android, SOCKET server, std::uint64_t& out, std::uint64_t& in) {
    std::jthread fromServer([&] {
        char buffer[16 * 1024];
        for (;;) {
            const int n = recv(server, buffer, static_cast<int>(sizeof buffer), 0);
            if (n <= 0 || !SendAll(android, buffer, static_cast<std::size_t>(n))) break;
            in += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n);
        }
        shutdown(android, SD_SEND);
    });
    char buffer[16 * 1024];
    for (;;) {
        const int n = recv(android, buffer, static_cast<int>(sizeof buffer), 0);
        if (n <= 0 || !SendAll(server, buffer, static_cast<std::size_t>(n))) break;
        out += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n);
    }
    shutdown(server, SD_BOTH);
    CancelIoEx(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(server), nullptr);  // a receive still waiting returns
}

void RunSession(std::uintptr_t handle) {
    const auto android = static_cast<SOCKET>(handle);
    const auto line = ReadLine(android);
    if (!line) return;  // WSA ends, or the daemon restarted
    const auto request = Parse(*line);
    if (!request) {
        Bt::Log("mms: Android sent a request the host does not understand");
        Reply(android, "ERR\tbad request");
        return;
    }
    const auto link = OpenApn(*request);
    if (!link) {
        Reply(android, "ERR\tAPN " + request->apn + " not opened");
        return;
    }
    const SOCKET server = ConnectThrough(*link, Resolve(*request, *link));
    if (server == INVALID_SOCKET) {
        Bt::Log("mms: {}:{} did not answer through APN {}", request->host, request->port, request->apn);
        Reply(android, "ERR\tserver unreachable");
        return;
    }
    Bt::Log("mms: Android's MMS exchange with {}:{} through APN {}", request->host, request->port, request->apn);
    std::uint64_t out = 0, in = 0;
    if (Reply(android, "OK")) Pipe(android, server, out, in);
    closesocket(server);
    Bt::Log("mms: exchange done ({} bytes out, {} bytes in)", out, in);
}

}  // namespace

void RunMmsRelay(std::stop_token stop) {
    Guest::Serve(kMmsPort, "Android MMS relay", [](std::uintptr_t socket, std::stop_token) { RunSession(socket); }, stop);
}

}  // namespace WN::Tel
```

```h
// MMS for Android through the PC's modem. Android has no cellular network: its MmsService
// (android/patches/packages/services/Mms) hands each HTTP exchange to the wsa-mms daemon
```

```cpp
// The mobile broadband COM API (mbnapi.h) is marked deprecated in favour of WinRT; it stays the
// plain Win32 way to the modem, so the deprecation warning is off for this file.

namespace WN::Tel {
```
